// ============================================================================

import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
import { hashPassword } from "../src/lib/password";
import { computeOrderCommissions } from "../src/lib/commission";
import {
  ensureAccount, ensureWalletAccounts, postOrderPaid, postGatewaySettlement,
  postPayoutInitiated, postPayoutConfirmed, refreshWalletCache, ACCOUNTS,
} from "../src/lib/ledger";
import { defaultHomeSections, defaultPageSections } from "../src/lib/sections";
import { toJson } from "../src/lib/json";

const db = new PrismaClient();

const daysAgo = (n: number, hour = 10) => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - n);
  d.setHours(hour, 12, 0, 0);
  return d;
};
const daysAhead = (n: number) => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + n);
  return d;
};

let orderSeq = 100000;
const nextOrderNumber = () => `SM-${++orderSeq}`;

const img = (seed: string, w = 800, h = 800, label?: string) =>
  `/api/img/${seed}?w=${w}&h=${h}${label ? `&label=${encodeURIComponent(label)}` : ""}`;

async function wipe() {
  const tables = [
    db.ledgerLine, db.ledgerTransaction, db.ledgerAccount,
    db.payout, db.payoutBatch, db.bankAccount, db.wallet,
    db.dispute, db.refund, db.orderStatusHistory, db.orderItem, db.order,
    db.paymentWebhookLog, db.paymentIntent,
    db.couponRedemption, db.cartItem, db.cart,
    db.review, db.collectionProduct, db.collection,
    db.inventoryLog, db.productVariant, db.productImage, db.product, db.category,
    db.featuredSlot, db.marketplaceBanner, db.coupon,
    db.cmsPage, db.storeDomain, db.storeIntegration, db.webhookDelivery, db.webhookEndpoint, db.apiKey,
    db.store, db.sellerNote, db.kycDocument, db.seller,
    db.session, db.adminUser, db.adminAuditLog, db.activityLog,
    db.notificationLog, db.notificationTemplate, db.supportMessage, db.supportTicket,
    db.announcement, db.setting, db.featureFlag, db.commissionOverride, db.feeHoliday,
    db.commissionSetting, db.plan, db.counter, db.exportJob,
  ] as { deleteMany: () => Promise<unknown> }[];
  for (const t of tables) await t.deleteMany();
}

type SeedVariant = { name: string; optionName?: string; optionValue?: string; price: number; compareAt?: number; stock: number; sku?: string };
type SeedProduct = {
  title: string; slug: string; description: string; categorySlug: string;
  status?: string; price: number; compareAt?: number; stock?: number;
  variants?: SeedVariant[]; sales?: number; rating?: [number, number]; featured?: boolean;
  imgSeeds: string[];
};

async function seedProduct(storeId: string, p: SeedProduct, createdAt: Date) {
  const product = await db.product.create({
    data: {
      storeId,
      title: p.title,
      slug: p.slug,
      description: p.description,
      status: p.status ?? "active",
      priceMinor: p.price,
      isFeatured: p.featured ?? false,
      salesCount: p.sales ?? 0,
      ratingAvg: p.rating?.[0] ?? 0,
      ratingCount: p.rating?.[1] ?? 0,
      publishedAt: (p.status ?? "active") === "active" ? createdAt : null,
      createdAt,
      updatedAt: createdAt,
      categoryId: catMap[p.categorySlug] ?? null,
    },
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < p.imgSeeds.length; i++) {
    await db.productImage.create({
      data: { productId: product.id, url: img(p.imgSeeds[i], 900, 900, p.title), sortOrder: i },
    });
  }
  const variants = p.variants ?? [{ name: "Default", price: p.price, stock: p.stock ?? 40 }];
  for (const v of variants) {
    await db.productVariant.create({
      data: {
        productId: product.id,
        name: v.name,
        optionName: v.optionName ?? null,
        optionValue: v.optionValue ?? null,
        priceMinor: v.price,
        compareAtPriceMinor: v.compareAt ?? null,
        stock: v.stock,
        sku: v.sku ?? null,
      },
    });
  }
  return product;
}

const catMap: Record<string, string> = {};

async function seedCategories() {
  const tree: [string, string, string[], number | null][] = [
    ["Electronics", "electronics", ["Audio", "Gadgets"], 6],
    ["Fashion", "fashion", ["Women", "Men"], 10],
    ["Home & Living", "home-living", ["Decor", "Kitchen"], null],
    ["Beauty & Personal Care", "beauty", [], 9],
    ["Sports & Outdoors", "sports-outdoors", ["Camping & Hiking"], null],
    ["Food & Beverage", "food-beverage", ["Snacks", "Coffee & Tea"], 5],
    ["Pet Supplies", "pet-supplies", [], null],
    ["Toys & Games", "toys-games", [], null],
  ];
  for (const [name, slug, children, commission] of tree) {
    const parent = await db.category.create({
      data: { name, slug, imageUrl: img(`cat-${slug}`, 400, 300, name), commissionPercent: commission },
    });
    catMap[slug] = parent.id;
    for (const child of children) {
      const cslug = `${slug}-${child.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-")}`;
      const c = await db.category.create({
        data: { name: child, slug: cslug, parentId: parent.id, imageUrl: img(`cat-${cslug}`, 400, 300, child) },
      });
      catMap[cslug] = c.id;
    }
  }
}

async function seedSeller(opts: {
  email: string; password: string; fullName: string; displayName: string;
  storeName: string; slug: string; tagline: string; status: string;
  theme?: object; kyc: "approved" | "pending"; bank?: { holder: string; bank: string; last4: string; verified: boolean };
  commissionOverride?: number; holdOverride?: number; createdAt: Date; approvedAt?: Date;
}) {
  const seller = await db.seller.create({
    data: {
      email: opts.email,
      passwordHash: hashPassword(opts.password),
      fullName: opts.fullName,
      displayName: opts.displayName,
      countryCode: "MY",
      phone: "6012" + Math.floor(1000000 + Math.random() * 8999999),
      status: opts.status,
      kycStatus: opts.kyc,
      commissionOverridePercent: opts.commissionOverride ?? null,
      holdDaysOverride: opts.holdOverride ?? null,
      submittedAt: opts.status === "onboarding" ? null : opts.createdAt,
      approvedAt: opts.approvedAt ?? null,
      createdAt: opts.createdAt,
      updatedAt: opts.createdAt,
    },
  });
  const store = await db.store.create({
    data: {
      sellerId: seller.id,
      name: opts.storeName,
      slug: opts.slug,
      tagline: opts.tagline,
      description: `${opts.storeName} — curated goods shipped from Malaysia.`,
      status: opts.status === "active" ? "live" : "draft",
      themeJson: toJson({ primaryColor: "#0f766e", ...(opts.theme ?? {}) }),
      supportEmail: opts.email,
      whatsapp: "60123456789",
      socialJson: toJson({ instagram: `https://instagram.com/${opts.slug}` }),
      createdAt: opts.createdAt,
      updatedAt: opts.createdAt,
    },
  });
  const wallet = await db.wallet.create({ data: { sellerId: seller.id } });
  await ensureWalletAccounts(wallet.id);

  await db.cmsPage.create({
    data: {
      storeId: store.id, slug: "home", title: "Home", pageType: "home",
      draftJson: toJson({ sections: defaultHomeSections(opts.storeName, opts.tagline), version: 1 }),
      publishedJson: opts.status === "active" ? toJson({ sections: defaultHomeSections(opts.storeName, opts.tagline), version: 1 }) : null,
      draftVersion: 1,
      publishedVersion: opts.status === "active" ? 1 : 0,
    },
  });
  for (const p of [
    { slug: "about", title: "About Us", pageType: "about" },
    { slug: "contact", title: "Contact", pageType: "contact" },
    { slug: "policies", title: "Policies", pageType: "policy" },
  ]) {
    const doc = { sections: defaultPageSections(p.pageType, opts.storeName), version: 1 };
    await db.cmsPage.create({
      data: {
        storeId: store.id, slug: p.slug, title: p.title, pageType: p.pageType,
        draftJson: toJson(doc),
        publishedJson: opts.status === "active" ? toJson(doc) : null,
        draftVersion: 1, publishedVersion: opts.status === "active" ? 1 : 0,
      },
    });
  }

  if (opts.kyc === "approved") {
    for (const docType of ["ic_front", "ic_selfie", "business_reg"]) {
      await db.kycDocument.create({
        data: {
          sellerId: seller.id, docType, fileName: `${docType}_${opts.slug}.jpg`,
          status: "approved", reviewedBy: "admin@shopmesh.io", reviewedAt: new Date(opts.createdAt.getTime() + 86400000),
        },
      });
    }
  } else {
    for (const docType of ["ic_front", "business_reg"]) {
      await db.kycDocument.create({
        data: { sellerId: seller.id, docType, fileName: `${docType}_${opts.slug}.jpg`, status: "pending" },
      });
    }
  }
  if (opts.bank) {
    await db.bankAccount.create({
      data: {
        sellerId: seller.id,
        holderName: opts.bank.holder,
        bankName: opts.bank.bank,
        accountNumberMasked: `****${opts.bank.last4}`,
        accountNumberEnc: "enc:" + opts.bank.last4,
        verified: opts.bank.verified,
        verifiedAt: opts.bank.verified ? opts.createdAt : null,
      },
    });
  }
  return { seller, store, wallet };
}

type SeedOrderItem = { product: { title: string; id: string; categoryId: string | null }; variantId: string; title: string; variantLabel?: string; unitPrice: number; qty: number };

async function seedOrder(opts: {
  storeId: string; storeName: string; walletId: string;
  customer: { name: string; email: string; phone?: string };
  items: SeedOrderItem[];
  status: string; provider: string; daysBack: number;
  discountMinor?: number; couponCode?: string; shippingMinor?: number;
  withLedger?: boolean; withSettlement?: boolean;
}) {
  const createdAt = daysAgo(opts.daysBack, 9 + (opts.daysBack % 6));
  const settings = await db.commissionSetting.findUnique({ where: { id: 1 } });
  const holdDays = settings?.payoutHoldDays ?? 7;
  const subtotal = opts.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.unitPrice * i.qty, 0);
  const discount = opts.discountMinor ?? 0;
  const shipping = opts.shippingMinor ?? (subtotal >= 10000 ? 0 : 800);
  const total = subtotal - discount + shipping;

  const computed = await computeOrderCommissions({
    sellerId: (await db.store.findUnique({ where: { id: opts.storeId } }))!.sellerId,
    items: opts.items.map((i) => ({
      title: i.title, unitPriceMinor: i.unitPrice, qty: i.qty,
      productId: i.product.id, categoryId: i.product.categoryId, variantLabel: i.variantLabel ?? null,
    })),
    orderDiscountMinor: discount,
    shippingMinorTotal: shipping,
    now: createdAt,
  });

  const paid = !["payment_pending", "cancelled"].includes(opts.status);
  const paidAt = paid ? createdAt : null;
  const shippedAt = ["shipped", "delivered", "completed"].includes(opts.status) ? new Date(createdAt.getTime() + 86400000) : null;
  const deliveredAt = ["delivered", "completed"].includes(opts.status) ? new Date(createdAt.getTime() + 3 * 86400000) : null;
  const completedAt = opts.status === "completed" ? new Date(createdAt.getTime() + 9 * 86400000) : null;

  const order = await db.order.create({
    data: {
      storeId: opts.storeId,
      orderNumber: nextOrderNumber(),
      customerName: opts.customer.name,
      customerEmail: opts.customer.email,
      customerPhone: opts.customer.phone ?? "60125550011",
      status: opts.status,
      channel: "storefront",
      subtotalMinor: subtotal,
      discountMinor: discount,
      shippingMinor: shipping,
      totalMinor: total,
      couponCode: opts.couponCode ?? null,
      shippingAddressJson: toJson({
        line1: "42 Jalan Merdeka", city: "Kuala Lumpur", state: "Selangor", postcode: "43650", country: "MY",
      }),
      paymentProvider: opts.provider,
      paidAt,
      fulfilledAt: ["processing", "shipped", "delivered", "completed"].includes(opts.status) ? new Date(createdAt.getTime() + 43200000) : null,
      shippedAt,
      deliveredAt,
      completedAt,
      createdAt,
      updatedAt: createdAt,
    },
  });

  for (let i = 0; i < opts.items.length; i++) {
    const item = opts.items[i];
    const c = computed.items[i];
    await db.orderItem.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        productId: item.product.id,
        variantId: item.variantId,
        title: item.title,
        variantLabel: item.variantLabel ?? null,
        unitPriceMinor: item.unitPrice,
        qty: item.qty,
        lineSubtotalMinor: item.unitPrice * item.qty,
        discountMinor: c.discountMinor,
        shippingMinor: c.shippingMinor,
        commissionPercent: c.percent,
        commissionMinor: c.commissionMinor,
        fixedFeeMinor: c.fixedFeeMinor,
        sellerNetMinor: c.sellerNetMinor,
        breakdownJson: toJson(c.breakdown),
      },
    });
    await db.product.update({ where: { id: item.product.id }, data: { salesCount: { increment: item.qty } } });
    await db.productVariant.update({ where: { id: item.variantId }, data: { stock: { decrement: item.qty } } });
  }

  const historyTo: string[] = [];
  if (paid) historyTo.push("paid");
  if (["processing", "shipped", "delivered", "completed"].includes(opts.status)) historyTo.push("processing");
  if (shippedAt) historyTo.push("shipped");
  if (deliveredAt) historyTo.push("delivered");
  if (completedAt) historyTo.push("completed");
  let prev = "payment_pending";
  for (const st of historyTo) {
    await db.orderStatusHistory.create({
      data: { orderId: order.id, fromStatus: prev, toStatus: st, actor: st === "paid" ? "system" : "seller", createdAt: paidAt ?? createdAt },
    });
    prev = st;
  }

  if (opts.withLedger && paid) {
    await db.paymentIntent.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id, provider: opts.provider,
        providerRef: `ref_${order.orderNumber.toLowerCase()}`,
        amountMinor: total, status: "succeeded", expiresAt: daysAhead(1), createdAt, updatedAt: createdAt,
      },
    });
    await postOrderPaid({
      orderId: order.id, orderNumber: order.orderNumber, walletId: opts.walletId,
      provider: opts.provider, totalMinor: total,
      sellerNetMinor: computed.orderSellerNetMinor, commissionMinor: computed.orderCommissionMinor,
      holdUntil: new Date((paidAt as Date).getTime() + holdDays * 86400000),
      occurredAt: paidAt as Date,
    });
    if (opts.withSettlement && completedAt) {
      await postGatewaySettlement({
        provider: opts.provider, amountMinor: total,
        ref: `stl_${order.orderNumber.toLowerCase()}`, occurredAt: new Date((paidAt as Date).getTime() + 172800000),
      });
    }
  } else if (opts.status === "payment_pending") {
    await db.paymentIntent.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id, provider: opts.provider,
        providerRef: `ref_${order.orderNumber.toLowerCase()}`,
        amountMinor: total, status: "requires_payment", expiresAt: new Date(createdAt.getTime() + 1800000),
        redirectUrl: `/pay/${`ref_${order.orderNumber.toLowerCase()}`}`,
      },
    });
  }
  return order;
}

// Shared product-card shaping for market + storefront APIs (Task 2-b scope).
// ProductCard = {id, slug, title, priceMinor, compareAtPriceMinor, imageUrl,
//                storeName, storeSlug, ratingAvg, ratingCount, salesCount, categoryName}
import { parseJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const FALLBACK_IMG = "/api/img/fallback?w=600&h=600";

export const productCardInclude = {
  images: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" as const } },
  variants: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" as const } },
  store: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, status: true } },
  category: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } },
};

type VariantLike = { priceMinor: number; compareAtPriceMinor: number | null; isActive?: boolean };

export function minVariant(variants: VariantLike[]): VariantLike | null {
  const active = variants.filter((v) => v.isActive !== false);
  const pool = active.length > 0 ? active : variants;
  if (pool.length === 0) return null;
  return pool.reduce((min, v) => (v.priceMinor < min.priceMinor ? v : min), pool[0]);
}

export type ProductWithRelations = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  priceMinor: number;
  salesCount: number;
  ratingAvg: number;
  ratingCount: number;
  images: { url: string; sortOrder: number }[];
  variants: VariantLike[];
  store: { name: string; slug: string };
  category?: { name: string } | null;
};

export function toProductCard(p: ProductWithRelations) {
  const mv = minVariant(p.variants);
  const priceMinor = mv ? mv.priceMinor : p.priceMinor;
  const compareAtPriceMinor = mv?.compareAtPriceMinor ?? null;
  const imageUrl = p.images[0]?.url ?? FALLBACK_IMG;
  return {
    id: p.id,
    slug: p.slug,
    title: p.title,
    priceMinor,
    compareAtPriceMinor,
    imageUrl,
    storeName: p.store.name,
    storeSlug: p.store.slug,
    ratingAvg: p.ratingAvg,
    ratingCount: p.ratingCount,
    salesCount: p.salesCount,
    categoryName: p.category?.name ?? null,
  };
}

export function parseSocial(json: string | null | undefined): Record<string, string> {
  return parseJson<Record<string, string>>(json, {});
}

// Task 2-a local helpers — shared by /api/admin/** routes only.
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";

export type Body = Record<string, unknown>;

/** Parse a JSON body safely; throws 400 on malformed JSON. */
export async function readBody(req: NextRequest): Promise<Body> {
  try {
    const raw = await req.json();
    if (raw == null || typeof raw !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw)) return {};
    return raw as Body;
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError(400, "BAD_JSON", "Request body must be valid JSON");
  }
}

export function str(body: Body, key: string): string | undefined {
  const v = body[key];
  return typeof v === "string" && v.trim() !== "" ? v.trim() : undefined;
}

export function reqStr(body: Body, key: string, label?: string): string {
  const v = str(body, key);
  if (v == null) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", `${label ?? key} is required`);
  return v;
}

export function optNum(body: Body, key: string): number | undefined {
  const v = body[key];
  if (v == null || v === "") return undefined;
  const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : parseFloat(String(v));
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : undefined;
}

export function reqNum(body: Body, key: string, label?: string): number {
  const v = optNum(body, key);
  if (v == null) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", `${label ?? key} is required and must be a number`);
  return v;
}

export function optBool(body: Body, key: string): boolean | undefined {
  const v = body[key];
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return v;
  if (v === "true") return true;
  if (v === "false") return false;
  return undefined;
}

export function optDate(body: Body, key: string): Date | undefined | null {
  const v = body[key];
  if (v == null || v === "") return undefined;
  const d = new Date(String(v));
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", `${key} is not a valid date`);
  return d;
}

/** YYYY-MM-DD key for a date (UTC-stable). */
export function dayKey(d: Date): string {
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function startOfToday(): Date {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return d;
}

export function daysAgo(n: number): Date {
  return new Date(Date.now() - n * 86400000);
}

/** Escape a value for CSV output. */
export function csvCell(v: unknown): string {
  if (v == null) return "";
  const s = String(v);
  if (/[",\n\r]/.test(s)) return `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  return s;
}

export function csvRow(cells: unknown[]): string {
  return cells.map(csvCell).join(",");
}

/** Parse a string column that holds JSON, with fallback. */
export function parseMaybeJson<T>(raw: string | null | undefined, fallback: T): T {
  if (!raw) return fallback;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

/** Strip password hashes before returning seller rows. */
export function stripSeller<T extends { passwordHash?: string }>(s: T): Omit<T, "passwordHash"> {
  const { passwordHash: _ph, ...rest } = s;
  return rest;
}

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { handle, okPaged, getPagination } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// GET /api/admin/activity-logs?actorType=&action=&page=&size= (RBAC logs.view)
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireCap("logs.view");
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const actorType = url.searchParams.get("actorType");
  const action = url.searchParams.get("action");

  const where: Prisma.ActivityLogWhereInput = {
    ...(actorType && actorType !== "all" ? { actorType } : {}),
    ...(action ? { action: { contains: action } } : {}),
  };

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.activityLog.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, skip, take }),
    db.activityLog.count({ where }),
  ]);

  const data = rows.map((r) => ({
    ...r,
    meta: parseSafe(r.metaJson),
    metaJson: undefined,
  }));
  return okPaged(data, { page, size, total });
});

function parseSafe(raw: string | null): unknown {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return raw;
  }
}

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, str, optDate, optBool } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// PATCH /api/admin/announcements/[id]
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const ann = await db.announcement.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!ann) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Announcement not found");

  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const title = str(body, "title");
  if (title != null) data.title = title;
  const text = str(body, "body");
  if (text != null) data.body = text;
  const audience = str(body, "audience");
  if (audience != null) {
    if (!["all", "sellers", "admins"].includes(audience)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "audience must be all | sellers | admins");
    data.audience = audience;
  }
  if ("startsAt" in body) data.startsAt = optDate(body, "startsAt") ?? null;
  if ("endsAt" in body) data.endsAt = optDate(body, "endsAt") ?? null;
  const isActive = optBool(body, "isActive");
  if (isActive != null) data.isActive = isActive;
  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "Nothing to update");

  const updated = await db.announcement.update({ where: { id }, data });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "announcement.update",
    entityType: "announcement",
    entityId: id,
    before: { title: ann.title, isActive: ann.isActive },
    after: data,
  });

  return ok(updated);
});

  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const bank = await db.bankAccount.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { seller: true } });

  const updated = await db.bankAccount.update({ where: { id }, data: { verified: true, verifiedAt: new Date() } });

  await notify({
    event: "bank.verified",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: bank.seller.email,
    subject: "Bank account verified",
  });

    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "bank.verify",
    entityType: "bank_account",
    entityId: id,
    before: { verified: bank.verified, bankName: bank.bankName, sellerId: bank.sellerId },
    after: { verified: true },
  });

  return ok(updated);
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, str, optNum } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// PATCH /api/admin/categories/[id] {name?, commissionPercent?, sortOrder?}
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const category = await db.category.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!category) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Category not found");

  const data: { name?: string; commissionPercent?: number | null; sortOrder?: number } = {};
  const name = str(body, "name");
  if (name != null) data.name = name;
  if ("commissionPercent" in body) {
    const v = optNum(body, "commissionPercent");
    if (v != null && (v < 0 || v > 100)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "commissionPercent must be 0..100");
    data.commissionPercent = v ?? null;
  }
  const sortOrder = optNum(body, "sortOrder");
  if (sortOrder != null) data.sortOrder = Math.round(sortOrder);
  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "Nothing to update");

  const updated = await db.category.update({ where: { id }, data });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "category.update",
    entityType: "category",
    entityId: id,
    before: { name: category.name, commissionPercent: category.commissionPercent, sortOrder: category.sortOrder },
    after: data,
  });

  return ok(updated);
});

// DELETE /api/admin/categories/[id] — detach products (categoryId=null), re-parent children, then delete
export const DELETE = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const category = await db.category.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!category) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Category not found");

  await db.product.updateMany({ where: { categoryId: id }, data: { categoryId: null } });
  await db.category.updateMany({ where: { parentId: id }, data: { parentId: null } });
  await db.category.delete({ where: { id } });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "category.delete",
    entityType: "category",
    entityId: id,
    before: { name: category.name, slug: category.slug },
    after: null,
  });

  return ok({ deleted: true });
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin, slugify } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, reqStr, optNum } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/categories — nested tree (parents with children)
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const all = await db.category.findMany({
    include: { _count: { select: { products: true } } },
    orderBy: [{ sortOrder: "asc" }, { name: "asc" }],
  });
  const byParent = new Map<string | null, typeof all>();
  for (const c of all) {
    const key = c.parentId ?? null;
    const list = byParent.get(key) ?? [];
    list.push(c);
    byParent.set(key, list);
  }
  const build = (parentId: string | null): unknown[] =>
    (byParent.get(parentId) ?? []).map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      name: c.name,
      slug: c.slug,
      commissionPercent: c.commissionPercent,
      imageUrl: c.imageUrl,
      sortOrder: c.sortOrder,
      productCount: c._count.products,
      children: build(c.id),
    }));
  return ok(build(null));
});

// POST /api/admin/categories {name, parentId?, commissionPercent?}
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const name = reqStr(body, "name", "name");
  const parentId = typeof body.parentId === "string" && body.parentId !== "" ? body.parentId : null;
  const commissionPercent = optNum(body, "commissionPercent");
  if (commissionPercent != null && (commissionPercent < 0 || commissionPercent > 100)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "commissionPercent must be 0..100");
  }
  if (parentId) {
    const parent = await db.category.findUnique({ where: { id: parentId } });
    if (!parent) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Parent category not found");
  }

  const base = slugify(name) || "category";
  let slug = base;
  let n = 2;
  while (await db.category.findUnique({ where: { slug } })) slug = `${base}-${n++}`;

  const created = await db.category.create({ data: { name, slug, parentId, commissionPercent: commissionPercent ?? null } });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "category.create",
    entityType: "category",
    entityId: created.id,
    after: { name, slug, parentId, commissionPercent: commissionPercent ?? null },
  });

  return ok(created);
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin, requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, reqStr, optNum, optDate, optBool } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/commission/holidays
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const rows = await db.feeHoliday.findMany({ orderBy: { startsAt: "desc" } });
  const data = rows.map((h) => ({ ...h, scopeIdsList: h.scopeIds ? (JSON.parse(h.scopeIds) as string[]) : [] }));
  return ok(data);
});

// POST /api/admin/commission/holidays (RBAC commission.manage)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("commission.manage");
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const name = reqStr(body, "name", "name");
  const scope = typeof body.scope === "string" && ["all", "sellers", "categories"].includes(body.scope) ? body.scope : "all";
  let scopeIds: string | null = null;
  if (scope === "all") {
    scopeIds = null;
  } else {
    const ids = Array.isArray(body.scopeIds) ? body.scopeIds.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string") : [];
    if (ids.length === 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", `scopeIds required for scope=${scope}`);
    scopeIds = JSON.stringify(ids);
  }
  const percent = optNum(body, "percent") ?? 0;
  if (percent < 0 || percent > 100) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "percent must be 0..100");
  const startsAt = optDate(body, "startsAt");
  const endsAt = optDate(body, "endsAt");
  if (!startsAt || !endsAt) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "startsAt and endsAt are required");
  if (startsAt > endsAt) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "startsAt must be before endsAt");
  const isActive = optBool(body, "isActive") ?? true;

  const created = await db.feeHoliday.create({
    data: { name, scope, scopeIds, percent, startsAt, endsAt, isActive },
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "commission.holiday.create",
    entityType: "fee_holiday",
    entityId: created.id,
    after: { name, scope, percent, startsAt, endsAt, isActive },
  });

  return ok(created);
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin, requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, reqStr, optNum, optDate } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/commission/overrides
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const scope = url.searchParams.get("scope");

  const rows = await db.commissionOverride.findMany({
    where: scope ? { scope } : {},
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });
  // names resolved manually (no relations declared on override model)
  const categoryIds = rows.map((r) => r.categoryId).filter((x): x is string => !!x);
  const sellerIds = rows.map((r) => r.sellerId).filter((x): x is string => !!x);
  const productIds = rows.map((r) => r.productId).filter((x): x is string => !!x);
  const [categories, sellers, products] = await Promise.all([
    categoryIds.length ? db.category.findMany({ where: { id: { in: categoryIds } }, select: { id: true, name: true } }) : [],
    sellerIds.length ? db.seller.findMany({ where: { id: { in: sellerIds } }, select: { id: true, displayName: true, email: true } }) : [],
    productIds.length ? db.product.findMany({ where: { id: { in: productIds } }, select: { id: true, title: true } }) : [],
  ]);
  const cMap = new Map(categories.map((c) => [c.id, c.name]));
  const sMap = new Map(sellers.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const pMap = new Map(products.map((p) => [p.id, p.title]));
  const data = rows.map((r) => ({
    ...r,
    categoryName: r.categoryId ? cMap.get(r.categoryId) ?? null : null,
    sellerName: r.sellerId ? sMap.get(r.sellerId)?.displayName ?? null : null,
    sellerEmail: r.sellerId ? sMap.get(r.sellerId)?.email ?? null : null,
    productName: r.productId ? pMap.get(r.productId) ?? null : null,
  }));
  return ok(data);
});

// POST /api/admin/commission/overrides (RBAC commission.manage)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("commission.manage");
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const scope = reqStr(body, "scope", "scope");
  if (!["category", "seller", "product"].includes(scope)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "scope must be category | seller | product");
  }
  const categoryId = typeof body.categoryId === "string" && body.categoryId !== "" ? body.categoryId : null;
  const sellerId = typeof body.sellerId === "string" && body.sellerId !== "" ? body.sellerId : null;
  const productId = typeof body.productId === "string" && body.productId !== "" ? body.productId : null;
  if (scope === "category" && !categoryId) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "categoryId required for category scope");
  if (scope === "seller" && !sellerId) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "sellerId required for seller scope");
  if (scope === "product" && !productId) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "productId required for product scope");

  const percent = optNum(body, "percent");
  if (percent != null && (percent < 0 || percent > 100)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "percent must be 0..100");
  const fixedFeeMinor = optNum(body, "fixedFeeMinor");
  if (fixedFeeMinor != null && fixedFeeMinor < 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "fixedFeeMinor must be >= 0");
  const holdDays = optNum(body, "holdDays");
  if (holdDays != null && (holdDays < 0 || holdDays > 60)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "holdDays must be 0..60");
  const validFrom = optDate(body, "validFrom") ?? null;
  const validTo = optDate(body, "validTo") ?? null;
  if (validFrom && validTo && validFrom > validTo) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "validFrom must be before validTo");

  const created = await db.commissionOverride.create({
    data: {
      scope,
      categoryId,
      sellerId,
      productId,
      percent: percent ?? null,
      fixedFeeMinor: fixedFeeMinor != null ? Math.round(fixedFeeMinor) : null,
      holdDays: holdDays != null ? Math.round(holdDays) : null,
      validFrom,
      validTo,
      createdBy: admin.id,
    },
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "commission.override.create",
    entityType: "commission_override",
    entityId: created.id,
    after: { scope, categoryId, sellerId, productId, percent, fixedFeeMinor, holdDays },
  });

  return ok(created);
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";

// GET /api/admin/commission/settings
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const settings = await getCommissionSettings();
  return ok(settings);
});

// PUT /api/admin/commission/settings (RBAC commission.manage)
export const PUT = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("commission.manage");
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const before = await getCommissionSettings();

  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const defaultPercent = optNum(body, "defaultPercent");
  if (defaultPercent != null) {
    if (defaultPercent < 0 || defaultPercent > 100) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "defaultPercent must be 0..100");
    data.defaultPercent = defaultPercent;
  }
  const payoutHoldDays = optNum(body, "payoutHoldDays");
  if (payoutHoldDays != null) {
    if (payoutHoldDays < 0 || payoutHoldDays > 60) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "payoutHoldDays must be 0..60");
    data.payoutHoldDays = Math.round(payoutHoldDays);
  }
  const appliesToShipping = optBool(body, "appliesToShipping");
  if (appliesToShipping != null) data.appliesToShipping = appliesToShipping;
  const basePriceRule = typeof body.basePriceRule === "string" ? body.basePriceRule : undefined;
  if (basePriceRule != null) {
    if (!["paid_price", "list_price"].includes(basePriceRule)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "basePriceRule must be paid_price | list_price");
    data.basePriceRule = basePriceRule;
  }
  const fixedFeeMinor = optNum(body, "fixedFeeMinor");
  if (fixedFeeMinor != null) {
    if (fixedFeeMinor < 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "fixedFeeMinor must be >= 0");
    data.fixedFeeMinor = Math.round(fixedFeeMinor);
  }
  const minCommissionMinor = optNum(body, "minCommissionMinor");
  if (minCommissionMinor != null) {
    if (minCommissionMinor < 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "minCommissionMinor must be >= 0");
    data.minCommissionMinor = Math.round(minCommissionMinor);
  }
  const holdReleaseRule = typeof body.holdReleaseRule === "string" ? body.holdReleaseRule : undefined;
  if (holdReleaseRule != null) {
    if (!["days_after_paid", "days_after_delivered"].includes(holdReleaseRule)) {
      throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "holdReleaseRule must be days_after_paid | days_after_delivered");
    }
    data.holdReleaseRule = holdReleaseRule;
  }
  const graceDaysAfterDelivered = optNum(body, "graceDaysAfterDelivered");
  if (graceDaysAfterDelivered != null) {
    if (graceDaysAfterDelivered < 0 || graceDaysAfterDelivered > 60) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "graceDaysAfterDelivered must be 0..60");
    data.graceDaysAfterDelivered = Math.round(graceDaysAfterDelivered);
  }

  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "Nothing to update");

  const after = await db.commissionSetting.upsert({
    where: { id: 1 },
    create: { id: 1, ...data },
    update: data,
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "commission.settings.update",
    entityType: "commission_settings",
    entityId: "1",
    before,
    after: data,
  });

  return ok(after);
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { handle, okPaged, getPagination, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, reqStr, str, optNum, optDate, optBool } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/coupons
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const scope = url.searchParams.get("scope");

  const where: Prisma.CouponWhereInput = scope && scope !== "all" ? { scope } : {};
  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.coupon.findMany({ where, include: { store: { select: { id: true, name: true } } }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, skip, take }),
    db.coupon.count({ where }),
  ]);
  return okPaged(rows, { page, size, total });
});

// POST /api/admin/coupons
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const code = reqStr(body, "code", "code").toUpperCase();
  const exists = await db.coupon.findUnique({ where: { code } });
  if (exists) throw new ApiError(409, "CONFLICT", `Coupon code ${code} already exists`);

  const type = str(body, "type") ?? "percent";
  if (!["percent", "fixed", "freeship"].includes(type)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "type must be percent | fixed | freeship");
  const percent = optNum(body, "percent");
  if (percent != null && (percent < 0 || percent > 100)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "percent must be 0..100");
  const amountMinor = optNum(body, "amountMinor");
  if (amountMinor != null && amountMinor < 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "amountMinor must be >= 0");
  if (type === "percent" && percent == null) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "percent is required for percent coupons");
  if (type === "fixed" && amountMinor == null) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "amountMinor is required for fixed coupons");

  const storeId = typeof body.storeId === "string" && body.storeId !== "" ? body.storeId : null;
  if (storeId) {
    const store = await db.store.findUnique({ where: { id: storeId } });
    if (!store) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Store not found");
  }

  const created = await db.coupon.create({
    data: {
      scope: storeId ? "store" : "platform",
      storeId,
      code,
      description: str(body, "description") ?? null,
      type,
      percent: percent ?? null,
      amountMinor: amountMinor != null ? Math.round(amountMinor) : null,
      minSpendMinor: Math.round(optNum(body, "minSpendMinor") ?? 0),
      maxRedemptions: optNum(body, "maxRedemptions") != null ? Math.round(optNum(body, "maxRedemptions") as number) : null,
      perCustomerLimit: Math.round(optNum(body, "perCustomerLimit") ?? 1),
      startsAt: optDate(body, "startsAt") ?? null,
      endsAt: optDate(body, "endsAt") ?? null,
      isActive: optBool(body, "isActive") ?? true,
    },
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "coupon.create",
    entityType: "coupon",
    entityId: created.id,
    after: { code, type, percent, amountMinor, scope: created.scope },
  });

  return ok(created);
});

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { dayKey, startOfToday, daysAgo } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/dashboard — command centre KPIs
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();

  const todayStart = startOfToday();
  const d30Start = daysAgo(29);
  d30Start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  const [
    ordersTodayAgg,
    ordersTodayCount,
    commissionToday,
    activeStores,
    pendingKyc,
    productsToModerate,
    refundsQueue,
    disputesOpen,
    wallets,
    seriesOrders,
    topStoreGroups,
    stores,
    recentSellers,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    // GMV today
    db.order.aggregate({ where: { paidAt: { gte: todayStart, not: null } }, _sum: { totalMinor: true } }),
    db.order.count({ where: { paidAt: { gte: todayStart, not: null } } }),
    // commission today = sum commissionMinor on items of orders paid today
    db.orderItem.findMany({ where: { order: { paidAt: { gte: todayStart } } }, select: { commissionMinor: true } }),
    db.store.count({ where: { status: "live" } }),
    db.seller.count({ where: { status: "pending_review" } }),
    db.product.count({ where: { status: "pending_review" } }),
    db.refund.count({ where: { status: "requested" } }),
    db.dispute.count({ where: { status: { in: ["open", "under_review"] } } }),
    db.wallet.findMany({ select: { availableMinor: true } }),
    // 30d series (compute per-day in JS)
    db.order.findMany({
      where: { paidAt: { gte: d30Start, not: null } },
      select: { paidAt: true, totalMinor: true },
    }),
    // top stores by 30d GMV
    db.order.groupBy({
      by: ["storeId"],
      where: { paidAt: { gte: d30Start, not: null } },
      _sum: { totalMinor: true },
      _count: { _all: true },
      orderBy: { _sum: { totalMinor: "desc" } },
      take: 5,
    }),
    db.store.findMany({ select: { id: true, name: true } }),
    db.seller.findMany({
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 5,
      select: { id: true, displayName: true, status: true, createdAt: true, store: { select: { name: true } } },
    }),
  ]);

  // payouts due: wallets with availableMinor >= 1000 (RM 10.00)
  const dueWallets = wallets.filter((w) => w.availableMinor >= 1000);

  // gmv series 30d
  const seriesMap = new Map<string, { gmvMinor: number; orders: number }>();
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    seriesMap.set(dayKey(daysAgo(29 - i)), { gmvMinor: 0, orders: 0 });
  }
  for (const o of seriesOrders) {
    const key = o.paidAt ? dayKey(o.paidAt) : "";
    if (key && seriesMap.has(key)) {
      const cell = seriesMap.get(key)!;
      cell.gmvMinor += o.totalMinor;
      cell.orders += 1;
    }
  }

  const storeNameById = new Map(stores.map((s) => [s.id, s.name]));

  return ok({
    gmvTodayMinor: ordersTodayAgg._sum.totalMinor ?? 0,
    ordersToday: ordersTodayCount,
    commissionTodayMinor: commissionToday.reduce((s, it) => s + it.commissionMinor, 0),
    activeStores,
    pendingKyc,
    productsToModerate,
    refundsQueue,
    disputesOpen,
    payoutsDueMinor: dueWallets.reduce((s, w) => s + w.availableMinor, 0),
    payoutsDueSellers: dueWallets.length,
    gmvSeries30d: [...seriesMap.entries()].map(([date, v]) => ({ date, gmvMinor: v.gmvMinor, orders: v.orders })),
    topStores: topStoreGroups.map((g) => ({
      storeName: storeNameById.get(g.storeId) ?? "Unknown store",
      gmv30dMinor: g._sum.totalMinor ?? 0,
      orders30d: g._count._all,
    })),
    recentSellers: recentSellers.map((s) => ({
      id: s.id,
      displayName: s.displayName,
      storeName: s.store?.name ?? null,
      status: s.status,
      createdAt: s.createdAt,
    })),
  });
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin, notify } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, reqStr, str } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// PATCH /api/admin/disputes/[id] {status, resolution?} (RBAC disputes.manage)
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("disputes.manage");
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const dispute = await db.dispute.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { order: true } });
  if (!dispute) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Dispute not found");

  const status = reqStr(body, "status", "status");
  if (!["open", "under_review", "resolved", "rejected"].includes(status)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "status must be open | under_review | resolved | rejected");
  }
  const resolution = str(body, "resolution") ?? null;
  if ((status === "resolved" || status === "rejected") && !resolution && !dispute.resolution) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "resolution is required when resolving/rejecting a dispute");
  }

  const updated = await db.dispute.update({
    where: { id },
    data: {
      status,
      resolution: resolution ?? dispute.resolution,
      resolvedAt: status === "resolved" || status === "rejected" ? new Date() : null,
    },
  });

  // resolving clears the order dispute flag
  if (status === "resolved" && dispute.order.disputedFlag) {
    await db.order.update({ where: { id: dispute.orderId }, data: { disputedFlag: false } });
  }

  if (status === "resolved") {
    await notify({
      event: "dispute.resolved",
      channel: "email",
      recipient: dispute.order.customerEmail,
      subject: `Dispute resolved for order ${dispute.order.orderNumber}`,
    });
  }

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "dispute.update",
    entityType: "dispute",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: dispute.status, resolution: dispute.resolution, orderNumber: dispute.order.orderNumber },
    after: { status, resolution: resolution ?? dispute.resolution },
  });

  return ok(updated);
});

```

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { handle, okPaged, getPagination } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// GET /api/admin/disputes?status=&page=&size=
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const status = url.searchParams.get("status");

  const where: Prisma.DisputeWhereInput = status && status !== "all" ? { status } : {};

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.dispute.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        order: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            orderNumber: true,
            status: true,
            totalMinor: true,
            customerName: true,
            customerEmail: true,
            store: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      skip,
      take,
    }),
    db.dispute.count({ where }),
  ]);

  return okPaged(rows, { page, size, total });
});

```
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { handle, ApiError, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { csvRow } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

const MAX_ROWS = 500;

// GET /api/admin/export?entity=orders|sellers|ledger — CSV download (capped at 500 rows)
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const entity = url.searchParams.get("entity") ?? "orders";

  let csv = "";
  let filename = "export.csv";

  if (entity === "orders") {
    const orders = await db.order.findMany({
      include: {
        store: { select: { name: true } },
        items: { select: { commissionMinor: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: MAX_ROWS,
    });
    csv = [
      csvRow(["order_number", "created_at", "paid_at", "store", "customer_email", "status", "subtotal_minor", "discount_minor", "shipping_minor", "total_minor", "commission_minor"]),
      ...orders.map((o) =>
        csvRow([
          o.orderNumber,
          o.createdAt.toISOString(),
          o.paidAt?.toISOString() ?? "",
          o.store.name,
          o.customerEmail,
          o.status,
          o.subtotalMinor,
          o.discountMinor,
          o.shippingMinor,
          o.totalMinor,
          o.items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.commissionMinor, 0),
        ])
      ),
    ].join("\n");
    filename = "orders.csv";
  } else if (entity === "sellers") {
    const sellers = await db.seller.findMany({
      include: { store: { select: { name: true, slug: true } }, wallet: true },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: MAX_ROWS,
    });
    csv = [
      csvRow(["email", "display_name", "legal_name", "status", "kyc_status", "risk_tier", "store_name", "wallet_available_minor", "created_at"]),
      ...sellers.map((s) =>
        csvRow([
          s.email,
          s.displayName,
          s.fullName,
          s.status,
          s.kycStatus,
          s.riskTier,
          s.store?.name ?? "",
          s.wallet?.availableMinor ?? 0,
          s.createdAt.toISOString(),
        ])
      ),
    ].join("\n");
    filename = "sellers.csv";
  } else if (entity === "ledger") {
    const txns = await db.ledgerTransaction.findMany({
      include: { lines: true },
      orderBy: { id: "desc" },
    });
    const rows: string[] = [csvRow(["txn_id", "occurred_at", "txn_type", "ref_type", "ref_id", "account_code", "direction", "amount_minor", "memo"])];
    outer: for (const t of txns) {
      for (const l of t.lines) {
        rows.push(
          csvRow([t.id, t.occurredAt.toISOString(), t.txnType, t.refType ?? "", t.refId ?? "", l.accountCode, l.direction, l.amountMinor, l.memo ?? ""])
        );
        if (rows.length > MAX_ROWS * 6) break outer;
      }
    }
    csv = rows.join("\n");
    filename = "ledger.csv";
  } else {
    throw new ApiError(400, "BAD_ENTITY", "entity must be orders | sellers | ledger");
  }

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "admin",
    actorId: admin.id,
    actorLabel: admin.email,
    action: "export.csv",
    entityType: entity,
    meta: { entity, filename },
  });

  return new NextResponse(csv, {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
      "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
    },
  });
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin, requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, reqStr, optNum, optBool } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/feature-flags
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const rows = await db.featureFlag.findMany({ orderBy: { key: "asc" } });
  return ok(rows);
});

// PATCH /api/admin/feature-flags {key, isEnabled?, rolloutPercent?, description?} (RBAC settings.manage)
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("settings.manage");
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const key = reqStr(body, "key", "key");

  const existing = await db.featureFlag.findUnique({ where: { key } });

  const data: { isEnabled?: boolean; rolloutPercent?: number; description?: string } = {};
  const isEnabled = optBool(body, "isEnabled");
  if (isEnabled != null) data.isEnabled = isEnabled;
  const rolloutPercent = optNum(body, "rolloutPercent");
  if (rolloutPercent != null) {
    if (rolloutPercent < 0 || rolloutPercent > 100) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "rolloutPercent must be 0..100");
    data.rolloutPercent = Math.round(rolloutPercent);
  }
  if (typeof body.description === "string") data.description = body.description;

  const flag = await db.featureFlag.upsert({
    where: { key },
    create: { key, isEnabled: data.isEnabled ?? false, rolloutPercent: data.rolloutPercent ?? 100, description: data.description ?? null },
    update: data,
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "feature_flag.update",
    entityType: "feature_flag",
    entityId: key,
    before: existing ? { isEnabled: existing.isEnabled, rolloutPercent: existing.rolloutPercent } : null,
    after: data,
  });

  return ok(flag);
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// DELETE /api/admin/featured/[id]
export const DELETE = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const slot = await db.featuredSlot.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { product: true } });
  if (!slot) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Featured slot not found");

  await db.featuredSlot.delete({ where: { id } });
  const remaining = await db.featuredSlot.count({ where: { productId: slot.productId } });
  if (remaining === 0) {
    await db.product.update({ where: { id: slot.productId }, data: { isFeatured: false } });
  }

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "featured.delete",
    entityType: "featured_slot",
    entityId: id,
    before: { productId: slot.productId, title: slot.product.title, slot: slot.slot },
    after: null,
  });

  return ok({ deleted: true });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, str, optNum } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/featured — featured slots joined with product info
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const slots = await db.featuredSlot.findMany({
    include: {
      product: {
        include: {
          images: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" }, take: 1 },
          store: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } },
        },
      },
    },
    orderBy: [{ slot: "asc" }, { sortOrder: "asc" }],
  });

  const data = slots.map((s) => ({
    id: s.id,
    slot: s.slot,
    sortOrder: s.sortOrder,
    isActive: s.isActive,
    createdAt: s.createdAt,
    product: {
      id: s.product.id,
      title: s.product.title,
      slug: s.product.slug,
      priceMinor: s.product.priceMinor,
      status: s.product.status,
      imageUrl: s.product.images[0]?.url ?? null,
      storeName: s.product.store.name,
      storeSlug: s.product.store.slug,
    },
  }));
  return ok(data);
});

// POST /api/admin/featured {productId, slot?}
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const productId = typeof body.productId === "string" ? body.productId : "";
  const slot = str(body, "slot") ?? "home_grid";
  const sortOrder = Math.round(optNum(body, "sortOrder") ?? 0);

  const product = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { id: productId } });
  if (!product) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Product not found");

  const created = await db.featuredSlot.create({ data: { productId, slot, sortOrder } });
  await db.product.update({ where: { id: productId }, data: { isFeatured: true } });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "featured.create",
    entityType: "featured_slot",
    entityId: created.id,
    after: { productId, title: product.title, slot, sortOrder },
  });

  return ok(created);
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// GET /api/admin/ledger/accounts — accounts with summed debit/credit balances
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();

  const [accounts, grouped] = await Promise.all([
    db.ledgerAccount.findMany({ orderBy: { code: "asc" } }),
    db.ledgerLine.groupBy({
      by: ["accountCode"],
      _sum: { amountMinor: true },
      _count: { _all: true },
    }),
  ]);

  // split by direction for signed balances
  const lines = await db.ledgerLine.findMany({ select: { accountCode: true, direction: true, amountMinor: true } });
  const sums = new Map<string, { debit: number; credit: number }>();
  for (const l of lines) {
    const cur = sums.get(l.accountCode) ?? { debit: 0, credit: 0 };
    if (l.direction === "debit") cur.debit += l.amountMinor;
    else cur.credit += l.amountMinor;
    sums.set(l.accountCode, cur);
  }

  const meta = new Map(grouped.map((g) => [g.accountCode, { count: g._count._all }]));

  const data = accounts.map((a) => {
    const s = sums.get(a.code) ?? { debit: 0, credit: 0 };
    // asset accounts: debit-positive; liability/revenue: credit-positive
    const balanceMinor = a.type === "asset" ? s.debit - s.credit : s.credit - s.debit;
    return {
      code: a.code,
      name: a.name,
      type: a.type,
      walletId: a.walletId,
      debitMinor: s.debit,
      creditMinor: s.credit,
      balanceMinor,
      lineCount: meta.get(a.code)?.count ?? 0,
    };
  });

  return ok(data);
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { handle, ok } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// GET /api/admin/ledger/transactions?type=&walletId=&cursor= — latest 100, cursor by id desc
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const type = url.searchParams.get("type");
  const walletId = url.searchParams.get("walletId");
  const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor");

  const where: Prisma.LedgerTransactionWhereInput = {
    ...(type && type !== "all" ? { txnType: type } : {}),
    ...(walletId ? { lines: { some: { walletId } } } : {}),
    ...(cursor ? { id: { lt: cursor } } : {}),
  };

  const txns = await db.ledgerTransaction.findMany({
    where,
    include: { lines: { orderBy: { id: "asc" } } },
    orderBy: { id: "desc" },
    take: 101,
  });

  const hasMore = txns.length > 100;
  const items = hasMore ? txns.slice(0, 100) : txns;
  const nextCursor = hasMore ? items[items.length - 1].id : null;

  return ok({ items, nextCursor, count: items.length });
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// GET /api/admin/orders/[id] — full order dossier
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const order = await db.order.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    include: {
      store: { include: { seller: { select: { id: true, email: true, displayName: true, fullName: true } } } },
      items: true,
      history: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } },
      paymentIntents: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
      refunds: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
      disputes: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
    },
  });
  if (!order) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Order not found");

  const wallet = await db.wallet.findUnique({ where: { sellerId: order.store.seller.id } });

  return ok({
    order,
    items: order.items,
    history: order.history,
    paymentIntents: order.paymentIntents,
    refunds: order.refunds,
    dispute: order.disputes[0] ?? null,
    disputes: order.disputes,
    seller: order.store.seller,
    store: { id: order.store.id, name: order.store.name, slug: order.store.slug },
    wallet,
  });
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { handle, okPaged, getPagination } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// GET /api/admin/orders?status=&storeId=&search=&page=&size=
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const status = url.searchParams.get("status");
  const storeId = url.searchParams.get("storeId");
  const search = url.searchParams.get("search");

  const where: Prisma.OrderWhereInput = {
    ...(status && status !== "all" ? { status } : {}),
    ...(storeId ? { storeId } : {}),
    ...(search
      ? {
          OR: [
            { orderNumber: { contains: search } },
            { customerName: { contains: search } },
            { customerEmail: { contains: search } },
            { store: { is: { name: { contains: search } } } },
          ],
        }
      : {}),
  };

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.order.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        store: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } },
        items: { select: { commissionMinor: true } },
        _count: { select: { items: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      skip,
      take,
    }),
    db.order.count({ where }),
  ]);

  const data = rows.map((o) => ({
    ...o,
    itemsCount: o._count.items,
    commissionMinor: o.items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.commissionMinor, 0),
    items: undefined,
    _count: undefined,
  }));
  return okPaged(data, { page, size, total });
});

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin, requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { refreshWalletCache, postPayoutInitiated, buildPayoutStatement } from "@/lib/ledger";
import { parseMaybeJson, readBody, optBool, daysAgo } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/payout-batches
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const batches = await db.payoutBatch.findMany({
    include: { payouts: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } } },
    orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
  });

  // seller info resolved manually (no relation declared on Payout)
  const sellerIds = [...new Set(batches.flatMap((b) => b.payouts.map((p) => p.sellerId)))];
  const sellers = sellerIds.length
    ? await db.seller.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: sellerIds } },
        select: { id: true, email: true, displayName: true, store: { select: { name: true } } },
      })
    : [];
  const sMap = new Map(sellers.map((s) => [s.id, s]));

  const data = batches.map((b) => ({
    ...b,
    payouts: b.payouts.map((p) => {
      const s = sMap.get(p.sellerId);
      return { ...p, sellerName: s?.store?.name ?? s?.displayName ?? null, sellerEmail: s?.email ?? null };
    }),
  }));
  return ok(data);
});

// POST /api/admin/payout-batches {dryRun?: boolean} — run a payout batch (RBAC payouts.manage)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("payouts.manage");
  const body = await readBody(req).catch(() => ({}) as Record<string, never>);
  const dryRun = optBool(body as Record<string, unknown>, "dryRun") ?? false;

  // settings
  const [minSetting, modeSetting] = await Promise.all([
    db.setting.findUnique({ where: { key: "payout.min_minor" } }),
    db.setting.findUnique({ where: { key: "payout.mode" } }),
  ]);
  const minMinor = parseMaybeJson<number>(minSetting?.valueJson, 1000);
  const mode = parseMaybeJson<string>(modeSetting?.valueJson, "manual_csv");

  // refresh all wallet caches from ledger truth
  const wallets = await db.wallet.findMany({
    include: {
      seller: { select: { id: true, email: true, displayName: true, store: { select: { id: true, name: true } }, bankAccounts: true } },
    },
  });
  const refreshed = [];
  for (const w of wallets) {
    const truth = await refreshWalletCache(w.id);
    refreshed.push({ ...w, truth });
  }

  const eligible = refreshed.filter((w) => w.truth.availableMinor >= minMinor);

  const preview = eligible.map((w) => {
    const bank = w.seller.bankAccounts.find((b) => b.verified) ?? w.seller.bankAccounts[0] ?? null;
    return {
      walletId: w.id,
      sellerId: w.seller.id,
      sellerName: w.seller.displayName,
      storeName: w.seller.store?.name ?? null,
      availableMinor: w.truth.availableMinor,
      bank: bank ? { id: bank.id, bankName: bank.bankName, holderName: bank.holderName, accountNumberMasked: bank.accountNumberMasked, verified: bank.verified } : null,
    };
  });

  if (dryRun) {
    return ok({ dryRun: true, minMinor, mode, eligibleCount: preview.length, eligibleTotalMinor: preview.reduce((s, e) => s + e.availableMinor, 0), eligible: preview });
  }

  if (preview.length === 0) {
    throw new ApiError(409, "NO_ELIGIBLE_WALLETS", `No wallet meets the minimum payout of ${minMinor} minor units`);
  }

  // create batch + payouts (processing) + T3 per wallet
  const batch = await db.payoutBatch.create({
    data: { runType: "manual", status: "running", currency: "MYR", totalMinor: 0, payoutCount: 0 },
  });

  const createdPayouts = [];
  for (const w of eligible) {
    const bank = w.seller.bankAccounts.find((b) => b.verified) ?? w.seller.bankAccounts[0] ?? null;
    const counter = await db.counter.upsert({
      where: { key: "payout_number" },
      create: { key: "payout_number", value: 100002 },
      update: { value: { increment: 1 } },
    });
    const referenceNo = `PO-${counter.value}`;

    const orderCount = await db.order.count({ where: { storeId: w.seller.store?.id, paidAt: { not: null } } });
    const statementJson = buildPayoutStatement({
      sellerName: w.seller.store?.name ?? w.seller.displayName,
      periodFrom: daysAgo(30),
      periodTo: new Date(),
      salesMinor: w.truth.lifetimeEarnedMinor + w.truth.lifetimeCommissionMinor,
      commissionMinor: w.truth.lifetimeCommissionMinor,
      refundsMinor: 0,
      adjustmentsMinor: 0,
      negativeCarryMinor: 0,
      orderCount,
    });

    const payout = await db.payout.create({
      data: {
        batchId: batch.id,
        sellerId: w.seller.id,
        walletId: w.id,
        referenceNo,
        amountMinor: w.truth.availableMinor,
        status: "processing",
        method: mode,
        bankAccountId: bank?.id ?? null,
        statementJson,
      },
    });

    await postPayoutInitiated({ walletId: w.id, payoutId: payout.id, referenceNo, amountMinor: payout.amountMinor });
    createdPayouts.push(payout);
  }

  const totalMinor = createdPayouts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.amountMinor, 0);
  const finished = await db.payoutBatch.update({
    where: { id: batch.id },
    data: { status: "completed", totalMinor, payoutCount: createdPayouts.length, finishedAt: new Date() },
    include: { payouts: true },
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "payout.batch.run",
    entityType: "payout_batch",
    entityId: batch.id,
    before: null,
    after: {
      batchId: batch.id,
      payoutCount: createdPayouts.length,
      totalMinor,
      minMinor,
      mode,
      wallets: createdPayouts.map((p) => ({ referenceNo: p.referenceNo, amountMinor: p.amountMinor, sellerId: p.sellerId })),
    },
  });

  return ok({ batch: finished, payouts: createdPayouts });
});

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin, notify } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { postPayoutFailed } from "@/lib/ledger";
import { readBody, reqStr } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/payouts/[id]/fail {reason} — T4f reversal (RBAC payouts.manage)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("payouts.manage");
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const reason = reqStr(body, "reason", "reason");

  const payout = await db.payout.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!payout) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Payout not found");
  if (payout.status !== "processing") throw new ApiError(409, "CONFLICT", `Payout is ${payout.status}, only processing payouts can fail`);

  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({ where: { id: payout.sellerId } });
  if (!seller) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Seller not found");

  const txn = await postPayoutFailed({
    walletId: payout.walletId,
    payoutId: payout.id,
    referenceNo: payout.referenceNo,
    amountMinor: payout.amountMinor,
    reason,
  });

  const updated = await db.payout.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { status: "failed", failReason: reason },
  });

  await notify({
    event: "payout.failed",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: "ops@shopmesh.io",
    subject: `Payout ${payout.referenceNo} failed`,
  });
  await notify({
    event: "payout.failed",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: seller.email,
    subject: `Payout ${payout.referenceNo} failed`,
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "payout.fail",
    entityType: "payout",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: payout.status, referenceNo: payout.referenceNo, amountMinor: payout.amountMinor },
    after: { status: "failed", reason, txnId: txn.id },
  });

  return ok(updated);
});

```

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/payouts/[id]/mark-paid {referenceNo} — T4 (RBAC payouts.manage)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("payouts.manage");
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const referenceNo = reqStr(body, "referenceNo", "referenceNo (bank transfer reference)");

  const payout = await db.payout.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!payout) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Payout not found");
  if (payout.status !== "processing") throw new ApiError(409, "CONFLICT", `Payout is ${payout.status}, only processing payouts can be marked paid`);

  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({ where: { id: payout.sellerId } });
  if (!seller) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Seller not found");

  const txn = await postPayoutConfirmed({
    walletId: payout.walletId,
    payoutId: payout.id,
    referenceNo: payout.referenceNo,
    amountMinor: payout.amountMinor,
  });

  const updated = await db.payout.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { status: "paid", paidAt: new Date(), providerRef: referenceNo },
  });

  });

  return ok(updated);
});

    action: "product.ban",
    entityType: "product",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: product.status, title: product.title },
    after: { status: "banned", reason },

});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin, notify, dispatchStoreWebhooks, transitionOrder } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { postRefund } from "@/lib/ledger";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/refunds/[id]/process — posts ledger T5 + updates order/items/stock (RBAC refunds.manage)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("refunds.manage");
  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const refund = await db.refund.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    include: {
      order: {
        include: {
          items: { orderBy: { id: "asc" } },
          store: { include: { seller: { include: { wallet: true } } } },
          refunds: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!refund) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Refund not found");
  if (refund.status === "processed") throw new ApiError(409, "ALREADY_PROCESSED", "Refund already processed");
  if (refund.status === "rejected") throw new ApiError(409, "CONFLICT", "Rejected refund cannot be processed");

  const order = refund.order;
  const wallet = order.store.seller.wallet;
  if (!wallet) throw new ApiError(400, "NO_WALLET", "Seller has no wallet");

  // first item with remaining (un-refunded) amount
  const item = order.items.find((it) => it.lineSubtotalMinor - it.refundedMinor > 0) ?? order.items[0];
  if (!item) throw new ApiError(400, "NO_ITEMS", "Order has no items");

  const commissionReversalMinor = Math.round((refund.amountMinor * item.commissionPercent) / 100);

  // T5 — ledger refund (balanced): DR seller payable + DR commission revenue | CR gateway
  const txn = await postRefund({
    orderId: order.id,
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    walletId: wallet.id,
    provider: order.paymentProvider ?? "fpx_toyyibpay",
    amountMinor: refund.amountMinor,
    commissionReversalMinor,
  });

  // total refunded so far (processed refunds incl. this one)
  const priorProcessed = order.refunds
    .filter((r) => r.id !== refund.id && r.status === "processed")
    .reduce((s, r) => s + r.amountMinor, 0);
  const totalRefunded = priorProcessed + refund.amountMinor;
  const fullyRefunded = totalRefunded >= order.totalMinor;

  // advance order status (writes history row)
  await transitionOrder({
    orderId: order.id,
    toStatus: fullyRefunded ? "refunded" : "partially_refunded",
    actor: `admin:${admin.email}`,
    note: `Refund ${refund.amountMinor / 100} processed (reason: ${refund.reason ?? "n/a"})`,
  });

  // item refund bookkeeping + optional restock
  const remaining = item.lineSubtotalMinor - item.refundedMinor;
  const applied = Math.min(refund.amountMinor, Math.max(0, remaining));
  await db.orderItem.update({ where: { id: item.id }, data: { refundedMinor: item.refundedMinor + applied } });
  if (refund.restock && item.variantId) {
    await db.productVariant.update({ where: { id: item.variantId }, data: { stock: { increment: item.qty } } });
    await db.inventoryLog.create({
      data: { variantId: item.variantId, delta: item.qty, reason: "refund_restock", refId: refund.id },
    });
  }

  const processed = await db.refund.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { status: "processed", processedAt: new Date(), commissionReversalMinor },
  });

  // gateway intent reflects refund
  await db.paymentIntent.updateMany({
    where: { orderId: order.id, status: "succeeded" },
    data: { status: "refunded" },
  });

  // notifications: customer + seller
  await notify({
    event: "refund.approved",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: order.customerEmail,
    subject: `Refund processed for order ${order.orderNumber}`,
  });
  await notify({
    event: "refund.approved",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: order.store.seller.email,
    subject: `Refund processed for order ${order.orderNumber}`,
  });

  // store webhooks
  await dispatchStoreWebhooks({
    storeId: order.storeId,
    event: "order.refunded",
    payload: {
      orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
      refundId: refund.id,
      amountMinor: refund.amountMinor,
      commissionReversalMinor,
      status: fullyRefunded ? "refunded" : "partially_refunded",
    },
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "refund.process",
    entityType: "refund",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: refund.status, orderStatus: order.status, amountMinor: refund.amountMinor },
    after: {
      status: "processed",
      orderStatus: fullyRefunded ? "refunded" : "partially_refunded",
      totalRefundedMinor: totalRefunded,
      commissionReversalMinor,
      restocked: refund.restock,
      txnId: txn.id,
    },
  });

  return ok({ refund: processed, txnId: txn.id, orderStatus: fullyRefunded ? "refunded" : "partially_refunded", totalRefundedMinor: totalRefunded });
});

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin, notify } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/refunds/[id]/reject {reason?} (RBAC refunds.manage)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("refunds.manage");
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req).catch(() => ({}) as Record<string, never>);
  const reason = typeof body.reason === "string" ? body.reason : "Refund request declined";

  const refund = await db.refund.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { order: { include: { store: { include: { seller: true } } } } } });
  if (!refund) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Refund not found");
  if (refund.status === "processed") throw new ApiError(409, "CONFLICT", "Processed refund cannot be rejected");

  const updated = await db.refund.update({ where: { id }, data: { status: "rejected" } });

  await notify({
    event: "refund.rejected",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: refund.order.store.seller.email,
    subject: `Refund rejected for order ${refund.order.orderNumber}`,
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "refund.reject",
    entityType: "refund",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: refund.status, amountMinor: refund.amountMinor },
    after: { status: "rejected", reason },
  });

  return ok(updated);
});
