```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { handle, okPaged, getPagination } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// GET /api/admin/refunds?status=&page=&size=
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const status = url.searchParams.get("status");

  const where: Prisma.RefundWhereInput = status && status !== "all" ? { status } : {};

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.refund.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        order: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            orderNumber: true,
            status: true,
            totalMinor: true,
            currency: true,
            customerName: true,
            customerEmail: true,
            store: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      skip,
      take,
    }),
    db.refund.count({ where }),
  ]);

  return okPaged(rows, { page, size, total });
});

```
```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { dayKey, daysAgo } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ type: string }> };

// GET /api/admin/reports/[type]?days=30 — type in sales | sellers | commission | payouts
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const { type } = await ctx.params;
  if (!["sales", "sellers", "commission", "payouts"].includes(type)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "BAD_TYPE", "type must be sales | sellers | commission | payouts");
  }

  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const days = Math.min(365, Math.max(1, parseInt(url.searchParams.get("days") ?? "30", 10) || 30));
  const since = daysAgo(days - 1);
  since.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  if (type === "payouts") {
    const batches = await db.payoutBatch.findMany({
      include: { payouts: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } } },
      orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
    });
    const payouts = batches.flatMap((b) => b.payouts);

    // seller names resolved manually (no relation declared on Payout)
    const sellerIds = [...new Set(payouts.map((p) => p.sellerId))];
    const sellers = sellerIds.length
      ? await db.seller.findMany({
          where: { id: { in: sellerIds } },
          select: { id: true, displayName: true, email: true, store: { select: { name: true } } },
        })
      : [];
    const sMap = new Map(sellers.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
    const sellerNameOf = (sellerId: string) => {
      const s = sMap.get(sellerId);
      return s?.store?.name ?? s?.displayName ?? "Unknown";
    };

    return ok({
      batches: batches.map((b) => ({
        id: b.id,
        runType: b.runType,
        status: b.status,
        totalMinor: b.totalMinor,
        payoutCount: b.payoutCount,
        startedAt: b.startedAt,
        finishedAt: b.finishedAt,
        payouts: b.payouts.map((p) => ({
          id: p.id,
          referenceNo: p.referenceNo,
          sellerName: sellerNameOf(p.sellerId),
          amountMinor: p.amountMinor,
          status: p.status,
          method: p.method,
          paidAt: p.paidAt,
        })),
      })),
      totals: {
        totalMinor: payouts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.amountMinor, 0),
        count: payouts.length,
        paidMinor: payouts.filter((p) => p.status === "paid").reduce((s, p) => s + p.amountMinor, 0),
        processingMinor: payouts.filter((p) => p.status === "processing").reduce((s, p) => s + p.amountMinor, 0),
        failedMinor: payouts.filter((p) => p.status === "failed").reduce((s, p) => s + p.amountMinor, 0),
        batchCount: batches.length,
      },
      days,
    });
  }

  // sales / sellers / commission — all built from paid orders in window
  const orders = await db.order.findMany({
    where: { paidAt: { gte: since, not: null } },
    select: {
      id: true,
      paidAt: true,
      totalMinor: true,
      store: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      items: {
        select: {
          commissionMinor: true,
          lineSubtotalMinor: true,
          product: { select: { category: { select: { name: true } } } },
        },
      },
    },
    orderBy: { paidAt: "asc" },
  });

  // day series (fills gaps with zero days)
  const seriesMap = new Map<string, { gmvMinor: number; orders: number; commissionMinor: number }>();
  for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
    const d = daysAgo(days - 1 - i);
    seriesMap.set(dayKey(d), { gmvMinor: 0, orders: 0, commissionMinor: 0 });
  }
  const byStore = new Map<string, { storeName: string; gmvMinor: number; orders: number; commissionMinor: number; itemsValue: number }>();
  const byCategory = new Map<string, number>();
  let totalGmv = 0;
  let totalCommission = 0;
  let totalItems = 0;

  for (const o of orders) {
    const key = o.paidAt ? dayKey(o.paidAt) : "";
    const commission = o.items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.commissionMinor, 0);
    totalGmv += o.totalMinor;
    totalCommission += commission;
    totalItems += o.items.length;

    if (key && seriesMap.has(key)) {
      const cell = seriesMap.get(key)!;
      cell.gmvMinor += o.totalMinor;
      cell.orders += 1;
      cell.commissionMinor += commission;
    }

    const sid = o.store.id;
    const storeCell = byStore.get(sid) ?? { storeName: o.store.name, gmvMinor: 0, orders: 0, commissionMinor: 0, itemsValue: 0 };
    storeCell.gmvMinor += o.totalMinor;
    storeCell.orders += 1;
    storeCell.commissionMinor += commission;
    storeCell.itemsValue += o.items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.lineSubtotalMinor, 0);
    byStore.set(sid, storeCell);

    for (const it of o.items) {
      const cat = it.product?.category?.name ?? "Uncategorised";
      byCategory.set(cat, (byCategory.get(cat) ?? 0) + it.commissionMinor);
    }
  }

  if (type === "sales") {
    const series = [...seriesMap.entries()].map(([date, v]) => ({ date, ...v }));
    return ok({
      series,
      totals: {
        gmvMinor: totalGmv,
        orders: orders.length,
        commissionMinor: totalCommission,
        aovMinor: orders.length ? Math.round(totalGmv / orders.length) : 0,
      },
      days,
    });
  }

  if (type === "sellers") {
    const rows = [...byStore.values()]
      .map((r) => ({
        storeName: r.storeName,
        gmvMinor: r.gmvMinor,
        orders: r.orders,
        commissionMinor: r.commissionMinor,
        aovMinor: r.orders ? Math.round(r.gmvMinor / r.orders) : 0,
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.gmvMinor - a.gmvMinor);
    return ok({
      rows,
      totals: { gmvMinor: totalGmv, orders: orders.length, commissionMinor: totalCommission, stores: rows.length },
      days,
    });
  }

  // commission report
  const gmvBase = [...byStore.values()].reduce((s, r) => s + r.itemsValue, 0);
  return ok({
    series: [...seriesMap.entries()].map(([date, v]) => ({ date, commissionMinor: v.commissionMinor, gmvMinor: v.gmvMinor, orders: v.orders })),
    byCategory: [...byCategory.entries()]
      .map(([categoryName, commissionMinor]) => ({ categoryName, commissionMinor }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.commissionMinor - a.commissionMinor),
    effectiveRate: totalGmv > 0 ? Math.round((totalCommission / totalGmv) * 10000) / 100 : 0,
    totals: { commissionMinor: totalCommission, gmvMinor: totalGmv, items: totalItems, itemsValueMinor: gmvBase },
    days,
  });
});
```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin, notify } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { stripSeller } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/sellers/[id]/activate (RBAC sellers.suspend)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("sellers.suspend");
  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { store: true } });
  if (!seller) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Seller not found");
  if (seller.status === "terminated" || seller.status === "rejected") {
    throw new ApiError(409, "CONFLICT", `Cannot activate a ${seller.status} seller`);
  }

  const updated = await db.seller.update({ where: { id }, data: { status: "active" } });
  if (seller.store) await db.store.update({ where: { id: seller.store.id }, data: { status: "live" } });

  await notify({
    event: "seller.activated",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: seller.email,
    subject: "Your store is back online",
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "seller.activate",
    entityType: "seller",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: seller.status, storeStatus: seller.store?.status ?? null },
    after: { status: "active", storeStatus: seller.store ? "live" : null },
  });

  return ok(stripSeller(updated));
});
```

## FILE: src/app/api/admin/sellers/[id]/kyc/[docId]/route.ts
```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, reqStr } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string; docId: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/sellers/[id]/kyc/[docId] {decision: approved|rejected, reason?}
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("sellers.approve");
  const { id, docId } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const decision = reqStr(body, "decision", "decision");
  if (!["approved", "rejected"].includes(decision)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "decision must be approved | rejected");
  const reason = typeof body.reason === "string" ? body.reason : null;
  if (decision === "rejected" && !reason) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "reason is required when rejecting a document");

  const doc = await db.kycDocument.findUnique({ where: { id: docId } });
  if (!doc || doc.sellerId !== id) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "KYC document not found for this seller");
  if (doc.status === decision) throw new ApiError(409, "CONFLICT", `Document already ${doc.status}`);

  const updatedDoc = await db.kycDocument.update({
    where: { id: docId },
    data: {
      status: decision,
      rejectReason: decision === "rejected" ? reason : null,
      reviewedBy: admin.email,
      reviewedAt: new Date(),
    },
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: `kyc.doc.${decision}`,
    entityType: "kyc_document",
    entityId: docId,
    before: { status: doc.status, docType: doc.docType, sellerId: id },
    after: { status: decision, reason, reviewedBy: admin.email },
  });

  // Auto-rule: all docs approved + ≥1 verified bank + ≥1 product ⇒ seller kycStatus approved.
  let sellerKycStatus: string | null = null;
  if (decision === "approved") {
    const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        kycDocuments: true,
        bankAccounts: true,
        store: { include: { _count: { select: { products: true } } } },
      },
    });
    if (seller && seller.kycDocuments.length > 0) {
      const allDocsApproved = seller.kycDocuments.every((d) => d.status === "approved");
      const bankVerified = seller.bankAccounts.some((b) => b.verified);
      const hasProduct = (seller.store?._count.products ?? 0) >= 1;
      if (allDocsApproved && bankVerified && hasProduct && seller.kycStatus !== "approved") {
        await db.seller.update({ where: { id }, data: { kycStatus: "approved" } });
        sellerKycStatus = "approved";
        await logActivity({
          actorType: "system",
          action: "seller.kyc.auto_approved",
          entityType: "seller",
          entityId: id,
          meta: { triggerDocId: docId, by: admin.email },
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return ok({ doc: updatedDoc, sellerKycStatus });
});

```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, optNum, optBool, str, stripSeller, daysAgo } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// GET /api/admin/sellers/[id] — full seller profile
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    include: {
      store: true,
      wallet: true,
      kycDocuments: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } },
      bankAccounts: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
      sellerNotes: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
    },
  });
  if (!seller) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Seller not found");

  const [recentProducts, recentOrders, productCount] = await Promise.all([
    db.product.findMany({
      where: { storeId: seller.store?.id ?? "__none__" },
      include: { images: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" }, take: 1 }, category: true },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 5,
    }),
    db.order.findMany({
      where: { storeId: seller.store?.id ?? "__none__" },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 5,
    }),
    db.product.count({ where: { storeId: seller.store?.id ?? "__none__" } }),
  ]);

  const since = daysAgo(30);
  const agg = seller.store
    ? await db.order.aggregate({
        where: { storeId: seller.store.id, paidAt: { gte: since, not: null } },
        _sum: { totalMinor: true },
        _count: { _all: true },
      })
    : { _sum: { totalMinor: 0 }, _count: { _all: 0 } };

  return ok({
    seller: stripSeller(seller),
    store: seller.store,
    kycDocuments: seller.kycDocuments,
    bankAccounts: seller.bankAccounts,
    wallet: seller.wallet,
    products: recentProducts,
    orders: recentOrders,
    notes: seller.sellerNotes,
    gmv30dMinor: agg._sum.totalMinor ?? 0,
    orders30d: agg._count._all,
    productCount,
  });
});

// PATCH /api/admin/sellers/[id] — risk tier / commission / hold overrides / marketplace opt-in
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!seller) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Seller not found");

  const data: {
    riskTier?: string;
    commissionOverridePercent?: number | null;
    holdDaysOverride?: number | null;
    marketplaceOptIn?: boolean;
  } = {};
  const riskTier = str(body, "riskTier");
  if (riskTier != null) {
    if (!["low", "medium", "high"].includes(riskTier)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "riskTier must be low | medium | high");
    data.riskTier = riskTier;
  }
  if ("commissionOverridePercent" in body) {
    const v = optNum(body, "commissionOverridePercent");
    if (v != null && (v < 0 || v > 100)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "commissionOverridePercent must be 0..100");
    data.commissionOverridePercent = v ?? null;
  }
  if ("holdDaysOverride" in body) {
    const v = optNum(body, "holdDaysOverride");
    if (v != null && (v < 0 || v > 60)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "holdDaysOverride must be 0..60");
    data.holdDaysOverride = v != null ? Math.round(v) : null;
  }
  const marketplaceOptIn = optBool(body, "marketplaceOptIn");
  if (marketplaceOptIn != null) data.marketplaceOptIn = marketplaceOptIn;

  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "Nothing to update");

  const updated = await db.seller.update({ where: { id }, data });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "seller.update",
    entityType: "seller",
    entityId: id,
    before: {
      riskTier: seller.riskTier,
      commissionOverridePercent: seller.commissionOverridePercent,
      holdDaysOverride: seller.holdDaysOverride,
      marketplaceOptIn: seller.marketplaceOptIn,
    },
    after: data,
  });

  return ok(stripSeller(updated));
});
```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin, notify } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, stripSeller } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/sellers/[id]/suspend {reason?} (RBAC sellers.suspend)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("sellers.suspend");
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req).catch(() => ({}) as Record<string, never>);
  const reason = typeof body.reason === "string" ? body.reason : "Policy review";

  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { store: true } });
  if (!seller) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Seller not found");
  if (seller.status !== "active") throw new ApiError(409, "CONFLICT", `Only active sellers can be suspended (current: ${seller.status})`);

  const updated = await db.seller.update({ where: { id }, data: { status: "suspended" } });
  if (seller.store) await db.store.update({ where: { id: seller.store.id }, data: { status: "draft" } });

  await notify({
    event: "seller.suspended",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: seller.email,
    subject: "Your store has been suspended",
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "seller.suspend",
    entityType: "seller",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: seller.status, storeStatus: seller.store?.status ?? null },
    after: { status: "suspended", storeStatus: seller.store ? "draft" : null, reason },
  });

  return ok(stripSeller(updated));
});

```
```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { handle, okPaged, getPagination } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { stripSeller } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/sellers?status=&search=&riskTier=&page=&size=
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const status = url.searchParams.get("status");
  const riskTier = url.searchParams.get("riskTier");
  const search = url.searchParams.get("search");

  const where: Prisma.SellerWhereInput = {
    ...(status && status !== "all" ? { status } : {}),
    ...(riskTier && riskTier !== "all" ? { riskTier } : {}),
    ...(search
      ? {
          OR: [
            { email: { contains: search } },
            { fullName: { contains: search } },
            { displayName: { contains: search } },
            { store: { is: { name: { contains: search } } } },
            { store: { is: { slug: { contains: search } } } },
          ],
        }
      : {}),
  };

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.seller.findMany({
      where,
      include: { store: true, wallet: true },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      skip,
      take,
    }),
    db.seller.count({ where }),
  ]);

  // GMV last 30d per store (paid orders)
  const since = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86400000);
  const gmv = await db.order.groupBy({
    by: ["storeId"],
    where: { paidAt: { gte: since, not: null } },
    _sum: { totalMinor: true },
    _count: { _all: true },
  });
  const gmvByStore = new Map(gmv.map((g) => [g.storeId, { gmv: g._sum.totalMinor ?? 0, orders: g._count._all }]));

  const data = rows.map((s) => {
    const stats = s.store ? gmvByStore.get(s.store.id) : undefined;
    return {
      ...stripSeller(s),
      store: s.store ? { ...s.store, gmv30dMinor: stats?.gmv ?? 0, orders30d: stats?.orders ?? 0 } : null,
      wallet: s.wallet,
    };
  });
  return okPaged(data, { page, size, total });
});

```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin, requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/settings — key/valueJson list
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const rows = await db.setting.findMany({ orderBy: { key: "asc" } });
  return ok(rows);
});

// PUT /api/admin/settings {settings: [{key, valueJson}]} (RBAC settings.manage)
export const PUT = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("settings.manage");
  const body = await readBody(req);
  const settings = Array.isArray(body.settings) ? body.settings : null;
  if (!settings || settings.length === 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "settings array is required");

  const before: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const after: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  for (const s of settings) {
    if (!s || typeof s !== "object") continue;
    const key = typeof (s as Record<string, unknown>).key === "string" ? ((s as Record<string, unknown>).key as string) : null;
    if (!key) continue;
    const existing = await db.setting.findUnique({ where: { key } });
    before[key] = existing ? existing.valueJson : null;
    let valueJson: string;
    const raw = (s as Record<string, unknown>).valueJson;
    if (typeof raw === "string") {
      // accept pre-serialized JSON or raw scalar; normalize scalars into JSON
      const trimmed = raw.trim();
      if (trimmed === "" ) valueJson = '""';
      else if (trimmed.startsWith("{") || trimmed.startsWith("[") || trimmed.startsWith("\"") || /^(true|false|null|-?\d+(\.\d+)?)$/.test(trimmed)) valueJson = trimmed;
      else valueJson = JSON.stringify(trimmed);
    } else {
      valueJson = JSON.stringify(raw ?? null);
    }
    const upserted = await db.setting.upsert({
      where: { key },
      create: { key, valueJson },
      update: { valueJson },
    });
    after[key] = upserted.valueJson;
  }

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "settings.update",
    entityType: "setting",
    entityId: null,
    before,
    after,
  });

  const rows = await db.setting.findMany({ orderBy: { key: "asc" } });
  return ok(rows);
});

```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, reqStr } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/tickets/[id]/reply {body}
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const payload = await readBody(req);
  const text = reqStr(payload, "body", "body");

  const ticket = await db.supportTicket.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!ticket) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Ticket not found");

  const message = await db.supportMessage.create({
    data: { ticketId: id, authorType: "admin", authorLabel: admin.name, body: text },
  });
  // admin reply moves the ticket to pending (awaiting seller)
  const updated = await db.supportTicket.update({ where: { id }, data: { status: "pending" } });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "ticket.reply",
    entityType: "support_ticket",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: ticket.status },
    after: { status: "pending", messageId: message.id },
  });

  return ok({ message, ticket: updated });
});
```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readBody, str } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// GET /api/admin/tickets/[id] — ticket with full message thread
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const ticket = await db.supportTicket.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    include: { messages: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } } },
  });
  if (!ticket) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Ticket not found");

  // store resolved manually (no relation declared on SupportTicket)
  const store = ticket.storeId ? await db.store.findUnique({ where: { id: ticket.storeId }, select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } }) : null;

  return ok({ ...ticket, store });
});

// PATCH /api/admin/tickets/[id] {status?, priority?}
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const ticket = await db.supportTicket.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!ticket) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Ticket not found");

  const data: { status?: string; priority?: string } = {};
  const status = str(body, "status");
  if (status != null) {
    if (!["open", "pending", "closed"].includes(status)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "status must be open | pending | closed");
    data.status = status;
  }
  const priority = str(body, "priority");
  if (priority != null) {
    if (!["low", "normal", "high", "urgent"].includes(priority)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "priority must be low | normal | high | urgent");
    data.priority = priority;
  }
  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "Nothing to update");

  const updated = await db.supportTicket.update({ where: { id }, data });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "ticket.update",
    entityType: "support_ticket",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: ticket.status, priority: ticket.priority, subject: ticket.subject },
    after: data,
  });

  return ok(updated);
});
```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { handle, okPaged, getPagination } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// GET /api/admin/tickets?status=&page=&size=
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const status = url.searchParams.get("status");

  const where: Prisma.SupportTicketWhereInput = status && status !== "all" ? { status } : {};

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.supportTicket.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        messages: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: 1 },
        _count: { select: { messages: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
      skip,
      take,
    }),
    db.supportTicket.count({ where }),
  ]);

  // store names resolved manually (no relation declared on SupportTicket)
  const storeIds = [...new Set(rows.map((t) => t.storeId).filter((x): x is string => !!x))];
  const stores = storeIds.length ? await db.store.findMany({ where: { id: { in: storeIds } }, select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } }) : [];
  const stMap = new Map(stores.map((s) => [s.id, s]));

  const data = rows.map((t) => ({
    ...t,
    store: t.storeId ? stMap.get(t.storeId) ?? null : null,
    lastMessage: t.messages[0] ?? null,
    messageCount: t._count.messages,
    messages: undefined,
    _count: undefined,
  }));
  return okPaged(data, { page, size, total });
});
```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireCap } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { postAdminAdjustment, refreshWalletCache, walletTruth } from "@/lib/ledger";
import { readBody, reqNum, reqStr } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/wallets/[id]/adjust {amountMinor, direction: credit|debit, reason} — T6 (RBAC payouts.manage)
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireCap("payouts.manage");
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = await readBody(req);

  const amountMinor = reqNum(body, "amountMinor", "amountMinor");
  if (amountMinor <= 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "amountMinor must be > 0");
  const direction = reqStr(body, "direction", "direction");
  if (!["credit", "debit"].includes(direction)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "direction must be credit | debit");
  const reason = reqStr(body, "reason", "reason");

  const wallet = await db.wallet.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { seller: true } });
  if (!wallet) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Wallet not found");

  const before = await walletTruth(id);

  const txn = await postAdminAdjustment({
    walletId: id,
    direction: direction as "credit" | "debit",
    amountMinor,
    reason,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
  });

  const after = await refreshWalletCache(id);
  const fresh = await db.wallet.findUnique({ where: { id } });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "wallet.adjust",
    entityType: "wallet",
    entityId: id,
    before: { pendingMinor: before.pendingMinor, availableMinor: before.availableMinor, sellerEmail: wallet.seller.email },
    after: { pendingMinor: after.pendingMinor, availableMinor: after.availableMinor, direction, amountMinor, reason, txnId: txn.id },
  });

  return ok({ wallet: fresh, txnId: txn.id, before, after });
});
```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { refreshWalletCache } from "@/lib/ledger";

// GET /api/admin/wallets — wallets w/ seller + store names, truth-refreshed balances
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const wallets = await db.wallet.findMany({
    include: {
      seller: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          email: true,
          displayName: true,
          fullName: true,
          status: true,
          riskTier: true,
          store: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, status: true } },
        },
      },
    },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
  });

  const data = [];
  for (const w of wallets) {
    const truth = await refreshWalletCache(w.id);
    data.push({
      ...w,
      pendingMinor: truth.pendingMinor,
      availableMinor: truth.availableMinor,
      lifetimeEarnedMinor: truth.lifetimeEarnedMinor,
      lifetimeCommissionMinor: truth.lifetimeCommissionMinor,
      storeName: w.seller.store?.name ?? null,
      storeSlug: w.seller.store?.slug ?? null,
    });
  }
  return ok(data);
});
```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, auditAdmin } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/admin/webhook-deliveries/[id]/replay — simulate a successful retry
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest, ctx: Ctx) => {
  const admin = await requireAdmin();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const delivery = await db.webhookDelivery.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { endpoint: { include: { store: true } } } });
  if (!delivery) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Webhook delivery not found");

  const updated = await db.webhookDelivery.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { attempts: delivery.attempts + 1, status: "success", responseCode: 200, lastAttemptAt: new Date() },
  });

  await auditAdmin({
    adminId: admin.id,
    adminEmail: admin.email,
    action: "webhook_delivery.replay",
    entityType: "webhook_delivery",
    entityId: id,
    before: { status: delivery.status, attempts: delivery.attempts, event: delivery.event, endpointUrl: delivery.endpoint.url },
    after: { status: "success", attempts: delivery.attempts + 1, responseCode: 200 },
  });

  return ok(updated);
});
```

```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { handle, ok } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { parseMaybeJson } from "@/app/api/admin/_helpers";

// GET /api/admin/webhook-deliveries — deliveries joined with endpoint + store
export const GET = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  await requireAdmin();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const status = url.searchParams.get("status");

  const rows = await db.webhookDelivery.findMany({
    where: status && status !== "all" ? { status } : {},
    include: {
      endpoint: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          url: true,
          isActive: true,
          store: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } },
        },
      },
    },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: 200,
  });

  const data = rows.map((d) => ({
    id: d.id,
    event: d.event,
    status: d.status,
    attempts: d.attempts,
    responseCode: d.responseCode,
    lastAttemptAt: d.lastAttemptAt,
    createdAt: d.createdAt,
    payload: parseMaybeJson<unknown>(d.payloadJson, null),
    endpointUrl: d.endpoint.url,
    endpointActive: d.endpoint.isActive,
    storeName: d.endpoint.store.name,
    storeSlug: d.endpoint.store.slug,
  }));
  return ok(data);
});

```
```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { verifyPassword } from "@/lib/password";
import { createSession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { handle, ok, fail, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";

// POST /api/auth/login { email, password, portal: "admin" | "seller" }
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const body = (await req.json()) as { email?: string; password?: string; portal?: "admin" | "seller" };
  const email = (body.email ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const password = body.password ?? "";
  const portal = body.portal === "admin" ? "admin" : "seller";
  if (!email || !password) return fail(400, "VALIDATION", "Email and password are required");

  if (portal === "admin") {
    const admin = await db.adminUser.findUnique({ where: { email } });
    if (!admin || !admin.isActive || !verifyPassword(password, admin.passwordHash)) {
      return fail(401, "INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Invalid admin credentials");
    }
    await db.adminUser.update({ where: { id: admin.id }, data: { lastLoginAt: new Date() } });
    await createSession("admin", admin.id);
    await logActivity({ actorType: "admin", actorId: admin.id, actorLabel: admin.email, action: "admin.login" });
    return ok({ userType: "admin", admin: { id: admin.id, email: admin.email, name: admin.name, role: admin.role } });
  }

  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({ where: { email } });
  if (!seller || !verifyPassword(password, seller.passwordHash)) {
    return fail(401, "INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Invalid seller credentials");
  }
  if (seller.status === "terminated") {
    return fail(403, "ACCOUNT_TERMINATED", "This account has been terminated");
  }
  await createSession("seller", seller.id);
  await logActivity({ actorType: "seller", actorId: seller.id, actorLabel: seller.email, action: "seller.login" });
  const store = await db.store.findUnique({ where: { sellerId: seller.id } });
  return ok({
    userType: "seller",
    seller: {
      id: seller.id, email: seller.email, fullName: seller.fullName, displayName: seller.displayName,
      status: seller.status, storeId: store?.id ?? null, storeSlug: store?.slug ?? null, storeName: store?.name ?? null,
    },
  });
});

```

```
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSession, requireAdmin, requireSeller } from "@/lib/auth";
import { handle, ok } from "@/lib/api";

export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const sess = await getSession();
  if (!sess) return ok({ userType: null });
  if (sess.userType === "admin") {
    const admin = await requireAdmin();
    return ok({ userType: "admin", admin });
  }
  const seller = await requireSeller();
  return ok({ userType: "seller", seller });
});

```
```
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { hashPassword } from "@/lib/password";
import { createSession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { handle, ok, fail, slugify, logActivity, notify } from "@/lib/api";
import { defaultHomeSections, defaultPageSections, toJson } from "@/lib/sections";
import { ensureWalletAccounts } from "@/lib/ledger";

// POST /api/auth/register — seller self-service signup (M02)
// Creates: seller (status=onboarding) + draft store w/ default template pages + wallet.
export const POST = handle(async (req: NextRequest) => {
  const body = (await req.json()) as {
    email?: string; password?: string; fullName?: string; displayName?: string;
    countryCode?: string; storeName?: string; storeSlug?: string; phone?: string;
  };
  const email = (body.email ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const password = body.password ?? "";
  const fullName = (body.fullName ?? "").trim();
  const displayName = (body.displayName ?? "").trim() || fullName;
  const storeName = (body.storeName ?? "").trim() || `${displayName}'s Store`;

  if (!email.includes("@")) return fail(400, "VALIDATION", "A valid email is required");
  if (password.length < 8) return fail(400, "VALIDATION", "Password must be at least 8 characters");
  if (!fullName) return fail(400, "VALIDATION", "Full name is required");

  const exists = await db.seller.findUnique({ where: { email } });
  if (exists) return fail(409, "EMAIL_TAKEN", "An account with this email already exists");

  // unique slug
  let slug = slugify(body.storeSlug || storeName) || `store-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
  let attempt = 0;
  while (await db.store.findUnique({ where: { slug } })) {
    attempt += 1;
    slug = `${slugify(body.storeSlug || storeName) || "store"}-${attempt}`;
    if (attempt > 50) {
      slug = `store-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
      break;
    }
  }

  const result = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const seller = await tx.seller.create({
      data: {
        email,
        passwordHash: hashPassword(password),
        fullName,
        displayName,
        countryCode: body.countryCode ?? "MY",
        phone: body.phone ?? null,
        status: "onboarding",
      },
    });
    const store = await tx.store.create({
      data: {
        sellerId: seller.id,
        name: storeName,
        slug,
        tagline: "New on SHOPMESH",
        status: "draft",
      },
    });
    const wallet = await tx.wallet.create({ data: { sellerId: seller.id } });
    // default pages — a publishable store in <60s (PART 1 §1.5)
    const homeSections = defaultHomeSections(storeName, "New on SHOPMESH");
    await tx.cmsPage.create({
      data: {
        storeId: store.id,
        slug: "home",
        title: "Home",
        pageType: "home",
        draftJson: toJson({ sections: homeSections, version: 1 }),
        draftVersion: 1,
      },
    });
    for (const p of [
      { slug: "about", title: "About Us", pageType: "about" },
      { slug: "contact", title: "Contact", pageType: "contact" },
      { slug: "policies", title: "Policies", pageType: "policy" },
    ]) {
      await tx.cmsPage.create({
        data: {
          storeId: store.id,
          slug: p.slug,
          title: p.title,
          pageType: p.pageType,
          draftJson: toJson({ sections: defaultPageSections(p.pageType, storeName), version: 1 }),
          draftVersion: 1,
        },
      });
    }
    return { seller, store, wallet };
  });

  await ensureWalletAccounts(result.wallet.id);
  await logActivity({ actorType: "seller", actorId: result.seller.id, actorLabel: email, action: "seller.register", entityType: "store", entityId: result.store.id, meta: { slug } });
  await notify({ event: "seller.registered", channel: "email", recipient: "admin@shopmesh.io", subject: "New seller registered" });
  await createSession("seller", result.seller.id);

  return ok(
    {
      userType: "seller",
      seller: {
        id: result.seller.id, email, fullName, displayName, status: "onboarding",
        storeId: result.store.id, storeSlug: slug, storeName,
      },
    },
    { status: 201 }
  );
});

```

```
// Cart helpers — cookie token "sm_cart", one cart per store (Task 2-b scope).
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { randomToken } from "@/lib/password";

export const CART_COOKIE = "sm_cart";
const CART_TTL_S = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30; // 30 days
const FALLBACK_IMG = "/api/img/fallback?w=600&h=600";

export async function getCartToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  const store = await cookies();
  return store.get(CART_COOKIE)?.value ?? null;
}

export async function setCartToken(token: string): Promise<void> {
  const store = await cookies();
  store.set(CART_COOKIE, token, {
    httpOnly: false,
    sameSite: "lax",
    path: "/",
    maxAge: CART_TTL_S,
  });
}

export async function findCartByToken(token: string | null) {
  if (!token) return null;
  return db.cart.findUnique({
    where: { token },
    include: {
      items: {
        include: {
          variant: {
            include: {
              product: {
                include: {
                  store: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, status: true } },
                  images: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" }, take: 1 },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      },
    },
  });
}

export async function createCart(storeId: string) {
  return db.cart.create({ data: { token: randomToken(16), storeId } });
}

type CartWithItems = NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof findCartByToken>>>;

export function shapeCart(cart: CartWithItems | null) {
  if (!cart) {
    return { id: null, storeSlug: null, storeName: null, storeId: null, items: [] };
  }
  return {
    id: cart.id,
    storeId: cart.storeId,
    storeSlug: cart.items[0]?.variant.product.store.slug ?? null,
    storeName: cart.items[0]?.variant.product.store.name ?? null,
    items: cart.items.map((it) => {
      const v = it.variant;
      const p = v.product;
      const variantLabel = [v.optionName, v.optionValue].filter(Boolean).join(": ") || v.name;
      return {
        id: it.id,
        variantId: v.id,
        productId: p.id,
        title: p.title,
        productSlug: p.slug,
        variantLabel,
        unitPriceMinor: v.priceMinor,
        compareAtPriceMinor: v.compareAtPriceMinor,
        qty: it.qty,
        stock: v.stock,
        lineTotalMinor: v.priceMinor * it.qty,
        imageUrl: p.images[0]?.url ?? FALLBACK_IMG,
        storeSlug: p.store.slug,
        storeName: p.store.name,
      };
    }),
  };
}

/** Validate a variant for adding to cart: variant + product active, store live. */
export async function loadAddableVariant(variantId: string) {
  const variant = await db.productVariant.findUnique({
    where: { id: variantId },
    include: {
      product: {
        include: { store: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, status: true } } },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!variant || !variant.isActive) return null;
  if (variant.product.status !== "active") return null;
  if (variant.product.store.status !== "live") return null;
  return variant;
}

```

```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { findCartByToken, getCartToken, shapeCart } from "../../cart";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

async function requireCartItem(cartId: string | null, itemId: string) {
  if (!cartId) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Cart is empty");
  const item = await db.cartItem.findUnique({ where: { id: itemId }, include: { variant: { include: { product: true } } } });
  if (!item || item.cartId !== cartId) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Cart item not found");
  return item;
}

// PATCH /api/cart/items/[id] {qty} — qty 0 removes the item.
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const qty = Math.round(Number(body.qty));
  if (!Number.isFinite(qty) || qty < 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "qty must be >= 0");
  if (qty > 99) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "qty cannot exceed 99");

  const token = await getCartToken();
  const cart = await findCartByToken(token);
  const item = await requireCartItem(cart?.id ?? null, id);

  if (qty === 0) {
    await db.cartItem.delete({ where: { id: item.id } });
  } else {
    await db.cartItem.update({ where: { id: item.id }, data: { qty } });
  }

  const fresh = token ? await findCartByToken(token) : null;
  return ok({ cart: shapeCart(fresh) });
});

// DELETE /api/cart/items/[id]
export const DELETE = handle(async (_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const token = await getCartToken();
  const cart = await findCartByToken(token);
  const item = await requireCartItem(cart?.id ?? null, id);

  await db.cartItem.delete({ where: { id: item.id } });

  const fresh = token ? await findCartByToken(token) : null;
  return ok({ cart: shapeCart(fresh) });
});
```

## FILE: src/app/api/cart/items/route.ts
```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { createCart, findCartByToken, getCartToken, loadAddableVariant, setCartToken, shapeCart } from "../cart";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/cart/items {variantId, qty>0} — add item; cart is locked to one store.
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const variantId = String(body.variantId ?? "");
  const qty = Math.round(Number(body.qty ?? 1));
  if (!variantId) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "variantId is required");
  if (!Number.isFinite(qty) || qty <= 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "qty must be a positive integer");
  if (qty > 99) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "qty cannot exceed 99");

  const variant = await loadAddableVariant(variantId);
  if (!variant) throw new ApiError(400, "VARIANT_UNAVAILABLE", "This item is not available for purchase");
  const storeId = variant.product.store.id;

  const token = await getCartToken();
  let cart = await findCartByToken(token);

  // One cart per store: switching stores replaces the cart.
  if (cart && cart.storeId !== storeId) {
    await db.cart.delete({ where: { id: cart.id } }).catch(() => null);
    cart = null;
  }
  if (!cart) {
    cart = await createCart(storeId);
    cart = (await findCartByToken(cart.token))!;
  }
  await setCartToken(cart.token);

  // Merge duplicates: same variant → increment qty (capped at 99).
  const existing = cart.items.find((it) => it.variantId === variant.id);
  if (existing) {
    await db.cartItem.update({
      where: { id: existing.id },
      data: { qty: Math.min(99, existing.qty + qty) },
    });
  } else {
    await db.cartItem.create({ data: { cartId: cart.id, variantId: variant.id, qty } });
  }

  const fresh = await findCartByToken(cart.token);
  return ok({ cart: shapeCart(fresh) }, { status: 201 });
});

```

```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, nextOrderNumber, notify, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { computePricing } from "../pricing";
import { computeOrderCommissions } from "@/lib/commission";
import { randomToken } from "@/lib/password";
import { toJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const KNOWN_PROVIDERS = ["fpx_toyyibpay", "fpx_curlec", "tng", "grabpay", "card_stripe"];

// POST /api/checkout/create — header Idempotency-Key REQUIRED.
// Server recomputes ALL money math; stock + salesCount updated here (NOT in webhook).
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const idemKey = req.headers.get("Idempotency-Key")?.trim();
  if (!idemKey) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED", "Idempotency-Key header is required");
  }

  // Idempotent replay: same key → return the original order.
  const existing = await db.order.findUnique({
    where: { idemKey },
    include: { paymentIntents: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: 1 } },
  });
  if (existing) {
    return ok({
      orderNumber: existing.orderNumber,
      orderPaymentRef: existing.paymentIntents[0]?.providerRef ?? null,
      totalMinor: existing.totalMinor,
      status: existing.status,
      duplicate: true,
    });
  }

  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const storeSlug = String(body.storeSlug ?? "");
  const store = await db.store.findUnique({ where: { slug: storeSlug } });
  if (!store || store.status !== "live") throw new ApiError(404, "STORE_NOT_FOUND", "Store not found");

  const customer = (body.customer ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const customerName = String(customer.name ?? "").trim();
  const customerEmail = String(customer.email ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const customerPhone = customer.phone != null ? String(customer.phone).trim() : null;
  if (!customerName) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "customer.name is required");
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(customerEmail)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "customer.email is invalid");

  const provider = String(body.provider ?? "fpx_toyyibpay");
  if (!KNOWN_PROVIDERS.includes(provider)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_PROVIDER", `provider must be one of: ${KNOWN_PROVIDERS.join(", ")}`);
  }

  const shippingAddress = body.shippingAddress ?? {};
  const shippingAddressJson = typeof shippingAddress === "string" ? toJson({ address: shippingAddress }) : toJson(shippingAddress);

  // Recompute totals EXACTLY like quote — never trust client numbers.
  const pricing = await computePricing({
    storeId: store.id,
    items: (body.items ?? []) as { variantId: string; qty: number }[],
    couponCode: body.couponCode != null ? String(body.couponCode) : null,
    shippingRateId: body.shippingRateId != null ? String(body.shippingRateId) : null,
  });

  const comm = await computeOrderCommissions({
    sellerId: store.sellerId,
    items: pricing.lines.map((l) => ({
      productId: l.productId,
      categoryId: l.categoryId,
      title: l.title,
      variantLabel: l.variantLabel,
      unitPriceMinor: l.unitPriceMinor,
      qty: l.qty,
    })),
    orderDiscountMinor: pricing.discountMinor,
    shippingMinorTotal: pricing.shippingMinor,
  });

  const orderNumber = await nextOrderNumber();
  const providerRef = `ref_${randomToken(8)}`;
  const now = new Date();
  const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + 30 * 60 * 1000);

  const { order, intent } = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Re-validate stock inside the transaction (guards concurrent checkouts).
    for (const line of pricing.lines) {
      const v = await tx.productVariant.findUnique({ where: { id: line.variantId } });
      if (!v || !v.isActive || v.stock < line.qty) {
        throw new ApiError(409, "OUT_OF_STOCK", `Insufficient stock for "${line.title}"${line.variantLabel ? ` (${line.variantLabel})` : ""}`);
      }
    }

    const order = await tx.order.create({
      data: {
        storeId: store.id,
        orderNumber,
        customerName,
        customerEmail,
        customerPhone,
        status: "payment_pending",
        channel: "storefront",
        currency: store.currency,
        subtotalMinor: pricing.subtotalMinor,
        discountMinor: pricing.discountMinor,
        shippingMinor: pricing.shippingMinor,
        totalMinor: pricing.totalMinor,
        couponCode: pricing.coupon.valid ? pricing.coupon.code : null,
        shippingAddressJson,
        customerNote: body.customerNote != null ? String(body.customerNote) : null,
        paymentProvider: provider,
        idemKey,
      },
    });

    await tx.orderItem.createMany({
      data: pricing.lines.map((l, i) => {
        const c = comm.items[i];
        return {
          orderId: order.id,
          productId: l.productId,
          variantId: l.variantId,
          title: l.title,
          variantLabel: l.variantLabel,
          unitPriceMinor: l.unitPriceMinor,
          qty: l.qty,
          lineSubtotalMinor: l.lineTotalMinor,
          discountMinor: c.discountMinor,
          shippingMinor: c.shippingMinor,
          commissionPercent: c.percent,
          commissionMinor: c.commissionMinor,
          fixedFeeMinor: c.fixedFeeMinor,
          sellerNetMinor: c.sellerNetMinor,
          breakdownJson: toJson(c.breakdown),
        };
      }),
    });

    // Stock + sales move AT CHECKOUT (per contract) — never repeated in webhook.
    for (const line of pricing.lines) {
      await tx.productVariant.update({ where: { id: line.variantId }, data: { stock: { decrement: line.qty } } });
      await tx.inventoryLog.create({
        data: { variantId: line.variantId, delta: -line.qty, reason: `order:${orderNumber}`, refId: order.id },
      });
      if (line.productId) {
        await tx.product.update({ where: { id: line.productId }, data: { salesCount: { increment: line.qty } } });
      }
    }

    const intent = await tx.paymentIntent.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        provider,
        providerRef,
        amountMinor: pricing.totalMinor,
        status: "requires_payment",
        redirectUrl: `/pay/${providerRef}`,
        expiresAt,
      },
    });

    await tx.orderStatusHistory.create({
      data: { orderId: order.id, fromStatus: null, toStatus: "payment_pending", actor: "shopper", note: `Checkout via ${provider}` },
    });

    if (pricing.coupon.valid && pricing.coupon.couponId) {
      await tx.couponRedemption.create({
        data: {
          couponId: pricing.coupon.couponId,
          orderId: order.id,
          customerEmail,
          discountMinor: pricing.discountMinor,
        },
      });
      await tx.coupon.update({ where: { id: pricing.coupon.couponId }, data: { timesUsed: { increment: 1 } } });
    }

    return { order, intent };
  });

  await notify({
    event: "order.created",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: "admin@shopmesh.io",
    subject: `New order ${order.orderNumber} — ${store.name}`,
  });
  await logActivity({
    actorType: "shopper",
    action: "order.created",
    entityType: "order",
    entityId: order.id,
    meta: { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, storeSlug: store.slug, totalMinor: order.totalMinor },
  });

  return ok(
    {
      orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
      orderPaymentRef: intent.providerRef,
      totalMinor: order.totalMinor,
      redirectUrl: intent.redirectUrl,
      status: order.status,
    },
    { status: 201 }
  );
});

```
```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { hmacSha256Hex } from "@/lib/password";
import { processPaymentWebhook, WEBHOOK_SECRET } from "../../../../webhooks/payments/process";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/checkout/payments/[ref]/simulate {result: "succeeded"|"failed"}
// SANDBOX MOCK (public): the server signs the webhook payload itself and runs the
// exact same verification+processing pipeline as /api/webhooks/payments/[provider].
// The HMAC secret never reaches the client.
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ ref: string }> }) => {
  const { ref } = await ctx.params;
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const result = String(body.result ?? "succeeded");
  if (!["succeeded", "failed"].includes(result)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", 'result must be "succeeded" or "failed"');
  }

  const intent = await db.paymentIntent.findUnique({ where: { providerRef: ref } });
  if (!intent) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Payment not found");

  const eventType = result === "succeeded" ? "payment.succeeded" : "payment.failed";
  const ts = Date.now();
  const payload = { providerRef: ref, eventType, amountMinor: intent.amountMinor, ts };

  // Server-side signature — same MAC the gateway would send.
  const sig = hmacSha256Hex(WEBHOOK_SECRET, `${ref}.${eventType}.${intent.amountMinor}.${ts}`);

  const outcome = await processPaymentWebhook({
    provider: intent.provider,
    body: { ...payload, sig },
    rawBody: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });

  return ok({ status: outcome.intentStatus, orderNumber: outcome.orderNumber });
});
```

## FILE: src/app/api/checkout/pricing.ts
```
// ============================================================================
// Checkout pricing engine (shared by /api/checkout/quote and /api/checkout/create).
// Server-side recompute of unit prices, shipping, coupons — client totals NEVER trusted.
// ============================================================================
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";

export const FREE_SHIP_THRESHOLD_MINOR = 10000; // RM 100

export const SHIPPING_RATES: Record<string, { label: string; amountMinor: number; freeOverSubtotal: boolean }> = {
  standard: { label: "Standard (2-4 working days)", amountMinor: 800, freeOverSubtotal: true },
  express: { label: "Express (1-2 working days)", amountMinor: 1500, freeOverSubtotal: false },
};

export type QuoteItemInput = { variantId: string; qty: number };

export type PricedLine = {
  variantId: string;
  productId: string | null;
  categoryId: string | null;
  title: string;
  variantLabel: string | null;
  qty: number;
  unitPriceMinor: number;
  compareAtPriceMinor: number | null;
  lineTotalMinor: number;
  stock: number;
};

/** Validate + price cart items against a store. Throws ApiError on any invalid line. */
export async function priceItems(storeId: string, items: QuoteItemInput[]): Promise<PricedLine[]> {
  if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "EMPTY_CART", "At least one item is required");
  }
  const variantIds = items.map((i) => String(i.variantId));
  const variants = await db.productVariant.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: variantIds } },
    include: { product: { select: { id: true, title: true, status: true, storeId: true, categoryId: true } } },
  });
  const byId = new Map(variants.map((v) => [v.id, v]));
  const lines: PricedLine[] = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    const qty = Math.floor(Number(item.qty));
    if (!Number.isFinite(qty) || qty <= 0) {
      throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_QTY", "Quantity must be a positive integer");
    }
    const v = byId.get(String(item.variantId));
    if (!v || !v.isActive || v.product.status !== "active" || v.product.storeId !== storeId) {
      throw new ApiError(400, "VARIANT_INVALID", "One of the items is unavailable in this store");
    }
    const variantLabel = [v.optionName, v.optionValue].filter(Boolean).join(": ") || null;
    lines.push({
      variantId: v.id,
      productId: v.product.id,
      categoryId: v.product.categoryId,
      title: v.product.title,
      variantLabel,
      qty,
      unitPriceMinor: v.priceMinor,
      compareAtPriceMinor: v.compareAtPriceMinor ?? null,
      lineTotalMinor: v.priceMinor * qty,
      stock: v.stock,
    });
  }
  return lines;
}

export type CouponVerdict = {
  code: string;
  valid: boolean;
  reason?: string;
  discountMinor: number;
  freeShip: boolean;
  couponId: string | null;
};

/** Validate a coupon for a store + subtotal. Store coupons only valid for their store. */
export async function evaluateCoupon(
  storeId: string,
  rawCode: string | null | undefined,
  subtotalMinor: number,
  shippingMinor: number
): Promise<CouponVerdict> {
  const code = (rawCode ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!code) return { code: "", valid: false, reason: "No coupon provided", discountMinor: 0, freeShip: false, couponId: null };
  const coupon = await db.coupon.findUnique({ where: { code } });
  if (!coupon || !coupon.isActive) return { code, valid: false, reason: "Coupon not found or inactive", discountMinor: 0, freeShip: false, couponId: null };
  if (coupon.scope === "store" && coupon.storeId !== storeId) {
    return { code, valid: false, reason: "Coupon not valid for this store", discountMinor: 0, freeShip: false, couponId: null };
  }
  const now = new Date();
  if (coupon.startsAt && coupon.startsAt > now) return { code, valid: false, reason: "Coupon not started yet", discountMinor: 0, freeShip: false, couponId: null };
  if (coupon.endsAt && coupon.endsAt < now) return { code, valid: false, reason: "Coupon expired", discountMinor: 0, freeShip: false, couponId: null };
  if (coupon.minSpendMinor > subtotalMinor) {
    return { code, valid: false, reason: `Minimum spend not met`, discountMinor: 0, freeShip: false, couponId: null };
  }
  if (coupon.maxRedemptions != null && coupon.timesUsed >= coupon.maxRedemptions) {
    return { code, valid: false, reason: "Coupon redemption limit reached", discountMinor: 0, freeShip: false, couponId: null };
  }
  let discountMinor = 0;
  let freeShip = false;
  if (coupon.type === "percent") {
    const percent = coupon.percent ?? 0;
    discountMinor = Math.floor((subtotalMinor * percent) / 100);
  } else if (coupon.type === "fixed") {
    discountMinor = Math.min(coupon.amountMinor ?? 0, subtotalMinor);
  } else if (coupon.type === "freeship") {
    freeShip = true;
    discountMinor = 0;
  }
  if (freeShip) shippingMinor = 0;
  return { code, valid: true, discountMinor, freeShip, couponId: coupon.id };
}

export type PricingResult = {
  lines: PricedLine[];
  subtotalMinor: number;
  discountMinor: number;
  shippingMinor: number;
  totalMinor: number;
  shippingRateId: string;
  coupon: CouponVerdict;
};

/** Full pricing pipeline: items + shipping + coupon → totals. */
export async function computePricing(input: {
  storeId: string;
  items: QuoteItemInput[];
  couponCode?: string | null;
  shippingRateId?: string | null;
}): Promise<PricingResult> {
  const lines = await priceItems(input.storeId, input.items);
  const subtotalMinor = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.lineTotalMinor, 0);
  const rateId = input.shippingRateId && SHIPPING_RATES[input.shippingRateId] ? input.shippingRateId : "standard";
  let shippingMinor = SHIPPING_RATES[rateId].amountMinor;
  if (SHIPPING_RATES[rateId].freeOverSubtotal && subtotalMinor >= FREE_SHIP_THRESHOLD_MINOR) shippingMinor = 0;
  const coupon = await evaluateCoupon(input.storeId, input.couponCode ?? null, subtotalMinor, shippingMinor);
  if (coupon.freeShip) shippingMinor = 0;
  const discountMinor = Math.min(coupon.discountMinor, subtotalMinor);
  const totalMinor = Math.max(0, subtotalMinor - discountMinor + shippingMinor);
  return { lines, subtotalMinor, discountMinor, shippingMinor, totalMinor, shippingRateId: rateId, coupon };
}
```

```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { computePricing } from "../pricing";
import { computeOrderCommissions } from "@/lib/commission";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/checkout/quote {storeSlug, items:[{variantId, qty}], couponCode?, shippingRateId?}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const storeSlug = String(body.storeSlug ?? "");
  const store = await db.store.findUnique({ where: { slug: storeSlug } });
  if (!store || store.status !== "live") throw new ApiError(404, "STORE_NOT_FOUND", "Store not found");

  const pricing = await computePricing({
    storeId: store.id,
    items: (body.items ?? []) as { variantId: string; qty: number }[],
    couponCode: body.couponCode != null ? String(body.couponCode) : null,
    shippingRateId: body.shippingRateId != null ? String(body.shippingRateId) : null,
  });

  // Optional commission preview (percent parts only, no persistence).
  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({ where: { id: store.sellerId }, select: { id: true } });
  let commissionPreviewMinor = 0;
  if (seller) {
    const comm = await computeOrderCommissions({
      sellerId: seller.id,
      items: pricing.lines.map((l) => ({
        productId: l.productId,
        categoryId: l.categoryId,
        title: l.title,
        variantLabel: l.variantLabel,
        unitPriceMinor: l.unitPriceMinor,
        qty: l.qty,
      })),
      orderDiscountMinor: pricing.discountMinor,
      shippingMinorTotal: pricing.shippingMinor,
    });
    commissionPreviewMinor = comm.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.percentPartMinor, 0);
  }

  return ok({
    subtotalMinor: pricing.subtotalMinor,
    discountMinor: pricing.discountMinor,
    shippingMinor: pricing.shippingMinor,
    totalMinor: pricing.totalMinor,
    shippingRateId: pricing.shippingRateId,
    coupon: pricing.coupon.valid
      ? { code: pricing.coupon.code, valid: true, discountMinor: pricing.coupon.discountMinor, freeShip: pricing.coupon.freeShip }
      : { code: pricing.coupon.code, valid: false, reason: pricing.coupon.reason ?? "Invalid coupon" },
    items: pricing.lines.map((l) => ({
      title: l.title,
      variantLabel: l.variantLabel,
      qty: l.qty,
      unitPriceMinor: l.unitPriceMinor,
      lineTotalMinor: l.lineTotalMinor,
    })),
    commissionPreviewMinor,
  });
});

```
```
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

// Deterministic SVG placeholder image service: /api/img/{seed}?w=800&h=600&label=Ceramic+Vase
const PALETTES: [string, string][] = [
  ["#134e4a", "#14b8a6"],
  ["#4c1d95", "#a78bfa"],
  ["#7c2d12", "#fb923c"],
  ["#14532d", "#4ade80"],
  ["#713f12", "#facc15"],
  ["#831843", "#f472b6"],
  ["#1e3a8a", "#60a5fa"],
  ["#3f3f46", "#a1a1aa"],
];

function hashStr(s: string): number {
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
  }
  return h >>> 0;
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest, ctx: { params: Promise<{ seed: string }> }) {
  const { seed } = await ctx.params;
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const w = Math.min(2400, Math.max(40, parseInt(url.searchParams.get("w") ?? "800", 10) || 800));
  const h = Math.min(2400, Math.max(40, parseInt(url.searchParams.get("h") ?? "600", 10) || 600));
  const label = url.searchParams.get("label") ?? seed.replace(/[-_]/g, " ");
  const palette = PALETTES[hashStr(seed) % PALETTES.length];
  const initials = label
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((p) => p.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join("");
  const fs = Math.round(Math.min(w, h) / 5);
  const dotR = hashStr(label) % 4;
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${w}" height="${h}" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${palette[0]}"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${palette[1]}"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="url(#g)"/>
  <circle cx="${w * 0.82}" cy="${h * 0.2}" r="${Math.min(w, h) * (0.18 + dotR * 0.04)}" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.08"/>
  <circle cx="${w * 0.16}" cy="${h * 0.82}" r="${Math.min(w, h) * 0.24}" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
  <text x="50%" y="52%" dominant-baseline="middle" text-anchor="middle" font-family="system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="${fs}" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92">${initials}</text>
  <text x="50%" y="${52 + fs / 2.2}%" text-anchor="middle" font-family="system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif" font-size="${Math.round(fs / 3.4)}" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.75">${label.replace(/[<>&]/g, "")}</text>
</svg>`;
  return new NextResponse(svg, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "image/svg+xml",
      "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=31536000, immutable",
    },
  });
}
```

```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok } from "@/lib/api";
import { productCardInclude, toProductCard, type ProductWithRelations } from "../../_shared/product-card";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// store "marketplace opt-in" lives on the Seller model (schema) — filter through relation.
const liveStore = { is: { status: "live", seller: { is: { marketplaceOptIn: true } } } };

// GET /api/market/home — public marketplace landing payload.
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const [banners, roots, featuredSlots, latest, topStores] = await Promise.all([
    db.marketplaceBanner.findMany({ where: { isActive: true }, orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" }, take: 6 }),
    db.category.findMany({
      where: { parentId: null },
      orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" },
      include: { children: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" } } },
    }),
    db.featuredSlot.findMany({
      where: { isActive: true, product: { status: "active", store: liveStore } },
      include: { product: { include: productCardInclude } },
      orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" },
      take: 8,
    }),
    db.product.findMany({
      where: { status: "active", store: liveStore },
      include: productCardInclude,
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 8,
    }),
    db.store.findMany({
      where: { status: "live" },
      include: { _count: { select: { products: { where: { status: "active" } } } } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      take: 6,
    }),
  ]);

  const categories = roots.map((c) => ({
    id: c.id,
    name: c.name,
    slug: c.slug,
    imageUrl: c.imageUrl,
    children: c.children.map((ch) => ({ id: ch.id, name: ch.name, slug: ch.slug })),
  }));

  return ok({
    banners: banners.map((b) => ({ id: b.id, title: b.title, imageUrl: b.imageUrl, linkUrl: b.linkUrl })),
    categories,
    featured: featuredSlots.map((fs) => toProductCard(fs.product as ProductWithRelations)),
    latest: latest.map((p) => toProductCard(p as ProductWithRelations)),
    topStores: topStores.map((s) => ({
      id: s.id,
      name: s.name,
      slug: s.slug,
      tagline: s.tagline,
      logoUrl: s.logoUrl,
      bannerUrl: s.bannerUrl,
      productCount: s._count.products,
    })),
  });
});

```
```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, okPaged, getPagination } from "@/lib/api";
import { productCardInclude, toProductCard, type ProductWithRelations } from "../../_shared/product-card";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// store "marketplace opt-in" lives on the Seller model (schema) — filter through relation.
const liveStore = { is: { status: "live", seller: { is: { marketplaceOptIn: true } } } };

// GET /api/market/products?search=&category=&sort=newest|price_asc|price_desc|popular&page=&size=
export const GET = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const search = url.searchParams.get("search")?.trim();
  const categorySlug = url.searchParams.get("category")?.trim();
  const sort = url.searchParams.get("sort") ?? "newest";

  const where: Record<string, unknown> = { status: "active", store: liveStore };

  if (search) where.title = { contains: search };

  if (categorySlug) {
    const cat = await db.category.findUnique({ where: { slug: categorySlug } });
    if (cat) {
      const children = await db.category.findMany({ where: { parentId: cat.id }, select: { id: true } });
      where.categoryId = { in: [cat.id, ...children.map((c) => c.id)] };
    } else {
      where.categoryId = "__none__";
    }
  }

  let orderBy: Record<string, string> = { createdAt: "desc" };
  if (sort === "price_asc") orderBy = { priceMinor: "asc" };
  else if (sort === "price_desc") orderBy = { priceMinor: "desc" };
  else if (sort === "popular") orderBy = { salesCount: "desc" };

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.product.findMany({ where, include: productCardInclude, orderBy, skip, take }),
    db.product.count({ where }),
  ]);

  return okPaged(rows.map((p) => toProductCard(p as ProductWithRelations)), { page, size, total });
});
```

```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/orders/lookup?email=&orderNumber= — guest order tracking.
export const GET = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const email = (url.searchParams.get("email") ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const orderNumber = (url.searchParams.get("orderNumber") ?? "").trim();
  if (!email || !orderNumber) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "email and orderNumber are required");
  }

  const order = await db.order.findUnique({
    where: { orderNumber },
    include: {
      items: { select: { title: true, qty: true } },
      history: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" }, select: { toStatus: true, createdAt: true } },
      store: { select: { name: true } },
    },
  });

  // SQLite has no case-insensitive filter — compare in app layer.
  if (!order || order.customerEmail.toLowerCase() !== email) {
    throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "No order found for that email and order number");
  }

  return ok({
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    status: order.status,
    totalMinor: order.totalMinor,
    storeName: order.store.name,
    createdAt: order.createdAt,
    items: order.items.map((i) => ({ title: i.title, qty: i.qty })),
    history: order.history.map((h) => ({ toStatus: h.toStatus, createdAt: h.createdAt })),
  });
});
```

```
  const email = String(body.email ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "A valid email is required");
  }

  const store = await db.store.findUnique({ where: { slug } });
  if (!store || store.status !== "live") throw new ApiError(404, "STORE_NOT_FOUND", "Store not found");

  await notify({
    event: "newsletter.subscribed",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: email,
    subject: `Welcome to the ${store.name} list`,
  });
  await logActivity({
    actorType: "shopper",
    action: "newsletter.subscribe",
    entityType: "store",
    entityId: store.id,
    meta: { email, storeSlug: store.slug },
  });

  return ok({ subscribed: true });
});
```

```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/sf/[slug]/products/[pSlug]/reviews {customerName, rating 1..5, title?, body?}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ slug: string; pSlug: string }> }) => {
  const { slug, pSlug } = await ctx.params;
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const customerName = String(body.customerName ?? "").trim();
  const rating = Math.round(Number(body.rating));
  if (!customerName) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "customerName is required");
  if (!Number.isFinite(rating) || rating < 1 || rating > 5) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "rating must be an integer between 1 and 5");
  }

  const store = await db.store.findUnique({ where: { slug } });
  if (!store || store.status !== "live") throw new ApiError(404, "STORE_NOT_FOUND", "Store not found");

  const product = await db.product.findFirst({ where: { slug: pSlug, storeId: store.id } });
  if (!product || product.status !== "active") throw new ApiError(404, "PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND", "Product not found");

  const review = await db.review.create({
    data: {
      productId: product.id,
      customerName,
      rating,
      title: body.title != null ? String(body.title) : null,
      body: body.body != null ? String(body.body) : null,
      status: "published",
    },
  });

  // Recompute product rating aggregates from published reviews.
  const agg = await db.review.aggregate({
    where: { productId: product.id, status: "published" },
    _avg: { rating: true },
    _count: { rating: true },
  });
  await db.product.update({
    where: { id: product.id },
    data: {
      ratingAvg: Math.round((agg._avg.rating ?? 0) * 100) / 100,
      ratingCount: agg._count.rating,
    },
  });

  return ok(
    {
      id: review.id,
      customerName: review.customerName,
      rating: review.rating,
      title: review.title,
      body: review.body,
      createdAt: review.createdAt,
      ratingAvg: Math.round((agg._avg.rating ?? 0) * 100) / 100,
      ratingCount: agg._count.rating,
    },
    { status: 201 }
  );
});
```

```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { productCardInclude, toProductCard, minVariant, type ProductWithRelations } from "../../../../_shared/product-card";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/sf/[slug]/products/[pSlug] — full product detail page payload.
export const GET = handle(async (_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ slug: string; pSlug: string }> }) => {
  const { slug, pSlug } = await ctx.params;

  const store = await db.store.findUnique({ where: { slug } });
  if (!store || store.status !== "live") throw new ApiError(404, "STORE_NOT_FOUND", "Store not found");

  const product = await db.product.findFirst({
    where: { slug: pSlug, storeId: store.id },
    include: {
      ...productCardInclude,
      reviews: { where: { status: "published" }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: 20 },
    },
  });
  if (!product || product.status !== "active") throw new ApiError(404, "PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND", "Product not found");

  const related = await db.product.findMany({
    where: { storeId: store.id, status: "active", id: { not: product.id } },
    include: productCardInclude,
    orderBy: { salesCount: "desc" },
    take: 6,
  });

  const mv = minVariant(product.variants);

  return ok({
    product: {
      id: product.id,
      title: product.title,
      slug: product.slug,
      description: product.description,
      priceMinor: mv ? mv.priceMinor : product.priceMinor,
      compareAtPriceMinor: mv?.compareAtPriceMinor ?? null,
      ratingAvg: product.ratingAvg,
      ratingCount: product.ratingCount,
      salesCount: product.salesCount,
      categoryId: product.category?.id ?? null,
      categoryName: product.category?.name ?? null,
      images: product.images.map((i) => i.url),
      variants: product.variants.map((v) => ({
        id: v.id,
        name: v.name,
        optionName: v.optionName,
        optionValue: v.optionValue,
        priceMinor: v.priceMinor,
        compareAtPriceMinor: v.compareAtPriceMinor,
        stock: v.stock,
        sku: v.sku,
        isActive: v.isActive,
      })),
    },
    reviews: product.reviews.map((r) => ({
      id: r.id,
      customerName: r.customerName,
      rating: r.rating,
      title: r.title,
      body: r.body,
      reply: r.reply,
      createdAt: r.createdAt,
    })),
    related: related.map((p) => toProductCard(p as ProductWithRelations)),
    store: {
      id: store.id,
      name: store.name,
      slug: store.slug,
      tagline: store.tagline,
      logoUrl: store.logoUrl,
      whatsapp: store.whatsapp,
    },
  });
});
```
