import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { productCardInclude, toProductCard, type ProductWithRelations } from "../../../_shared/product-card";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/sf/[slug]/products?search=&collection=&source=latest|featured&limit=
export const GET = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) => {
  const { slug } = await ctx.params;
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const search = url.searchParams.get("search")?.trim();
  const collectionSlug = url.searchParams.get("collection")?.trim();
  const source = url.searchParams.get("source") ?? "latest";
  const limit = Math.min(50, Math.max(1, parseInt(url.searchParams.get("limit") ?? "8", 10) || 8));

  const store = await db.store.findUnique({ where: { slug } });
  if (!store || store.status !== "live") throw new ApiError(404, "STORE_NOT_FOUND", "Store not found");

  const where: Record<string, unknown> = { storeId: store.id, status: "active" };
  if (search) where.title = { contains: search };

  if (collectionSlug) {
    const collection = await db.collection.findFirst({ where: { storeId: store.id, slug: collectionSlug } });
    if (!collection) {
      return ok([]);
    }
    const memberships = await db.collectionProduct.findMany({
      where: { collectionId: collection.id },
      select: { productId: true },
    });
    where.id = { in: memberships.map((m) => m.productId) };
  } else if (source === "featured") {
    where.isFeatured = true;
  }

  const orderBy = source === "featured" ? ([{ salesCount: "desc" }, { createdAt: "desc" }] as const) : ({ createdAt: "desc" } as const);

  const products = await db.product.findMany({
    where,
    include: productCardInclude,
    orderBy,
    take: limit,
  });

  return ok(products.map((p) => toProductCard(p as ProductWithRelations)));
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/store/bank-accounts
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { me } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const accounts = await db.bankAccount.findMany({
    where: { sellerId: me.id },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });
  return ok(accounts);
});

// POST /api/store/bank-accounts {holderName, bankName, accountNumber}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const holderName = String(body.holderName ?? "").trim();
  const bankName = String(body.bankName ?? "").trim();
  const accountNumber = String(body.accountNumber ?? "").trim();
  if (!holderName || !bankName || !accountNumber) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "holderName, bankName and accountNumber are required");
  }
  if (!/^[0-9]{4,}$/.test(accountNumber.replace(/\s+/g, ""))) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "accountNumber must be at least 4 digits");
  }

  const clean = accountNumber.replace(/\s+/g, "");
  const last4 = clean.slice(-4);
  const account = await db.bankAccount.create({
    data: {
      sellerId: me.id,
      holderName,
      bankName,
      accountNumberMasked: `****${last4}`,
      accountNumberEnc: `enc:${last4}`,
      verified: false,
    },
  });

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "bank.account.added",
    entityType: "bank_account",
    entityId: account.id,
    meta: { bankName, masked: account.accountNumberMasked },
  });

  return ok(account, { status: 201 });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/store/collections/[id]/products {productIds: []} — replace membership.
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const collection = await db.collection.findFirst({ where: { id, storeId: store.id } });
  if (!collection) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Collection not found");

  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { productIds?: unknown };
  if (!Array.isArray(body.productIds)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "productIds must be an array of product ids");
  }
  const productIds = [...new Set(body.productIds.map((p) => String(p)))].filter(Boolean);

  // Only products owned by this store may join the collection.
  const owned = await db.product.findMany({ where: { id: { in: productIds }, storeId: store.id }, select: { id: true } });
  const ownedIds = owned.map((p) => p.id);

  await db.$transaction([
    db.collectionProduct.deleteMany({ where: { collectionId: collection.id } }),
    ...ownedIds.map((productId) =>
      db.collectionProduct.create({ data: { collectionId: collection.id, productId } })
    ),
  ]);

  return ok({ id: collection.id, slug: collection.slug, productIds: ownedIds });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, slugify } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/store/collections
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const collections = await db.collection.findMany({
    where: { storeId: store.id },
    include: { products: { include: { product: { select: { id: true, title: true, slug: true, priceMinor: true, status: true } } } } },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });
  return ok(
    collections.map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      name: c.name,
      slug: c.slug,
      description: c.description,
      productCount: c.products.length,
      products: c.products.map((cp) => cp.product),
      createdAt: c.createdAt,
    }))
  );
});

// POST /api/store/collections {name, description?}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const name = String(body.name ?? "").trim();
  if (!name) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "name is required");

  const base = slugify(name) || "collection";
  const existing = await db.collection.findMany({ where: { storeId: store.id, slug: { startsWith: base } }, select: { slug: true } });
  const taken = new Set(existing.map((e) => e.slug));
  let slug = base;
  let n = 2;
  while (taken.has(slug)) slug = `${base}-${n++}`;

  const collection = await db.collection.create({
    data: {
      storeId: store.id,
      name,
      slug,
      description: body.description != null ? String(body.description) : null,
    },
  });

  return ok({ ...collection, productCount: 0, products: [] }, { status: 201 });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

async function ownCoupon(storeId: string, id: string) {
  const coupon = await db.coupon.findFirst({ where: { id, storeId } });
  if (!coupon) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Coupon not found");
  return coupon;
}

// PATCH /api/store/coupons/[id]
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const coupon = await ownCoupon(store.id, id);
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.description !== undefined) data.description = body.description == null ? null : String(body.description);
  if (body.percent !== undefined && coupon.type === "percent") {
    const percent = Number(body.percent);
    if (!Number.isFinite(percent) || percent <= 0 || percent > 100) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "percent must be 1..100");
    data.percent = percent;
  }
  if (body.amountMinor !== undefined && coupon.type === "fixed") {
    data.amountMinor = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.amountMinor)));
  }
  if (body.minSpendMinor !== undefined) data.minSpendMinor = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.minSpendMinor)));
  if (body.maxRedemptions !== undefined) data.maxRedemptions = body.maxRedemptions == null ? null : Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(body.maxRedemptions)));
  if (body.startsAt !== undefined) data.startsAt = body.startsAt == null || body.startsAt === "" ? null : new Date(String(body.startsAt));
  if (body.endsAt !== undefined) data.endsAt = body.endsAt == null || body.endsAt === "" ? null : new Date(String(body.endsAt));
  if (body.isActive !== undefined) data.isActive = !!body.isActive;

  const updated = await db.coupon.update({ where: { id: coupon.id }, data });
  return ok(updated);
});

// DELETE /api/store/coupons/[id]
export const DELETE = handle(async (_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const coupon = await ownCoupon(store.id, id);
  await db.coupon.delete({ where: { id: coupon.id } });
  return ok({ id: coupon.id, deleted: true });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function parseDate(v: unknown): Date | null {
  if (v == null || v === "") return null;
  const d = new Date(String(v));
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
}

// GET /api/store/coupons
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const coupons = await db.coupon.findMany({
    where: { storeId: store.id },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });
  return ok(coupons);
});

// POST /api/store/coupons {code, type: percent|fixed|freeship, ...}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const code = String(body.code ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!/^[A-Z0-9_-]{3,24}$/.test(code)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "code must be 3-24 chars (A-Z, 0-9, - or _)");
  }
  const type = String(body.type ?? "percent");
  if (!["percent", "fixed", "freeship"].includes(type)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "type must be percent | fixed | freeship");
  }
  const exists = await db.coupon.findUnique({ where: { code } });
  if (exists) throw new ApiError(409, "CODE_TAKEN", "Coupon code already exists");

  const percent = body.percent != null ? Number(body.percent) : null;
  const amountMinor = body.amountMinor != null ? Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.amountMinor))) : null;
  if (type === "percent" && (percent == null || percent <= 0 || percent > 100)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "percent must be 1..100 for percent coupons");
  }
  if (type === "fixed" && (amountMinor == null || amountMinor <= 0)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "amountMinor must be positive for fixed coupons");
  }

  const coupon = await db.coupon.create({
    data: {
      scope: "store",
      storeId: store.id,
      code,
      description: body.description != null ? String(body.description) : null,
      type,
      percent: type === "percent" ? percent : null,
      amountMinor: type === "fixed" ? amountMinor : null,
      minSpendMinor: body.minSpendMinor != null ? Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.minSpendMinor))) : 0,
      maxRedemptions: body.maxRedemptions != null ? Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(body.maxRedemptions))) : null,
      perCustomerLimit: body.perCustomerLimit != null ? Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(body.perCustomerLimit))) : 1,
      startsAt: parseDate(body.startsAt),
      endsAt: parseDate(body.endsAt),
      isActive: body.isActive === undefined ? true : !!body.isActive,
    },
  });

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "coupon.created",
    entityType: "coupon",
    entityId: coupon.id,
    meta: { code, type },
  });

  return ok(coupon, { status: 201 });
});

```

import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type Card = { orders: number; revenueMinor: number; commissionMinor: number; netMinor: number };

const EMPTY: Card = { orders: 0, revenueMinor: 0, commissionMinor: 0, netMinor: 0 };

function startOfToday(): Date {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return d;
}

// GET /api/store/dashboard — cards, low stock, latest orders, pending actions.
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const now = new Date();
  const t0 = startOfToday();
  const d7 = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 86400000);
  const d30 = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 86400000);

  const paidOrders = await db.order.findMany({
    where: { storeId: store.id, paidAt: { not: null }, paidAt: { gte: d30 } },
    include: { items: { select: { commissionMinor: true } } },
  });

  const cards: Record<string, Card> = { today: { ...EMPTY }, "7d": { ...EMPTY }, "30d": { ...EMPTY } };
  const inWindow = (paidAt: Date, from: Date) => paidAt >= from;
  for (const o of paidOrders) {
    const paidAt = o.paidAt as Date;
    const commission = o.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.commissionMinor, 0);
    const windows: [string, boolean][] = [
      ["today", inWindow(paidAt, t0)],
      ["7d", inWindow(paidAt, d7)],
      ["30d", true],
    ];
    for (const [key, hit] of windows) {
      if (!hit) continue;
      cards[key].orders += 1;
      cards[key].revenueMinor += o.totalMinor;
      cards[key].commissionMinor += commission;
      cards[key].netMinor += o.totalMinor - commission;
    }
  }

  const [lowStock, latestOrders, unfulfilled, refundRequests, pendingProducts] = await Promise.all([
    db.productVariant.findMany({
      where: {
        isActive: true,
        stock: { lte: 100000 },
        product: { is: { storeId: store.id, status: { notIn: ["archived", "banned"] } } },
      },
      include: { product: { select: { id: true, title: true, slug: true, status: true } } },
      orderBy: { stock: "asc" },
      take: 50,
    }),
    db.order.findMany({
      where: { storeId: store.id },
      include: { items: { select: { id: true } } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 5,
    }),
    db.order.count({ where: { storeId: store.id, status: { in: ["paid", "processing"] } } }),
    db.refund.count({ where: { order: { is: { storeId: store.id } }, status: "requested" } }),
    db.product.count({ where: { storeId: store.id, status: "pending_review" } }),
  ]);

  return ok({
    cards,
    lowStock: lowStock
      .filter((v) => v.stock <= v.lowStockThreshold)
      .slice(0, 10)
      .map((v) => ({
        id: v.id,
        name: v.name,
        optionValue: v.optionValue,
        sku: v.sku,
        stock: v.stock,
        lowStockThreshold: v.lowStockThreshold,
        productId: v.product.id,
        productTitle: v.product.title,
      })),
    latestOrders: latestOrders.map((o) => ({
      id: o.id,
      orderNumber: o.orderNumber,
      customerName: o.customerName,
      status: o.status,
      totalMinor: o.totalMinor,
      itemCount: o.items.length,
      createdAt: o.createdAt,
    })),
    pendingActions: {
      unfulfilledPaidOrders: unfulfilled,
      openRefundRequests: refundRequests,
      productsPendingReview: pendingProducts,
    },
  });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, notify, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/store/domains
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const domains = await db.storeDomain.findMany({
    where: { storeId: store.id },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });
  return ok(domains);
});

// POST /api/store/domains {domain, mode: cname|ns}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const domain = String(body.domain ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$/.test(domain)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "domain must be a valid hostname (e.g. shop.example.com)");
  }
  const mode = String(body.mode ?? "cname");
  if (!["cname", "ns"].includes(mode)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "mode must be cname or ns");
  }
  const exists = await db.storeDomain.findUnique({ where: { domain } });
  if (exists) throw new ApiError(409, "DOMAIN_TAKEN", "Domain already connected to a store");

  const record = await db.storeDomain.create({
    data: { storeId: store.id, domain, mode, status: "verifying", sslStatus: "pending" },
  });

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "domain.added",
    entityType: "store_domain",
    entityId: record.id,
    meta: { domain, mode },
  });

  return ok(record, { status: 201 });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { toJson } from "@/lib/json";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { parseJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const PROVIDERS = ["meta_pixel", "ga4", "tiktok_pixel", "gtm"] as const;

// GET /api/store/integrations — all supported providers with current config.
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const rows = await db.storeIntegration.findMany({ where: { storeId: store.id } });
  const byProvider = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.provider, r]));
  const integrations = PROVIDERS.map((provider) => {
    const row = byProvider.get(provider);
    return {
      provider,
      config: row ? parseJson<Record<string, unknown>>(row.configJson, {}) : {},
      isEnabled: row?.isEnabled ?? false,
      updatedAt: row?.updatedAt ?? null,
    };
  });
  return ok(integrations);
});

// PUT /api/store/integrations {provider, config, isEnabled} — upsert per provider.
export const PUT = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const provider = String(body.provider ?? "");
  if (!PROVIDERS.includes(provider as (typeof PROVIDERS)[number])) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", `provider must be one of: ${PROVIDERS.join(", ")}`);
  }
  const config = typeof body.config === "string" ? body.config : toJson(body.config ?? {});
  const isEnabled = body.isEnabled === undefined ? false : !!body.isEnabled;

  const existing = await db.storeIntegration.findUnique({
    where: { storeId_provider: { storeId: store.id, provider } },
  });

  const integration = existing
    ? await db.storeIntegration.update({
        where: { id: existing.id },
        data: { configJson: config, isEnabled },
      })
    : await db.storeIntegration.create({
        data: { storeId: store.id, provider, configJson: config, isEnabled },
      });

  return ok({
    provider: integration.provider,
    config: parseJson<Record<string, unknown>>(integration.configJson, {}),
    isEnabled: integration.isEnabled,
  });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, notify } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/store/inventory/adjust {variantId, delta, reason}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const variantId = String(body.variantId ?? "");
  const delta = Math.round(Number(body.delta));
  const reason = String(body.reason ?? "manual adjustment");
  if (!variantId) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "variantId is required");
  if (!Number.isFinite(delta) || delta === 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "delta must be a non-zero integer");

  const variant = await db.productVariant.findUnique({
    where: { id: variantId },
    include: { product: { select: { storeId: true, title: true } } },
  });
  if (!variant || variant.product.storeId !== store.id) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Variant not found");

  const newStock = variant.stock + delta;
  if (newStock < 0) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", `Stock cannot go below 0 (current ${variant.stock}, delta ${delta})`);
  }

  const [updated] = await db.$transaction([
    db.productVariant.update({ where: { id: variant.id }, data: { stock: newStock } }),
    db.inventoryLog.create({ data: { variantId: variant.id, delta, reason } }),
  ]);

  if (newStock <= variant.lowStockThreshold) {
    await notify({
      event: "stock.low",
      channel: "inapp",
      recipient: me.email,
      subject: `Low stock: ${variant.product.title}${variant.optionValue ? ` (${variant.optionValue})` : ""}`,
    });
  }

  return ok({ id: updated.id, stock: updated.stock, lowStock: newStock <= updated.lowStockThreshold });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { refreshWalletCache } from "@/lib/ledger";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/store/me — seller + store + wallet + onboarding checklist + stats.
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();

  const [sellerRow, productCount, bankVerified, orders30] = await Promise.all([
    db.seller.findUnique({ where: { id: me.id } }),
    db.product.count({ where: { storeId: store.id, status: { not: "archived" } } }),
    db.bankAccount.findFirst({ where: { sellerId: me.id, verified: true } }),
    db.order.findMany({
      where: { storeId: store.id, paidAt: { not: null } },
      select: { totalMinor: true, paidAt: true },
    }),
  ]);

  const checklist = {
    profile: !!(sellerRow?.fullName && sellerRow?.phone),
    storeIdentity: !!(store.name && store.tagline),
    kyc: sellerRow?.kycStatus === "approved",
    bank: !!bankVerified,
    products: productCount > 0,
  };

  let step: string;
  if (sellerRow?.status === "active") step = "done";
  else if (sellerRow?.status === "pending_review") step = "under_review";
  else if (sellerRow?.status === "rejected") step = "rejected";
  else if (sellerRow?.status === "suspended" || sellerRow?.status === "terminated") step = "suspended";
  else if (Object.values(checklist).every(Boolean)) step = "submit";
  else step = "setup";

  const cutoff30 = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86400000);
  const revenue30dMinor = orders30.filter((o) => o.paidAt && o.paidAt >= cutoff30).reduce((s, o) => s + o.totalMinor, 0);

  let wallet = null;
  if (sellerRow) {
    const w = await db.wallet.findUnique({ where: { sellerId: sellerRow.id } });
    if (w) {
      await refreshWalletCache(w.id);
      wallet = await db.wallet.findUnique({ where: { id: w.id } });
    }
  }

  const ordersCount = await db.order.count({ where: { storeId: store.id } });

  return ok({
    seller: {
      id: me.id,
      email: me.email,
      fullName: me.fullName,
      displayName: me.displayName,
      phone: sellerRow?.phone ?? null,
      status: sellerRow?.status ?? me.status,
      kycStatus: sellerRow?.kycStatus ?? null,
      riskTier: sellerRow?.riskTier ?? null,
      planCode: sellerRow?.planCode ?? null,
      marketplaceOptIn: sellerRow?.marketplaceOptIn ?? true,
      submittedAt: sellerRow?.submittedAt ?? null,
      rejectReason: sellerRow?.rejectReason ?? null,
    },
    store: {
      id: store.id,
      name: store.name,
      slug: store.slug,
      tagline: store.tagline,
      logoUrl: store.logoUrl,
      bannerUrl: store.bannerUrl,
      description: store.description,
      status: store.status,
      supportEmail: store.supportEmail,
      supportPhone: store.supportPhone,
      whatsapp: store.whatsapp,
      marketplaceOptIn: store.marketplaceOptIn,
      theme: store.themeJson,
    },
    wallet,
    onboarding: { step, checklist },
    stats: { ordersCount, productCount, revenue30dMinor },
  });
});

import { requireSeller } from "@/lib/auth";

  const me = await requireSeller();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { action?: string };
  if (body.action !== "submit") {
    throw new ApiError(400, "BAD_REQUEST", 'action must be "submit"');

  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({ where: { id: me.id } });
  if (!seller) throw new ApiError(401, "UNAUTHORIZED", "Seller not found");
  if (!["onboarding", "rejected"].includes(seller.status)) {
    throw new ApiError(409, "INVALID_STATUS", `Cannot submit from status '${seller.status}'`);
  }

  const updated = await db.seller.update({
    where: { id: seller.id },
    data: { status: "pending_review", submittedAt: new Date(), rejectReason: null },

  await notify({
    event: "kyc.submitted",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: "admin@shopmesh.io",
    subject: `KYC review requested: ${seller.displayName}`,
  });
  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: seller.id,
    actorLabel: seller.email,
    action: "seller.onboarding.submitted",
    entityType: "seller",
    entityId: seller.id,
  });

  return ok({ status: updated.status, submittedAt: updated.submittedAt });
});

```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, notify, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/store/orders/[id]/refund-request {amountMinor, reason?, restock?}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const amountMinor = Math.round(Number(body.amountMinor));
  if (!Number.isFinite(amountMinor) || amountMinor <= 0) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "amountMinor must be a positive integer");
  }

  const order = await db.order.findFirst({
    where: { OR: [{ id }, { orderNumber: id }], storeId: store.id },
    include: { refunds: true },
  });
  if (!order) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Order not found");

  const refundableStatuses = ["paid", "processing", "shipped", "delivered", "completed"];
  if (!refundableStatuses.includes(order.status)) {
    throw new ApiError(409, "INVALID_STATUS", `Cannot request refund for order in status '${order.status}'`);
  }

  const alreadyRequested = order.refunds.filter((r) => r.status !== "rejected").reduce((s, r) => s + r.amountMinor, 0);
  if (amountMinor > order.totalMinor - alreadyRequested) {
    throw new ApiError(409, "INVALID_AMOUNT", "Refund amount exceeds refundable balance");
  }

  const refund = await db.refund.create({
    data: {
      orderId: order.id,
      amountMinor,
      reason: body.reason != null ? String(body.reason) : null,
      status: "requested",
      requestedBy: "seller",
      restock: body.restock === undefined ? true : !!body.restock,
    },
  });

  await notify({
    event: "refund.requested",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: "admin@shopmesh.io",
    subject: `Refund requested for ${order.orderNumber}`,
  });
  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "refund.requested",
    entityType: "refund",
    entityId: refund.id,
    meta: { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, amountMinor },
  });

  return ok(refund, { status: 201 });
});

```

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, transitionOrder, dispatchStoreWebhooks, notify, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/store/orders/[id]/ship {provider, trackingNumber}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const provider = String(body.provider ?? "").trim();
  const trackingNumber = String(body.trackingNumber ?? "").trim();
  if (!provider || !trackingNumber) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "provider and trackingNumber are required");
  }

  const order = await db.order.findFirst({ where: { OR: [{ id }, { orderNumber: id }], storeId: store.id } });
  if (!order) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Order not found");
  if (!["paid", "processing"].includes(order.status)) {
    throw new ApiError(409, "INVALID_STATUS", `Cannot ship order in status '${order.status}'`);
  }

  await transitionOrder({
    orderId: order.id,
    toStatus: "shipped",
    actor: "seller",
    note: `Shipped via ${provider}: ${trackingNumber}`,
    timestamps: { shippedAt: new Date() },
  });

  const fresh = await db.order.update({
    where: { id: order.id },
    data: { trackingProvider: provider, trackingNumber },
  });

  await dispatchStoreWebhooks({
    storeId: store.id,
    event: "order.shipped",
    payload: { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, tracking: trackingNumber, provider },
  });

  await notify({
    event: "order.shipped",
    channel: "email",
    recipient: order.customerEmail,
    subject: `Your order ${order.orderNumber} has shipped`,
  });

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "order.shipped",
    entityType: "order",
    entityId: order.id,
    meta: { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, provider, trackingNumber },
  });

  return ok({
    id: fresh.id,
    status: fresh.status,
    shippedAt: fresh.shippedAt,
    trackingNumber,
    trackingProvider: provider,
  });
});

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/** Status group filters for seller order views. */
export function statusGroup(group: string): string[] {
  switch (group) {
    case "unpaid":
      return ["payment_pending"];
    case "to_fulfill":
      return ["paid", "processing"];
    case "shipped":
      return ["shipped"];
    case "done":
      return ["delivered", "completed"];
    case "refunds":
      return ["refunding", "partially_refunded", "refunded"];
    case "cancelled":
      return ["cancelled", "closed"];
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

// GET /api/store/orders?status=to_fulfill|shipped|done|refunds|<raw>&search=&page=&size=
export const GET = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const statusParam = url.searchParams.get("status")?.trim();
  const search = url.searchParams.get("search")?.trim();

  const where: Record<string, unknown> = { storeId: store.id };
  if (statusParam && statusParam !== "all") {
    const group = statusGroup(statusParam);
    where.status = group.length > 0 ? { in: group } : statusParam;
  }
  if (search) {
    where.OR = [
      { orderNumber: { contains: search } },
      { customerName: { contains: search } },
      { customerEmail: { contains: search } },
    ];
  }

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.order.findMany({
      where,
      include: { items: { select: { id: true } } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      skip,
      take,
    }),
    db.order.count({ where }),
  ]);

  return okPaged(
    rows.map((o) => ({
      id: o.id,
      orderNumber: o.orderNumber,
      customerName: o.customerName,
      customerEmail: o.customerEmail,
      status: o.status,
      channel: o.channel,
      totalMinor: o.totalMinor,
      currency: o.currency,
      itemCount: o.items.length,
      trackingNumber: o.trackingNumber,
      createdAt: o.createdAt,
      paidAt: o.paidAt,
      shippedAt: o.shippedAt,
    })),
    { page, size, total }
  );
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { newSectionId, parsePageDoc } from "@/lib/sections";
import { toJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

async function ownPage(storeId: string, id: string) {
  const page = await db.cmsPage.findFirst({ where: { id, storeId } });
  if (!page) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Page not found");
  return page;
}

// PUT /api/store/pages/[id]/draft {sections: [{id, type, props}]}
export const PUT = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const page = await ownPage(store.id, id);
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { sections?: unknown };

  if (!Array.isArray(body.sections)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "sections must be an array");
  }
  const sections = (body.sections as Record<string, unknown>[]).map((s) => ({
    id: s.id ? String(s.id) : newSectionId(),
    type: String(s.type ?? "rich_text"),
    props: (s.props ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>,
  }));

  const doc = { sections, version: page.draftVersion + 1 };
  const updated = await db.cmsPage.update({
    where: { id: page.id },
    data: {
      draftJson: toJson(doc),
      draftVersion: page.draftVersion + 1,
      hasUnpublished: true,
    },
  });

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "store.page.draft_saved",
    entityType: "cms_page",
    entityId: page.id,
    meta: { slug: page.slug, version: updated.draftVersion, sections: sections.length },
  });

  return ok({
    id: updated.id,
    slug: updated.slug,
    draftVersion: updated.draftVersion,
    hasUnpublished: updated.hasUnpublished,
    doc: parsePageDoc(updated.draftJson),
  });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { parsePageDoc } from "@/lib/sections";
import { toJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/store/pages/[id]/revert — discard draft, restore published into draft.
export const POST = handle(async (_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const page = await db.cmsPage.findFirst({ where: { id, storeId: store.id } });
  if (!page) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Page not found");
  if (!page.publishedJson) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "NEVER_PUBLISHED", "Page has never been published — nothing to revert to");
  }

  // Keep the draft version counter monotonic while restoring published content.
  const published = parsePageDoc(page.publishedJson);
  const updated = await db.cmsPage.update({
    where: { id: page.id },
    data: {
      draftJson: toJson({ sections: published.sections, version: page.draftVersion }),
      hasUnpublished: false,
    },
  });

  return ok({
    id: updated.id,
    slug: updated.slug,
    draftVersion: updated.draftVersion,
    hasUnpublished: updated.hasUnpublished,
    doc: parsePageDoc(updated.draftJson),
  });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { parsePageDoc } from "@/lib/sections";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/store/pages/[id] — full page with parsed draft + published docs.
// Added by Task 2-d (additive, read-only complement to the 2-b pages API):
// the builder needs the raw draft sections, which the list endpoint (summary
// only) and PUT-draft round-trip cannot provide without overwriting the draft.
export const GET = handle(async (_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const page = await db.cmsPage.findFirst({ where: { OR: [{ id }, { slug: id }], storeId: store.id } });
  if (!page) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Page not found");

  return ok({
    page: {
      id: page.id,
      slug: page.slug,
      title: page.title,
      pageType: page.pageType,
      draftVersion: page.draftVersion,
      publishedVersion: page.publishedVersion,
      hasUnpublished: page.hasUnpublished,
      published: !!page.publishedJson && page.publishedVersion > 0,
    },
    draft: parsePageDoc(page.draftJson),
    published: page.publishedJson ? parsePageDoc(page.publishedJson) : null,
  });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { toJson } from "@/lib/json";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { parseJson } from "@/lib/json";
import { matchFlags, ownProduct, recomputePrice, uniqueSlug, validateVariants } from "../helpers";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/store/products/[id]
export const GET = handle(async (_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const product = await ownProduct(store.id, id);
  return ok(product);
});

// PATCH /api/store/products/[id] — update fields; status stays unless resubmitted.
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const product = await ownProduct(store.id, id);
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.title !== undefined) {
    const title = String(body.title).trim();
    if (!title) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "title cannot be empty");
    data.title = title;
    // keep slug stable unless explicitly regenerated
    if (body.regenerateSlug === true) data.slug = await uniqueSlug(store.id, title);
  }
  if (body.description !== undefined) data.description = body.description == null ? null : String(body.description);
  if (body.categoryId !== undefined) {
    const categoryId = body.categoryId == null ? null : String(body.categoryId);
    if (categoryId) {
      const cat = await db.category.findUnique({ where: { id: categoryId } });
      if (!cat) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "Category not found");
    }
    data.categoryId = categoryId;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(body.images)) {
    const images = body.images.map((u) => String(u)).filter(Boolean);
    data.images = { deleteMany: {}, create: images.map((url, i) => ({ url, sortOrder: i })) };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(body.variants)) {
    const incoming = validateVariants(body.variants);
    // Update existing variants in order, create the rest (never delete — orders may reference).
    const existing = [...product.variants];
    const updates = incoming.slice(0, existing.length);
    const creates = incoming.slice(existing.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < updates.length; i++) {
      await db.productVariant.update({ where: { id: existing[i].id }, data: { ...updates[i] } });
    }
    if (creates.length > 0) {
      data.variants = { create: creates.map((v) => ({ ...v })) };
    }
  }

  // Resubmit for moderation (e.g. after rejection).
  let statusNote: string | null = null;
  if (body.resubmit === true) {
    data.status = "pending_review";
    data.rejectReason = null;
    statusNote = "resubmitted";
  }

  await db.product.update({ where: { id: product.id }, data });

  const after = await db.product.findUnique({
    where: { id: product.id },
    include: { variants: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } } },
  });
  if (!after) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Product not found");

  // Keep product.priceMinor = cheapest active variant.
  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const priceMinor = recomputePrice(after.variants);
  if (priceMinor !== after.priceMinor) patch.priceMinor = priceMinor;

  // Re-flag banned keywords when title/description changed.
  const flags = matchFlags(`${after.title} ${after.description ?? ""}`);
  const currentFlags = parseJson<string[]>(after.flagsJson, []);
  if (flags.length > 0 && JSON.stringify(flags) !== JSON.stringify(currentFlags)) {
    patch.flagsJson = toJson(flags);
    patch.status = "pending_review";
    statusNote = statusNote ?? "flagged";
  }
  if (Object.keys(patch).length > 0) {
    await db.product.update({ where: { id: after.id }, data: patch });
  }

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: statusNote ? `product.${statusNote}` : "product.updated",
    entityType: "product",
    entityId: product.id,
    meta: { fields: Object.keys(data) },
  });

  const fresh = await db.product.findUnique({
    where: { id: product.id },
    include: {
      images: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" } },
      variants: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } },
      category: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } },
    },
  });
  return ok(fresh);
});

// DELETE /api/store/products/[id] — soft archive.
export const DELETE = handle(async (_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const product = await ownProduct(store.id, id);
  const updated = await db.product.update({ where: { id: product.id }, data: { status: "archived" } });
  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "product.archived",
    entityType: "product",
    entityId: product.id,
    meta: { title: product.title },
  });
  return ok({ id: updated.id, status: updated.status });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { ownProduct, recomputePrice } from "../../helpers";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/store/products/[id]/variants — add a variant.
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const product = await ownProduct(store.id, id);
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const priceMinor = Math.round(Number(body.priceMinor));
  if (!Number.isFinite(priceMinor) || priceMinor < 0) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "priceMinor must be >= 0");
  }

  const variant = await db.productVariant.create({
    data: {
      productId: product.id,
      name: body.name ? String(body.name) : "Default",
      optionName: body.optionName != null ? String(body.optionName) : null,
      optionValue: body.optionValue != null ? String(body.optionValue) : null,
      priceMinor,
      compareAtPriceMinor: body.compareAtPriceMinor != null ? Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.compareAtPriceMinor))) : null,
      stock: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.stock ?? 0)) || 0),
      lowStockThreshold: body.lowStockThreshold != null ? Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.lowStockThreshold))) : 5,
      sku: body.sku != null ? String(body.sku) : null,
    },
  });

  // Keep product.priceMinor = cheapest active variant.
  const all = await db.productVariant.findMany({ where: { productId: product.id } });
  const price = recomputePrice(all);
  if (price !== product.priceMinor) {
    await db.product.update({ where: { id: product.id }, data: { priceMinor: price } });
  }

  return ok(variant, { status: 201 });
});

```
// Product helpers for seller catalog routes (not a route file — helpers only).
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { ApiError, slugify } from "@/lib/api";
import { parseJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const BANNED_KEYWORDS = ["replica", "fake", "gun", "drug"];

export function matchFlags(text: string): string[] {
  const t = text.toLowerCase();
  return BANNED_KEYWORDS.filter((k) => t.includes(k));
}

/** First N products of a store go to moderation (setting moderation.first_n, default 5). */
export async function moderationStatus(storeId: string): Promise<"pending_review" | "active"> {
  const setting = await db.setting.findUnique({ where: { key: "moderation.first_n" } });
  const firstN = Math.max(0, parseJson<number>(setting?.valueJson, 5));
  const count = await db.product.count({ where: { storeId, status: { not: "archived" } } });
  return count < firstN ? "pending_review" : "active";
}

export async function uniqueSlug(storeId: string, title: string): Promise<string> {
  const base = slugify(title) || "product";
  const existing = await db.product.findMany({
    where: { storeId, slug: { startsWith: base } },
    select: { slug: true },
  });
  const taken = new Set(existing.map((e) => e.slug));
  if (!taken.has(base)) return base;
  let n = 2;
  while (taken.has(`${base}-${n}`)) n++;
  return `${base}-${n}`;
}

export type VariantInput = {
  name: string;
  optionName: string | null;
  optionValue: string | null;
  priceMinor: number;
  compareAtPriceMinor: number | null;
  stock: number;
  lowStockThreshold: number;
  sku: string | null;
};

export function validateVariants(raw: unknown): VariantInput[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw) || raw.length === 0) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "At least one variant is required");
  }
  return raw.map((v) => {
    const vv = v as Record<string, unknown>;
    const priceMinor = Math.round(Number(vv.priceMinor));
    if (!Number.isFinite(priceMinor) || priceMinor < 0) {
      throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "Each variant needs a valid priceMinor >= 0");
    }
    const stock = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(vv.stock ?? 0)) || 0);
    return {
      name: vv.name ? String(vv.name) : "Default",
      optionName: vv.optionName != null ? String(vv.optionName) : null,
      optionValue: vv.optionValue != null ? String(vv.optionValue) : null,
      priceMinor,
      compareAtPriceMinor: vv.compareAtPriceMinor != null ? Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(vv.compareAtPriceMinor))) : null,
      stock,
      lowStockThreshold: vv.lowStockThreshold != null ? Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(vv.lowStockThreshold))) : 5,
      sku: vv.sku != null ? String(vv.sku) : null,
    };
  });
}

export async function ownProduct(storeId: string, id: string) {
  const product = await db.product.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    include: { variants: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } }, images: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" } } },
  });
  if (!product || product.storeId !== storeId) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Product not found");
  return product;
}

export function recomputePrice(variants: { priceMinor: number; isActive: boolean }[]): number {
  const active = variants.filter((v) => v.isActive);
  const pool = active.length > 0 ? active : variants;
  return pool.length > 0 ? Math.min(...pool.map((v) => v.priceMinor)) : 0;
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, okPaged, ApiError, getPagination, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { toJson } from "@/lib/json";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { matchFlags, moderationStatus, uniqueSlug, validateVariants } from "./helpers";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/store/products?search=&status=&page=&size=
export const GET = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const { page, size, skip, take } = getPagination(url);
  const search = url.searchParams.get("search")?.trim();
  const status = url.searchParams.get("status")?.trim();

  const where: Record<string, unknown> = { storeId: store.id };
  if (search) where.title = { contains: search };
  if (status && status !== "all") where.status = status;

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    db.product.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        images: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" } },
        variants: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } },
        category: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      skip,
      take,
    }),
    db.product.count({ where }),
  ]);

  return okPaged(rows, { page, size, total });
});

// POST /api/store/products — create with images[] + variants[].
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const title = String(body.title ?? "").trim();
  if (!title) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "title is required");
  const description = body.description != null ? String(body.description) : null;
  const variants = validateVariants(body.variants);
  const images = Array.isArray(body.images) ? body.images.map((u) => String(u)).filter(Boolean) : [];

  // Moderation: first N products need review; banned keywords force review.
  let status = await moderationStatus(store.id);
  const flags = matchFlags(`${title} ${description ?? ""}`);
  if (flags.length > 0) status = "pending_review";

  const priceMinor = Math.min(...variants.map((v) => v.priceMinor));
  const slug = await uniqueSlug(store.id, title);

  const categoryId = body.categoryId != null ? String(body.categoryId) : null;
  if (categoryId) {
    const cat = await db.category.findUnique({ where: { id: categoryId } });
    if (!cat) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "Category not found");
  }

  const product = await db.product.create({
    data: {
      storeId: store.id,
      categoryId,
      title,
      slug,
      description,
      status,
      priceMinor,
      flagsJson: flags.length > 0 ? toJson(flags) : "[]",
      publishedAt: status === "active" ? new Date() : null,
      images: { create: images.map((url, i) => ({ url, sortOrder: i })) },
      variants: { create: variants.map((v) => ({ ...v })) },
    },
    include: {
      images: { orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" } },
      variants: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } },
      category: { select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true } },
    },
  });

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { toJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// PATCH /api/store/settings — whitelist of editable store fields.
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.name !== undefined) {
    const name = String(body.name).trim();
    if (!name) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "Store name cannot be empty");
    data.name = name;
  }
  if (body.tagline !== undefined) data.tagline = body.tagline == null ? null : String(body.tagline);
  if (body.description !== undefined) data.description = body.description == null ? null : String(body.description);
  if (body.supportEmail !== undefined) data.supportEmail = body.supportEmail == null ? null : String(body.supportEmail);
  if (body.supportPhone !== undefined) data.supportPhone = body.supportPhone == null ? null : String(body.supportPhone);
  if (body.whatsapp !== undefined) data.whatsapp = body.whatsapp == null ? null : String(body.whatsapp);
  if (body.marketplaceOptIn !== undefined) data.marketplaceOptIn = !!body.marketplaceOptIn;
  if (body.logoUrl !== undefined) data.logoUrl = body.logoUrl == null ? null : String(body.logoUrl);
  if (body.bannerUrl !== undefined) data.bannerUrl = body.bannerUrl == null ? null : String(body.bannerUrl);
  if (body.social !== undefined) {
    data.socialJson = typeof body.social === "string" ? body.social : toJson(body.social ?? {});
  }

  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "No editable fields provided");
  }

  const updated = await db.store.update({ where: { id: store.id }, data });

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "store.settings.updated",
    entityType: "store",
    entityId: store.id,
    meta: { fields: Object.keys(data) },
  });

  return ok({ id: updated.id, name: updated.name, tagline: updated.tagline, updated: Object.keys(data) });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { parseTheme } from "@/lib/sections";
import { toJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/store/theme
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  return ok({ theme: parseTheme(store.themeJson) });
});

// PUT /api/store/theme {theme: {...tokens}}
export const PUT = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { theme?: Record<string, unknown> };
  if (!body.theme || typeof body.theme !== "object") {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "theme object is required");
  }
  // merge over existing tokens so unspecified ones persist
  const merged = { ...parseTheme(store.themeJson), ...body.theme };
  const updated = await db.store.update({
    where: { id: store.id },
    data: { themeJson: toJson(merged) },
  });
  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "store.theme.updated",
    entityType: "store",
    entityId: store.id,
  });
  return ok({ theme: parseTheme(updated.themeJson) });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { recomputePrice } from "../../products/helpers";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

async function ownVariant(storeId: string, id: string) {
  const variant = await db.productVariant.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    include: { product: { select: { id: true, storeId: true, priceMinor: true } } },
  });
  if (!variant || variant.product.storeId !== storeId) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Variant not found");
  return variant;
}

// PATCH /api/store/variants/[id] — price/stock/etc.
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const variant = await ownVariant(store.id, id);
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.name !== undefined) data.name = String(body.name);
  if (body.optionName !== undefined) data.optionName = body.optionName == null ? null : String(body.optionName);
  if (body.optionValue !== undefined) data.optionValue = body.optionValue == null ? null : String(body.optionValue);
  if (body.priceMinor !== undefined) {
    const priceMinor = Math.round(Number(body.priceMinor));
    if (!Number.isFinite(priceMinor) || priceMinor < 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "priceMinor must be >= 0");
    data.priceMinor = priceMinor;
  }
  if (body.compareAtPriceMinor !== undefined) {
    data.compareAtPriceMinor = body.compareAtPriceMinor == null ? null : Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.compareAtPriceMinor)));
  }
  if (body.stock !== undefined) {
    data.stock = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.stock)) || 0);
  }
  if (body.lowStockThreshold !== undefined) {
    data.lowStockThreshold = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(body.lowStockThreshold)) || 0);
  }
  if (body.sku !== undefined) data.sku = body.sku == null ? null : String(body.sku);
  if (body.isActive !== undefined) data.isActive = !!body.isActive;

  const updated = await db.productVariant.update({ where: { id: variant.id }, data });

  // Keep product.priceMinor = cheapest active variant.
  const all = await db.productVariant.findMany({ where: { productId: variant.productId } });
  const price = recomputePrice(all);
  if (price !== variant.product.priceMinor) {
    await db.product.update({ where: { id: variant.productId }, data: { priceMinor: price } });
  }

  return ok(updated);
});

// DELETE /api/store/variants/[id] — soft deactivate (orders may reference it).
export const DELETE = handle(async (_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const variant = await ownVariant(store.id, id);
  const updated = await db.productVariant.update({ where: { id: variant.id }, data: { isActive: false } });
  return ok({ id: updated.id, isActive: updated.isActive });
});

```

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { ACCOUNTS, refreshWalletCache } from "@/lib/ledger";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// GET /api/store/wallet — ledger-truth wallet + recent lines + payouts.
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { me } = await requireActiveSellerStore();

  const wallet = await db.wallet.findUnique({ where: { sellerId: me.id } });
  if (!wallet) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Wallet not found");

  await refreshWalletCache(wallet.id);
  const fresh = await db.wallet.findUnique({ where: { id: wallet.id } });

  const [recentLines, payouts] = await Promise.all([
    db.ledgerLine.findMany({
      where: { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.sellerPayable(wallet.id) },
      include: { txn: { select: { id: true, txnType: true, description: true, occurredAt: true } } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 20,
    }),
    db.payout.findMany({ where: { walletId: wallet.id }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: 20 }),
  ]);

  return ok({ wallet: fresh, recentLines, payouts });
});

```
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { parseJson, toJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

async function ownEndpoint(storeId: string, id: string) {
  const endpoint = await db.webhookEndpoint.findFirst({ where: { id, storeId } });
  if (!endpoint) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Webhook endpoint not found");
  return endpoint;
}

// PATCH /api/store/webhooks/[id] {url?, events?, isActive?}
export const PATCH = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const endpoint = await ownEndpoint(store.id, id);
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.url !== undefined) {
    const url = String(body.url).trim();
    if (!/^https?:\/\/.+/.test(url)) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "url must be a valid http(s) URL");
    data.url = url;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(body.events)) {
    const events = body.events.map((e) => String(e)).filter(Boolean);
    if (events.length === 0) throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "events cannot be empty");
    data.eventsJson = JSON.stringify(events);
  }
  if (body.isActive !== undefined) data.isActive = !!body.isActive;

  const updated = await db.webhookEndpoint.update({ where: { id: endpoint.id }, data });
  return ok({
    id: updated.id,
    url: updated.url,
    secret: updated.secret,
    events: parseJson<string[]>(updated.eventsJson, []),
    isActive: updated.isActive,
  });
});

// DELETE /api/store/webhooks/[id]
export const DELETE = handle(async (_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const endpoint = await ownEndpoint(store.id, id);
  await db.webhookEndpoint.delete({ where: { id: endpoint.id } });
  return ok({ id: endpoint.id, deleted: true });
});

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { handle, ok, ApiError, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireActiveSellerStore } from "@/lib/auth";
import { randomToken } from "@/lib/password";
import { parseJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const DEFAULT_EVENTS = ["order.paid", "order.shipped", "order.refunded"];

// GET /api/store/webhooks — endpoints with their last 10 deliveries.
export const GET = handle(async () => {
  const { store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const endpoints = await db.webhookEndpoint.findMany({
    where: { storeId: store.id },
    include: { deliveries: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: 10 } },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });
  return ok(
    endpoints.map((ep) => ({
      id: ep.id,
      url: ep.url,
      secret: ep.secret,
      events: parseJson<string[]>(ep.eventsJson, []),
      isActive: ep.isActive,
      createdAt: ep.createdAt,
      deliveries: ep.deliveries,
    }))
  );
});

// POST /api/store/webhooks {url, events: [...]}
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request) => {
  const { me, store } = await requireActiveSellerStore();
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const url = String(body.url ?? "").trim();
  if (!/^https?:\/\/.+/.test(url)) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "VALIDATION", "url must be a valid http(s) URL");
  }
  const events = Array.isArray(body.events) && body.events.length > 0
    ? body.events.map((e) => String(e))
    : DEFAULT_EVENTS;

  const endpoint = await db.webhookEndpoint.create({
    data: {
      storeId: store.id,
      url,
      secret: `whsec_${randomToken(12)}`,
      eventsJson: JSON.stringify(events),
      isActive: true,
    },
  });

  await logActivity({
    actorType: "seller",
    actorId: me.id,
    actorLabel: me.email,
    action: "webhook.created",
    entityType: "webhook_endpoint",
    entityId: endpoint.id,
    meta: { url, events },
  });

  return ok(
    {
      id: endpoint.id,
      url: endpoint.url,
      secret: endpoint.secret,
      events: parseJson<string[]>(endpoint.eventsJson, []),
      isActive: endpoint.isActive,
      deliveries: [],
    },
    { status: 201 }
  );
});

import { handle, ok } from "@/lib/api";
import { processPaymentWebhook } from "../process";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// POST /api/webhooks/payments/[provider] — mock gateway callback.
// Body: {providerRef, eventType: payment.succeeded|payment.failed, amountMinor, ts, sig?}
// Signature (HMAC-SHA256 hex of "ref.eventType.amount.ts") accepted via
// header X-SM-Signature OR body.sig. Invalid → 400 BAD_SIGNATURE (still logged).
export const POST = handle(async (req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ provider: string }> }) => {
  const { provider } = await ctx.params;
  const rawBody = await req.text();
  const body = JSON.parse(rawBody || "{}") as Record<string, unknown>;
  const headerSignature = req.headers.get("X-SM-Signature");

  const outcome = await processPaymentWebhook({
    provider,
    body: body as { providerRef?: string; eventType?: string; amountMinor?: number; ts?: number; sig?: string },
    rawBody,
    headerSignature,
  });

  return ok({ ok: true, duplicate: outcome.duplicate, orderNumber: outcome.orderNumber, orderStatus: outcome.orderStatus });
});

## FILE: src/app/api/webhooks/payments/process.ts
```
// ============================================================================
// Shared payment-webhook verification + processing.
// Used by POST /api/webhooks/payments/[provider] AND POST /api/checkout/payments/[ref]/simulate
// (sandbox mock). HMAC secret NEVER leaves the server.
// ============================================================================
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { hmacSha256Hex } from "@/lib/password";
import { transitionOrder, dispatchStoreWebhooks, notify, logActivity } from "@/lib/api";
import { getCommissionSettings } from "@/lib/commission";
import { postOrderPaid } from "@/lib/ledger";
import { toJson } from "@/lib/json";

export const WEBHOOK_SECRET = "sm_webhook_secret_demo";

export function expectedSignature(providerRef: string, eventType: string, amountMinor: number, ts: number): string {
  return hmacSha256Hex(WEBHOOK_SECRET, `${providerRef}.${eventType}.${amountMinor}.${ts}`);
}

export type ProcessResult = {
  ok: true;
  duplicate: boolean;
  eventType: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  orderStatus: string;
  intentStatus: string;
};

/**
 * Verify signature (caller may pre-compute it, as simulate does), log the raw
 * webhook, then process idempotently. Throws ApiError with proper status codes.
 */
export async function processPaymentWebhook(input: {
  provider: string;
  body: { providerRef?: string; eventType?: string; amountMinor?: number; ts?: number; sig?: string };
  rawBody: string;
  headerSignature?: string | null;
}): Promise<ProcessResult> {
  const providerRef = String(input.body.providerRef ?? "");
  const eventType = String(input.body.eventType ?? "");
  const amountMinor = Math.round(Number(input.body.amountMinor ?? 0));
  const ts = Math.round(Number(input.body.ts ?? 0));
  if (!providerRef || !eventType) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "BAD_REQUEST", "providerRef and eventType are required");
  }

  const providedSig = input.headerSignature ?? (input.body.sig ? String(input.body.sig) : null);
  const expected = expectedSignature(providerRef, eventType, amountMinor, ts);
  const signatureValid = !!providedSig && providedSig === expected;

  const intent = await db.paymentIntent.findUnique({ where: { providerRef } });

  // ALWAYS log the webhook first (even for invalid signature / unknown intent).
  const log = await db.paymentWebhookLog.create({
    data: {
      provider: input.provider,
      providerRef,
      eventType,
      payloadJson: input.rawBody,
      signatureValid,
      processed: false,
      orderId: intent?.orderId ?? null,
    },
  });

  if (!signatureValid) {
    throw new ApiError(400, "BAD_SIGNATURE", "Webhook signature verification failed");
  }
  if (!intent) {
    throw new ApiError(404, "INTENT_NOT_FOUND", "Payment intent not found");
  }

  // Idempotency: already succeeded → no-op.
  if (intent.status === "succeeded") {
    await db.paymentWebhookLog.update({ where: { id: log.id }, data: { processed: true } });
    const order = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id: intent.orderId } });
    return {
      ok: true,
      duplicate: true,
      eventType,
      orderNumber: order?.orderNumber ?? "",
      orderStatus: order?.status ?? "",
      intentStatus: intent.status,
    };
  }

  if (eventType === "payment.failed") {
    await db.paymentIntent.update({ where: { id: intent.id }, data: { status: "failed" } });
    const order = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id: intent.orderId } });
    await db.paymentWebhookLog.update({ where: { id: log.id }, data: { processed: true } });
    return {
      ok: true,
      duplicate: false,
      eventType,
      orderNumber: order?.orderNumber ?? "",
      orderStatus: order?.status ?? "",
      intentStatus: "failed",
    };
  }

  if (eventType !== "payment.succeeded") {
    throw new ApiError(400, "UNKNOWN_EVENT", `Unsupported eventType: ${eventType}`);
  }

  if (amountMinor !== intent.amountMinor) {
    throw new ApiError(409, "AMOUNT_MISMATCH", `Webhook amount ${amountMinor} does not match intent ${intent.amountMinor}`);
  }

  const paidAt = new Date();
  await db.paymentIntent.update({ where: { id: intent.id }, data: { status: "succeeded" } });
  const order = await db.order.findUnique({
    where: { id: intent.orderId },
    include: { items: true, store: { include: { seller: { include: { wallet: true } } } } },
  });
  if (!order) throw new ApiError(404, "ORDER_NOT_FOUND", "Order for payment intent not found");

  await transitionOrder({ orderId: order.id, toStatus: "paid", actor: "system", note: `Payment ${providerRef} succeeded via ${intent.provider}`, timestamps: { paidAt } });

  // Ledger T1 — seller wallet credited with net, hold until = paidAt + holdDays.
  const wallet = order.store.seller.wallet;
  if (wallet) {
    const settings = await getCommissionSettings();
    const holdDays = order.store.seller.holdDaysOverride ?? settings.payoutHoldDays;
    const holdUntil = new Date(paidAt.getTime() + holdDays * 86400000);
    const commissionMinor = order.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.commissionMinor, 0);
    const sellerNetMinor = order.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.sellerNetMinor, 0);
    await postOrderPaid({
      orderId: order.id,
      orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
      walletId: wallet.id,
      provider: intent.provider,
      totalMinor: intent.amountMinor,
      sellerNetMinor,
      commissionMinor,
      holdUntil,
      currency: order.currency,
      occurredAt: paidAt,
    });
  }

  // Store webhooks + notifications.
  await dispatchStoreWebhooks({
    storeId: order.storeId,
    event: "order.paid",
    payload: { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, totalMinor: order.totalMinor, currency: order.currency },
  });
  await notify({ event: "order.paid", channel: "email", recipient: order.store.seller.email, subject: `You have a new paid order ${order.orderNumber}` });
  await notify({ event: "order.paid", channel: "inapp", recipient: order.store.seller.email, subject: "You have a new paid order" });
  await notify({ event: "order.receipt", channel: "email", recipient: order.customerEmail, subject: `Your order ${order.orderNumber} is confirmed` });
  await logActivity({ actorType: "system", action: "payment.succeeded", entityType: "order", entityId: order.id, meta: { providerRef, provider: intent.provider, totalMinor: intent.amountMinor } });

  await db.paymentWebhookLog.update({ where: { id: log.id }, data: { processed: true } });

  return {
    ok: true,
    duplicate: false,
    eventType,
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    orderStatus: "paid",
    intentStatus: "succeeded",
  };
}

export function webhookPayloadJson(body: unknown): string {
  return toJson(body);
}

```
