"use client";
// Admin command centre shell — auth gate, sidebar navigation (PART 4 tree),
// sticky top bar and the view switch. Views are client state (no URLs).
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState, type ComponentType } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import {
  Activity,
  Banknote,
  BarChart3,
  Bell,
  BookOpen,
  CalendarClock,
  FlaskConical,
  HeartPulse,
  Landmark,
  LayoutDashboard,
  LifeBuoy,
  Loader2,
  LogOut,
  Megaphone,
  Menu,
  PackageSearch,
  Percent,
  RotateCcw,
  Scale,
  ScrollText,
  Settings,
  ShieldCheck,
  ShoppingCart,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Star,
  Store,
  Tags,
  Ticket,
  ToggleLeft,
  UserCheck,
  Users,
  Wallet,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/ui/avatar";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetHeader, SheetTitle } from "@/components/ui/sheet";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useApp } from "@/lib/app-store";
import { apiSend } from "./use-api";
import type { AdminNav, AdminParams } from "./nav";
import { EmptyState } from "./ui-bits";

// views
import { DashboardView } from "./dashboard";
import { SellersView, KycQueueView } from "./sellers";
import { SellerDetailView } from "./seller-detail";
import { StoresView } from "./stores";
import { ModerationView } from "./moderation";
import { CategoriesView } from "./categories";
import { OrdersView, RefundsView, DisputesView } from "./orders";
import { OrderDetailView } from "./order-detail";
import { CommissionSettingsView, SimulatorView } from "./commission";
import { OverridesView, FeeHolidaysView } from "./finance";
import { WalletsView, LedgerView } from "./wallets-ledger";
import { PayoutsView, PayoutDetailView } from "./payouts";
import { BanksView } from "./banks";
import { BannersView, FeaturedView, CouponsView } from "./marketing";
import { SupportView } from "./support";
import { ReportsView } from "./reports";
import { SettingsView, FlagsView, AuditView, ActivityView, NotificationsView, HealthView } from "./system";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ nav tree */

type NavItem = { view: string; label: string; icon: LucideIcon };
type NavGroup = { label: string; items: NavItem[] };

const NAV_GROUPS: NavGroup[] = [
  { label: "", items: [{ view: "dashboard", label: "Dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard }] },
  {
    label: "Sellers",
    items: [
      { view: "sellers", label: "All Sellers", icon: Users },
      { view: "kyc-queue", label: "KYC Queue", icon: UserCheck },
    ],
  },
  { label: "Stores", items: [{ view: "stores", label: "Stores & Domains", icon: Store }] },
  {
    label: "Catalog",
    items: [
      { view: "moderation", label: "Product Moderation", icon: PackageSearch },
      { view: "categories", label: "Categories", icon: Tags },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: "Orders",
    items: [
      { view: "orders", label: "All Orders", icon: ShoppingCart },
      { view: "refunds", label: "Refunds", icon: RotateCcw },
      { view: "disputes", label: "Disputes", icon: Scale },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: "Finance",
    items: [
      { view: "commission", label: "Commission", icon: Percent },
      { view: "overrides", label: "Overrides", icon: SlidersHorizontal },
      { view: "holidays", label: "Fee Holidays", icon: CalendarClock },
      { view: "simulator", label: "Simulator", icon: FlaskConical },
      { view: "wallets", label: "Wallets", icon: Wallet },
      { view: "ledger", label: "Ledger Explorer", icon: BookOpen },
      { view: "payouts", label: "Payout Batches", icon: Banknote },
      { view: "banks", label: "Bank Verification", icon: Landmark },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: "Marketing",
    items: [
      { view: "banners", label: "Banners", icon: Megaphone },
      { view: "featured", label: "Featured", icon: Star },
      { view: "coupons", label: "Coupons", icon: Ticket },
    ],
  },
  { label: "Support", items: [{ view: "tickets", label: "Tickets", icon: LifeBuoy }] },
  { label: "Reports", items: [{ view: "reports", label: "Reports & Exports", icon: BarChart3 }] },
  {
    label: "System",
    items: [
      { view: "settings", label: "Settings", icon: Settings },
      { view: "flags", label: "Feature Flags", icon: ToggleLeft },
      { view: "audit", label: "Audit Log", icon: ScrollText },
      { view: "activity", label: "Activity Log", icon: Activity },
      { view: "notifications", label: "Notifications", icon: Bell },
      { view: "health", label: "System Health", icon: HeartPulse },
    ],
  },
];

const VIEW_TITLES: Record<string, string> = {
  ...Object.fromEntries(NAV_GROUPS.flatMap((g) => g.items.map((i) => [i.view, i.label]))),
  "seller-detail": "Seller Detail",
  "order-detail": "Order Detail",
  "payout-detail": "Payout Batch",
};

const VIEW_MAP: Record<string, ComponentType<{ nav: AdminNav }>> = {
  dashboard: DashboardView,
  sellers: SellersView,
  "kyc-queue": KycQueueView,
  stores: StoresView,
  moderation: ModerationView,
  categories: CategoriesView,
  orders: OrdersView,
  refunds: RefundsView,
  disputes: DisputesView,
  commission: CommissionSettingsView,
  overrides: OverridesView,
  holidays: FeeHolidaysView,
  simulator: SimulatorView,
  wallets: WalletsView,
  ledger: LedgerView,
  payouts: PayoutsView,
  banks: BanksView,
  banners: BannersView,
  featured: FeaturedView,
  coupons: CouponsView,
  tickets: SupportView,
  reports: ReportsView,
  settings: SettingsView,
  flags: FlagsView,
  audit: AuditView,
  activity: ActivityView,
  notifications: NotificationsView,
  health: HealthView,
};

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- shell */

export default function AdminShell() {
  const me = useApp((s) => s.me);
  const refreshMe = useApp((s) => s.refreshMe);

  const [view, setView] = useState("dashboard");
  const [params, setParams] = useState<AdminParams>({});

  const navigate = useCallback((v: string, p?: AdminParams) => {
    setView(v);
    setParams(p ?? {});
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }, []);

  const nav: AdminNav = useMemo(() => ({ view, params, navigate }), [view, params, navigate]);

  if (!me.loaded) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center p-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 text-muted-foreground">
          <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin" />
          <p className="text-sm">Loading command centre…</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!me.admin) {
    return <LoginCard onLogin={() => void refreshMe()} />;
  }

  const title = VIEW_TITLES[view] ?? "Command Centre";

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen w-full">
      {/* desktop sidebar */}
      <aside className="sticky top-0 hidden h-screen w-56 shrink-0 border-r bg-card/40 lg:block">
        <SidebarContent nav={nav} />
      </aside>

      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
        {/* top bar */}
        <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b bg-background/95 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/80">
          <div className="flex h-14 items-center gap-3 px-4 sm:px-6">
            <MobileNav nav={nav} />
            <h1 className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-base">{title}</h1>
            <AdminMenu admin={me.admin} />
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* view switch */}
        <main className="flex-1 space-y-4 p-4 pb-28 sm:p-6 sm:pb-28">
          {view === "seller-detail" ? (
            params.sellerId ? (
              <SellerDetailView nav={nav} sellerId={params.sellerId} />
            ) : (
              <MissingRef
                message="No seller selected — open one from the sellers list."
                actionLabel="Go to sellers"
                onAction={() => navigate("sellers")}
              />
            )
          ) : view === "order-detail" ? (
            params.orderId ? (
              <OrderDetailView nav={nav} orderId={params.orderId} />
            ) : (
              <MissingRef
                message="No order selected — open one from the orders list."
                actionLabel="Go to orders"
                onAction={() => navigate("orders")}
              />
            )
          ) : view === "payout-detail" ? (
            params.batchId ? (
              <PayoutDetailView nav={nav} batchId={params.batchId} />
            ) : (
              <MissingRef
                message="No payout batch selected — open one from the batches list."
                actionLabel="Go to payout batches"
                onAction={() => navigate("payouts")}
              />
            )
          ) : (
            (() => {
              const Active = VIEW_MAP[view] ?? DashboardView;
              return <Active nav={nav} />;
            })()
          )}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- sidebar */

function SidebarContent({ nav, onNavigate }: { nav: AdminNav; onNavigate?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-b px-4 py-4">
        <span className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-sm">
          <ShieldCheck className="h-[18px] w-[18px]" />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold tracking-tight">SHOPMESH</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Command Centre</p>
        </div>
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="shrink-0 border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-[10px] font-semibold text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300"
        >
          DEMO
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-2 py-3 [scrollbar-width:thin] [scrollbar-color:rgba(20,184,166,0.4)_transparent] [&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb]:rounded-full [&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb]:bg-teal-600/30 [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:w-1.5" aria-label="Admin navigation">
        {NAV_GROUPS.map((group, gi) => (
          <div key={group.label || `g${gi}`} className="mb-2">
            {group.label ? (
              <p className="px-2.5 pb-1 pt-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">{group.label}</p>
            ) : null}
            {group.items.map((item) => {
              const active = nav.view === item.view;
              const Icon = item.icon;
              return (
                <button
                  key={item.view}
                  onClick={() => {
                    nav.navigate(item.view);
                    onNavigate?.();
                  }}
                  aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex min-h-[40px] w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-left text-sm transition-colors",
                    active
                      ? "bg-primary/10 font-medium text-primary"
                      : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
                  )}
                >
                  <Icon className={cn("h-4 w-4 shrink-0", active ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground/80")} />
                  <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>

      <div className="border-t px-4 py-3">
        <p className="text-[10px] leading-tight text-muted-foreground">
          PART 4 wireframes · SHOPMESH v1
          <br />
          All actions are audited.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MobileNav({ nav }: { nav: AdminNav }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        size="icon"
        className="-ml-2 h-10 w-10 lg:hidden"
        aria-label="Open navigation menu"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
      >
        <Menu className="h-5 w-5" />
      </Button>
      <SheetContent side="left" className="w-64 p-0">
        <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
          <SheetTitle>Admin navigation</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>Navigate between command centre views</SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <SidebarContent nav={nav} onNavigate={() => setOpen(false)} />
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- top bar */

function AdminMenu({ admin }: { admin: { id: string; email: string; name: string; role: string } }) {
  const refreshMe = useApp((s) => s.refreshMe);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const logout = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiSend("/api/auth/logout", "POST");
      toast.success("Signed out", { description: "Session ended — see you soon." });
      await refreshMe();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Logout failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const initials = (admin.name || admin.email || "?")
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((w) => w[0])
    .slice(0, 2)
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();

  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
        <button
          className="flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-2 rounded-full pl-1 pr-2 transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600"
          aria-label="Account menu"
        >
          <Avatar className="h-8 w-8">
            <AvatarFallback className="bg-teal-600/10 text-xs font-semibold text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-300">
              {initials}
            </AvatarFallback>
          </Avatar>
          <span className="hidden max-w-[140px] truncate text-sm font-medium sm:block">{admin.name}</span>
        </button>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-60">
        <DropdownMenuLabel>
          <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{admin.name}</p>
          <p className="truncate text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">{admin.email}</p>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="mt-1.5 capitalize">
            {admin.role.replace(/_/g, " ")}
          </Badge>
        </DropdownMenuLabel>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem disabled={busy} onClick={() => void logout()} className="text-red-600 focus:text-red-600">
          <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" /> Sign out
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- login */

const DEMO_ACCOUNTS: { role: string; email: string; password: string }[] = [
  { role: "Superadmin", email: "admin@shopmesh.io", password: "Admin123!" },
  { role: "Ops", email: "ops@shopmesh.io", password: "Ops12345!" },
  { role: "Finance", email: "finance@shopmesh.io", password: "Finance123!" },
  { role: "Moderator", email: "moderator@shopmesh.io", password: "Mod12345!" },
];

function LoginCard({ onLogin }: { onLogin: () => void }) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fill = (a: (typeof DEMO_ACCOUNTS)[number]) => {
    setEmail(a.email);
    setPassword(a.password);
    setError(null);
  };

  const submit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const body = await apiSend<{ userType?: string; admin?: { name?: string } | null }>("/api/auth/login", "POST", {
        email: email.trim(),
        password,
        portal: "admin",
      });
      if (body?.userType !== "admin") {
        setError("This account cannot access the admin command centre.");
        setBusy(false);
        return;
      }
      toast.success(`Welcome back, ${body.admin?.name ?? "admin"}`);
      onLogin();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Login failed — check your credentials.");
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center p-4 py-12">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 text-center">
          <span className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-md">
            <ShieldCheck className="h-6 w-6" />
          </span>
          <div>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">SHOPMESH</p>
            <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Command Centre</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Card className="py-0">
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="admin-email">Email</Label>
                <Input
                  id="admin-email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="username"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="admin@shopmesh.io"
                  className="min-h-[44px]"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="admin-password">Password</Label>
                <Input
                  id="admin-password"
                  type="password"
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  className="min-h-[44px]"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              {error ? (
                <p className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300" role="alert">
                  {error}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              <Button type="submit" className="min-h-[44px] w-full" disabled={busy}>
                {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : "Sign in to command centre"}
              </Button>
            </form>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/40 p-4">
          <p className="mb-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Demo accounts — one-click fill</p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {DEMO_ACCOUNTS.map((a) => (
              <button
                key={a.email}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => fill(a)}
                className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-left transition-colors hover:border-teal-300 hover:bg-teal-50/60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600 dark:hover:border-teal-800 dark:hover:bg-teal-950/30"

                <p className="truncate font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{a.email}</p>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- misc bits */

function MissingRef({ message, actionLabel, onAction }: { message: string; actionLabel: string; onAction: () => void }) {
  return (
    <Card className="py-0">
      <CardContent className="p-4">
        <EmptyState title="Nothing selected" hint={message} />
        <div className="flex justify-center pb-4">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onAction} className="min-h-[44px]">
            {actionLabel}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

"use client";
// FIN-08 Bank Verification — unverified queue with holder/store name match hint,
// verify / reject actions, and the verified accounts list below.
import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { BadgeCheck, CheckCircle2, Landmark, ShieldQuestion, XCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { apiSend, useApi } from "./use-api";
import {
  ConfirmDialog,
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  PageHeader,
  StatusChip,
  TableSkeleton,
  fmtDT,
} from "./ui-bits";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type BankRow = {
  id: string;
  holderName: string;
  bankName: string;
  accountNumberMasked: string;
  verified: boolean;
  verifiedAt?: string | null;
  createdAt?: string;
  sellerId?: string;
  sellerLegalName?: string;
  sellerEmail?: string;
  sellerStatus?: string;
  storeName?: string | null;
};

/** Heuristic holder↔store similarity: shared normalised tokens (≥1, or all when single-token). */
function nameMatches(holder: string | null | undefined, store: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  const norm = (s: string | null | undefined) =>
    (s ?? "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ").split(/\s+/).filter((t) => t.length > 1);
  const h = norm(holder);
  const s = norm(store);
  if (h.length === 0 || s.length === 0) return false;
  const overlap = h.filter((t) => s.some((st) => st === t || st.includes(t) || t.includes(st))).length;
  const smaller = Math.min(h.length, s.length);
  return overlap >= Math.min(2, smaller) || (smaller === 1 && overlap === 1);
}

export function BanksView() {
  const queue = useApi<BankRow[]>("/api/admin/banks?verified=false");
  const verified = useApi<BankRow[]>("/api/admin/banks?verified=true");
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [rejectTarget, setRejectTarget] = useState<BankRow | null>(null);
  const [verifyTarget, setVerifyTarget] = useState<BankRow | null>(null);

  const act = async (b: BankRow, kind: "verify" | "reject") => {
    setBusyId(b.id);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/banks/${b.id}/${kind}`, "POST");
      toast.success(kind === "verify" ? "Bank account verified" : "Bank account rejected", {
        description: `${b.bankName} ${b.accountNumberMasked} · ${b.storeName ?? b.sellerLegalName ?? ""}`,
      });
      setVerifyTarget(null);
      setRejectTarget(null);
      void queue.refetch();
      void verified.refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(`Could not ${kind} account`, { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const queueRows = queue.data ?? [];
  const verifiedRows = verified.data ?? [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Bank Verification"
        description="Payout bank accounts submitted by sellers. Compare the holder name against the store before approving."
      />

      {/* verification queue */}
      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
            <ShieldQuestion className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
            Verification queue ({queueRows.length})
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Unverified accounts awaiting an ops decision.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0">
          {queue.error ? (
            <ErrorState message={queue.error} onRetry={() => void queue.refetch()} />
          ) : queue.loading ? (
            <TableSkeleton rows={3} cols={6} />
          ) : queueRows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="Queue is clear" hint="No bank accounts waiting for verification." />
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {queueRows.map((b) => {
                const match = nameMatches(b.holderName, b.storeName);
                return (
                  <div
                    key={b.id}
                    className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border p-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <p className="font-semibold">{b.holderName}</p>
                        <Badge
                          variant="outline"
                          className={cn(
                            match
                              ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300"
                              : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300"
                          )}
                        >
                          {match ? "holder name match" : "check holder name"}
                        </Badge>
                        <StatusChip status={b.sellerStatus} />
                      </div>
                      <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        <Landmark className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                        {b.bankName} · <span className="font-mono">{b.accountNumberMasked}</span>
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        Seller {b.sellerLegalName ?? "—"} ({b.sellerEmail ?? "—"}) · Store {b.storeName ?? "—"} · added {fmtDT(b.createdAt)}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-2">
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        className="min-h-[44px] flex-1 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 lg:flex-none"
                        disabled={busyId !== null}
                        onClick={() => setVerifyTarget(b)}
                      >
                        <BadgeCheck className="h-4 w-4" /> Verify
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="outline"
                        className="min-h-[44px] flex-1 border-red-200 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 lg:flex-none dark:border-red-900 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                        disabled={busyId !== null}
                        onClick={() => setRejectTarget(b)}
                      >
                        <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" /> Reject
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* verified list */}
      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />

          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Accounts cleared for payouts.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {verified.error ? (

            ) : verified.loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={3} cols={5} />
            ) : verifiedRows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="Nothing verified yet" hint="Approve accounts from the queue above." />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Holder</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Bank · Number</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Store</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Verified at</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Action</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {verifiedRows.map((b) => (
                    <TableRow key={b.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <p className="font-medium">{b.holderName}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{b.sellerEmail ?? ""}</p>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-sm sm:table-cell">
                        {b.bankName} · <span className="font-mono">{b.accountNumberMasked}</span>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-sm">{b.storeName ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{fmtDT(b.verifiedAt)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="ghost"
                          className="min-h-[44px] text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 sm:min-h-0 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                          disabled={busyId !== null}
                          onClick={() => setRejectTarget(b)}
                        >
                          Un-verify
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={verifyTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setVerifyTarget(null)}
        title="Verify bank account?"
        description={
          verifyTarget
            ? `${verifyTarget.holderName} · ${verifyTarget.bankName} ${verifyTarget.accountNumberMasked} will be marked verified and becomes payout-eligible.`

        }

"use client";
// CAT-03 Categories — tree table with inline commission edit, create + delete.
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Plus, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { apiSend, useApi } from "./use-api";
import {
  ConfirmDialog,
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  PageHeader,
  TableSkeleton,
  TypingConfirm,
  TONE_CLASS,
} from "./ui-bits";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

type CatRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  parentId: string | null;
  commissionPercent: number | null;
  sortOrder?: number;
};

type CatNode = CatRow & { children: CatNode[]; depth: number };

function buildTree(rows: CatRow[]): CatNode[] {
  const byParent = new Map<string | null, CatRow[]>();
  for (const r of rows) {
    const key = r.parentId ?? null;
    const list = byParent.get(key) ?? [];
    list.push(r);
    byParent.set(key, list);
  }
  const sortFn = (a: CatRow, b: CatRow) => (a.sortOrder ?? 0) - (b.sortOrder ?? 0) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
  const attach = (parent: string | null, depth: number): CatNode[] =>
    (byParent.get(parent) ?? []).sort(sortFn).map((r) => ({ ...r, depth, children: attach(r.id, depth + 1) }));
  return attach(null, 0);
}

function flatten(nodes: CatNode[]): CatNode[] {
  const out: CatNode[] = [];
  const walk = (list: CatNode[]) => {
    for (const n of list) {
      out.push(n);
      walk(n.children);
    }
  };
  walk(nodes);
  return out;
}

export function CategoriesView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<CatRow[]>("/api/admin/categories");
  const rows = data ?? [];
  const nodes = useMemo(() => buildTree(rows), [rows]);
  const flat = useMemo(() => flatten(nodes), [nodes]);

  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");
  const [newParent, setNewParent] = useState("root");
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<{ id: string; value: string } | null>(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<CatRow | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const toggleCollapse = (id: string) =>
    setCollapsed((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });

  const create = async () => {
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      await apiSend("/api/admin/categories", "POST", {
        name: newName.trim(),
        parentId: newParent === "root" ? undefined : newParent,
      });
      toast.success("Category created", { description: newName.trim() });
      setCreateOpen(false);
      setNewName("");
      setNewParent("root");
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Create failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const saveCommission = async (cat: CatRow, value: string) => {
    const percent = value.trim() === "" ? null : Number(value);
    if (percent !== null && (Number.isNaN(percent) || percent < 0 || percent > 100)) {
      toast.error("Percent must be between 0 and 100");
      return;
    }
    if ((cat.commissionPercent ?? null) === percent) return;
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/categories/${cat.id}`, "PATCH", { commissionPercent: percent });
      toast.success(percent === null ? "Commission reset to inherit" : `Commission set to ${percent}%`);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Update failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleting) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/categories/${deleting.id}`, "DELETE");
      toast.success("Category deleted", { description: "Products under it were unlinked." });
      setDeleting(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Delete failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const visible = flat.filter((n) => {
    // hide children of collapsed ancestors
    let p = n.parentId;
    while (p) {
      if (collapsed.has(p)) return false;
      p = flat.find((f) => f.id === p)?.parentId ?? null;
    }
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Categories"
        description="Catalog taxonomy with per-category commission rates (nearest ancestor wins in M09)."
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New category
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          {error ? (
            <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
          ) : loading ? (
            <TableSkeleton rows={6} cols={4} />
          ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No categories yet" hint="Create top-level categories, then nest children." />
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Category</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden w-40 md:table-cell">Slug</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="w-44">Commission %</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="w-10 text-right" />
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {visible.map((n) => {
                    const hasKids = n.children.length > 0;
                    const isCollapsed = collapsed.has(n.id);
                    return (
                      <TableRow key={n.id}>
                        <TableCell>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ paddingLeft: n.depth * 20 }}>
                            {hasKids ? (
                              <button
                                onClick={() => toggleCollapse(n.id)}
                                aria-label={isCollapsed ? `Expand ${n.name}` : `Collapse ${n.name}`}
                                className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded hover:bg-muted"
                              >
                                {isCollapsed ? <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" />}
                              </button>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="inline-block h-6 w-6" />
                            )}
                            <span className="font-medium">{n.name}</span>
                            {n.depth > 0 ? (
                              <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                                child
                              </Badge>
                            ) : null}
                          </div>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{n.slug}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {editing?.id === n.id ? (
                            <Input
                              autoFocus
                              inputMode="decimal"
                              value={editing.value}
                              onChange={(e) => setEditing({ id: n.id, value: e.target.value })}
                              onBlur={() => {
                                void saveCommission(n, editing.value);
                                setEditing(null);
                              }}
                              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                                if (e.key === "Enter") (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
                                if (e.key === "Escape") setEditing(null);
                              }}
                              className="h-9 w-28"
                              aria-label={`Commission percent for ${n.name}`}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setEditing({ id: n.id, value: n.commissionPercent != null ? String(n.commissionPercent) : "" })}
                              className="group inline-flex min-h-[36px] items-center gap-1.5 rounded px-1.5 text-sm hover:bg-muted"
                              aria-label={`Edit commission for ${n.name}`}
                            >
                              {n.commissionPercent != null ? (
                                <Badge variant="outline" className={cn(TONE_CLASS.teal, "tabular-nums")}>{n.commissionPercent}%</Badge>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-muted-foreground">inherit</span>
                              )}
                              <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3 opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-0" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right">
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="min-h-[44px] text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 sm:min-h-0 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                            onClick={() => setDeleting(n)}
                            aria-label={`Delete ${n.name}`}
                          >
                            Delete
                          </Button>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  })}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* create dialog */}
      <Dialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>New category</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>Top-level categories group the marketplace; children refine commission resolution.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="cat-name">Name</Label>
              <Input id="cat-name" value={newName} onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Home & Living" className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Parent</Label>
              <Select value={newParent} onValueChange={setNewParent}>
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Parent category"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent className="max-h-72">
                  <SelectItem value="root">— top level —</SelectItem>
                  {flat.map((c) => (
                    <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                      {"\u00A0".repeat(c.depth * 2)}
                      {c.name}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">Cancel</Button>
            <Button onClick={() => void create()} disabled={creating || !newName.trim()} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
              {creating ? "Creating…" : "Create"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <ConfirmTypingDelete
        target={deleting}
        busy={busy}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleting(null)}
        onConfirm={() => void doDelete()}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function ConfirmTypingDelete({
  target,
  busy,
  onOpenChange,
  onConfirm,
}: {
  target: CatRow | null;
  busy: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void;
  onConfirm: () => void;
}) {
  if (!target) return null;
  return (
    <TypingConfirm
      open={target !== null}
      onOpenChange={onOpenChange}
      title={`Delete “${target.name}”?`}
      description="Products in this category will be unlinked. Child categories are re-parented to its parent."
      expected={target.id}
      confirmLabel="Delete category"
      loading={busy}
      onConfirm={onConfirm}
    />
  );
}

// FIN-01 Commission Settings (w/ live example math) + FIN-04 Commission Simulator.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group";

import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";

  basePriceRule: "paid_price" | "list_price";
  fixedFeeMinor: number;
  minCommissionMinor: number;
  payoutHoldDays: number;
  holdReleaseRule: "days_after_paid" | "days_after_delivered";
  graceDaysAfterDelivered: number;
};

type SimTrace = {
  rule_source: string;
  source_id?: string;
  holiday_id?: string;
  percent: number;
  base: number;
  percent_part: number;
  fixed_fee_allocated: number;
  discount_allocated: number;
  shipping_allocated: number;
  flags: string[];
};

type SimResult = {
  commissionMinor: number;
  sellerNetMinor: number;
  holdDays: number;
  trace: SimTrace;
};

type SimBody = {
  priceMinor: number;
  qty: number;
  discountMinor: number;
  shippingMinor: number;
  categoryId?: string | null;
  sellerId?: string | null;
  productId?: string | null;
};

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- FIN-01 */

const emptyForm = {
  defaultPercent: "0",
  fixedFee: "0.00",
  minCommission: "0.00",
  appliesToShipping: false,
  basePriceRule: "paid_price",
  payoutHoldDays: "7",
  holdReleaseRule: "days_after_paid",
  graceDays: "2",
};

export function CommissionSettingsView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<SettingsBody>("/api/admin/commission/settings");
  const [form, setForm] = useState<typeof emptyForm | null>(null);
  const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // example math inputs
  const [exPrice, setExPrice] = useState("120.00");
  const [exDiscount, setExDiscount] = useState("0");
  const [exShipping, setExShipping] = useState("8.90");

  const [simResult, setSimResult] = useState<SimResult | null>(null);
  const [simError, setSimError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const debouncedEx = useDebounced(`${exPrice}|${exDiscount}|${exShipping}`, 450);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (data && !form) {
      setForm({
        defaultPercent: String(data.defaultPercent),
        fixedFee: (data.fixedFeeMinor / 100).toFixed(2),
        minCommission: (data.minCommissionMinor / 100).toFixed(2),
        appliesToShipping: data.appliesToShipping,
        basePriceRule: data.basePriceRule,
        payoutHoldDays: String(data.payoutHoldDays),
        holdReleaseRule: data.holdReleaseRule,
        graceDays: String(data.graceDaysAfterDelivered),
      });
    }
  }, [data, form]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const run = async () => {
      const [price, discount, shipping] = debouncedEx.split("|");
      try {
        const res = await apiSend<SimResult>("/api/admin/commission/simulate", "POST", {
          priceMinor: toMinor(price || "0"),
          qty: 1,
          discountMinor: toMinor(discount || "0"),
          shippingMinor: toMinor(shipping || "0"),
        });
        if (!cancelled) {
          setSimResult(res);
          setSimError(null);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setSimResult(null);
          setSimError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Simulation unavailable");
        }
      }
    };
    void run();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [debouncedEx]);

  const diffRows = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data || !form) return [];
    return [
      { label: "defaultPercent", from: `${data.defaultPercent}%`, to: `${form.defaultPercent}%`, changed: Number(form.defaultPercent) !== data.defaultPercent },
      { label: "fixedFee", from: formatMinor(data.fixedFeeMinor), to: formatMinor(toMinor(form.fixedFee)), changed: toMinor(form.fixedFee) !== data.fixedFeeMinor },
      { label: "minCommission", from: formatMinor(data.minCommissionMinor), to: formatMinor(toMinor(form.minCommission)), changed: toMinor(form.minCommission) !== data.minCommissionMinor },
      { label: "appliesToShipping", from: String(data.appliesToShipping), to: String(form.appliesToShipping), changed: form.appliesToShipping !== data.appliesToShipping },
      { label: "basePriceRule", from: data.basePriceRule, to: form.basePriceRule, changed: form.basePriceRule !== data.basePriceRule },
      { label: "payoutHoldDays", from: `${data.payoutHoldDays}d`, to: `${form.payoutHoldDays}d`, changed: Number(form.payoutHoldDays) !== data.payoutHoldDays },
      { label: "holdReleaseRule", from: data.holdReleaseRule, to: form.holdReleaseRule, changed: form.holdReleaseRule !== data.holdReleaseRule },
      { label: "graceDaysAfterDelivered", from: `${data.graceDaysAfterDelivered}d`, to: `${form.graceDays}d`, changed: Number(form.graceDays) !== data.graceDaysAfterDelivered },
    ];
  }, [data, form]);

  const dirty = useMemo(() => diffRows.some((r) => r.changed), [diffRows]);

  const save = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!form) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await apiSend("/api/admin/commission/settings", "PUT", {
        defaultPercent: Number(form.defaultPercent),
        fixedFeeMinor: toMinor(form.fixedFee),
        minCommissionMinor: toMinor(form.minCommission),
        appliesToShipping: form.appliesToShipping,
        basePriceRule: form.basePriceRule,
        payoutHoldDays: Number(form.payoutHoldDays),
        holdReleaseRule: form.holdReleaseRule,
        graceDaysAfterDelivered: Number(form.graceDays),
      });
      toast.success("Commission settings saved", { description: "Audited server-side; affects future orders." });
      setConfirmOpen(false);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Save failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }, [form, refetch]);

  if (error) {
    return <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="p-4"><ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} /></CardContent></Card>;
  }
  if (loading || !data || !form) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="h-8 w-64 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
        <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="h-72 p-4"><div className="h-full w-full animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" /></CardContent></Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // local estimate with unsaved values (client-side M09 core math)
  const exBase = Math.max(
    0,
    toMinor(exPrice || "0") - toMinor(exDiscount || "0") + (form.appliesToShipping ? toMinor(exShipping || "0") : 0)
  );
  const exPercentPart = Math.round(exBase * Number(form.defaultPercent || "0")) / 100;
  const exCommission = Math.round(exPercentPart) + toMinor(form.fixedFee || "0");
  const exNet = exBase + toMinor(exShipping || "0") - exCommission;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Commission"
        description="Global M09 engine defaults. Resolution: fee holiday → product → category → seller → global."
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(true)} disabled={!dirty}>
            {dirty ? "Save changes…" : "Saved"}
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-5">
        <Card className="py-0 xl:col-span-3">
          <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Global settings</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Money fields are entered in RM and stored as integer minor units.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 sm:p-6 sm:pt-0">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Default commission %</Label>
                <Input inputMode="decimal" value={form.defaultPercent} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, defaultPercent: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Fixed fee per order (RM)</Label>
                <Input inputMode="decimal" value={form.fixedFee} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, fixedFee: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Min commission per order (RM)</Label>
                <Input inputMode="decimal" value={form.minCommission} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, minCommission: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Payout hold days</Label>
                <Input inputMode="numeric" value={form.payoutHoldDays} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, payoutHoldDays: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Grace days after delivered</Label>
                <Input inputMode="numeric" value={form.graceDays} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, graceDays: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-end gap-3 pb-1.5">
                <Switch id="ship" checked={form.appliesToShipping} onCheckedChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, appliesToShipping: v })} />
                <Label htmlFor="ship" className="text-sm">Commission applies to shipping</Label>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Base price rule</Label>
                <RadioGroup value={form.basePriceRule} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, basePriceRule: v })} className="gap-2">
                  {["paid_price", "list_price"].map((v) => (
                    <div key={v} className="flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3">
                      <RadioGroupItem value={v} id={`bp-${v}`} />
                      <Label htmlFor={`bp-${v}`} className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-normal">
                        {v === "paid_price" ? "Paid price (after discounts)" : "List price (before discounts)"}
                      </Label>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </RadioGroup>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Hold release rule</Label>
                <RadioGroup value={form.holdReleaseRule} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, holdReleaseRule: v })} className="gap-2">
                  {["days_after_paid", "days_after_delivered"].map((v) => (
                    <div key={v} className="flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3">
                      <RadioGroupItem value={v} id={`hr-${v}`} />
                      <Label htmlFor={`hr-${v}`} className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-normal">
                        {v === "days_after_paid" ? "Days after payment" : "Days after delivery"}
                      </Label>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </RadioGroup>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* live example math */}
        <Card className="py-0 xl:col-span-2">
          <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Example math</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Live simulation against saved settings (debounced).</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-3 p-4 pt-0 sm:p-6 sm:pt-0">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Price RM</Label>
                <Input inputMode="decimal" value={exPrice} onChange={(e) => setExPrice(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[40px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Discount RM</Label>
                <Input inputMode="decimal" value={exDiscount} onChange={(e) => setExDiscount(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[40px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Shipping RM</Label>
                <Input inputMode="decimal" value={exShipping} onChange={(e) => setExShipping(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[40px]" />
              </div>
            </div>

            {simError ? (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-xs text-red-700 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300">
                {simError}
              </div>
            ) : simResult ? (
              <div className="space-y-2 rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Server trace (saved settings)</p>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">Commission</span>
                  <Money minor={simResult.commissionMinor} bold />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">Seller net</span>
                  <Money minor={simResult.sellerNetMinor} bold />
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className={cn(TONE_CLASS.teal, "capitalize")}>{(simResult.trace?.rule_source ?? "global").replace(/_/g, " ")}</Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline">{simResult.trace?.percent ?? 0}%</Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline">base {formatMinor(simResult.trace?.base ?? 0)}</Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline">hold {simResult.holdDays}d</Badge>
                  {(simResult.trace?.flags ?? []).map((f) => (
                    <Badge key={f} variant="outline" className={cn(TONE_CLASS.amber)}>{f.replace(/_/g, " ")}</Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : null}

            {dirty ? (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/60 p-3 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/30">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">Estimated with unsaved changes</p>
                <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">Commission</span>
                  <Money minor={exCommission} bold />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">Seller net</span>
                  <Money minor={exNet} bold />
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {confirmOpen ? (
        <SettingsDiffDialog rows={diffRows} saving={saving} onClose={() => setConfirmOpen(false)} onSave={() => void save()} />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function SettingsDiffDialog({
  rows,
  saving,
  onClose,
  onSave,
}: {
  rows: { label: string; from: string; to: string; changed: boolean }[];
  saving: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-4" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-xl border bg-background p-4 shadow-xl sm:p-6" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Confirm new commission settings</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Changed rows are highlighted; the save is audited.</p>
        <div className="mt-4 max-h-[50vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border [scrollbar-width:thin]">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Field</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Current</TableHead>
                <TableHead>New</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <TableRow key={r.label} className={cn(r.changed && "bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-amber-950/25")}>
                  <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{r.label}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-sm tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{r.from}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-sm font-medium tabular-nums">{r.to}</TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={onSave} disabled={saving} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">{saving ? "Saving…" : "Save settings"}</Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- FIN-04 */

type SimCategory = { id: string; name: string };
type SimSeller = { id: string; displayName: string };

export function SimulatorView() {
  const [price, setPrice] = useState("89.90");
  const [qty, setQty] = useState("1");
  const [discount, setDiscount] = useState("0");
  const [shipping, setShipping] = useState("0");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState("none");
  const [sellerId, setSellerId] = useState("none");

  const cats = useApi<SimCategory[]>("/api/admin/categories");
  const sellers = useApi<SimSeller[]>("/api/admin/sellers?size=100");

  const body: SimBody = useMemo(
    () => ({
      priceMinor: toMinor(price || "0"),
      qty: Math.max(1, Number(qty || "1")),
      discountMinor: toMinor(discount || "0"),
      shippingMinor: toMinor(shipping || "0"),
      categoryId: categoryId === "none" ? null : categoryId,
      sellerId: sellerId === "none" ? null : sellerId,
      productId: null,
    }),
    [price, qty, discount, shipping, categoryId, sellerId]
  );
  const debouncedBody = useDebounced(JSON.stringify(body), 450);

  const [result, setResult] = useState<SimResult | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const run = async () => {
      setRunning(true);
      setErr(null);
      try {
        const res = await apiSend<SimResult>("/api/admin/commission/simulate", "POST", JSON.parse(debouncedBody) as SimBody);
        if (!cancelled) setResult(res);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setResult(null);
          setErr(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Simulation failed");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setRunning(false);
      }
    };
    void run();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [debouncedBody]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader title="Commission Simulator" description="Pure what-if tool — nothing is persisted." />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <Card className="py-0">
          <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Inputs</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 p-4 pt-0 sm:p-6 sm:pt-0">
            <div className="space-y-1"><Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Price (RM)</Label><Input inputMode="decimal" value={price} onChange={(e) => setPrice(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" /></div>
            <div className="space-y-1"><Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Qty</Label><Input inputMode="numeric" value={qty} onChange={(e) => setQty(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" /></div>
            <div className="space-y-1"><Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Discount (RM)</Label><Input inputMode="decimal" value={discount} onChange={(e) => setDiscount(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" /></div>
            <div className="space-y-1"><Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Shipping (RM)</Label><Input inputMode="decimal" value={shipping} onChange={(e) => setShipping(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" /></div>
            <div className="col-span-2 space-y-1">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Category</Label>
              <Select value={categoryId} onValueChange={setCategoryId}>
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Category"><SelectValue placeholder="Any" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent className="max-h-72">
                  <SelectItem value="none">— any —</SelectItem>
                  {(cats.data ?? []).map((c) => <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="col-span-2 space-y-1">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Seller</Label>
              <Select value={sellerId} onValueChange={setSellerId}>
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Seller"><SelectValue placeholder="Any" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent className="max-h-72">
                  <SelectItem value="none">— any —</SelectItem>
                  {(sellers.data ?? []).map((s) => <SelectItem key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.displayName}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="py-0">
          <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
              Results
              {running ? <span className="h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-teal-500" aria-label="computing" /> : null}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 sm:p-6 sm:pt-0">
            {err ? (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300">{err}</div>
            ) : result ? (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-center">
                  <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3">
                    <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Commission</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-base font-bold text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-400 sm:text-lg">{formatMinor(result.commissionMinor)}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3">
                    <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Seller net</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-base font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 sm:text-lg">{formatMinor(result.sellerNetMinor)}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3">
                    <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Hold</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-base font-bold sm:text-lg">{result.holdDays}d</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <p className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Rule trace</p>
                  <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
                    <Table>
                      <TableBody>
                        <SimRow k="rule_source" v={result.trace?.rule_source} chip />
                        <SimRow k="percent" v={result.trace ? `${result.trace.percent}%` : undefined} />
                        <SimRow k="base" v={result.trace ? formatMinor(result.trace.base) : undefined} />
                        <SimRow k="percent_part" v={result.trace ? formatMinor(result.trace.percent_part) : undefined} />
                        <SimRow k="fixed_fee_allocated" v={result.trace ? formatMinor(result.trace.fixed_fee_allocated) : undefined} />
                        <SimRow k="discount_allocated" v={result.trace ? formatMinor(result.trace.discount_allocated) : undefined} />
                        <SimRow k="shipping_allocated" v={result.trace ? formatMinor(result.trace.shipping_allocated) : undefined} />
                        <SimRow k="flags" v={result.trace?.flags?.length ? result.trace.flags.join(", ") : undefined} />
                      </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <EmptyState title="Adjust inputs" hint="The simulator recomputes as you type." />
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SimRow({ k, v, chip }: { k: string; v?: string; chip?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <TableRow>
      <TableCell className="w-44 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{k}</TableCell>
      <TableCell>
        {v ? (
          chip ? (
            <Badge variant="outline" className={cn(TONE_CLASS.teal, "capitalize")}>{v.replace(/_/g, " ")}</Badge>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-sm tabular-nums">{v}</span>
          )
        ) : (
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>
        )}
      </TableCell>
    </TableRow>
  );
}
