```
"use client";
// FIN-02 Commission Overrides + FIN-03 Fee Holidays.
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { CalendarClock, Package, Plus, Store as StoreIcon, Tags } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { formatMinor, toMinor } from "@/lib/money";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { apiSend, useApi } from "./use-api";
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, Money, PageHeader, TableSkeleton, TONE_CLASS, TypingConfirm, fmtDate } from "./ui-bits";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ shared */

type CatOpt = { id: string; name: string };
type SellerOpt = { id: string; displayName: string; email: string };
type ProductOpt = { id: string; title: string };

function useTargetMaps() {
  const cats = useApi<CatOpt[]>("/api/admin/categories");
  const sellers = useApi<SellerOpt[]>("/api/admin/sellers?size=100");
  const products = useApi<ProductOpt[]>("/api/admin/products?status=all&size=100");
  return {
    catName: (id: string) => cats.data?.find((c) => c.id === id)?.name,
    sellerName: (id: string) => sellers.data?.find((s) => s.id === id)?.displayName,
    productName: (id: string) => products.data?.find((p) => p.id === id)?.title,
    ready: !cats.loading && !sellers.loading && !products.loading,
  };
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- FIN-02 */

type OverrideRow = {
  id: string;
  scope: "category" | "seller" | "product";
  categoryId?: string | null;
  sellerId?: string | null;
  productId?: string | null;
  percent?: number | null;
  fixedFeeMinor?: number | null;
  holdDays?: number | null;
  validFrom?: string | null;
  validTo?: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
};

const SCOPE_ICON = { category: Tags, seller: StoreIcon, product: Package };

export function OverridesView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<OverrideRow[]>("/api/admin/commission/overrides");
  const maps = useTargetMaps();
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<OverrideRow | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const toggle = async (o: OverrideRow) => {
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/commission/overrides/${o.id}`, "PATCH", { isActive: !o.isActive });
      toast.success(o.isActive ? "Override disabled" : "Override enabled");
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Toggle failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  };

  const targetLabel = (o: OverrideRow): string => {
    if (o.scope === "category") return maps.catName(o.categoryId ?? "") ?? o.categoryId ?? "—";
    if (o.scope === "seller") return maps.sellerName(o.sellerId ?? "") ?? o.sellerId ?? "—";
    return maps.productName(o.productId ?? "") ?? o.productId ?? "—";
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Commission Overrides"
        description="Per category, seller or product rates that outrank the global default (below fee holidays)."
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New override
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={5} cols={6} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No overrides" hint="Create scoped commission overrides for specific categories, sellers or products." />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Scope</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Target</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Percent</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell">Fixed fee</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell">Hold days</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Valid window</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Active</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="w-10" />
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {rows.map((o) => {
                    const Icon = SCOPE_ICON[o.scope as keyof typeof SCOPE_ICON] ?? Tags;
                    return (
                      <TableRow key={o.id}>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className={cn("capitalize", TONE_CLASS.teal)}>
                            <Icon className="h-3 w-3" /> {o.scope}
                          </Badge>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="max-w-[200px] truncate font-medium">{targetLabel(o)}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right">{o.percent != null ? <Badge variant="outline" className="tabular-nums">{o.percent}%</Badge> : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell">{o.fixedFeeMinor != null ? <Money minor={o.fixedFeeMinor} /> : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-right tabular-nums sm:table-cell">{o.holdDays ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">
                          {o.validFrom || o.validTo ? `${o.validFrom ? fmtDate(o.validFrom) : "…"} → ${o.validTo ? fmtDate(o.validTo) : "…"}` : "always"}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right">
                          <Switch checked={o.isActive} onCheckedChange={() => void toggle(o)} aria-label="Toggle override" />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="min-h-[44px] text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 sm:min-h-0 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                            onClick={() => setDeleting(o)}
                            aria-label="Delete override"
                          >
                            Delete
                          </Button>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  })}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <OverrideCreateDialog
        open={createOpen}
        onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}
        onCreated={() => {
          setCreateOpen(false);
          void refetch();
        }}
      />

      <TypingConfirm
        open={deleting !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleting(null)}
        title="Delete override?"
        description="The affected scope falls back to the next rule in the M09 chain."
        expected={deleting?.id ?? ""}
        confirmLabel="Delete override"
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (!deleting) return;
          setBusy(true);
          try {
            await apiSend(`/api/admin/commission/overrides/${deleting.id}`, "DELETE");
            toast.success("Override deleted");
            setDeleting(null);
            void refetch();
          } catch (e) {
            toast.error("Delete failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
          } finally {
            setBusy(false);
          }
        }}
        loading={busy}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function OverrideCreateDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onCreated }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; onCreated: () => void }) {
  const cats = useApi<CatOpt[]>("/api/admin/categories");
  const sellers = useApi<SellerOpt[]>("/api/admin/sellers?size=100");
  const products = useApi<ProductOpt[]>("/api/admin/products?status=all&size=100");

  const [scope, setScope] = useState<"category" | "seller" | "product">("category");
  const [targetId, setTargetId] = useState("");
  const [percent, setPercent] = useState("");
  const [fixedFee, setFixedFee] = useState("");
  const [holdDays, setHoldDays] = useState("");
  const [validFrom, setValidFrom] = useState("");
  const [validTo, setValidTo] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const targetOptions =
    scope === "category"
      ? (cats.data ?? []).map((c) => ({ id: c.id, label: c.name }))
      : scope === "seller"
        ? (sellers.data ?? []).map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: s.displayName }))
        : (products.data ?? []).map((p) => ({ id: p.id, label: p.title }));

  const submit = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = { scope };
      if (scope === "category") body.categoryId = targetId;
      if (scope === "seller") body.sellerId = targetId;
      if (scope === "product") body.productId = targetId;
      if (percent !== "") body.percent = Number(percent);
      if (fixedFee !== "") body.fixedFeeMinor = toMinor(fixedFee);
      if (holdDays !== "") body.holdDays = Number(holdDays);
      if (validFrom) body.validFrom = new Date(validFrom).toISOString();
      if (validTo) body.validTo = new Date(validTo).toISOString();
      await apiSend("/api/admin/commission/overrides", "POST", body);
      toast.success("Override created");
      setTargetId("");
      setPercent("");
      setFixedFee("");
      setHoldDays("");
      setValidFrom("");
      setValidTo("");
      onCreated();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Create failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>New commission override</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Leave a field blank to inherit that part from the chain below this override.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Scope</Label>
              <Select
                value={scope}
                onValueChange={(v) => {
                  setScope(v as typeof scope);
                  setTargetId("");
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Scope"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="category">Category</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="seller">Seller</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="product">Product</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Target</Label>
              <Select value={targetId} onValueChange={setTargetId}>
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Target"><SelectValue placeholder="Pick…" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent className="max-h-64">
                  {targetOptions.map((t) => (
                    <SelectItem key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                      <span className="max-w-[220px] truncate">{t.label}</span>
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Percent</Label>
              <Input inputMode="decimal" value={percent} onChange={(e) => setPercent(e.target.value)} placeholder="—" className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Fixed (RM)</Label>
              <Input inputMode="decimal" value={fixedFee} onChange={(e) => setFixedFee(e.target.value)} placeholder="—" className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Hold days</Label>
              <Input inputMode="numeric" value={holdDays} onChange={(e) => setHoldDays(e.target.value)} placeholder="—" className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Valid from</Label>
              <Input type="date" value={validFrom} onChange={(e) => setValidFrom(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Valid to</Label>
              <Input type="date" value={validTo} onChange={(e) => setValidTo(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} disabled={saving} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => void submit()} disabled={saving || !targetId} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
            {saving ? "Creating…" : "Create override"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- FIN-03 */

type HolidayRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  scope: "all" | "sellers" | "categories";
  scopeIds?: string | null;
  percent: number;
  startsAt: string;
  endsAt: string;
  isActive: boolean;
};

export function FeeHolidaysView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<HolidayRow[]>("/api/admin/commission/holidays");
  const maps = useTargetMaps();
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<HolidayRow | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const scopeLabel = (h: HolidayRow): string => {
    if (h.scope === "all") return "everything";
    const ids = parseIds(h.scopeIds);
    if (ids.length === 0) return h.scope;
    const names = ids
      .map((id) => (h.scope === "sellers" ? maps.sellerName(id) : maps.catName(id)))
      .filter(Boolean) as string[];
    return names.length > 0 ? names.slice(0, 3).join(", ") + (names.length > 3 ? ` +${names.length - 3}` : "") : `${ids.length} target${ids.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  };

  const toggle = async (h: HolidayRow) => {
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/commission/holidays/${h.id}`, "PATCH", { isActive: !h.isActive });
      toast.success(h.isActive ? "Holiday disabled" : "Holiday enabled");
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Toggle failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Fee Holidays"
        description="Zero-commission windows — the highest priority rule in the M09 engine."
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>
            <CalendarClock className="h-4 w-4" /> New holiday
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={4} cols={6} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No fee holidays" hint="Campaign windows with 0% commission appear here." />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Scope</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Window</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Percent</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Active</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="w-10" />
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {rows.map((h) => (
                    <TableRow key={h.id} className={cn(h.isActive && "bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20")}>
                      <TableCell className="font-medium">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          {h.name}
                          {h.isActive ? <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" aria-label="active" /> : null}
                        </span>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="max-w-[220px]">
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="capitalize">{h.scope}</Badge>
                        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{scopeLabel(h)}</p>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:table-cell">
                        {fmtDate(h.startsAt)} → {fmtDate(h.endsAt)}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Badge variant="outline" className="tabular-nums">{h.percent}%</Badge></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <Switch checked={h.isActive} onCheckedChange={() => void toggle(h)} aria-label="Toggle holiday" />
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          className="min-h-[44px] text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 sm:min-h-0 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                          onClick={() => setDeleting(h)}
                          aria-label="Delete holiday"
                        >
                          Delete
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <HolidayCreateDialog
        open={createOpen}
        onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}
        onCreated={() => {
          setCreateOpen(false);
          void refetch();
        }}
      />

      <TypingConfirm
        open={deleting !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleting(null)}
        title={`Delete “${deleting?.name ?? ""}”?`}
        description="Commission returns to the normal chain for the affected scope."
        expected={deleting?.id ?? ""}
        confirmLabel="Delete holiday"
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (!deleting) return;
          setBusy(true);
          try {
            await apiSend(`/api/admin/commission/holidays/${deleting.id}`, "DELETE");
            toast.success("Fee holiday deleted");
            setDeleting(null);
            void refetch();
          } catch (e) {
            toast.error("Delete failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
          } finally {
            setBusy(false);
          }
        }}
        loading={busy}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function parseIds(json: string | null | undefined): string[] {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(json ?? "[]");
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.map(String) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function HolidayCreateDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onCreated }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; onCreated: () => void }) {
  const cats = useApi<CatOpt[]>("/api/admin/categories");
  const sellers = useApi<SellerOpt[]>("/api/admin/sellers?size=100");

  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<"all" | "sellers" | "categories">("all");
  const [targets, setTargets] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [percent, setPercent] = useState("0");
  const [startsAt, setStartsAt] = useState("");
  const [endsAt, setEndsAt] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const options =
    scope === "sellers"
      ? (sellers.data ?? []).map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: s.displayName }))
      : (cats.data ?? []).map((c) => ({ id: c.id, label: c.name }));

  const submit = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await apiSend("/api/admin/commission/holidays", "POST", {
        name: name.trim(),
        scope,
        scopeIds: scope === "all" ? [] : targets,
        percent: Number(percent || "0"),
        startsAt: startsAt ? new Date(startsAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
        endsAt: endsAt ? new Date(endsAt).toISOString() : new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400000).toISOString(),
      });
      toast.success("Fee holiday created");
      setName("");
      setScope("all");
      setTargets([]);
      setPercent("0");
      setStartsAt("");
      setEndsAt("");
      onCreated();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Create failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>New fee holiday</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Active windows force 0% commission — useful for campaigns.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Name</Label>
            <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Raya campaign" className="min-h-[44px]" />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Scope</Label>
              <Select
                value={scope}
                onValueChange={(v) => {
                  setScope(v as typeof scope);
                  setTargets([]);
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Scope"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">Everything</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="sellers">Selected sellers</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="categories">Selected categories</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Percent</Label>
              <Input inputMode="decimal" value={percent} onChange={(e) => setPercent(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
          </div>
          {scope !== "all" ? (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Targets ({targets.length} selected)</Label>
              <ScrollArea className="h-44 rounded-lg border p-2">
                <div className="space-y-1.5 pr-2">
                  {options.map((o) => (
                    <label key={o.id} className="flex min-h-[36px] cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded px-1.5 text-sm hover:bg-muted">
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={targets.includes(o.id)}
                        onCheckedChange={(v) => setTargets((prev) => (v ? [...prev, o.id] : prev.filter((x) => x !== o.id)))}
                        aria-label={o.label}
                      />
                      <span className="truncate">{o.label}</span>
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </ScrollArea>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Starts</Label>
              <Input type="date" value={startsAt} onChange={(e) => setStartsAt(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Ends</Label>
              <Input type="date" value={endsAt} onChange={(e) => setEndsAt(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} disabled={saving} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => void submit()} disabled={saving || !name.trim()} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
            {saving ? "Creating…" : "Create holiday"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

```
"use client";
// MKT-01 Banners · MKT-02 Featured slots · MKT-03 Platform coupons.
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- BannersView */

type BannerRow = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  imageUrl: string;
  linkUrl?: string | null;
  sortOrder: number;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt?: string;
};

function randomBannerSeed(): string {
  return `banner-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

export function BannersView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<BannerRow[]>("/api/admin/banners");
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [imageUrl, setImageUrl] = useState(`/api/img/${randomBannerSeed()}?w=1400&h=400`);
  const [linkUrl, setLinkUrl] = useState("/market");
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState("0");
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<BannerRow | null>(null);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const regenerate = () => setImageUrl(`/api/img/${randomBannerSeed()}?w=1400&h=400`);

  const create = async () => {
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      await apiSend("/api/admin/banners", "POST", {
        title: title.trim(),
        imageUrl: imageUrl.trim() || undefined,
        linkUrl: linkUrl.trim() || undefined,
        sortOrder: Number(sortOrder) || 0,
        isActive: true,
      });
      toast.success("Banner created", { description: title.trim() });
      setCreateOpen(false);
      setTitle("");
      setLinkUrl("/market");
      setSortOrder("0");
      regenerate();
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Create failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const toggle = async (b: BannerRow) => {
    setBusyId(b.id);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/banners/${b.id}`, "PATCH", { isActive: !b.isActive });
      toast.success(`Banner ${b.isActive ? "hidden" : "activated"}`, { description: b.title });
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Update failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteTarget) return;
    setBusyId(deleteTarget.id);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/banners/${deleteTarget.id}`, "DELETE");
      toast.success("Banner deleted", { description: deleteTarget.title });
      setDeleteTarget(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Delete failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Banners"
        description="Marketplace hero banners shown on the market home."
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New banner
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
            <Megaphone className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" /> Banners ({rows.length})
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {error ? (
            <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
          ) : loading ? (
            <TableSkeleton rows={3} cols={5} />
          ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No banners yet" hint="Create the first marketplace banner." />
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="w-28">Preview</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Banner</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Link</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden text-center sm:table-cell">Order</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Created</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-center">Active</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {rows.map((b) => (
                  <TableRow key={b.id}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="relative h-10 w-24 overflow-hidden rounded-md border bg-muted">
                        <Image src={b.imageUrl} alt={b.title} fill unoptimized sizes="96px" className="object-cover" />
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <p className="max-w-[280px] truncate font-medium">{b.title}</p>
                      <p className="max-w-[280px] truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{b.imageUrl}</p>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[160px] truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">
                      {b.linkUrl ?? "—"}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden text-center tabular-nums sm:table-cell">{b.sortOrder}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{fmtDT(b.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-center">
                      <Switch
                        checked={b.isActive}
                        disabled={busyId === b.id}
                        onCheckedChange={() => void toggle(b)}

                      />
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        className="min-h-[44px] text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 sm:min-h-0 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                        onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(b)}
                      >
                        Delete
                      </Button>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}

      <Dialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}>

                <Input id="banner-img" value={imageUrl} onChange={(e) => setImageUrl(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px] flex-1 font-mono text-xs" />
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px]" onClick={regenerate}>
                  Shuffle
                </Button>
              </div>
              <div className="relative mt-1 h-24 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-muted">
                <Image src={imageUrl} alt="Banner preview" fill unoptimized sizes="480px" className="object-cover" />

            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
              <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
                <Label htmlFor="banner-link">Link URL</Label>
                <Input id="banner-link" value={linkUrl} onChange={(e) => setLinkUrl(e.target.value)} placeholder="/market" className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="banner-order">Sort order</Label>
                <Input id="banner-order" inputMode="numeric" value={sortOrder} onChange={(e) => setSortOrder(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>

          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)} disabled={creating} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">Cancel</Button>
            <Button onClick={() => void create()} disabled={creating || !title.trim()} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
              {creating ? "Creating…" : "Create banner"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={deleteTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteTarget(null)}
        title="Delete banner?"
        description={deleteTarget ? `“${deleteTarget.title}” will be removed from the marketplace.` : ""}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        destructive
        loading={busyId !== null}
        onConfirm={() => void doDelete()}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ FeaturedView */

type FeaturedRow = {
  id: string;
  slot: string;
  sortOrder: number;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt?: string;
  product: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    slug: string;
    priceMinor: number;
    status: string;
    imageUrl: string | null;
    storeName: string;
    storeSlug: string;
  } | null;
};

type ProductOption = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  slug: string;
  priceMinor: number;
  status: string;
  store?: { name: string } | null;
  storeName?: string | null;
  images?: { url: string }[];
  imageUrl?: string | null;
};

export function FeaturedView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<FeaturedRow[]>("/api/admin/featured");
  const rows = data ?? [];
  const featuredIds = useMemo(() => new Set(rows.map((r) => r.product?.id).filter(Boolean) as string[]), [rows]);

  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");
  const search = useDebounced(searchInput.trim(), 350);
  const productsUrl = search ? `/api/admin/products${qs({ status: "active", search, size: 10 })}` : null;
  const products = useApi<ProductOption[]>(productsUrl);

  const [addingId, setAddingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<FeaturedRow | null>(null);

  const add = async (p: ProductOption) => {
    setAddingId(p.id);
    try {
      await apiSend("/api/admin/featured", "POST", { productId: p.id, slot: "home_grid" });
      toast.success("Added to featured", { description: p.title });
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Could not feature product", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setAddingId(null);
    }
  };

  const remove = async () => {
    if (!deleteTarget) return;
    setBusyId(deleteTarget.id);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/featured/${deleteTarget.id}`, "DELETE");
      toast.success("Removed from featured", { description: deleteTarget.product?.title ?? "" });
      setDeleteTarget(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Remove failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Featured"
        description="Curated products shown in the marketplace home grid."
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
            <Star className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" /> Featured products ({rows.length})
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Ordered by slot position — removal unsets isFeatured on the product.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {error ? (
            <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
          ) : loading ? (
            <TableSkeleton rows={4} cols={5} />
          ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="Nothing featured" hint="Search and add products below." />
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="w-14">Thumb</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Product</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Store</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Price</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Slot</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Status</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Action</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {rows.map((f) => (
                  <TableRow key={f.id}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="relative h-10 w-10 overflow-hidden rounded-md border bg-muted">
                        {f.product?.imageUrl ? (
                          <Image src={f.product.imageUrl} alt={f.product.title} fill unoptimized sizes="40px" className="object-cover" />
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="max-w-[240px] truncate font-medium">{f.product?.title ?? "(deleted product)"}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden text-sm text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{f.product?.storeName ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={f.product?.priceMinor ?? 0} /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden text-sm sm:table-cell">
                      <Badge variant="outline">{f.slot}</Badge> <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">#{f.sortOrder}</span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden lg:table-cell"><StatusChip status={f.product?.status ?? "unknown"} /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        className="min-h-[44px] text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 sm:min-h-0 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                        onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(f)}
                      >
                        Remove
                      </Button>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="text-base">Add a product</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Search active products across the marketplace, then feature them.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              value={searchInput}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search products by title or slug…"
              className="min-h-[44px] pl-9"
              aria-label="Search products to feature"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 max-h-[300px] space-y-2 overflow-y-auto [scrollbar-width:thin]">
            {!search ? (
              <p className="py-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Type at least a few characters to search.</p>
            ) : products.loading ? (
              Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />)
            ) : (products.data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">No active products match “{search}”.</p>
            ) : (
              (products.data ?? []).map((p) => {
                const featured = featuredIds.has(p.id);
                return (
                  <div key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-2.5">
                    <div className="relative h-11 w-11 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-md border bg-muted">
                      {p.images?.[0]?.url || p.imageUrl ? (
                        <Image src={(p.images?.[0]?.url ?? p.imageUrl) as string} alt={p.title} fill unoptimized sizes="44px" className="object-cover" />
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{p.title}</p>
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{p.store?.name ?? p.storeName ?? "—"} · <Money minor={p.priceMinor} muted /></p>
                    </div>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant={featured ? "outline" : "default"}
                      className="min-h-[36px] w-20 sm:min-h-0"
                      disabled={featured || addingId !== null}
                      onClick={() => void add(p)}
                    >
                      {featured ? "Featured" : addingId === p.id ? "Adding…" : "Add"}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={deleteTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteTarget(null)}
        title="Remove from featured?"
        description={deleteTarget?.product ? `“${deleteTarget.product.title}” will leave the marketplace home grid.` : ""}
        confirmLabel="Remove"
        destructive
        loading={busyId !== null}
        onConfirm={() => void remove()}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- CouponsView */

type CouponRow = {
  id: string;
  scope: string;
  code: string;
  description?: string | null;
  type: "percent" | "fixed" | "freeship" | string;
  percent?: number | null;
  amountMinor?: number | null;
  minSpendMinor?: number;
  maxRedemptions?: number | null;
  perCustomerLimit?: number;
  startsAt?: string | null;
  endsAt?: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
  timesUsed?: number;
  createdAt?: string;
  store?: { id: string; name: string } | null;
};

function couponValue(c: CouponRow): string {
  if (c.type === "percent") return `${c.percent ?? 0}% off`;
  if (c.type === "fixed") return formatMinor(c.amountMinor ?? 0) + " off";
  return "Free shipping";
}

export function CouponsView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<CouponRow[]>("/api/admin/coupons?size=50");
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState<"percent" | "fixed" | "freeship">("percent");
  const [percent, setPercent] = useState("10");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("10.00");
  const [minSpend, setMinSpend] = useState("0");
  const [perCustomerLimit, setPerCustomerLimit] = useState("1");
  const [startsAt, setStartsAt] = useState("");
  const [endsAt, setEndsAt] = useState("");
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<CouponRow | null>(null);

  const resetForm = () => {
    setCode("");
    setDescription("");
    setType("percent");
    setPercent("10");
    setAmount("10.00");
    setMinSpend("0");
    setPerCustomerLimit("1");
    setStartsAt("");
    setEndsAt("");
  };

  const create = async () => {
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
        code: code.trim().toUpperCase(),
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
        type,
        minSpendMinor: toMinor(minSpend || "0"),
        perCustomerLimit: Math.max(1, Number(perCustomerLimit) || 1),
      };
      if (type === "percent") body.percent = Number(percent);
      if (type === "fixed") body.amountMinor = toMinor(amount || "0");
      if (startsAt) body.startsAt = new Date(startsAt).toISOString();
      if (endsAt) body.endsAt = new Date(`${endsAt}T23:59:59`).toISOString();
      await apiSend("/api/admin/coupons", "POST", body);
      toast.success("Coupon created", { description: body.code as string });
      setCreateOpen(false);
      resetForm();
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Create failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const toggle = async (c: CouponRow) => {
    setBusyId(c.id);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/coupons/${c.id}`, "PATCH", { isActive: !c.isActive });
      toast.success(`Coupon ${c.isActive ? "disabled" : "enabled"}`, { description: c.code });
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Update failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteTarget) return;
    setBusyId(deleteTarget.id);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/coupons/${deleteTarget.id}`, "DELETE");
      toast.success("Coupon deleted", { description: deleteTarget.code });
      setDeleteTarget(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Delete failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Coupons"
        description="Platform-wide promo codes — store-scoped coupons are managed in the seller portal."
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>
            <Ticket className="h-4 w-4" /> New coupon
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={4} cols={7} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No coupons" hint="Create a platform coupon to attract first orders." />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Code</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Value</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Scope</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell">Min spend</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden text-center lg:table-cell">Used</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden xl:table-cell">Window</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-center">Active</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {rows.map((c) => (
                    <TableRow key={c.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <p className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold">{c.code}</p>
                        <p className="max-w-[200px] truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{c.description ?? "—"}</p>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="capitalize">{c.type}</Badge>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm">{couponValue(c)}</p>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-sm md:table-cell">
                        {c.scope === "store" ? c.store?.name ?? "store" : <Badge variant="outline">platform</Badge>}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell"><Money minor={c.minSpendMinor ?? 0} muted /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-center tabular-nums lg:table-cell">{c.timesUsed ?? 0}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground xl:table-cell">
                        {c.startsAt || c.endsAt ? `${c.startsAt ? fmtDT(c.startsAt) : "∞"} → ${c.endsAt ? fmtDT(c.endsAt) : "∞"}` : "always"}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-center">
                        <Switch checked={c.isActive} disabled={busyId === c.id} onCheckedChange={() => void toggle(c)} aria-label={`Toggle coupon ${c.code}`} />
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="ghost"
                          className="min-h-[44px] text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 sm:min-h-0 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                          onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(c)}
                        >
                          Delete
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Dialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-lg [scrollbar-width:thin]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>New platform coupon</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>Applies at checkout across all storefronts (unless a store scope is chosen server-side).</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="coupon-code">Code</Label>
                <Input
                  id="coupon-code"
                  value={code}
                  onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                  placeholder="RAYA25"
                  className="min-h-[44px] font-mono uppercase"
                  autoComplete="off"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label>Type</Label>
                <Select value={type} onValueChange={(v) => setType(v as typeof type)}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Coupon type"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="percent">Percent off</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="fixed">Fixed amount off</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="freeship">Free shipping</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="coupon-desc">Description</Label>
              <Input id="coupon-desc" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="Shown at checkout" className="min-h-[44px]" />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {type === "percent" ? (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="coupon-percent">Percent (%)</Label>
                  <Input id="coupon-percent" inputMode="decimal" value={percent} onChange={(e) => setPercent(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
                </div>
              ) : null}
              {type === "fixed" ? (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="coupon-amount">Amount (RM)</Label>
                  <Input id="coupon-amount" inputMode="decimal" value={amount} onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
                </div>
              ) : null}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="coupon-min">Min spend (RM)</Label>
                <Input id="coupon-min" inputMode="decimal" value={minSpend} onChange={(e) => setMinSpend(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="coupon-limit">Per-customer limit</Label>
                <Input id="coupon-limit" inputMode="numeric" value={perCustomerLimit} onChange={(e) => setPerCustomerLimit(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="coupon-start">Starts at (optional)</Label>
                <Input id="coupon-start" type="date" value={startsAt} onChange={(e) => setStartsAt(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="coupon-end">Ends at (optional)</Label>
                <Input id="coupon-end" type="date" value={endsAt} onChange={(e) => setEndsAt(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[44px]" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)} disabled={creating} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">Cancel</Button>
            <Button
              onClick={() => void create()}
              disabled={
                creating ||
                !code.trim() ||
                (type === "percent" && !(Number(percent) >= 0)) ||
                (type === "fixed" && !(Number(amount) >= 0))
              }
              className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0"
            >
              {creating ? "Creating…" : "Create coupon"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={deleteTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteTarget(null)}
        title="Delete coupon?"
        description={deleteTarget ? `Code ${deleteTarget.code} will stop working immediately.` : ""}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        destructive
        loading={busyId !== null}
        onConfirm={() => void doDelete()}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
"use client";
// CAT-01 Product Moderation — pending_review gallery + detail drawer with decisions.
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Drawer, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle } from "@/components/ui/drawer";
import { useApi, apiSend } from "./use-api";
import { qs } from "./nav";
import type { AdminNav } from "./nav";
import {
  ConfirmDialog,
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  Money,
  PageHeader,
  Pager,
  ReasonDialog,
  StatusChip,
  TypingConfirm,
  fmtDate,
} from "./ui-bits";

type AdminProductRow = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  slug: string;
  priceMinor: number;
  status: string;
  description?: string | null;
  flagsJson?: string | null;
  flags?: string[];
  reportsCount?: number;
  createdAt?: string;
  store?: { id: string; name: string; slug: string } | null;
  storeName?: string | null;
  images?: { id: string; url: string }[];
  imageUrl?: string | null;
  category?: { name: string } | null;
};

function flagsOf(p: AdminProductRow): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(p.flags)) return p.flags;
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(p.flagsJson ?? "[]");
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.map(String) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function firstImage(p: AdminProductRow): string | null {
  if (p.images && p.images.length > 0) return p.images[0].url;
  if (p.imageUrl) return p.imageUrl;
  return `/api/img/${encodeURIComponent(p.slug || p.id)}?w=400&h=300&label=${encodeURIComponent(p.title.slice(0, 12))}`;
}

export function ModerationView({ nav }: { nav: AdminNav }) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const url = useMemo(() => `/api/admin/products${qs({ status: "pending_review", page, size: "12" })}`, [page]);
  const { data, meta, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<AdminProductRow[]>(url);
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<AdminProductRow | null>(null);
  const [rejectTarget, setRejectTarget] = useState<AdminProductRow | null>(null);
  const [banTarget, setBanTarget] = useState<AdminProductRow | null>(null);
  const [approveTarget, setApproveTarget] = useState<AdminProductRow | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const moderate = async (p: AdminProductRow, kind: "approve" | "reject" | "ban", reason?: string) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/products/${p.id}/${kind}`, "POST", kind === "approve" ? undefined : { reason });
      toast.success(`Product ${kind === "approve" ? "approved" : kind}`, { description: p.title });
      setDetail(null);
      setRejectTarget(null);
      setBanTarget(null);
      setApproveTarget(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(`Failed to ${kind} product`, { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Moderation"
        description="Products awaiting review before they can go live."
        actions={
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => void refetch()} disabled={loading}>
            Refresh
          </Button>
        }
      />

      {error ? (
        <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="p-4"><ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} /></CardContent></Card>
      ) : loading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 2xl:grid-cols-4">
          {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border">
              <div className="aspect-[4/3] animate-pulse bg-muted" />
              <div className="space-y-2 p-4"><div className="h-4 w-3/4 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" /><div className="h-3 w-1/2 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" /></div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="p-4"><EmptyState title="Moderation queue is clear" hint="New or flagged products will appear here." /></CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 2xl:grid-cols-4">
            {rows.map((p) => {
              const flags = flagsOf(p);
              return (
                <button
                  key={p.id}
                  onClick={() => setDetail(p)}
                  className="group overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-card text-left shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600"
                >
                  <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] bg-muted">
                    <Image
                      src={firstImage(p) as string}
                      alt={p.title}
                      fill
                      unoptimized
                      sizes="(max-width: 640px) 100vw, (max-width: 1024px) 50vw, 25vw"
                      className="object-cover"
                    />
                    {flags.length > 0 ? (
                      <Badge className="absolute right-2 top-2 border-red-200 bg-red-600 text-white">
                        {flags.length} flag{flags.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
                      </Badge>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 p-4">
                    <p className="line-clamp-1 text-sm font-semibold">{p.title}</p>
                    <p className="line-clamp-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{p.store?.name ?? p.storeName ?? "—"}</p>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
                      <Money minor={p.priceMinor} bold />
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{fmtDate(p.createdAt)}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <Pager page={meta?.page ?? page} size={meta?.size ?? 12} total={meta?.total ?? rows.length} onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))} onNext={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)} />
        </>
      )}

      {/* detail drawer */}
      <Drawer open={detail !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetail(null)}>
        <DrawerContent className="max-h-[92vh]">
          {detail ? (
            <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-2xl overflow-y-auto p-4 [scrollbar-width:thin]">
              <DrawerHeader className="px-0 pt-0">
                <DrawerTitle className="text-left">{detail.title}</DrawerTitle>
                <DrawerDescription className="text-left">
                  {detail.store?.name ?? detail.storeName ?? "—"} · listed {fmtDate(detail.createdAt)}
                </DrawerDescription>
              </DrawerHeader>

              <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 [scrollbar-width:thin]">
                {(detail.images && detail.images.length > 0
                  ? detail.images.map((i) => i.url)
                  : [firstImage(detail) as string]
                ).map((u, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="relative h-40 w-40 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-muted">
                    <Image src={u} alt={`${detail.title} image ${i + 1}`} fill unoptimized sizes="160px" className="object-cover" />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-sm">
                <div><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Price</p><Money minor={detail.priceMinor} bold /></div>
                <div><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Category</p><p>{detail.category?.name ?? "—"}</p></div>
                <div><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Status</p><StatusChip status={detail.status} /></div>
                <div><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Reports</p><p>{detail.reportsCount ?? 0}</p></div>
                <div className="col-span-2">
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Store</p>
                  <button
                    className="text-sm font-medium text-teal-700 underline-offset-2 hover:underline dark:text-teal-400"
                    onClick={() => nav.navigate("stores")}
                  >
                    {detail.store?.name ?? detail.storeName ?? "—"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {flagsOf(detail).length > 0 ? (
                <div className="mt-3">
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Moderation flags</p>
                  <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {flagsOf(detail).map((f, i) => (
                      <Badge key={i} variant="outline" className="border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300">
                        {f}
                      </Badge>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}

              {detail.description ? (
                <div className="mt-3">
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Description</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg border bg-muted/40 p-3 text-sm">{detail.description}</p>
                </div>
              ) : null}

              <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col gap-2 pb-4 sm:flex-row">
                <Button className="min-h-[44px] flex-1 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setApproveTarget(detail)}>
                  Approve
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] flex-1" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setRejectTarget(detail)}>
                  Reject…
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] flex-1 border-red-200 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 dark:border-red-900 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setBanTarget(detail)}>
                  Ban…
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </DrawerContent>
      </Drawer>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={approveTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setApproveTarget(null)}
        title="Approve product?"
        description={approveTarget ? `“${approveTarget.title}” will become active and buyable.` : ""}
        confirmLabel="Approve"
        loading={busy}
        onConfirm={() => approveTarget && void moderate(approveTarget, "approve")}
      />

      <ReasonDialog
        open={rejectTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setRejectTarget(null)}
        title="Reject product"
        description={rejectTarget ? `“${rejectTarget.title}” will be returned to the seller with your reason.` : ""}
        submitLabel="Reject"
        destructive
        loading={busy}
        onSubmit={(reason) => rejectTarget && void moderate(rejectTarget, "reject", reason)}
      />

      <TypingConfirm
        open={banTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setBanTarget(null)}
        title="Ban product"
        description="Policy violation — the product is removed from sale permanently."
        expected={banTarget?.id ?? ""}
        confirmLabel="Ban product"
        loading={busy}
        onConfirm={() => banTarget && void moderate(banTarget, "ban", "Banned by admin")}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
// Admin command centre — internal navigation types (no URLs; views are state).
export type AdminParams = Record<string, string>;

export type AdminNav = {
  view: string;
  params: AdminParams;
  navigate: (view: string, params?: AdminParams) => void;
};

/** Build a query string from a filter object (empty/nullish values skipped). */
export function qs(params: Record<string, string | number | null | undefined>): string {
  const sp = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (v !== null && v !== undefined && String(v) !== "") sp.set(k, String(v));
  }
  const s = sp.toString();
  return s ? `?${s}` : "";
}
```

```
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-t pt-2">
                <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{order.orderNumber}</span>
              </div>

}

function MoneyRow({
  label,
  minor,
  bold,
  accent,
}: {
  label: string;
  minor: number;
  bold?: boolean;
  accent?: "teal" | "emerald";
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-dashed border-border/60 pb-1.5 sm:block sm:border-0">
      <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt>
      <dd
        className={cn(
          "tabular-nums",
          bold && "font-semibold text-base",
          accent === "teal" && "text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-400",
          accent === "emerald" && "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
        )}
      >
        {formatMinor(minor)}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}
```
