"use client";
// ORD-01 All Orders list + ORD-03 Refunds queue + ORD-04 Disputes.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Search, X } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { apiSend, useApi } from "./use-api";
import { qs } from "./nav";
import type { AdminNav } from "./nav";
import {
  ConfirmDialog,
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  Money,
  PageHeader,
  Pager,
  ReasonDialog,
  StatusChip,
  TableSkeleton,
  fmtDT,
  timeAgo,
} from "./ui-bits";

const ORDER_STATUSES = [
  "payment_pending", "paid", "processing", "shipped", "delivered", "completed",
  "cancelled", "refunding", "partially_refunded", "refunded", "closed",
];

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- ORD-01 */

type AdminOrderRow = {
  id: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  status: string;
  totalMinor: number;
  commissionMinor?: number;
  paidAt?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  store?: { name: string } | null;
  storeName?: string | null;
};

type StoreOption = { id: string; name: string };

export function OrdersView({ nav }: { nav: AdminNav }) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
  const [storeId, setStoreId] = useState("all");
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  const stores = useApi<StoreOption[]>("/api/admin/stores");

  const url = useMemo(
    () => `/api/admin/orders${qs({ status: status === "all" ? "" : status, storeId: storeId === "all" ? "" : storeId, search, page, size: 20 })}`,
    [status, storeId, search, page]
  );
  const { data, meta, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<AdminOrderRow[]>(url);
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const activeFilters = status !== "all" || storeId !== "all" || search !== "";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader title="All Orders" description="Every order across storefronts and the marketplace." />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
            <form
              className="relative flex-1"
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                setPage(1);
                setSearch(searchInput.trim());
              }}
            >
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                value={searchInput}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search order number or customer…"
                className="min-h-[44px] pl-9"
                aria-label="Search orders"
              />
            </form>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Select value={status} onValueChange={(v) => { setStatus(v); setPage(1); }}>
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-full lg:w-44" aria-label="Order status filter"><SelectValue placeholder="Status" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
                  {ORDER_STATUSES.map((s) => (
                    <SelectItem key={s} value={s} className="capitalize">{s.replace(/_/g, " ")}</SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <Select value={storeId} onValueChange={(v) => { setStoreId(v); setPage(1); }}>
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-full lg:w-48" aria-label="Store filter"><SelectValue placeholder="Store" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All stores</SelectItem>
                  {(stores.data ?? []).map((s) => (
                    <SelectItem key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name}</SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              {activeFilters ? (
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="icon"
                  className="min-h-[44px] w-11 sm:min-h-0"
                  aria-label="Clear filters"
                  onClick={() => { setStatus("all"); setStoreId("all"); setSearch(""); setSearchInput(""); setPage(1); }}
                >
                  <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                </Button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={8} cols={7} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No orders match" hint="Adjust the filters above." />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>Order</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Store</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Customer</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">Total</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell">Commission</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Paid at</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">Age</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {rows.map((o) => (
                      <TableRow key={o.id} className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => nav.navigate("order-detail", { orderId: o.id })}>
                        <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{o.orderNumber}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[160px] truncate md:table-cell">{o.store?.name ?? o.storeName ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <p className="max-w-[160px] truncate font-medium">{o.customerName}</p>
                          <p className="max-w-[160px] truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{o.customerEmail}</p>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={o.totalMinor} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell">
                          {o.commissionMinor != null ? <Money minor={o.commissionMinor} muted /> : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell><StatusChip status={o.status} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{o.paidAt ? fmtDT(o.paidAt) : "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground">{timeAgo(o.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
                <div className="px-1 pb-1">
                  <Pager page={meta?.page ?? page} size={meta?.size ?? 20} total={meta?.total ?? rows.length} onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))} onNext={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)} />
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- ORD-03 */

type AdminRefundRow = {
  id: string;
  amountMinor: number;
  reason?: string | null;
  status: string;
  requestedBy: string;
  restock?: boolean;
  commissionReversalMinor?: number;
  processedAt?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  order?: { id: string; orderNumber: string; totalMinor: number } | null;
};

export function RefundsView({ nav }: { nav: AdminNav }) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
  const url = useMemo(() => `/api/admin/refunds${qs({ status: status === "all" ? "" : status })}`, [status]);
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<AdminRefundRow[]>(url);
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [processTarget, setProcessTarget] = useState<AdminRefundRow | null>(null);
  const [rejectTarget, setRejectTarget] = useState<AdminRefundRow | null>(null);

  const approve = async (r: AdminRefundRow): Promise<boolean> => {
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/refunds/${r.id}/approve`, "POST");
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Approve failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
      return false;
    }
  };

  const quickApprove = async (r: AdminRefundRow) => {
    setBusy(r.id);
    const ok = await approve(r);
    setBusy(null);
    if (ok) {
      toast.success("Refund approved", { description: "Ready to process (posts ledger refund)." });
      void refetch();
    }
  };

  const process = async (r: AdminRefundRow) => {
    setBusy(r.id);
    try {
      if (r.status === "requested") {
        const ok = await approve(r);
        if (!ok) return;
      }
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/refunds/${r.id}/process`, "POST");
      toast.success("Refund processed", { description: "Ledger T5 posted and wallet adjusted." });
      setProcessTarget(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Process failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const reject = async (r: AdminRefundRow, reason: string) => {
    setBusy(r.id);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/refunds/${r.id}/reject`, "POST", { reason });
      toast.success("Refund rejected");
      setRejectTarget(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Reject failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Refunds"
        description="Approve, then process — processing posts the ledger refund and reverses commission."
        actions={
          <Select value={status} onValueChange={setStatus}>
            <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-44" aria-label="Refund status filter"><SelectValue placeholder="Status" /></SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="requested">requested</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="approved">approved</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="processed">processed</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="rejected">rejected</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        }
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={6} cols={6} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No refunds here" hint="Seller refund requests will queue up in this view." />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Order</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Reason</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Requested by</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Created</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Action</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {rows.map((r) => (
                    <TableRow key={r.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <button
                          className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-teal-700 underline-offset-2 hover:underline dark:text-teal-400"
                          onClick={() => r.order?.id && nav.navigate("order-detail", { orderId: r.order.id })}
                        >
                          {r.order?.orderNumber ?? "view order"}
                        </button>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={r.amountMinor} bold /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[220px] truncate text-sm md:table-cell">{r.reason ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-sm capitalize">{r.requestedBy}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell><StatusChip status={r.status} /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{timeAgo(r.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                          {r.status === "requested" ? (
                            <>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => setRejectTarget(r)}>
                                Reject
                              </Button>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void quickApprove(r)}>
                                Approve
                              </Button>
                            </>
                          ) : null}
                          {r.status === "requested" || r.status === "approved" ? (
                            <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => setProcessTarget(r)}>
                              Process
                            </Button>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.processedAt ? timeAgo(r.processedAt) : "—"}</span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={processTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setProcessTarget(null)}
        title="Process refund?"
        description={
          processTarget
            ? `Posts ledger refund for ${processTarget.order?.orderNumber ?? "this order"}, reverses commission and adjusts the seller wallet${processTarget.restock === false ? ". No restock" : "; variants are restocked"}.`
            : ""
        }
        confirmLabel="Process refund"
        loading={busy !== null}
        onConfirm={() => processTarget && void process(processTarget)}
      />

      <ReasonDialog
        open={rejectTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setRejectTarget(null)}
        title="Reject refund"
        description="The seller/shopper will be notified with the reason."
        submitLabel="Reject refund"
        destructive
        loading={busy !== null}
        onSubmit={(reason) => rejectTarget && void reject(rejectTarget, reason)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

type AdminDisputeRow = {
  id: string;
  reason: string;
  status: string;
  openedBy: string;
  resolution?: string | null;
  resolvedAt?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  order?: { id: string; orderNumber: string; customerName: string; totalMinor: number } | null;
};

export function DisputesView({ nav }: { nav: AdminNav }) {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<AdminDisputeRow[]>("/api/admin/disputes");
  const rows = data ?? [];
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<AdminDisputeRow | null>(null);
  const [nextStatus, setNextStatus] = useState("under_review");
  const [resolution, setResolution] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (detail) {
      setNextStatus(detail.status === "open" ? "under_review" : detail.status);
      setResolution(detail.resolution ?? "");
    }
  }, [detail]);

  const patch = async () => {
    if (!detail) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/disputes/${detail.id}`, "PATCH", {
        status: nextStatus,
        resolution: nextStatus === "resolved" || nextStatus === "rejected" ? resolution.trim() : undefined,
      });
      toast.success(`Dispute ${nextStatus.replace(/_/g, " ")}`);
      setDetail(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Update failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader title="Disputes" description="Buyer disputes raised on orders across the platform." />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={5} cols={5} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No disputes" hint="You are all caught up." />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Order</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Reason</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Opened by</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Created</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Action</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {rows.map((d) => (
                    <TableRow key={d.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <button
                          className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-teal-700 underline-offset-2 hover:underline dark:text-teal-400"
                          onClick={() => d.order?.id && nav.navigate("order-detail", { orderId: d.order.id })}
                        >
                          {d.order?.orderNumber ?? "—"}
                        </button>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[260px] truncate text-sm md:table-cell">{d.reason}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell><StatusChip status={d.status} /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-sm capitalize sm:table-cell">{d.openedBy}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{fmtDT(d.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => setDetail(d)}>
                          Review
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Dialog open={detail !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetail(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Dispute — {detail?.order?.orderNumber ?? "order"}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {detail ? `Opened by ${detail.openedBy} · ${fmtDT(detail.createdAt)}` : ""}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          {detail ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm">
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Order</p>
                <button className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-teal-700 hover:underline dark:text-teal-400" onClick={() => { const id = detail.order?.id; setDetail(null); if (id) nav.navigate("order-detail", { orderId: id }); }}>
                  {detail.order?.orderNumber ?? "—"} · <Money minor={detail.order?.totalMinor} />
                </button>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm">{detail.order?.customerName ?? ""}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Reason</p>
                <p className="mt-1 rounded-lg border bg-muted/40 p-3 text-sm">{detail.reason}</p>
              </div>
              {detail.resolution ? (
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Current resolution note</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm">{detail.resolution}</p>
                </div>
              ) : null}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Set status</p>
                <Select value={nextStatus} onValueChange={setNextStatus}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Dispute status"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="under_review">under review</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="resolved">resolved</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="rejected">rejected</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              {(nextStatus === "resolved" || nextStatus === "rejected") ? (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Resolution note</p>
                  <Textarea value={resolution} onChange={(e) => setResolution(e.target.value)} rows={3} placeholder="Outcome shared with buyer and seller…" className="resize-none" />
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDetail(null)} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">Close</Button>
            <Button onClick={() => void patch()} disabled={busy} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
              {busy ? "Saving…" : "Update dispute"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// FIN-07 Payout Batches (run + preview + history) and Payout Batch Detail
// (per-payout statement trace, mark paid / mark failed with ledger T4 posts).
import { Fragment, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Landmark, PlayCircle, PlusCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { formatMinor } from "@/lib/money";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { apiSend, parseJsonSafe, useApi } from "./use-api";
import type { AdminNav } from "./nav";
import {
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  Money,
  PageHeader,
  ReasonDialog,
  StatusChip,
  TableSkeleton,
  fmtDT,
  timeAgo,
} from "./ui-bits";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ types */

type PayoutRow = {
  id: string;
  batchId: string;
  referenceNo: string;
  amountMinor: number;
  status: string;
  method: string;
  providerRef?: string | null;
  failReason?: string | null;
  paidAt?: string | null;
  statementJson?: string | null;
  createdAt?: string;
  sellerName?: string | null;
  sellerEmail?: string | null;
  bankAccount?: { id: string; bankName: string; holderName: string; accountNumberMasked: string } | null;
};

type PayoutBatch = {
  id: string;
  runType: string;
  status: string;
  currency: string;
  totalMinor: number;
  payoutCount: number;
  startedAt?: string;
  finishedAt?: string | null;
  payouts?: PayoutRow[];
};

type Statement = {
  sellerName?: string;
  periodFrom?: string;
  periodTo?: string;
  salesMinor?: number;
  commissionMinor?: number;
  refundsMinor?: number;
  adjustmentsMinor?: number;
  negativeCarryMinor?: number;
  orderCount?: number;
  lines?: { label: string; amountMinor: number }[];
};

type DryRunBody = {
  dryRun: boolean;
  minMinor: number;
  mode: string;
  eligibleCount: number;
  eligibleTotalMinor: number;
  eligible: {
    walletId: string;
    sellerId: string;
    sellerName: string;
    storeName: string | null;
    availableMinor: number;
    bank: { id: string; bankName: string; holderName: string; accountNumberMasked: string; verified: boolean } | null;
  }[];
};

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ PayoutsView */

export function PayoutsView({ nav }: { nav: AdminNav }) {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<PayoutBatch[]>("/api/admin/payout-batches");
  const rows = useMemo(() => data ?? [], [data]);

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<DryRunBody | null>(null);
  const [previewLoading, setPreviewLoading] = useState(false);
  const [previewError, setPreviewError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);

  const loadPreview = useCallback(async () => {
    setPreviewLoading(true);
    setPreviewError(null);
    try {
      const body = await apiSend<DryRunBody>("/api/admin/payout-batches", "POST", { dryRun: true });
      setPreview(body);
    } catch (e) {
      setPreview(null);
      setPreviewError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Preview failed");
    } finally {
      setPreviewLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) void loadPreview();
  }, [open, loadPreview]);

  const runBatch = async () => {
    setRunning(true);
    try {
      const body = await apiSend<{ batch?: PayoutBatch; payouts?: PayoutRow[] }>("/api/admin/payout-batches", "POST", { dryRun: false });
      const count = body?.payouts?.length ?? body?.batch?.payoutCount ?? 0;
      toast.success("Payout batch created", {
        description: `${count} payout${count === 1 ? "" : "s"} queued · ${formatMinor(body?.batch?.totalMinor ?? 0)} — ledger T3 posted per wallet.`,
      });
      setOpen(false);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
      toast.error("Batch not created", { description: msg });
      // A 409 NO_ELIGIBLE_WALLETS leaves the dialog open with a fresh preview.
      void loadPreview();
    } finally {
      setRunning(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Payout Batches"
        description="Weekly settlement runs — wallets above the minimum are swept to seller banks (T3 → T4)."
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
            <PlusCircle className="h-4 w-4" /> New Payout Batch
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={5} cols={6} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No payout batches yet" hint="Run your first batch — eligible wallets are previewed before anything is written." />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Batch</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Run type</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Payouts</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Total</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Started</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden text-right lg:table-cell">Finished</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {rows.map((b) => (
                    <TableRow
                      key={b.id}
                      className="cursor-pointer"
                      onClick={() => nav.navigate("payout-detail", { batchId: b.id })}
                    >
                      <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{b.id.slice(0, 8)}…</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="capitalize">{b.runType ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell><StatusChip status={b.status} /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{b.payoutCount ?? b.payouts?.length ?? 0}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={b.totalMinor} bold /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{b.startedAt ? fmtDT(b.startedAt) : "—"}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{b.finishedAt ? fmtDT(b.finishedAt) : "—"}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* new batch dialog */}
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-2xl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <PlayCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" /> New payout batch
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Dry-run preview first — nothing is written until you confirm. Eligibility: wallet available ≥ minimum payout setting.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          {previewLoading ? (
            <div className="space-y-2 py-2">
              {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="h-12 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : previewError ? (
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300">
              {previewError}
            </div>
          ) : preview ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <span>min payout <Money minor={preview.minMinor} muted /></span>
                <span>mode <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-1">{preview.mode}</Badge></span>
                <span>{preview.eligibleCount} eligible wallet{preview.eligibleCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}</span>
                <span>total <Money minor={preview.eligibleTotalMinor} muted bold /></span>
              </div>
              {preview.eligible.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState
                  title="No eligible wallets"
                  hint={`No wallet currently meets the ${formatMinor(preview.minMinor)} minimum — the live run would return 409 NO_ELIGIBLE_WALLETS.`}
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="max-h-[320px] overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border [scrollbar-width:thin]">
                  <Table>
                    <TableHeader>
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableHead>Seller / Store</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="text-right">Available</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="text-right">Will pay</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Bank</TableHead>
                      </TableRow>
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {preview.eligible.map((e) => (
                        <TableRow key={e.walletId}>
                          <TableCell>
                            <p className="font-medium">{e.sellerName}</p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{e.storeName ?? "—"}</p>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={e.availableMinor} muted /></TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={e.availableMinor} bold /></TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="hidden sm:table-cell">
                            {e.bank ? (
                              <span className="text-xs">
                                {e.bank.bankName} · <span className="font-mono">{e.bank.accountNumberMasked}</span>
                                {!e.bank.verified ? <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-1.5 border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300">unverified</Badge> : null}
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-xs text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">no bank on file</span>
                            )}
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      ))}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} disabled={running} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => void runBatch()} disabled={running || previewLoading || !preview || preview.eligibleCount === 0} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
              {running ? "Running…" : `Confirm run (${preview?.eligibleCount ?? 0})`}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------- PayoutDetailView */

export function PayoutDetailView({ nav, batchId }: { nav: AdminNav; batchId: string }) {
  const batches = useApi<PayoutBatch[]>("/api/admin/payout-batches");
  const payoutsReq = useApi<PayoutRow[]>(`/api/admin/payouts?batchId=${encodeURIComponent(batchId)}`);
  const batch = useMemo(
    () => (batches.data ?? []).find((b) => b.id === batchId) ?? null,
    [batches.data, batchId]
  );
  const payouts = payoutsReq.data ?? [];

  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [payTarget, setPayTarget] = useState<PayoutRow | null>(null);
  const [failTarget, setFailTarget] = useState<PayoutRow | null>(null);

  const done = () => {
    void payoutsReq.refetch();
    void batches.refetch();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="-ml-2 min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => nav.navigate("payouts")}>
        ← All payout batches
      </Button>

      {batches.error ? (
        <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="p-4"><ErrorState message={batches.error} onRetry={() => void batches.refetch()} /></CardContent></Card>
      ) : batches.loading ? (
        <div className="h-10 w-64 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
      ) : batch ? (
        <Card className="py-0">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 text-sm">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Batch</p>
                <p className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{batch.id}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Status</p>
                <StatusChip status={batch.status} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Total</p>
                <Money minor={batch.totalMinor} bold />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Payouts</p>
                <p className="tabular-nums">{batch.payoutCount ?? payouts.length}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Started</p>
                <p className="text-xs">{fmtDT(batch.startedAt)}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Finished</p>
                <p className="text-xs">{batch.finishedAt ? fmtDT(batch.finishedAt) : "—"}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <Card className="py-0">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Batch not found — it may have been removed.</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="text-base">Payouts in this batch</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Click a payout to inspect its settlement statement, then mark it paid or failed.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {payoutsReq.error ? (
              <ErrorState message={payoutsReq.error} onRetry={() => void payoutsReq.refetch()} />
            ) : payoutsReq.loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={4} cols={6} />
            ) : payouts.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No payouts in this batch" />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead className="w-8" />
                    <TableHead>Reference</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Seller</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Method</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden text-right lg:table-cell">Updated</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {payouts.map((p) => (
                    <Fragment key={p.id}>
                      <TableRow className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setExpanded(expanded === p.id ? null : p.id)}>
                        <TableCell>{expanded === p.id ? <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{p.referenceNo}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <p className="font-medium">{p.sellerName ?? "—"}</p>
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{p.sellerEmail ?? ""}</p>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={p.amountMinor} bold /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <StatusChip status={p.status} />
                          {p.failReason ? <p className="mt-1 max-w-[180px] truncate text-[11px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{p.failReason}</p> : null}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-sm capitalize md:table-cell">{p.method?.replace(/_/g, " ") ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{timeAgo(p.paidAt ?? p.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                      {expanded === p.id ? (
                        <TableRow>
                          <TableCell colSpan={7} className="bg-muted/30">
                            <PayoutExpand
                              payout={p}
                              onMarkPaid={() => setPayTarget(p)}
                              onMarkFailed={() => setFailTarget(p)}
                            />
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      ) : null}
                    </Fragment>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* mark paid */}
      <MarkPaidDialog
        payout={payTarget}
        onClose={() => setPayTarget(null)}
        onDone={() => {
          setPayTarget(null);
          done();
        }}
      />

      {/* mark failed */}
      <ReasonDialog
        open={failTarget !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setFailTarget(null)}
        title="Mark payout as failed"
        description={
          failTarget
            ? `${failTarget.referenceNo} · ${formatMinor(failTarget.amountMinor)} — the debit is reversed in the ledger (T4f) and funds return to the seller wallet.`
            : ""
        }
        placeholder="Reason (e.g. bank account closed)…"
        submitLabel="Mark failed"
        destructive
        onSubmit={(reason) => {
          if (!failTarget) return;
          apiSend(`/api/admin/payouts/${failTarget.id}/fail`, "POST", { reason })
            .then(() => {
              toast.success("Payout marked failed", { description: "Ledger reversal posted; funds returned to wallet." });
              setFailTarget(null);
              done();
            })
            .catch((e: unknown) => toast.error("Failed to update payout", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }));
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function PayoutExpand({
  payout,
  onMarkPaid,
  onMarkFailed,
}: {
  payout: PayoutRow;
  onMarkPaid: () => void;
  onMarkFailed: () => void;
}) {
  const st = parseJsonSafe<Statement>(payout.statementJson, {});
  const lines = st.lines ?? [];
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 p-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <div className="lg:col-span-2">
        <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
          Settlement statement{st.sellerName ? ` — ${st.sellerName}` : ""}
        </p>
        {lines.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No statement lines recorded for this payout.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-card">
            <Table>
              <TableBody>
                {lines.map((l, i) => (
                  <TableRow key={i}>
                    <TableCell className="text-sm">{l.label}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="w-32 text-right"><Money minor={l.amountMinor} /></TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
                <TableRow className="border-t-2">
                  <TableCell className="text-sm font-semibold">Net payout</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="w-32 text-right"><Money minor={payout.amountMinor} bold /></TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </div>
        )}
        {st.orderCount != null || st.periodTo ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {st.orderCount != null ? `${st.orderCount} paid order${st.orderCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : ""}
            {st.periodFrom && st.periodTo ? ` · ${fmtDT(st.periodFrom)} → ${fmtDT(st.periodTo)}` : ""}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Bank</p>
          {payout.bankAccount ? (
            <div className="mt-1.5 space-y-1 rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 text-sm">
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                <Landmark className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" /> {payout.bankAccount.bankName}
              </p>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{payout.bankAccount.holderName}</p>
              <p className="font-mono text-xs">{payout.bankAccount.accountNumberMasked}</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">No bank account linked</p>
          )}
        </div>
        {payout.providerRef ? (
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Bank reference</p>
            <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-xs">{payout.providerRef}</p>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {payout.status === "processing" ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700" onClick={onMarkPaid}>
              Mark paid…
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] border-red-200 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 dark:border-red-900 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40" onClick={onMarkFailed}>
              Mark failed…
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className={cn("text-xs", payout.status === "paid" ? "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-muted-foreground")}>
            {payout.status === "paid" ? `Paid ${fmtDT(payout.paidAt)}` : "No actions available"}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MarkPaidDialog({
  payout,
  onClose,
  onDone,
}: {
  payout: PayoutRow | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const [refNo, setRefNo] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (payout) setRefNo("");
  }, [payout]);

  const submit = async () => {
    if (!payout || !refNo.trim()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/payouts/${payout.id}/mark-paid`, "POST", { referenceNo: refNo.trim() });
      toast.success("Payout marked paid", {
        description: `${payout.referenceNo} · bank ref ${refNo.trim()} — ledger T4 posted.`,
      });
      onDone();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Mark paid failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={payout !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Mark payout as paid</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {payout ? `${payout.referenceNo} · ${formatMinor(payout.amountMinor)} to ${payout.sellerName ?? "seller"}.` : ""}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="payout-ref">Bank reference number (required)</Label>
          <Input
            id="payout-ref"
            value={refNo}
            onChange={(e) => setRefNo(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. BK-20261008-8817"
            className="min-h-[44px]"
            autoFocus
          />
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Recorded on the payout and posted to the ledger as payout_confirmed (T4).</p>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => void submit()} disabled={saving || !refNo.trim()} className="min-h-[44px] bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 sm:min-h-0">
            {saving ? "Posting…" : "Confirm paid"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";
// REP-01 Reports & Exports — sales / sellers / commission / payouts reports
// with a global window selector (7/30/90 days) and CSV export buttons.
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Bar,
  BarChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  Legend,
  Line,
  LineChart,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from "recharts";
import { Download } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { formatMinor } from "@/lib/money";
import { useApi } from "./use-api";
import {
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  KpiCard,
  Money,
  PageHeader,
  StatusChip,
  TableSkeleton,
  fmtDT,
} from "./ui-bits";

type SalesReport = {
  series: { date: string; gmvMinor: number; orders: number; commissionMinor: number }[];
  totals: { gmvMinor: number; orders: number; commissionMinor: number; aovMinor: number };
  days: number;
};

type SellersReport = {
  rows: { storeName: string; gmvMinor: number; orders: number; commissionMinor: number; aovMinor: number }[];
  totals: { gmvMinor: number; orders: number; commissionMinor: number; stores: number };
  days: number;
};

type CommissionReport = {
  series: { date: string; gmvMinor: number; orders: number; commissionMinor: number }[];
  byCategory: { categoryName: string; commissionMinor: number }[];
  effectiveRate: number;
  totals: { commissionMinor: number; gmvMinor: number; items: number; itemsValueMinor: number };
  days: number;
};

type PayoutsReport = {
  batches: {
    id: string;
    runType: string;
    status: string;
    totalMinor: number;
    payoutCount: number;
    startedAt?: string;
    finishedAt?: string | null;
    payouts: { id: string; referenceNo: string; sellerName: string; amountMinor: number; status: string; method: string; paidAt?: string | null }[];
  }[];
  totals: { totalMinor: number; count: number; paidMinor: number; processingMinor: number; failedMinor: number; batchCount: number };
  days: number;
};

const CHART_MARGIN = { top: 8, right: 12, left: 4, bottom: 0 };

const tooltipStyle = { borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 12 };

export function ReportsView() {
  const [days, setDays] = useState("30");

  const exportCsv = (entity: "orders" | "sellers" | "ledger") => {
    window.location.href = `/api/admin/export?entity=${entity}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Reports & Exports"
        description="Aggregated performance over a selectable window, plus CSV downloads."
        actions={
          <>
            <Select value={days} onValueChange={setDays}>
              <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-32" aria-label="Report window">
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="7">Last 7 days</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="30">Last 30 days</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="90">Last 90 days</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => exportCsv("orders")}>
              <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Orders CSV
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => exportCsv("sellers")}>
              <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Sellers CSV
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => exportCsv("ledger")}>
              <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Ledger CSV
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      />

      <Tabs defaultValue="sales">
        <TabsList className="h-auto flex-wrap">
          <TabsTrigger value="sales" className="min-h-[44px]">Sales</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="sellers" className="min-h-[44px]">Sellers</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="commission" className="min-h-[44px]">Commission</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="payouts" className="min-h-[44px]">Payouts</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="sales" className="mt-4"><SalesTab days={days} /></TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="sellers" className="mt-4"><SellersTab days={days} /></TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="commission" className="mt-4"><CommissionTab days={days} /></TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="payouts" className="mt-4"><PayoutsTab /></TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- sales */

function SalesTab({ days }: { days: string }) {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<SalesReport>(`/api/admin/reports/sales?days=${days}`);
  const series = useMemo(() => (data?.series ?? []).map((p) => ({ ...p, gmvMinor: Number(p.gmvMinor) || 0, commissionMinor: Number(p.commissionMinor) || 0 })), [data]);
  const t = data?.totals;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <KpiCard label="GMV" value={<Money minor={t?.gmvMinor} bold />} icon={undefined} sub={`${t?.orders ?? 0} paid orders`} />
        <KpiCard label="Commission" value={<Money minor={t?.commissionMinor} bold />} sub="platform earnings" />
        <KpiCard label="AOV" value={<Money minor={t?.aovMinor} bold />} sub="average order value" />
        <KpiCard label="Take rate" value={<span className="tabular-nums">{t?.gmvMinor ? `${((t.commissionMinor / t.gmvMinor) * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : "—"}</span>} sub="commission / GMV" />
      </div>

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="text-base">GMV & commission — last {days} days</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Daily paid-order totals across all storefronts</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="px-2 pb-4 sm:px-4">
          {error ? (
            <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
          ) : loading ? (
            <div className="h-[260px] animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />
          ) : series.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No data in this window" hint="Paid orders will populate the chart." />
          ) : (
            <div className="h-[280px] w-full">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <LineChart data={series} margin={CHART_MARGIN}>
                  <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="currentColor" className="text-border" vertical={false} />
                  <XAxis
                    dataKey="date"
                    tickFormatter={(v) => String(v).slice(5)}
                    fontSize={11}
                    tickLine={false}
                    axisLine={false}
                    minTickGap={24}
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    className="text-muted-foreground"
                  />
                  <YAxis
                    tickFormatter={(v) => `RM${Math.round(Number(v) / 100)}`}
                    fontSize={11}
                    tickLine={false}
                    axisLine={false}
                    width={58}
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    className="text-muted-foreground"
                  />
                  <Tooltip
                    formatter={(v, name) => [formatMinor(Number(v)), String(name)]}
                    labelFormatter={(l) => `Date: ${l}`}
                    contentStyle={tooltipStyle}
                  />
                  <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 12 }} />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="gmvMinor" name="GMV" stroke="#0d9488" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} />

        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <div className="max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto [scrollbar-width:thin]">
            {loading ? (

                    <TableHead className="text-right">Commission</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Orders</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {[...series].reverse().map((p) => (
                    <TableRow key={p.date}>
                      <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{p.date}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={p.gmvMinor} /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={p.commissionMinor} muted /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{p.orders}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- sellers */

function SellersTab({ days }: { days: string }) {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<SellersReport>(`/api/admin/reports/sellers?days=${days}`);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">

        <KpiCard label="Commission" value={<Money minor={t?.commissionMinor} bold />} sub="platform earnings" />
        <KpiCard label="Active stores" value={<span className="tabular-nums">{t?.stores ?? 0}</span>} sub="with paid orders" />
        <KpiCard
          label="Top store"
          value={<span className="truncate text-base font-semibold">{rows[0]?.storeName ?? "—"}</span>}
          sub={rows[0] ? `${formatMinor(rows[0].gmvMinor)} GMV` : "no data"}
        />
      </div>

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="text-base">Top 8 stores by GMV</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="px-2 pb-4 sm:px-4">
          {error ? (
            <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
          ) : loading ? (
            <div className="h-[260px] animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />
          ) : top8.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No seller GMV in this window" />
          ) : (
            <div className="h-[300px] w-full">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <BarChart data={top8} margin={CHART_MARGIN}>
                  <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="currentColor" className="text-border" vertical={false} />
                  <XAxis
                    dataKey="storeName"
                    fontSize={11}
                    tickLine={false}
                    axisLine={false}
                    interval={0}

                    angle={-20}

                    stroke="currentColor"
                    className="text-muted-foreground"

                  <YAxis
                    tickFormatter={(v) => `RM${Math.round(Number(v) / 100)}`}

                    axisLine={false}
                    width={58}

                    className="text-muted-foreground"
                  />
                  <Tooltip formatter={(v) => formatMinor(Number(v))} contentStyle={tooltipStyle} cursor={{ fill: "rgba(13,148,136,0.08)" }} />
                  <Bar dataKey="gmvMinor" name="GMV" fill="#0d9488" radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]} />
                </BarChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="text-base">All sellers ({rows.length})</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={5} cols={5} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No seller activity" hint="No paid orders in this window." />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Store</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Orders</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">GMV</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Commission</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell">AOV</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {rows.map((r) => (
                    <TableRow key={r.storeName}>
                      <TableCell className="max-w-[220px] truncate font-medium">{r.storeName}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{r.orders}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={r.gmvMinor} /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={r.commissionMinor} muted /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell"><Money minor={r.aovMinor} muted /></TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

                </TableHeader>

                    <TableRow key={b.id}>

                      <TableCell><StatusChip status={b.status} /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{b.payoutCount}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={b.totalMinor} bold /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{fmtDT(b.startedAt)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{b.finishedAt ? fmtDT(b.finishedAt) : "—"}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// SEL-02 Seller Detail — overview, KYC docs, products, orders, wallet, bank, notes.
import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";

  fmtDT,
  timeAgo,
} from "./ui-bits";

type KycDoc = { id: string; docType: string; fileName: string; status: string; rejectReason?: string | null; reviewedAt?: string | null };
type BankAcc = { id: string; holderName: string; bankName: string; accountNumberMasked: string; verified: boolean };
type Note = { id: string; author: string; body: string; createdAt: string };
type MiniProduct = { id: string; title: string; status: string; priceMinor: number };
type MiniOrder = { id: string; orderNumber: string; status: string; totalMinor: number; createdAt: string };

type SellerDetailBody = {
  seller: {
    id: string;
    email: string;
    fullName: string;
    displayName: string;
    status: string;
    riskTier: string;
    kycStatus: string;
    planCode: string;
    marketplaceOptIn: boolean;
    commissionOverridePercent: number | null;
    holdDaysOverride: number | null;
    rejectReason?: string | null;
    submittedAt?: string | null;
    approvedAt?: string | null;
    createdAt: string;
  };
  store?: { id: string; name: string; slug: string; status: string } | null;
  kycDocuments: KycDoc[];
  bankAccounts: BankAcc[];
  wallet?: { id: string; pendingMinor: number; availableMinor: number; lifetimeEarnedMinor: number; lifetimeCommissionMinor: number } | null;
  products?: MiniProduct[];
  orders?: MiniOrder[];
  notes?: Note[];
  gmv30dMinor?: number;
};

export function SellerDetailView({ nav, sellerId }: { nav: AdminNav; sellerId: string }) {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<SellerDetailBody>(`/api/admin/sellers/${sellerId}`);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // dialogs
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState<"approve" | "activate" | null>(null);
  const [rejectOpen, setRejectOpen] = useState(false);
  const [suspendOpen, setSuspendOpen] = useState(false);
  const [terminateOpen, setTerminateOpen] = useState(false);

  // overview form
  const [risk, setRisk] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [commPct, setCommPct] = useState<string>("");
  const [holdDays, setHoldDays] = useState<string>("");
  const [optIn, setOptIn] = useState<boolean | null>(null);

  const [noteBody, setNoteBody] = useState("");

  const seller = data?.seller;
  const store = data?.store;

  const act = async (key: string, path: string, body?: unknown, okMsg?: string) => {
    setBusy(key);
    try {
      await apiSend(path, "POST", body);
      toast.success(okMsg ?? "Done");
      void refetch();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Action failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
      return false;
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const saveOverview = async () => {
    if (!seller) return;
    setBusy("overview");
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/sellers/${seller.id}`, "PATCH", {
        riskTier: risk ?? seller.riskTier,
        commissionOverridePercent: commPct === "" ? null : Number(commPct),
        holdDaysOverride: holdDays === "" ? null : Number(holdDays),
        marketplaceOptIn: optIn ?? seller.marketplaceOptIn,
      });
      toast.success("Seller updated", { description: "Changes audited server-side." });
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Update failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  if (error) {
    return (
      <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="p-4"><ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} /></CardContent></Card>
    );
  }
  if (loading || !data || !seller) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="h-8 w-64 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
        <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="p-4"><TableSkeleton rows={4} cols={4} /></CardContent></Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const status = seller.status;
  const wallet = data.wallet;
  const docs = data.kycDocuments ?? [];
  const banks = data.bankAccounts ?? [];
  const notes = [...(data.notes ?? [])].sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt < b.createdAt ? 1 : -1));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="-ml-2 min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => nav.navigate("sellers")}>
        ← All sellers
      </Button>

      <PageHeader
        title={seller.displayName}
        description={`${store?.name ?? "No store"} · ${seller.email}`}
        actions={
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {status === "pending_review" || status === "rejected" ? (
              <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => setConfirm("approve")}>
                Approve
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {status === "pending_review" ? (
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => setRejectOpen(true)}>
                Reject
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {status === "active" ? (
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => setSuspendOpen(true)}>
                Suspend
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {status === "suspended" ? (
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => setConfirm("activate")}>
                Activate
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {status !== "terminated" ? (
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] border-red-200 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 sm:min-h-0 dark:border-red-900 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => setTerminateOpen(true)}>
                Terminate
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        }
      />

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <StatusChip status={status} />
        <RiskChip tier={seller.riskTier} />
        <Badge variant="outline" className="capitalize">{seller.kycStatus.replace(/_/g, " ")} kyc</Badge>
        <Badge variant="outline" className="capitalize">{seller.planCode} plan</Badge>
        <Badge variant="outline" className="capitalize">{seller.marketplaceOptIn ? "marketplace opt-in" : "marketplace off"}</Badge>
        {data.gmv30dMinor != null ? <Badge variant="outline" className="border-teal-200 bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 dark:border-teal-900 dark:bg-teal-950/60 dark:text-teal-300">GMV 30d {formatMinor(data.gmv30dMinor)}</Badge> : null}
      </div>

      <Tabs defaultValue="overview">
        <TabsList className="h-auto flex-wrap">
          <TabsTrigger value="overview" className="min-h-[44px]">Overview</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="kyc" className="min-h-[44px]">KYC docs ({docs.length})</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="products" className="min-h-[44px]">Products</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="orders" className="min-h-[44px]">Orders</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="wallet" className="min-h-[44px]">Wallet</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="bank" className="min-h-[44px]">Bank ({banks.length})</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="notes" className="min-h-[44px]">Notes ({notes.length})</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        {/* ------------------------------------------------- overview */}
        <TabsContent value="overview" className="mt-4 space-y-4">
          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
              <CardTitle className="text-base">Commission & risk controls</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Overrides applied by the M09 engine before category/global defaults.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 sm:p-6 sm:pt-0">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Risk tier</Label>
                  <Select value={risk ?? seller.riskTier} onValueChange={setRisk}>
                    <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Risk tier"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value="low">low</SelectItem>

                      <SelectItem value="high">high</SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Commission override % (blank = inherit)</Label>
                  <Input
                    inputMode="decimal"
                    value={commPct}
                    onChange={(e) => setCommPct(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={seller.commissionOverridePercent != null ? String(seller.commissionOverridePercent) : "inherit"}
                    className="min-h-[44px]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Payout hold days override (blank = global)</Label>
                  <Input
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    value={holdDays}
                    onChange={(e) => setHoldDays(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={seller.holdDaysOverride != null ? String(seller.holdDaysOverride) : "global default"}
                    className="min-h-[44px]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-end gap-3 pb-1">
                  <Switch
                    checked={optIn ?? seller.marketplaceOptIn}
                    onCheckedChange={setOptIn}
                    id="optin"

                  <Label htmlFor="optin" className="text-sm">Marketplace opt-in</Label>
                </div>

              <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
                <Button onClick={() => void saveOverview()} disabled={busy !== null} className="min-h-[44px]">

              </div>

          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
              <CardTitle className="text-base">Lifecycle</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 p-4 pt-0 text-sm sm:grid-cols-3 sm:p-6 sm:pt-0">
              <div><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Created</p><p>{fmtDT(seller.createdAt)}</p></div>
              <div><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Submitted for review</p><p>{fmtDT(seller.submittedAt)}</p></div>
              <div><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Approved</p><p>{fmtDT(seller.approvedAt)}</p></div>
              {seller.rejectReason ? <div className="sm:col-span-3"><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Reject reason</p><p className="text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{seller.rejectReason}</p></div> : null}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* ------------------------------------------------- kyc docs */}
        <TabsContent value="kyc" className="mt-4">
          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {docs.length === 0 ? (
