                    <TableBody>
                      {docs.map((d) => (
                        <KycDocRow key={d.id} doc={d} sellerId={seller.id} busy={busy !== null} onDone={() => void refetch()} />
                      ))}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                </ScrollY>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* ------------------------------------------------- products */}
        <TabsContent value="products" className="mt-4">
          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {(data.products ?? []).length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState title="No products" />
              ) : (
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>Title</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">Price</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {(data.products ?? []).map((p) => (
                      <TableRow key={p.id}>
                        <TableCell className="max-w-[280px] truncate font-medium">{p.title}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={p.priceMinor} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell><StatusChip status={p.status} /></TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* ------------------------------------------------- orders */}
        <TabsContent value="orders" className="mt-4">
          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {(data.orders ?? []).length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState title="No orders yet" />
              ) : (
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>Order</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">Total</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden text-right sm:table-cell">Placed</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {(data.orders ?? []).map((o) => (
                      <TableRow key={o.id} className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => nav.navigate("order-detail", { orderId: o.id })}>
                        <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs font-medium">{o.orderNumber}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={o.totalMinor} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell><StatusChip status={o.status} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:table-cell">{timeAgo(o.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* ------------------------------------------------- wallet */}
        <TabsContent value="wallet" className="mt-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <WalletCard label="Pending" minor={wallet?.pendingMinor} tone="amber" />
            <WalletCard label="Available" minor={wallet?.availableMinor} tone="emerald" />
            <WalletCard label="Lifetime earned" minor={wallet?.lifetimeEarnedMinor} />
            <WalletCard label="Lifetime commission" minor={wallet?.lifetimeCommissionMinor} />
          </div>
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Balances are ledger truth (M10) refreshed on write. Manage adjustments in Finance → Wallets.
          </p>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* ------------------------------------------------- bank */}
        <TabsContent value="bank" className="mt-4">
          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {banks.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState title="No bank accounts" />
              ) : (
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>Holder</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Bank</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Account</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                      <BankActionHead />
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {banks.map((b) => (
                      <BankRow key={b.id} acc={b} busy={busy !== null} onDone={() => void refetch()} />
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* ------------------------------------------------- notes */}
        <TabsContent value="notes" className="mt-4">
          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
              <CardTitle className="text-base">Internal notes</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Visible to admins only.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-3 p-4 pt-0 sm:p-6 sm:pt-0">
              <form
                className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row"
                onSubmit={async (e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  if (!noteBody.trim()) return;
                  const ok = await act("note", `/api/admin/sellers/${seller.id}/notes`, { body: noteBody.trim() }, "Note added");
                  if (ok) setNoteBody("");
                }}
              >
                <Textarea
                  value={noteBody}
                  onChange={(e) => setNoteBody(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Add an internal note…"
                  rows={2}
                  className="flex-1 resize-none"
                />
                <Button type="submit" disabled={busy !== null || !noteBody.trim()} className="min-h-[44px]">
                  {busy === "note" ? "Adding…" : "Add note"}
                </Button>
              </form>
              <ScrollY className="max-h-[360px]">
                {notes.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No notes yet.</p>
                ) : (
                  <ul className="space-y-2">
                    {notes.map((n) => (
                      <li key={n.id} className="rounded-lg border p-3">
                        <p className="text-sm">{n.body}</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{n.author} · {fmtDT(n.createdAt)}</p>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                )}
              </ScrollY>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      {/* --------------------------------------------------- dialogs */}
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirm !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setConfirm(null)}
        title={confirm === "approve" ? "Approve seller?" : "Reactivate seller?"}
        description={confirm === "approve" ? "Seller becomes active, store goes live, KYC approved." : "Seller becomes active again and the store returns to live."}
        confirmLabel={confirm === "approve" ? "Approve" : "Activate"}
        loading={busy !== null}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          const ok = await act(confirm === "approve" ? "approve" : "activate", `/api/admin/sellers/${seller.id}/${confirm}`, undefined, confirm === "approve" ? "Seller approved" : "Seller activated");
          if (ok) setConfirm(null);
        }}
      />

      <ReasonDialog
        open={rejectOpen}
        onOpenChange={setRejectOpen}
        title="Reject seller"
        description="The seller will be marked rejected and notified with this reason."
        submitLabel="Reject seller"
        destructive
        loading={busy !== null}
        onSubmit={async (reason) => {
          const ok = await act("reject", `/api/admin/sellers/${seller.id}/reject`, { reason }, "Seller rejected");
          if (ok) setRejectOpen(false);
        }}
      />

      <ReasonDialog
        open={suspendOpen}
        onOpenChange={setSuspendOpen}
        title="Suspend seller"
        description="Store will be set to draft and selling disabled."
        submitLabel="Suspend"
        destructive
        loading={busy !== null}
        onSubmit={async (reason) => {
          const ok = await act("suspend", `/api/admin/sellers/${seller.id}/suspend`, { reason }, "Seller suspended");
          if (ok) setSuspendOpen(false);
        }}
      />

      <TypingConfirm
        open={terminateOpen}
        onOpenChange={setTerminateOpen}
        title="Terminate seller"
        description="Permanent action — the seller is banned from the platform."
        expected={seller.id}
        confirmLabel="Terminate"
        loading={busy !== null}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          const ok = await act("terminate", `/api/admin/sellers/${seller.id}/terminate`, { reason: "Terminated from admin command centre" }, "Seller terminated");
          if (ok) setTerminateOpen(false);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function WalletCard({ label, minor, tone }: { label: string; minor?: number | null; tone?: "amber" | "emerald" }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4">
      <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
      <p className={`mt-2 text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums ${tone === "emerald" ? "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400" : tone === "amber" ? "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400" : ""}`}>
        {formatMinor(minor ?? 0)}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function BankActionHead() {
  return <TableHead className="text-right">Action</TableHead>;
}

function BankRow({ acc, busy, onDone }: { acc: BankAcc; busy: boolean; onDone: () => void }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <TableRow>
        <TableCell className="font-medium">{acc.holderName}</TableCell>
        <TableCell>{acc.bankName}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{acc.accountNumberMasked}</TableCell>
        <TableCell>{acc.verified ? <StatusChip status="verified" /> : <StatusChip status="pending" />}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="text-right">
          {!acc.verified ? (
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
                Reject
              </Button>
              <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void bankAction(acc.id, "verify", undefined, onDone)}>
                Verify
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>
          )}
        </TableCell>
      </TableRow>
      <ReasonDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        title="Reject bank account"
        description="Seller will be asked to re-submit their bank details."
        submitLabel="Reject"
        destructive
        onSubmit={async (reason) => {
          const ok = await bankAction(acc.id, "reject", { reason }, () => {
            setOpen(false);
            onDone();
          });
          if (ok) setOpen(false);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

async function bankAction(id: string, kind: "verify" | "reject", body: unknown, onDone: () => void): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await apiSend(`/api/admin/banks/${id}/${kind}`, "POST", body);
    toast.success(kind === "verify" ? "Bank account verified" : "Bank account rejected");
    onDone();
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    toast.error("Action failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    return false;
  }
}

function KycDocRow({ doc, sellerId, busy, onDone }: { doc: KycDoc; sellerId: string; busy: boolean; onDone: () => void }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const decide = async (decision: "approved" | "rejected", reason?: string) => {
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/sellers/${sellerId}/kyc/${doc.id}`, "POST", { decision, reason });
      toast.success(`Document ${decision}`);
      onDone();
      setOpen(false);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Decision failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  };
  return (
    <>
      <TableRow>
        <TableCell className="font-medium capitalize">{doc.docType.replace(/_/g, " ")}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[200px] truncate font-mono text-xs sm:table-cell">{doc.fileName}</TableCell>
        <TableCell><StatusChip status={doc.status} /></TableCell>
        <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{doc.reviewedAt ? fmtDT(doc.reviewedAt) : "—"}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="text-right">
          {doc.status === "pending" ? (
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
                Reject
              </Button>
              <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 sm:min-h-0" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void decide("approved")}>
                Approve
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{doc.rejectReason ?? "—"}</span>
          )}
        </TableCell>
      </TableRow>
      <ReasonDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        title={`Reject ${doc.docType.replace(/_/g, " ")}`}
        submitLabel="Reject document"
        destructive
        onSubmit={async (reason) => {
          await decide("rejected", reason);
          setOpen(false);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

"use client";
// SEL-01 All Sellers list + SEL-03 KYC Queue.
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { MoreHorizontal, Search, UserCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { apiSend, useApi } from "./use-api";
import type { AdminNav } from "./nav";
import {
  Badge,
} from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  CardsSkeleton,
  ConfirmDialog,
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  Money,
  PageHeader,
  Pager,
  RiskChip,
  StatusChip,
  TableSkeleton,
  fmtDate,
  timeAgo,
} from "./ui-bits";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ types */

export type AdminSellerRow = {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  fullName: string;
  displayName: string;
  status: string;
  riskTier: string;
  commissionOverridePercent: number | null;
  kycStatus: string;
  planCode: string;
  submittedAt?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  store?: { name: string; slug: string; status: string } | null;
  storeName?: string | null;
  wallet?: { availableMinor: number; pendingMinor: number } | null;
  gmv30dMinor?: number;
};

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- SEL-01 */

const SELLER_STATUSES = ["onboarding", "pending_review", "active", "suspended", "rejected", "terminated"];

export function SellersView({ nav }: { nav: AdminNav }) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
  const [risk, setRisk] = useState("all");
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  const url = useMemo(() => {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), size: "20" });
    if (status !== "all") sp.set("status", status);
    if (risk !== "all") sp.set("riskTier", risk);
    if (search) sp.set("search", search);
    return `/api/admin/sellers?${sp.toString()}`;
  }, [status, risk, search, page]);

  const { data, meta, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<AdminSellerRow[]>(url);
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const [confirmAction, setConfirmAction] = useState<{ kind: "approve" | "suspend"; seller: AdminSellerRow } | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const runQuickAction = async () => {
    if (!confirmAction) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const path = `/api/admin/sellers/${confirmAction.seller.id}/${confirmAction.kind}`;
      await apiSend(path, "POST", confirmAction.kind === "suspend" ? { reason: "Suspended from sellers list" } : undefined);
      toast.success(`Seller ${confirmAction.kind === "approve" ? "approved" : "suspended"}`);
      setConfirmAction(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Action failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="All Sellers"
        description="Marketplace tenants, their stores, wallets and overrides."
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          {/* filters */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
            <form
              className="relative flex-1"
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                setPage(1);
                setSearch(searchInput.trim());
              }}
            >
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                value={searchInput}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search name, store or email…"
                className="min-h-[44px] pl-9"
                aria-label="Search sellers"
              />
            </form>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Select
                value={status}
                onValueChange={(v) => {
                  setStatus(v);
                  setPage(1);
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-full lg:w-44" aria-label="Filter by status">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
                  {SELLER_STATUSES.map((s) => (
                    <SelectItem key={s} value={s} className="capitalize">
                      {s.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <Select
                value={risk}
                onValueChange={(v) => {
                  setRisk(v);
                  setPage(1);
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-full lg:w-36" aria-label="Filter by risk">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Risk" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All risk</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="low">Low</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="medium">Medium</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="high">High</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* table */}
          <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={8} cols={7} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No sellers found" hint="Try clearing filters or search." />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>Seller / Store</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Email</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Risk</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">GMV 30d</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden text-right lg:table-cell">Wallet avail.</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Comm. override</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden xl:table-cell">Created</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="w-10" />
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {rows.map((s) => (
                      <TableRow
                        key={s.id}
                        className="cursor-pointer"
                        onClick={() => nav.navigate("seller-detail", { sellerId: s.id })}
                      >
                        <TableCell>
                          <p className="font-medium">{s.displayName}</p>
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.store?.name ?? s.storeName ?? "—"}</p>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[200px] truncate text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{s.email}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell><StatusChip status={s.status} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden sm:table-cell"><RiskChip tier={s.riskTier} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={s.gmv30dMinor} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-right lg:table-cell">
                          <Money minor={s.wallet?.availableMinor ?? 0} className={cn((s.wallet?.availableMinor ?? 0) < 0 && "font-semibold")} />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden lg:table-cell">
                          {s.commissionOverridePercent != null ? (
                            <Badge variant="outline" className="border-teal-200 bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 dark:border-teal-900 dark:bg-teal-950/60 dark:text-teal-300">
                              {s.commissionOverridePercent}%
                            </Badge>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">inherit</span>
                          )}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground xl:table-cell">{fmtDate(s.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                          <DropdownMenu>
                            <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" aria-label={`Actions for ${s.displayName}`}>
                                <MoreHorizontal className="h-4 w-4" />
                              </Button>
                            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                            <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
                              <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => nav.navigate("seller-detail", { sellerId: s.id })}>
                                Open detail
                              </DropdownMenuItem>
                              {s.status === "pending_review" || s.status === "rejected" ? (
                                <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => setConfirmAction({ kind: "approve", seller: s })}>
                                  Approve seller
                                </DropdownMenuItem>
                              ) : null}
                              {s.status === "active" ? (
                                <DropdownMenuItem className="text-red-600 focus:text-red-600" onClick={() => setConfirmAction({ kind: "suspend", seller: s })}>
                                  Suspend seller
                                </DropdownMenuItem>
                              ) : null}
                            </DropdownMenuContent>
                          </DropdownMenu>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
                <div className="px-1 pb-1">
                  <Pager
                    page={meta?.page ?? page}
                    size={meta?.size ?? 20}
                    total={meta?.total ?? rows.length}
                    onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                    onNext={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmAction !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setConfirmAction(null)}
        title={confirmAction?.kind === "approve" ? "Approve seller?" : "Suspend seller?"}
        description={
          confirmAction
            ? confirmAction.kind === "approve"
              ? `${confirmAction.seller.displayName} will become active and their store will go live.`
              : `${confirmAction.seller.displayName} will be suspended and their store set to draft.`
            : ""
        }
        confirmLabel={confirmAction?.kind === "approve" ? "Approve" : "Suspend"}
        destructive={confirmAction?.kind === "suspend"}
        loading={busy}
        onConfirm={() => void runQuickAction()}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- SEL-03 */

type KycCardSeller = {
  id: string;
  displayName: string;
  email: string;
  submittedAt?: string | null;
  createdAt?: string;
  store?: { name: string; productCount?: number } | null;
  storeName?: string | null;
  kycDocuments?: { id: string; docType: string; status: string; fileName: string }[];
  /** API shape (kyc-queue route returns `docs`) */
  docs?: { id: string; docType: string; status: string; fileName: string }[];
  docsApproved?: number;
  docsTotal?: number;
  bankAccounts?: { id: string; verified: boolean; bankName: string; accountNumberMasked: string }[];
  banks?: { id: string; verified: boolean; bankName: string; accountNumberMasked: string }[];
  products?: unknown[];
  productCount?: number;
};

export function KycQueueView({ nav }: { nav: AdminNav }) {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<KycCardSeller[]>("/api/admin/kyc-queue");
  const sellers = data ?? [];
  const [approving, setApproving] = useState<KycCardSeller | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const submitAgeHours = (s: KycCardSeller): number | null => {
    if (!s.submittedAt) return null;
    return Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(s.submittedAt).getTime()) / 3600000);
  };

  const approve = async () => {
    if (!approving) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/sellers/${approving.id}/approve`, "POST");
      toast.success("Seller approved", { description: `${approving.displayName} is now active.` });
      setApproving(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Approve failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="KYC Queue"
        description="Sellers waiting for identity verification review."
        actions={
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => void refetch()} disabled={loading}>
            <UserCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Refresh
          </Button>
        }
      />

      {error ? (
        <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="p-4"><ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} /></CardContent></Card>
      ) : loading ? (
        <CardsSkeleton n={6} />
      ) : sellers.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="p-4"><EmptyState title="KYC queue is clear" hint="No sellers pending review right now." /></CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {sellers.map((s) => {
            const hours = submitAgeHours(s);
            const late = hours !== null && hours > 48;
            const docs = s.kycDocuments ?? s.docs ?? [];
            const banks = s.bankAccounts ?? s.banks ?? [];
            const bankVerified = banks.some((b) => b.verified);
            const productCount = s.products?.length ?? s.productCount ?? s.store?.productCount ?? 0;
            return (
              <div
                key={s.id}
                className={cn(
                  "flex flex-col rounded-xl border bg-card p-4 shadow-sm",
                  late && "border-red-300 dark:border-red-900"
                )}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate font-semibold">{s.displayName}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.store?.name ?? s.storeName ?? s.email}</p>
                  </div>
                  {hours !== null ? (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className={cn("shrink-0", late ? "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300" : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300")}>
                      {hours}h waiting
                    </Badge>
                  ) : (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="shrink-0">no submission date</Badge>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {docs.length === 0 ? (
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No documents uploaded</span>
                  ) : (
                    docs.map((d) => (
                      <Badge key={d.id} variant="outline" className={cn("capitalize", d.status === "approved" ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300" : d.status === "rejected" ? "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300" : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300")}>
                        {d.docType.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                      </Badge>
                    ))
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className={bankVerified ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300" : "border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400"}>
                    bank {bankVerified ? "verified" : "unverified"}
                  </Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline">{productCount} product{productCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}</Badge>
                  <span>submitted {timeAgo(s.submittedAt)}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
                  <Button size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] flex-1 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700" onClick={() => setApproving(s)}>
                    Approve
                  </Button>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] flex-1" onClick={() => nav.navigate("seller-detail", { sellerId: s.id })}>
                    Open detail
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={approving !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setApproving(null)}
        title="Approve seller?"
        description={approving ? `${approving.displayName} will become active, their store set live and KYC approved.` : ""}
        confirmLabel="Approve seller"
        loading={busy}
        onConfirm={() => void approve()}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// Stores & Domains admin view (stores table + aggregated domains table).
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Globe, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { apiSend, useApi } from "./use-api";
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, PageHeader, StatusChip, TableSkeleton } from "./ui-bits";

type AdminStoreRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  status: string;
  seller?: { displayName: string; email: string } | null;
  sellerName?: string | null;
  productCount?: number;
  domainsCount?: number;
  domains?: AdminDomainRow[];
  _count?: { products?: number; domains?: number };
};

type AdminDomainRow = {
  id: string;
  domain: string;
  mode: string;
  status: string;
  sslStatus: string;
  errorReason?: string | null;
  isPrimary?: boolean;
  storeName?: string | null;
};

export function StoresView() {
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const url = useMemo(() => `/api/admin/stores${search ? `?search=${encodeURIComponent(search)}` : ""}`, [search]);
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<AdminStoreRow[]>(url);
  const rows = data ?? [];
  const [verifying, setVerifying] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const domains: AdminDomainRow[] = useMemo(() => {
    const out: AdminDomainRow[] = [];
    for (const s of rows) {
      const list = s.domains ?? [];
      for (const d of list) out.push({ ...d, storeName: s.name });
    }
    return out;
  }, [rows]);

  const productsOf = (s: AdminStoreRow) => s.productCount ?? s._count?.products ?? 0;
  const domainsOf = (s: AdminStoreRow) => s.domainsCount ?? s._count?.domains ?? (s.domains?.length ?? 0);

  const retryDomain = async (d: AdminDomainRow) => {
    setVerifying(d.id);
    try {
      // Contract exposes domain verify on the seller surface; try an admin-flavoured
      // endpoint first and degrade gracefully if not implemented.
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/domains/${d.id}/verify`, "POST");
      toast.success("Domain re-verification triggered", { description: d.domain });
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.info("Domain re-verification unavailable", {
        description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "This action may only be run from the seller portal.",
      });
    } finally {
      setVerifying(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader title="Stores & Domains" description="All tenant storefronts and their custom domains." />

      <Tabs defaultValue="stores">
        <TabsList className="h-auto">
          <TabsTrigger value="stores" className="min-h-[44px]">Stores ({rows.length})</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="domains" className="min-h-[44px]">Domains ({domains.length})</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="stores" className="mt-4">
          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
                <Input
                  value={searchInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && setSearch(searchInput.trim())}
                  onBlur={() => setSearch(searchInput.trim())}
                  placeholder="Search stores…"
                  className="min-h-[44px] pl-9"
                  aria-label="Search stores"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto">
                {error ? (
                  <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
                ) : loading ? (
                  <TableSkeleton rows={6} cols={5} />
                ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
                  <EmptyState title="No stores found" />
                ) : (
                  <Table>
                    <TableHeader>
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableHead>Store</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Slug</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>Seller</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="text-right">Products</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="text-right">Domains</TableHead>
                      </TableRow>
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {rows.map((s) => (
                        <TableRow key={s.id}>
                          <TableCell>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <Globe className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" />
                              <span className="font-medium">{s.name}</span>
                            </div>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="hidden font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{s.slug}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-sm">{s.seller?.displayName ?? s.sellerName ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell><StatusChip status={s.status} /></TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{productsOf(s)}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{domainsOf(s)}</TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      ))}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="domains" className="mt-4">
          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                {error ? (
                  <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
                ) : loading ? (
                  <TableSkeleton rows={4} cols={6} />
                ) : domains.length === 0 ? (
                  <EmptyState
                    title="No domain data exposed"
                    hint="Domain details appear here once the admin stores payload includes them (seller portal manages DNS setup)."
                  />
                ) : (
                  <Table>
                    <TableHeader>
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableHead>Domain</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Store</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>Mode</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>SSL</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Error</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="text-right">Action</TableHead>
                      </TableRow>
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {domains.map((d) => (
                        <TableRow key={d.id}>
                          <TableCell className="font-medium">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              {d.domain}
                              {d.isPrimary ? <Badge variant="outline" className="border-teal-200 bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 dark:border-teal-900 dark:bg-teal-950/60 dark:text-teal-300">primary</Badge> : null}
                            </span>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="hidden text-sm sm:table-cell">{d.storeName ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="uppercase text-xs text-muted-foreground">{d.mode}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell><StatusChip status={d.status} /></TableCell>
                          <TableCell><StatusChip status={d.sslStatus} /></TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[220px] truncate text-xs text-red-600 lg:table-cell dark:text-red-400">{d.errorReason ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-right">
                            {d.status === "failed" || d.status === "pending" || d.status === "verifying" ? (
                              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={verifying !== null} onClick={() => void retryDomain(d)}>
                                {verifying === d.id ? "Checking…" : "Re-check"}
                              </Button>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>
                            )}
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      ))}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// SUP-01 Support Tickets — queue with status filter, thread dialog with reply,
// status + priority controls.
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { LifeBuoy, MessageSquare, Send } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { apiSend, useApi } from "./use-api";
import { qs } from "./nav";
import {
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  PageHeader,
  Pager,
  StatusChip,
  TableSkeleton,
  fmtDT,
  timeAgo,
} from "./ui-bits";

type TicketRow = {
  id: string;
  subject: string;
  status: string;
  priority: string;
  sellerEmail?: string | null;
  contextType?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
  store?: { id: string; name: string; slug: string } | null;
  lastMessage?: { authorType: string; authorLabel: string; body: string; createdAt: string } | null;
  messageCount?: number;
};

type ThreadMessage = {
  id: string;
  authorType: string;
  authorLabel: string;
  body: string;
  createdAt: string;
};

type TicketThread = {
  id: string;
  subject: string;
  status: string;
  priority: string;
  sellerEmail?: string | null;
  store?: { name: string; slug: string } | null;
  messages: ThreadMessage[];
};

const TICKET_STATUSES = ["open", "pending", "closed"];
const TICKET_PRIORITIES = ["low", "normal", "high", "urgent"];

export function SupportView() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const url = useMemo(() => `/api/admin/tickets${qs({ status: status === "all" ? "" : status, page, size: 15 })}`, [status, page]);
  const { data, meta, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<TicketRow[]>(url);
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reply, setReply] = useState("");
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);

  const thread = useApi<TicketThread>(openId ? `/api/admin/tickets/${openId}` : null);
  const active = rows.find((t) => t.id === openId) ?? null;

  const sendReply = async () => {
    if (!openId || !reply.trim()) return;
    setSending(true);
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/tickets/${openId}/reply`, "POST", { body: reply.trim() });
      toast.success("Reply sent", { description: "Ticket moved to pending (awaiting seller)." });
      setReply("");
      void thread.refetch();
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Reply failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const patchTicket = async (patch: { status?: string; priority?: string }) => {
    if (!openId) return;
    try {
      await apiSend(`/api/admin/tickets/${openId}`, "PATCH", patch);
      toast.success("Ticket updated");
      void thread.refetch();
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Update failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Tickets"
        description="Seller support conversations — reply, re-prioritise, close."
        actions={
          <Select
            value={status}
            onValueChange={(v) => {
              setStatus(v);
              setPage(1);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-44" aria-label="Ticket status filter">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
              {TICKET_STATUSES.map((s) => (
                <SelectItem key={s} value={s} className="capitalize">{s}</SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        }
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={5} cols={6} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No tickets" hint="Seller questions will queue here." />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>Subject</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Store / Seller</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Priority</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden text-center sm:table-cell">Messages</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden text-right lg:table-cell">Created</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="hidden text-right xl:table-cell">Last activity</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {rows.map((t) => (
                      <TableRow key={t.id} className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setOpenId(t.id)}>
                        <TableCell>
                          <p className="max-w-[260px] truncate font-medium">{t.subject}</p>
                          {t.contextType ? (
                            <Badge variant="outline" className="mt-1 text-[10px]">re: {t.contextType}</Badge>
                          ) : null}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden md:table-cell">
                          <p className="text-sm font-medium">{t.store?.name ?? "—"}</p>
                          <p className="max-w-[200px] truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.sellerEmail ?? "—"}</p>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell><StatusChip status={t.priority} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell><StatusChip status={t.status} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-center sm:table-cell">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm tabular-nums">
                            <MessageSquare className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                            {t.messageCount ?? 0}
                          </span>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{fmtDT(t.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground xl:table-cell">{timeAgo(t.updatedAt ?? t.lastMessage?.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
                <Pager
                  page={meta?.page ?? page}
                  size={meta?.size ?? 15}
                  total={meta?.total ?? rows.length}
                  onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                  onNext={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* thread dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openId !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setOpenId(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="flex max-h-[88vh] flex-col sm:max-w-2xl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <LifeBuoy className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" />
              {thread.data?.subject ?? active?.subject ?? "Ticket"}
              <StatusChip status={thread.data?.status ?? active?.status} />
              <StatusChip status={thread.data?.priority ?? active?.priority} />
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {thread.data?.store?.name ?? active?.store?.name ?? "—"}
              {thread.data?.sellerEmail ?? active?.sellerEmail ? ` · ${thread.data?.sellerEmail ?? active?.sellerEmail}` : ""}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          {/* thread */}
          <div className="min-h-[180px] flex-1 space-y-3 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 p-3 [scrollbar-width:thin]">
            {thread.error ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{thread.error}</p>
            ) : thread.loading ? (
              Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />)
            ) : (thread.data?.messages ?? []).length === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No messages in this thread yet.</p>
            ) : (
              (thread.data?.messages ?? []).map((m) => {
                const isAdmin = m.authorType === "admin";
                return (
                  <div key={m.id} className={isAdmin ? "flex justify-end" : "flex justify-start"}>
                    <div
                      className={
                        isAdmin
                          ? "max-w-[80%] rounded-2xl rounded-br-md bg-teal-600 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-white shadow-sm dark:bg-teal-700"
                          : "max-w-[80%] rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md border bg-card px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm shadow-sm"
                      }
                    >
                      <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide opacity-70">
                        {m.authorLabel} · {m.authorType}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap">{m.body}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-right text-[10px] opacity-60">{fmtDT(m.createdAt)}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>

          {/* controls */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <Textarea
              value={reply}
              onChange={(e) => setReply(e.target.value)}
              rows={3}
              placeholder="Write a reply to the seller…"
              className="resize-none"
              aria-label="Reply message"
            />
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Select
                  value={thread.data?.status ?? active?.status ?? "open"}
                  onValueChange={(v) => void patchTicket({ status: v })}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-36" aria-label="Ticket status">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {TICKET_STATUSES.map((s) => (
                      <SelectItem key={s} value={s} className="capitalize">{s}</SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
                <Select
                  value={thread.data?.priority ?? active?.priority ?? "normal"}
                  onValueChange={(v) => void patchTicket({ priority: v })}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-36" aria-label="Ticket priority">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Priority" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {TICKET_PRIORITIES.map((p) => (
                      <SelectItem key={p} value={p} className="capitalize">{p}</SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpenId(null)} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
                  Close
                </Button>
                <Button onClick={() => void sendReply()} disabled={sending || !reply.trim()} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
                  <Send className="h-4 w-4" /> {sending ? "Sending…" : "Send reply"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// SYS-01 Settings · SYS-02 Feature Flags · SYS-03 Audit Log (with diff viewer)
// SYS-04 Activity Log · SYS-05 Notifications · SYS-06 System Health.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

} from "@/components/ui/dialog";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- SettingsView */

type SettingRow = { key: string; valueJson: string; description?: string | null; updatedAt?: string };

function prettyValue(raw: string): string {
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(raw), null, 0);
  } catch {
    return raw;
  }
}

export function SettingsView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<SettingRow[]>("/api/admin/settings");
  const rows = data ?? [];

  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<SettingRow | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const openEdit = (r: SettingRow) => {
    setEditing(r);
    setDraft(r.valueJson ?? "");
  };

  const save = async () => {
    if (!editing) return;
    try {
      JSON.parse(draft);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Invalid JSON", {
        description: "Use quoted strings, numbers, booleans or objects — e.g. \"friday\" or 1000.",
      });
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await apiSend("/api/admin/settings", "PUT", { settings: [{ key: editing.key, valueJson: draft }] });
      toast.success("Setting saved", { description: editing.key });
      setEditing(null);
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Save failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="Settings"
        description="Platform configuration — JSON values consumed across commission, payouts, moderation and payments."
      />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
            ) : loading ? (
              <TableSkeleton rows={6} cols={3} />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No settings" />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Key</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Value</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Description</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="hidden text-right lg:table-cell">Updated</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Action</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {rows.map((r) => (
                    <TableRow key={r.key}>
                      <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{r.key}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <code className="block max-w-[240px] truncate rounded bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs" title={prettyValue(r.valueJson)}>
                          {prettyValue(r.valueJson)}
                        </code>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[280px] text-sm text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{r.description ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{timeAgo(r.updatedAt)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => openEdit(r)}>
                          Edit
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Dialog open={editing !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setEditing(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="font-mono text-sm">{editing?.key}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>{editing?.description ?? "Edit the JSON value for this setting."}</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Textarea
              value={draft}
              onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
              rows={5}
              className="resize-none font-mono text-xs"
              aria-label="Setting value (JSON)"
              placeholder='e.g. "friday" or 1000 or {"weights":{}}'
            />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Must be valid JSON — strings need quotes, numbers/booleans stay bare.</p>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditing(null)} disabled={saving} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">Cancel</Button>
            <Button onClick={() => void save()} disabled={saving} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
              {saving ? "Saving…" : "Save setting"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- FlagsView */

type FlagRow = { key: string; description?: string | null; isEnabled: boolean; rolloutPercent: number };

export function FlagsView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<FlagRow[]>("/api/admin/feature-flags");
  const rows = data ?? [];
  const [busyKey, setBusyKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const toggle = async (f: FlagRow) => {
    setBusyKey(f.key);
    try {
      await apiSend("/api/admin/feature-flags", "PATCH", { key: f.key, isEnabled: !f.isEnabled });
      toast.success(`Flag ${f.isEnabled ? "disabled" : "enabled"}`, { description: f.key });
      void refetch();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Toggle failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      setBusyKey(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader title="Feature Flags" description="Runtime switches for progressive delivery — changes are audited." />

      <Card className="py-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
            <Flag className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" /> Flags ({rows.length})
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {error ? (
            <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
          ) : loading ? (
            <TableSkeleton rows={5} cols={4} />
          ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No feature flags" />
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>Flag</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Description</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Rollout</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-center">Enabled</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {rows.map((f) => (
                  <TableRow key={f.key}>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{f.key}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[320px] text-sm text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{f.description ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge
                        variant="outline"
                        className={cn(
                          f.rolloutPercent >= 100
                            ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300"
                            : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300"
                        )}
                      >
                        {f.rolloutPercent}% rollout
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-center">
                      <Switch checked={f.isEnabled} disabled={busyKey === f.key} onCheckedChange={() => void toggle(f)} aria-label={`Toggle ${f.key}`} />
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- AuditView */

type AuditRow = {
  id: string;
  adminEmail: string;
  action: string;
  entityType?: string | null;
  entityId?: string | null;
  before?: unknown;
  after?: unknown;
  createdAt: string;
};

/** Audit rows deliver parsed objects; DiffViewer expects JSON strings. */
function asJsonStr(v: unknown): string | null {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof v === "string") return v;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(v);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function AuditView() {
  const [adminEmail, setAdminEmail] = useState("");
  const [action, setAction] = useState("");

            <Input

                setEntityType(e.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              placeholder="Entity type… e.g. payout"
              className="min-h-[44px]"
              aria-label="Filter by entity type"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto">
            {error ? (
              <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />

            ) : (

                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {rows.map((r) => (
                      <TableRow key={r.id} className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setDetail(r)}>
                        <TableCell className="max-w-[180px] truncate text-sm">{r.adminEmail}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-[11px]">{r.action}</Badge>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-sm text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{r.entityType ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">
                          {r.entityId ? `${r.entityId.slice(0, 10)}…` : "—"}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground">{timeAgo(r.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
                <Pager
                  page={meta?.page ?? page}
                  size={meta?.size ?? 20}
                  total={meta?.total ?? rows.length}
                  onPrev={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                  onNext={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Dialog open={detail !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetail(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="max-h-[88vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-2xl [scrollbar-width:thin]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 font-mono text-sm">
              {detail?.action}

type HealthAuditRow = {
  id: string;
  adminEmail?: string;
  action: string;
  entityType?: string | null;
  entityId?: string | null;
  beforeJson?: string | null;
  afterJson?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

type HealthBody = {
  status?: string;
  db?: string | boolean | { ok?: boolean };
  counts?: { sellers?: number; stores?: number; products?: number; orders?: number };
  ledger?: { ok?: boolean; problems?: string[]; txnCount?: number; walletCount?: number };
  recentAudit?: HealthAuditRow[];
};

export function HealthView() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<HealthBody>("/api/admin/system/health");
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<HealthAuditRow | null>(null);

  // light polling keeps the health board fresh (30s)
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => void refetch(), 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [refetch]);

  const dbOk = data?.db === "up" || data?.db === true || (typeof data?.db === "object" && data?.db?.ok === true);
  const ledgerOk = data?.ledger?.ok ?? true;
  const problems = data?.ledger?.problems ?? [];
  const counts = data?.counts ?? {};
  const recent = data?.recentAudit ?? [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageHeader
        title="System Health"
        description="Database, ledger invariants and platform counters — auto-refreshes every 30s."
        actions={
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => void refetch()} disabled={loading}>
            <RefreshCw className={cn("h-3.5 w-3.5", loading && "animate-spin")} /> Refresh
          </Button>
        }
      />

      {error ? (
        <Card className="py-0"><CardContent className="p-4"><ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} /></CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Card className="py-0">
              <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
                  <HeartPulse className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" /> Database
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="px-4 pb-4 sm:px-6 sm:pb-5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Connection</span>
                  <HealthDot ok={dbOk} label="Database" />
                </div>
                <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Overall status: <span className="font-medium capitalize">{data?.status ?? "unknown"}</span></p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="py-0">
              <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
                <CardTitle className="text-base">Ledger invariant</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>Double-entry integrity across {data?.ledger?.txnCount ?? "—"} txns · {data?.ledger?.walletCount ?? "—"} wallets</CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="px-4 pb-4 sm:px-6 sm:pb-5">
                <HealthDot ok={ledgerOk} label="Ledger invariant" />
                {problems.length > 0 ? (
                  <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-xs text-red-800 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300">
                    {problems.map((p, i) => (
                      <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                        <span className="mt-1 h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-red-500" />
                        <span className="font-mono">{p}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                ) : (
                  <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> No drift detected — debits equal credits.
                  </p>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <KpiCard label="Sellers" value={<span className="tabular-nums">{counts.sellers ?? 0}</span>} />
            <KpiCard label="Stores" value={<span className="tabular-nums">{counts.stores ?? 0}</span>} />
            <KpiCard label="Products" value={<span className="tabular-nums">{counts.products ?? 0}</span>} />
            <KpiCard label="Orders" value={<span className="tabular-nums">{counts.orders ?? 0}</span>} />
          </div>

          <Card className="py-0">
            <CardHeader className="px-4 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
                <ScrollText className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" /> Recent admin audit
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Click a row to inspect the before/after snapshot.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {recent.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState title="No audit entries yet" />
              ) : (
                <Table>
                  <TableBody>
                    {recent.map((r) => (
                      <TableRow key={r.id} className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setDetail(r)}>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-[11px]">{r.action}</Badge>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[180px] truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:table-cell">{r.adminEmail ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-sm text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{r.entityType ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground">{timeAgo(r.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            <ActivityIcon className="h-3 w-3" /> Polling active — latest check {fmtDT(new Date())}
          </p>
        </>
      )}

      <Dialog open={detail !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetail(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="max-h-[88vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-2xl [scrollbar-width:thin]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="font-mono text-sm">{detail?.action}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>{detail ? `${detail.adminEmail ?? ""} · ${fmtDT(detail.createdAt)}` : ""}</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          {detail ? <DiffViewer beforeJson={detail.beforeJson} afterJson={detail.afterJson} /> : null}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ tones */

type Tone = "emerald" | "amber" | "red" | "gray" | "teal" | "slate" | "violet";

export const TONE_CLASS: Record<Tone, string> = {
  emerald:
    "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
  amber:
    "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300",
  red: "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-800 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300",
  gray: "border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400",
  teal: "border-teal-200 bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 dark:border-teal-900 dark:bg-teal-950/60 dark:text-teal-300",
  slate:
    "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300",
  violet:
    "border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 text-violet-800 dark:border-violet-900 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300",
};

const EMERALD_STATUSES = new Set([
  "active", "live", "paid", "approved", "verified", "completed", "delivered", "success",
  "succeeded", "sent", "processed", "resolved", "issued", "ok", "done", "match",
]);
const AMBER_STATUSES = new Set([
  "pending", "pending_review", "processing", "verifying", "open", "queued", "requires_payment",
  "onboarding", "under_review", "refunding", "partially_refunded", "payment_pending", "requested",
  "running", "partial",
]);
const RED_STATUSES = new Set([
  "suspended", "rejected", "banned", "failed", "dead", "terminated", "urgent", "high",
  "mismatch", "drift",
]);
const TEAL_STATUSES = new Set(["shipped", "medium"]);

export function statusTone(status?: string | null): Tone {
  const s = (status ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (EMERALD_STATUSES.has(s)) return "emerald";
  if (AMBER_STATUSES.has(s)) return "amber";
  if (RED_STATUSES.has(s)) return "red";
  if (TEAL_STATUSES.has(s)) return "teal";
  return "gray";
}

export function StatusChip({ status, className }: { status?: string | null; className?: string }) {
  const tone = statusTone(status);
  const label = (status ?? "unknown").replace(/_/g, " ");
  return (
    <Badge variant="outline" className={cn(TONE_CLASS[tone], "capitalize", className)}>
      {label}
    </Badge>
  );
}

export function RiskChip({ tier }: { tier?: string | null }) {
  const t = (tier ?? "low").toLowerCase();
  const tone: Tone = t === "high" ? "red" : t === "medium" ? "amber" : "emerald";
  return (
    <Badge variant="outline" className={cn(TONE_CLASS[tone], "capitalize")}>
      risk: {t}
    </Badge>
  );
}

export function ChannelBadge({ channel }: { channel: string }) {
  const tone: Tone = channel === "email" ? "teal" : channel === "whatsapp" ? "emerald" : "violet";
  return <Badge variant="outline" className={TONE_CLASS[tone]}>{channel}</Badge>;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ money */

export function Money({

  className,
  muted,
  bold,
}: {
  minor: number | null | undefined;
  className?: string;
  muted?: boolean;
  bold?: boolean;
}) {
  const v = minor ?? 0;
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap",
        bold && "font-semibold",
        v < 0 && "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400",
        muted && "text-muted-foreground",
        className
      )}
    >
      {formatMinor(v)}
    </span>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ dates */

export function fmtDT(iso?: string | Date | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = typeof iso === "string" ? new Date(iso) : iso;
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  return d.toLocaleString("en-MY", {
    day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false,
  });
}

export function fmtDate(iso?: string | Date | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = typeof iso === "string" ? new Date(iso) : iso;
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-MY", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
}

export function timeAgo(iso?: string | Date | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = typeof iso === "string" ? new Date(iso) : iso;
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  const secs = Math.floor((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 1000);
  if (secs < 60) return "just now";
  if (secs < 3600) return `${Math.floor(secs / 60)}m ago`;
  if (secs < 86400) return `${Math.floor(secs / 3600)}h ago`;
  if (secs < 86400 * 30) return `${Math.floor(secs / 86400)}d ago`;
  return fmtDate(d);
}

export function KpiCard({
  label,
  value,
  sub,
  icon: Icon,
  onClick,
  tone = "plain",
}: {
  label: string;
  value: ReactNode;
  sub?: ReactNode;
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  onClick?: () => void;
  tone?: Tone | "plain";
}) {
  const clickable = Boolean(onClick);
  const iconColor =
    tone === "emerald"
      ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
      : tone === "amber"
        ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
        : tone === "red"
          ? "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400"
          : tone === "teal"
            ? "text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400"
            : "text-muted-foreground";
  return (
    <div
      role={clickable ? "button" : undefined}
      tabIndex={clickable ? 0 : undefined}
      onClick={onClick}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (clickable && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) {
          e.preventDefault();
          onClick?.();
        }
      }}
      className={cn(
        "rounded-xl border bg-card p-4 shadow-sm transition-shadow sm:p-5",
        clickable && "cursor-pointer hover:shadow-md focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600"
      )}
    >
