        <p className="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
        {Icon ? <Icon className={cn("h-4 w-4 shrink-0", iconColor)} /> : null}

}

export function Pager({
  page,
  size,
  total,
  onPrev,
  onNext,
}: {
  page: number;
  size: number;
  total: number;
  onPrev: () => void;
  onNext: () => void;
}) {
  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / Math.max(1, size)));
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-3">
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {total} record{total === 1 ? "" : "s"} · page {Math.min(page, pages)} of {pages}
      </p>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={onPrev}>
          Previous
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" disabled={page >= pages} onClick={onNext}>
          Next
        </Button>
      </div>

  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- dialogs */

export function ConfirmDialog({
  open,

  title,
  description,

  onConfirm,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  destructive?: boolean;
  loading?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>

        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel disabled={loading}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            disabled={loading}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              onConfirm();
            }}
            className={cn(destructive && "bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 focus-visible:ring-red-600")}
          >
            {loading ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : confirmLabel}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

/** Destructive confirm where the user must type the object id exactly. */
export function TypingConfirm({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  title,
  description,
  expected,
  confirmLabel = "Delete",
  loading,
  onConfirm,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  expected: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  loading?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      {open ? (
        <TypingConfirmInner
          title={title}
          description={description}
          expected={expected}
          confirmLabel={confirmLabel}
          loading={loading}
          onConfirm={onConfirm}
        />
      ) : null}
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

function TypingConfirmInner({
  title,
  description,
  expected,
  confirmLabel = "Delete",
  loading,
  onConfirm,
}: {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  expected: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  loading?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => void;
}) {
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const match = text.trim() === expected;
  return (
    <AlertDialogContent>
      <AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <TriangleAlert className="h-4 w-4 text-red-600" /> {title}
        </AlertDialogTitle>
        <AlertDialogDescription>
          {description ?? "This action is irreversible."} Type{" "}
          <code className="rounded bg-muted px-1 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-foreground">{expected}</code>{" "}
          to confirm.
        </AlertDialogDescription>
      </AlertDialogHeader>
      <Input
        value={text}
        onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
        placeholder={expected}
        aria-label={`Type ${expected} to confirm`}
        className="min-h-[44px]"
        autoComplete="off"
      />
      <AlertDialogFooter>
        <AlertDialogCancel disabled={loading}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
        <AlertDialogAction
          disabled={!match || loading}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (match) onConfirm();
          }}
          className="bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 focus-visible:ring-red-600"
        >
          {loading ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : confirmLabel}
        </AlertDialogAction>
      </AlertDialogFooter>
    </AlertDialogContent>
  );
}

export function ReasonDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  title,
  description,
  placeholder,
  submitLabel = "Submit",
  destructive,
  loading,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  submitLabel?: string;
  destructive?: boolean;
  loading?: boolean;
  onSubmit: (reason: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      {open ? (
        <ReasonDialogInner
          onOpenChange={onOpenChange}
          title={title}
          description={description}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          submitLabel={submitLabel}
          destructive={destructive}
          loading={loading}
          onSubmit={onSubmit}
        />
      ) : null}
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function ReasonDialogInner({
  onOpenChange,
  title,
  description,
  placeholder,
  submitLabel = "Submit",
  destructive,
  loading,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  submitLabel?: string;
  destructive?: boolean;
  loading?: boolean;
  onSubmit: (reason: string) => void;
}) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  return (
    <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
      <DialogHeader>
        <DialogTitle>{title}</DialogTitle>
        {description ? <DialogDescription>{description}</DialogDescription> : null}
      </DialogHeader>
      <Textarea
        value={reason}
        onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
        placeholder={placeholder ?? "Reason…"}
        rows={4}
        className="resize-none"
      />
      <DialogFooter>
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} disabled={loading} className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0">
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button
          onClick={() => onSubmit(reason.trim())}
          disabled={loading || !reason.trim()}
          className={cn("min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0", destructive && "bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700")}
        >
          {loading ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : submitLabel}
        </Button>
      </DialogFooter>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}

export function CopyButton({ text, label }: { text: string; label?: string }) {
  return (
    <Button
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      className="h-8 w-8"
      aria-label={label ?? "Copy"}
      onClick={async () => {
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
          toast.success("Copied to clipboard", { description: text });
        } catch {
          toast.error("Could not copy");
        }
      }}
    >
      <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
    </Button>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- breakdown */

const BREAKDOWN_MONEY_KEYS = new Set([
  "base", "percent_part", "fixed_fee_allocated", "discount_allocated", "shipping_allocated",
]);

function breakdownValue(key: string, v: unknown): string | null {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return null;
  if (key === "flags") {
    const arr = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(String) : [];
    return arr.length ? arr.join(", ") : null;
  }
  if (BREAKDOWN_MONEY_KEYS.has(key)) return formatMinor(Number(v));
  if (typeof v === "number") return key === "percent" ? `${v}%` : String(v);
  if (typeof v === "string") return v;
  return JSON.stringify(v);
}

/** Renders a commission breakdownJson payload as key:value chips. */
export function BreakdownChips({ json, className }: { json?: string | null; className?: string }) {
  const data = parseJsonSafe<Record<string, unknown>>(json, {});
  const entries = Object.entries(data).filter(([k, v]) => breakdownValue(k, v) !== null);
  if (entries.length === 0) return <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No breakdown snapshot</span>;
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-wrap gap-1.5", className)}>
      {entries.map(([k, v]) => {
        const val = breakdownValue(k, v) as string;
        const highlight = k === "rule_source";
        return (
          <span
            key={k}
            className={cn(
              "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px]",
              highlight ? TONE_CLASS.teal : "bg-muted/60 text-muted-foreground"
            )}
          >
            <span className="font-medium capitalize">{k.replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>
            <span className="tabular-nums">{val}</span>
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- diff view */

function flatObj(v: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  return v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v) ? (v as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
}

function diffVal(key: string, v: unknown): string {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === "") return "—";
  if (typeof v === "object") return JSON.stringify(v);
  if (key.endsWith("Minor")) return formatMinor(Number(v));
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return v ? "true" : "false";
  return String(v);
}

/** Field-by-field before/after viewer for audit log rows. */
export function DiffViewer({ beforeJson, afterJson }: { beforeJson?: string | null; afterJson?: string | null }) {
  const before = flatObj(parseJsonSafe<unknown>(beforeJson, {}));
  const after = flatObj(parseJsonSafe<unknown>(afterJson, {}));
  const keys = Array.from(new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(after)])).sort();
  if (keys.length === 0) {
    return <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No structured before/after snapshot recorded for this entry.</p>;
  }
  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead className="w-40">Field</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Before</TableHead>
            <TableHead>After</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {keys.map((k) => {
            const b = k in before ? diffVal(k, before[k]) : null;
            const a = k in after ? diffVal(k, after[k]) : null;
            const changed = b !== a;
            const added = b === null;
            const removed = a === null;
            return (
              <TableRow key={k} className={cn(changed && !removed && "bg-amber-50/60 dark:bg-amber-950/20")}>
                <TableCell className="font-mono text-[11px] font-medium">{k}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className={cn("text-xs tabular-nums", removed && "text-red-600 line-through dark:text-red-400")}>
                  {b ?? "—"}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className={cn("text-xs tabular-nums", added && "font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400")}>
                  {a ?? "—"}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            );
          })}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Green/red health dot used across dashboard + health screens. */
export function HealthDot({ ok, label }: { ok: boolean; label?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium" aria-label={label ?? (ok ? "Healthy" : "Problem")}>
      <span className={cn("relative flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full", ok ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-red-500")}>
        {!ok ? <span className="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-red-500 opacity-60" /> : null}
      </span>
      <span className={ok ? "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400"}>
        {ok ? "Healthy" : "Problem"}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

export function CheckRow({ ok, children }: { ok: boolean; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs", ok ? "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-muted-foreground")}>
      <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> {children}
    </span>
  );
}

"use client";
// Data fetching helpers for the admin command centre.
// All requests are same-origin with cookies (session) included automatically.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export type ApiMeta = { page: number; size: number; total: number };

type EnvelopeBody = { data?: unknown; meta?: ApiMeta; error?: { code?: string; message?: string; details?: unknown } };

async function parseBody(res: Response): Promise<EnvelopeBody> {
  try {
    return (await res.json()) as EnvelopeBody;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function bodyError(body: EnvelopeBody, status: number): string {
  return body.error?.message || `Request failed (${status})`;
}

/** GET with the standard envelope; throws Error(message) on failure. */
export async function apiGet<T>(url: string): Promise<{ data: T; meta?: ApiMeta }> {
  const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
  const body = await parseBody(res);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(bodyError(body, res.status));
  return { data: (body.data ?? null) as T, meta: body.meta };
}

/** POST / PATCH / PUT / DELETE with JSON body; resolves with envelope data. */
export async function apiSend<T = unknown>(
  url: string,
  method: "POST" | "PATCH" | "PUT" | "DELETE",
  body?: unknown
): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method,
    cache: "no-store",
    headers: body !== undefined ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : undefined,
    body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const parsed = await parseBody(res);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(bodyError(parsed, res.status));
  return (parsed.data ?? null) as T;
}

/**
 * useApi — fetch a JSON endpoint with cache:"no-store".
 * Returns { data, meta, error, loading, refetch }. `refetch` is silent (keeps current data).
 * When `url` changes, previous data is cleared and a skeleton-friendly loading pass runs.
 */
export function useApi<T>(url: string | null) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState<ApiMeta | undefined>(undefined);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(Boolean(url));
  const seq = useRef(0);
  const lastUrl = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const refetch = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!url) return;
    const id = ++seq.current;
    try {
      const body = await apiGet<T>(url);
      if (seq.current !== id) return;
      setData(body.data);
      setMeta(body.meta);
      setError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      if (seq.current !== id) return;
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Request failed");
    } finally {
      if (seq.current === id) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [url]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (lastUrl.current !== url) {
      lastUrl.current = url;
      seq.current += 1;
      setData(null);
      setMeta(undefined);
      setError(null);
      setLoading(Boolean(url));
    }
    if (!url) return;
    void refetch();
  }, [refetch, url]);

  return { data, meta, error, loading, refetch };
}

/** Debounce a fast-changing value (used for search boxes and the live simulator). */
export function useDebounced<T>(value: T, delayMs = 400): T {
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delayMs);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, delayMs]);
  return debounced;
}

/** Safe JSON parse with fallback (schema JSON columns are strings in SQLite). */
export function parseJsonSafe<T>(raw: string | null | undefined, fallback: T): T {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined || raw === "") return fallback;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

      onDone();

      toast.error("Adjustment failed", { description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });

      setSaving(false);

  return (

export function LedgerView() {

function LedgerTransactions() {
  const [type, setType] = useState("all");
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [txns, setTxns] = useState<LedgerTxn[]>([]);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [nextCursor, setNextCursor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const url = useMemo(() => {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams();
    if (type !== "all") sp.set("type", type);
    if (cursor) sp.set("cursor", cursor);
    return `/api/admin/ledger/transactions?${sp.toString()}`;
  }, [type, cursor]);

  useMemo(() => url, [url]); // stable debug anchor (kept intentionally minimal)
  void searchInput;
  void search;

  const load = async (append: boolean) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
      const body = (await res.json()) as { data?: LedgerTxn[] };
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Request failed (${res.status})`);
      const rows = body.data ?? [];
      setTxns((prev) => (append ? [...prev, ...rows] : rows));
      const last = rows.length > 0 ? rows[rows.length - 1].id : null;
      setNextCursor(rows.length > 0 ? last : null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load ledger");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useMemo(() => {
    void 0;
  }, []);
  // re-load when url changes
  const [lastUrl, setLastUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  if (lastUrl !== url) {
    setLastUrl(url);
    void load(false);
  }

  const filtered = search ? txns.filter((t) => (t.description ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || t.id.includes(search)) : txns;

  return (
    <Card className="py-0">
      <CardContent className="p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
          <Select value={type} onValueChange={(v) => { setType(v); setCursor(null); }}>
            <SelectTrigger className="min-h-[44px] w-full sm:w-52" aria-label="Transaction type"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All types</SelectItem>
              {Object.keys(TXN_TONES).map((t) => (

            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();

            <Input value={searchInput} onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)} placeholder="Filter by description or id…" className="min-h-[44px] pl-9" aria-label="Search transactions" />
          </form>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto">
          {error ? (
            <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void load(false)} />
          ) : loading ? (
            <TableSkeleton rows={6} cols={6} />
          ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No transactions" hint="Post an order or payout to see ledger entries." />
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="w-8" />

                  <TableHead className="text-right">DR</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">CR</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden text-right lg:table-cell">Occurred</TableHead>

              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {filtered.map((t) => {
                  const dr = t.lines.filter((l) => l.direction === "debit").reduce((s, l) => s + l.amountMinor, 0);
                  const cr = t.lines.filter((l) => l.direction === "credit").reduce((s, l) => s + l.amountMinor, 0);
                  return (
                    <Fragment key={t.id}>
                      <TableRow className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setExpanded(expanded === t.id ? null : t.id)}>
                        <TableCell>{expanded === t.id ? <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{t.id.slice(0, 8)}…</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className={cn("capitalize", TXN_TONES[t.txnType] ?? "")}>{t.txnType.replace(/_/g, " ")}</Badge>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[260px] truncate md:table-cell">{t.description ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={dr} muted /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={cr} muted /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:table-cell">{fmtDT(t.occurredAt)}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                      {expanded === t.id ? (
                        <TableRow>
                          <TableCell colSpan={7} className="bg-muted/30 p-0">
                            <div className="p-3">
                              <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Journal lines</p>
                              <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border">
                                <Table>
                                  <TableHeader>
                                    <TableRow>
                                      <TableHead>Account</TableHead>
                                      <TableHead>Direction</TableHead>
                                      <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
                                      <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Available at</TableHead>
                                      <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Memo</TableHead>
                                    </TableRow>
                                  </TableHeader>
                                  <TableBody>
                                    {t.lines.map((l) => (
                                      <TableRow key={l.id}>
                                        <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{l.accountCode}</TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                          <Badge variant="outline" className={cn("uppercase", l.direction === "debit" ? TONE_CLASS.slate : TONE_CLASS.teal)}>
                                            {l.direction === "debit" ? "DR" : "CR"}
                                          </Badge>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={l.amountMinor} /></TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:table-cell">{l.availableAt ? fmtDT(l.availableAt) : "immediate"}</TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="hidden max-w-[220px] truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{l.memo ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                                      </TableRow>
                                    ))}
                                  </TableBody>
                                </Table>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      ) : null}
                    </Fragment>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </div>

        {nextCursor && !loading ? (
          <div className="mt-3 flex justify-center">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0" onClick={() => setCursor(nextCursor)}>
              Load older transactions
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function LedgerAccounts() {
  const { data, error, loading, refetch } = useApi<LedgerAccountRow[]>("/api/admin/ledger/accounts");
  const rows = data ?? [];
  return (
    <Card className="py-0">
      <CardContent className="p-4">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {error ? (
            <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={() => void refetch()} />
          ) : loading ? (
            <TableSkeleton rows={6} cols={5} />
          ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No accounts" />
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>Code</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Type</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Total debit</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Total credit</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden text-right md:table-cell">Balance note</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {rows.map((a) => {
                  const dr = a.totalDebitMinor ?? a.totalDebit ?? a.debitMinor ?? 0;
                  const cr = a.totalCreditMinor ?? a.totalCredit ?? a.creditMinor ?? 0;
                  const debitNormal = a.type === "asset" || a.type === "expense";
                  const balance = debitNormal ? dr - cr : cr - dr;
                  return (
                    <TableRow key={a.code}>
                      <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{a.code}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="font-medium">{a.name}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell><StatusChip status={a.type} className="capitalize" /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={dr} muted /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right"><Money minor={cr} muted /></TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">
                        {balance === 0 ? "settled" : `${debitNormal ? "DR" : "CR"} ${formatMinor(Math.abs(balance))}`}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

type LedgerAccountRow = {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  totalDebitMinor?: number;
  totalCreditMinor?: number;
  totalDebit?: number;
  totalCredit?: number;
  debitMinor?: number;
  creditMinor?: number;
};

"use client";
// Task 2-d — builder-render: canvas previews for ALL 15 section types using the
// SAME prop contract as the storefront renderer (src/lib/sections.ts registry).
// Purely presentational: product grids show skeleton cards, not live data.
import type { Section, ThemeTokens } from "@/lib/sections";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type Props = { section: Section; theme: ThemeTokens; storeName: string };

function str(v: unknown, fallback = ""): string {
  return typeof v === "string" ? v : typeof v === "number" ? String(v) : fallback;
}
function num(v: unknown, fallback: number): number {
  const n = Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
}
function list<T>(v: unknown): T[] {
  return Array.isArray(v) ? (v as T[]) : [];
}

function px(radius: ThemeTokens["radius"]): string {
  switch (radius) {
    case "none": return "0px";
    case "sm": return "4px";
    case "md": return "10px";
    case "full": return "9999px";
    default: return "16px";
  }
}

function Cta({ label, theme, href = "#" }: { label: string; theme: ThemeTokens; href?: string }) {
  const isOutline = theme.buttonStyle === "outline";
  const isPill = theme.buttonStyle === "pill";
  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
      className={cn("inline-block px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold", isPill && "rounded-full")}
      style={{
        borderRadius: isPill ? undefined : px(theme.radius),
        backgroundColor: isOutline ? "transparent" : theme.primaryColor,
        color: isOutline ? theme.primaryColor : "#fff",
        border: isOutline ? `2px solid ${theme.primaryColor}` : "none",
      }}
    >
      {label}
    </a>
  );
}

function SkeletonCard({ radius }: { radius: ThemeTokens["radius"] }) {
  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden border" style={{ borderRadius: px(radius) }}>
      <div className="aspect-square w-full bg-muted" />
      <div className="space-y-1.5 p-2.5">
        <div className="h-2.5 w-3/4 rounded bg-muted" />
        <div className="h-2.5 w-1/3 rounded bg-muted" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  SortableContext,
  arrayMove,
  sortableKeyboardCoordinates,
  useSortable,
  verticalListSortingStrategy,
} from "@dnd-kit/sortable";
import { CSS } from "@dnd-kit/utilities";
import { useApp } from "@/lib/app-store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { DEFAULT_THEME, SECTION_REGISTRY, createSection, sectionDef, type Section, type SectionField, type ThemeTokens, parseTheme } from "@/lib/sections";
import {
  apiGet,
  apiSend,
  RowsSkeleton,
  StatusChip,
  useApi,
  useDebouncedCallback,
  type SellerNav,
} from "./ui-bits";
import { SectionPreview } from "./builder-render";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  ArrowDown,
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowUp,
  Check,
  Copy,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  ExternalLink,
  GripVertical,
  Layers,
  Loader2,
  Monitor,
  Palette,
  Plus,
  RotateCcw,
  Smartphone,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- page list

type PageRow = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  pageType: string;
  draftVersion: number;
  publishedVersion: number;
  hasUnpublished: boolean;
  published: boolean;
  sectionCount: number;
  updatedAt: string;
};

type PageDetail = {
  page: Omit<PageRow, "sectionCount" | "updatedAt">;
  draft: { sections: Section[]; version: number };
  published: { sections: Section[]; version: number } | null;
};

export default function PageBuilder({
  pageId,
  onNavigate,
  storeSlug,
  storeName,
}: {
  pageId?: string;
  onNavigate: (n: SellerNav) => void;
  storeSlug: string;
  storeName: string;
}) {
  if (pageId) {
    return <BuilderEditor key={pageId} pageId={pageId} onNavigate={onNavigate} storeSlug={storeSlug} storeName={storeName} />;
  }
  return <PageList onNavigate={onNavigate} />;
}

function PageList({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate: (n: SellerNav) => void }) {
  const { data, loading, error } = useApi<PageRow[]>("/api/store/pages");

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Every page is an ordered stack of sections. Edit the draft, then publish to push it live to shoppers.
      </p>
      {loading ? (
        <RowsSkeleton rows={4} />
      ) : error ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-6 text-sm text-rose-600">Failed to load pages: {error}</CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {(data ?? []).map((p) => (
            <button
              key={p.id}
              onClick={() => onNavigate({ view: "builder", pageId: p.id })}
              className="group rounded-2xl border bg-card p-4 text-left transition-all hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-sm"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <p className="font-semibold">{p.title}</p>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                  {p.pageType}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">/{p.slug} · {p.sectionCount} sections</p>
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                <StatusChip status={p.published ? "live" : "draft"} />
                <span className="rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">draft v{p.draftVersion}</span>
                {p.publishedVersion > 0 ? (
                  <span className="rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">published v{p.publishedVersion}</span>
                ) : null}
                {p.hasUnpublished ? (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-amber-800">
                    <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500" /> unpublished changes
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- editor

function BuilderEditor({
  pageId,
  onNavigate,
  storeSlug,
  storeName,
}: {
  pageId: string;
  onNavigate: (n: SellerNav) => void;
  storeSlug: string;
  storeName: string;
}) {
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<PageDetail | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<Section[]>([]);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hiddenIds, setHiddenIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [device, setDevice] = useState<"desktop" | "mobile">("desktop");
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<ThemeTokens>(DEFAULT_THEME);
  const [themeOpen, setThemeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<"saved" | "dirty" | "saving">("saved");
  const [publishing, setPublishing] = useState(false);
  const skipFirst = useRef(true);

  // initial load: page doc + theme
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [d, t] = await Promise.all([
          apiGet<PageDetail>(`/api/store/pages/${pageId}`),
          apiGet<{ theme: ThemeTokens }>("/api/store/theme"),
        ]);
        if (!alive) return;
        setDetail(d);
        setSections(d.draft.sections);
        setTheme(parseTheme(JSON.stringify(t.theme)));
      } catch (e) {
        if (alive) toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load page");
      } finally {
        if (alive) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [pageId]);

  const saveDraft = useCallback(
    async (secs: Section[], silent = false) => {
      setSaveState("saving");
      try {
        const res = await apiSend<{ doc: { sections: Section[]; version: number } }>(
          "PUT",
          `/api/store/pages/${pageId}/draft`,
          { sections: secs }
        );
        setDetail((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                draft: res.doc,
                page: { ...prev.page, draftVersion: res.doc.version, hasUnpublished: true },
              }
            : prev
        );
        setSaveState("saved");
        if (!silent) toast.success("Draft saved");
      } catch (e) {
        setSaveState("dirty");
        if (!silent) toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Save failed");
      }
    },
    [pageId]
  );

  const { run: scheduleSave } = useDebouncedCallback((secs: Section[]) => saveDraft(secs, true), 3000);

  // autosave on any sections change (skip the initial load assignment)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (skipFirst.current) {
      skipFirst.current = false;
      return;
    }
    setSaveState("dirty");
    scheduleSave(sections);
  }, [sections, scheduleSave]);

  const mutate = useCallback((updater: (prev: Section[]) => Section[]) => {
    setSections((prev) => updater(prev));
  }, []);

  const addSection = (type: string) => {
    const s = createSection(type);
    if (!s) return;
    mutate((prev) => [...prev, s]);
    setSelectedId(s.id);
    toast.success(`${sectionDef(type)?.label ?? type} added`);
  };

  const duplicateSection = (id: string) => {
    mutate((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((s) => s.id === id);
      if (idx < 0) return prev;
      const copy: Section = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev[idx]));
      copy.id = `sec_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
      const next = [...prev];
      next.splice(idx + 1, 0, copy);
      return next;
    });
    toast.success("Section duplicated");
  };

  const removeSection = (id: string) => {
    mutate((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== id));
    setSelectedId((sel) => (sel === id ? null : sel));
  };

  const updateProp = (id: string, key: string, value: unknown) => {
    mutate((prev) => prev.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, props: { ...s.props, [key]: value } } : s)));
  };

  const onDragEnd = (e: DragEndEvent) => {
    const { active, over } = e;
    if (!over || active.id === over.id) return;
    mutate((prev) => {
      const from = prev.findIndex((s) => s.id === active.id);
      const to = prev.findIndex((s) => s.id === over.id);
      return from < 0 || to < 0 ? prev : arrayMove(prev, from, to);
    });
  };

  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(PointerSensor, { activationConstraint: { distance: 6 } }),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, { coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates })
  );

  const publish = async () => {
    setPublishing(true);
    await saveDraft(sections, true);
    try {
      const res = await apiSend<{ publishedVersion: number; hasUnpublished: boolean }>(
        "POST",
        `/api/store/pages/${pageId}/publish`
      );
      setDetail((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, page: { ...prev.page, publishedVersion: res.publishedVersion, hasUnpublished: res.hasUnpublished, published: true } } : prev));
      setSaveState("saved");
      toast.success(`Published v${res.publishedVersion} — live on your storefront`);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Publish failed");
    } finally {
      setPublishing(false);
    }
  };

  const discardDraft = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiSend<{ doc: { sections: Section[]; version: number } }>("POST", `/api/store/pages/${pageId}/revert`);
      setSections(res.doc.sections);
      skipFirst.current = true; // don't autosave the reverted state right back
      setSaveState("saved");
      toast.success("Draft reverted to the published version");
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Revert failed");
    }
  };

  const previewStorefront = () => {
    const app = useApp.getState();
    app.setActiveStoreSlug(storeSlug || null);
    app.setSurface("shopper");
    if (!detail?.page.published) {
      toast.info("Heads up: this page has never been published — shoppers see it only after you press Publish.");
    }
  };

  const selected = sections.find((s) => s.id === selectedId) ?? null;

  if (loading) return <RowsSkeleton rows={6} />;
  if (!detail) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => onNavigate({ view: "builder" })} className="gap-1.5"><ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Pages</Button>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-6 text-sm text-rose-600">Could not load this page.</CardContent></Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const topbar = (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b bg-background/95 px-3 py-2.5">
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={() => onNavigate({ view: "builder" })}>
        <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Pages
      </Button>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{detail.page.title}</p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">/{detail.page.slug}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
        <span className="rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">draft v{detail.page.draftVersion}</span>
        {detail.page.publishedVersion > 0 ? (
          <span className="rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">published v{detail.page.publishedVersion}</span>
        ) : (
          <StatusChip status="draft" />
        )}
        {detail.page.hasUnpublished ? (
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-amber-800">
            <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500" /> unpublished
          </span>
        ) : null}
        <span
          className={cn(
            "rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium",
            saveState === "saved" && "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700",
            saveState === "dirty" && "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
            saveState === "saving" && "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
          )}
        >
          {saveState === "saved" ? "Saved" : saveState === "saving" ? "Saving…" : "Unsaved"}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="ml-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
        <div className="flex rounded-lg border p-0.5">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className={cn("h-7 gap-1 px-2", device === "desktop" && "bg-muted")} onClick={() => setDevice("desktop")} aria-label="Desktop preview">
            <Monitor className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Button>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className={cn("h-7 gap-1 px-2", device === "mobile" && "bg-muted")} onClick={() => setDevice("mobile")} aria-label="Mobile preview">
            <Smartphone className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={() => setThemeOpen(true)}>
          <Palette className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Theme
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={previewStorefront}>
          <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Preview
        </Button>
        {detail.page.publishedVersion > 0 ? (
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground" onClick={discardDraft}>
            <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Discard draft
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        <Button size="sm" onClick={publish} disabled={publishing} className="gap-1.5">
          {publishing ? <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} Publish
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const library = (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {(["structure", "content", "commerce", "social"] as const).map((cat) => (
        <div key={cat}>
          <p className="mb-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">{cat}</p>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {SECTION_REGISTRY.filter((d) => d.category === cat).map((d) => (
              <button
                key={d.type}
                onClick={() => addSection(d.type)}
                className="group flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-transparent px-2.5 py-2 text-left transition-colors hover:border-border hover:bg-muted/60"
                title={d.description}
              >
                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary" />
                <span className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="block truncate text-xs font-medium">{d.label}</span>
                  <span className="block truncate text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{d.description}</span>
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );

  const canvas = (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "mx-auto min-h-full bg-neutral-100",
        device === "mobile" ? "max-w-[420px] border-x" : "w-full"
      )}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setSelectedId(null);
      }}
    >
      {sections.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Empty page — add sections from the library on the left.
        </div>
      ) : (
        sections.map((s) => {
          const isHidden = hiddenIds.includes(s.id);
          return (
            <div
              key={s.id}
              onClick={() => setSelectedId(s.id)}
              className={cn(
                "relative cursor-pointer transition-shadow",
                selectedId === s.id ? "z-10 ring-2 ring-inset ring-primary" : "hover:ring-1 hover:ring-inset hover:ring-primary/30",
                isHidden && "opacity-40"
              )}
            >
              {selectedId === s.id ? (
                <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 z-20 rounded-full bg-primary px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary-foreground shadow">
                  {sectionDef(s.type)?.label ?? s.type}
                </span>
              ) : null}
              <SectionPreview section={s} theme={theme} storeName={storeName} />
            </div>
          );
        })
      )}
    </div>
  );

  const moveSection = (id: string, dir: 1 | -1) =>
    mutate((prev) => {
      const i = prev.findIndex((x) => x.id === id);
      const j = i + dir;
      if (i < 0 || j < 0 || j >= prev.length) return prev;
      return arrayMove(prev, i, j);
    });

  const toggleHidden = (id: string) =>
    setHiddenIds((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...prev, id]));

  const rowProps = (s: Section) => ({
    section: s,
    selected: selectedId === s.id,
    onSelect: () => setSelectedId(s.id),
    hidden: hiddenIds.includes(s.id),
    onToggleHidden: () => toggleHidden(s.id),
    onDuplicate: () => duplicateSection(s.id),
    onDelete: () => removeSection(s.id),
    onMove: (dir: 1 | -1) => moveSection(s.id, dir),
  });

  const layersPanel = (
    <div>
      <p className="mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">
        <Layers className="h-3 w-3" /> Sections ({sections.length})
      </p>
      <DndContext sensors={sensors} collisionDetection={closestCenter} onDragEnd={onDragEnd}>
        <SortableContext items={sections.map((s) => s.id)} strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            {sections.map((s) => (
              <SortableRow key={s.id} {...rowProps(s)} />
            ))}
            {sections.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed p-3 text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                No sections yet — add one from the library below.
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </SortableContext>
      </DndContext>
      <p className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Drag the grip to reorder · arrows as fallback</p>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="-m-4 sm:-m-6">
      {topbar}
      {/* desktop 3-pane */}
      <div className="hidden lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[260px_1fr_320px] xl:grid-cols-[280px_1fr_340px]" style={{ height: "calc(100vh - 122px)" }}>
        <aside className="overflow-y-auto border-r bg-background p-3">
          {layersPanel}
          <div className="my-3 border-t" />
          {library}
        </aside>
        <div className="overflow-y-auto bg-neutral-100">{canvas}</div>
        <aside className="overflow-y-auto border-l bg-background p-3">
          {selected ? (
            <PropsForm section={selected} updateProp={updateProp} />
          ) : (
            <p className="p-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Select a section on the canvas to edit its content.</p>
          )}
        </aside>
      </div>

      {/* mobile stacked tabs */}
      <div className="lg:hidden">
        <Tabs defaultValue="canvas" className="p-3">
          <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3">
            <TabsTrigger value="sections" className="gap-1"><Layers className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Sections</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="canvas">Canvas</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="props">Content</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          <TabsContent value="sections" className="mt-3 max-h-[70vh] space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
            {layersPanel}
            <div className="border-t" />
            {library}
          </TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="canvas" className="mt-3 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto border">{canvas}</TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="props" className="mt-3 max-h-[65vh] overflow-y-auto">
            {selected ? <PropsForm section={selected} updateProp={updateProp} /> : <p className="p-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Select a section first (Canvas tab → tap a block).</p>}
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>

      <ThemeDialog open={themeOpen} onOpenChange={setThemeOpen} theme={theme} onThemeChange={setTheme} />
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- sortable row

function SortableRow({
  section,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  hidden,
  onToggleHidden,
  onDuplicate,
  onDelete,
  onMove,
}: {
  section: Section;
  selected: boolean;
  onSelect: () => void;
  hidden: boolean;
  onToggleHidden: () => void;
  onDuplicate: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onMove: (dir: 1 | -1) => void;
}) {
  const { attributes, listeners, setNodeRef, transform, transition, isDragging } = useSortable({ id: section.id });
  return (
    <div
      ref={setNodeRef}
      style={{ transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform), transition }}
      className={cn(
        "flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-2 py-1.5",
        selected && "border-primary ring-1 ring-primary/40",
        isDragging && "z-50 shadow-lg",
        hidden && "opacity-50"
      )}
    >
      <button
        className="touch-none rounded p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
        aria-label="Drag to reorder"
        {...attributes}
        {...listeners}
      >
        <GripVertical className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
      </button>
      <button onClick={onSelect} className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-left text-xs font-medium">
        {sectionDef(section.type)?.label ?? section.type}
      </button>
      <button onClick={onToggleHidden} aria-label={hidden ? "Show section" : "Hide section"} className="rounded p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground">
        {hidden ? <EyeOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
      </button>
      <button onClick={() => onMove(-1)} aria-label="Move up" className="rounded p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground">
        <ArrowUp className="h-3 w-3" />
      </button>
      <button onClick={() => onMove(1)} aria-label="Move down" className="rounded p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground">
        <ArrowDown className="h-3 w-3" />
      </button>
      <button onClick={onDuplicate} aria-label="Duplicate section" className="rounded p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground">
        <Copy className="h-3 w-3" />
      </button>
      <button onClick={onDelete} aria-label="Delete section" className="rounded p-1 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600">
        <Trash2 className="h-3 w-3" />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- props form

type FieldProps = {
  section: Section;
  updateProp: (id: string, key: string, value: unknown) => void;
};

function PropsForm({ section, updateProp }: FieldProps) {
  const def = sectionDef(section.type);
  if (!def) return <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Unknown section type.</p>;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3.5">
      <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 p-2.5">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold">{def.label}</p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{def.description}</p>
      </div>
      {def.fields.map((f) => {
        const value = section.props[f.key];
        return (
          <div key={f.key} className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label className="text-xs" htmlFor={`f-${section.id}-${f.key}`}>{f.label}</Label>
            <FieldControl field={f} value={value} sectionId={section.id} updateProp={updateProp} />
            {f.help ? <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{f.help}</p> : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
      <p className="border-t pt-2 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Changes autosave to the draft after 3s. Publish to go live.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function FieldControl({
  field,
  value,
  sectionId,
  updateProp,
}: {
  field: SectionField;
  value: unknown;
  sectionId: string;
  updateProp: (id: string, key: string, value: unknown) => void;
}) {
  const [jsonText, setJsonText] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [jsonError, setJsonError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [imgBust, setImgBust] = useState(0);

  switch (field.type) {
    case "switch":
      return <Switch checked={value === true} onCheckedChange={(v) => updateProp(sectionId, field.key, v)} aria-label={field.label} />;

    case "textarea":
      return (
        <Textarea
          id={`f-${sectionId}-${field.key}`}
          rows={4}
          value={typeof value === "string" ? value : ""}
          onChange={(e) => updateProp(sectionId, field.key, e.target.value)}
          placeholder={field.placeholder}
        />
      );

    case "number":
      return (
        <Input
          id={`f-${sectionId}-${field.key}`}
          type="number"
          value={typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "string" ? String(value) : ""}
          onChange={(e) => updateProp(sectionId, field.key, e.target.value === "" ? "" : Number(e.target.value))}
        />
      );

    case "select":
      return (
        <Select value={String(value ?? "")} onValueChange={(v) => updateProp(sectionId, field.key, v)}>
          <SelectTrigger id={`f-${sectionId}-${field.key}`} aria-label={field.label}>
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {(field.options ?? []).map((o) => (
              <SelectItem key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      );

    case "color":
      return (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input
            type="color"
            aria-label={field.label}
            className="h-9 w-10 cursor-pointer rounded border bg-card"
            value={typeof value === "string" && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(value) ? value : "#000000"}
            onChange={(e) => updateProp(sectionId, field.key, e.target.value)}
          />
          <Input
            className="h-9 font-mono text-xs"
            value={String(value ?? "")}
            onChange={(e) => updateProp(sectionId, field.key, e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      );

    case "image": {
      const url = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
      const seedMatch = url.match(/\/api\/img\/([^?]*)/);
      const regenerate = () => {
        if (!seedMatch) return;
        const base = seedMatch[1].replace(/-v\d+$/, "");
        const next = url.replace(/\/api\/img\/[^?]*/, `/api/img/${base}-v${Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000 + 1000)}`);
        updateProp(sectionId, field.key, next);
        setImgBust((b) => b + 1);
      };
      return (
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          {url ? (
            <img key={imgBust} src={url} alt="Section image preview" className="h-16 w-full rounded-lg border object-cover" />
          ) : (
            <div className="flex h-16 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">No image</div>
          )}
          <Input
            id={`f-${sectionId}-${field.key}`}
            className="h-8 font-mono text-[11px]"
            value={url}
            onChange={(e) => updateProp(sectionId, field.key, e.target.value)}
          />
          {seedMatch ? (
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-7 gap-1 text-[11px]" onClick={regenerate}>
              <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" /> Regenerate placeholder
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      );
    }

    case "json": {
      const text = jsonText ?? (value === undefined ? "" : JSON.stringify(value, null, 2));
      return (
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Textarea
            id={`f-${sectionId}-${field.key}`}
            rows={6}
            className={cn("font-mono text-[11px]", jsonError && "border-rose-400 focus-visible:ring-rose-300")}
            value={text}
            onChange={(e) => setJsonText(e.target.value)}
            onBlur={() => {
              try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
                setJsonError(null);
                setJsonText(null);
                updateProp(sectionId, field.key, parsed);
              } catch (err) {
                setJsonError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Invalid JSON");
              }
            }}
          />
          {jsonError ? <p className="text-[10px] text-rose-600">Invalid JSON — {jsonError}</p> : null}
        </div>
      );
    }

    // text + url
    default:
      return (
        <Input
          id={`f-${sectionId}-${field.key}`}
          value={typeof value === "string" ? value : ""}
          onChange={(e) => updateProp(sectionId, field.key, e.target.value)}
          placeholder={field.placeholder}
        />
      );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- theme dialog

function ThemeDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  theme,
  onThemeChange,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void;
  theme: ThemeTokens;
  onThemeChange: (t: ThemeTokens) => void;
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ThemeTokens>(theme);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) setDraft(theme);
  }, [open, theme]);

  const save = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiSend("PUT", "/api/store/theme", { theme: draft });
      onThemeChange(draft);
      toast.success("Theme saved — storefront updated");
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not save theme");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Store theme</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs">Primary color</Label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input type="color" aria-label="Primary color" className="h-9 w-10 cursor-pointer rounded border" value={draft.primaryColor} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, primaryColor: e.target.value })} />
                <Input className="h-9 font-mono text-xs" value={draft.primaryColor} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, primaryColor: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs">Accent color</Label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input type="color" aria-label="Accent color" className="h-9 w-10 cursor-pointer rounded border" value={draft.accentColor} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, accentColor: e.target.value })} />
                <Input className="h-9 font-mono text-xs" value={draft.accentColor} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, accentColor: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs">Corner radius</Label>
              <Select value={draft.radius} onValueChange={(v) => setDraft({ ...draft, radius: v as ThemeTokens["radius"] })}>
                <SelectTrigger aria-label="Corner radius"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="none">None</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="sm">Small</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="md">Medium</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="lg">Large</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="full">Pill</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs">Button style</Label>
              <Select value={draft.buttonStyle} onValueChange={(v) => setDraft({ ...draft, buttonStyle: v as ThemeTokens["buttonStyle"] })}>
                <SelectTrigger aria-label="Button style"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="solid">Solid</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="outline">Outline</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="pill">Pill</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-xl border p-3" style={{ backgroundColor: draft.primaryColor + "10" }}>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold" style={{ color: draft.primaryColor }}>Live preview</p>
            <span className="mt-1.5 inline-block px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white" style={{ backgroundColor: draft.primaryColor, borderRadius: draft.radius === "full" ? 9999 : draft.radius === "none" ? 0 : draft.radius === "sm" ? 4 : draft.radius === "md" ? 10 : 16 }}>
              Button
            </span>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={save} disabled={busy} className="w-full min-h-[44px] gap-2">
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="h-4 w-4" />} Save theme
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";
// Task 2-d — SD-09 Domains: add (CNAME|NS), status stepper, DNS instructions
// with copy buttons, sandbox verify (active + SSL), delete.
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  apiSend,
  EmptyState,
  RowsSkeleton,
  StatusChip,
  fmtDate,
  runMutation,
  useApi,
} from "./ui-bits";
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group";
import { BadgeCheck, Copy, Globe, Info, Loader2, Lock, ShieldCheck, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type Domain = {
  id: string;
  domain: string;
  mode: "cname" | "ns" | string;
  status: string;
  sslStatus: string;
  isPrimary: boolean;
  lastCheckedAt: string | null;
  errorReason: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

const STEPS = ["pending", "verifying", "verified", "active"];

export default function SellerDomains({ storeSlug }: { storeSlug: string }) {
  const { data, loading, refetch } = useApi<Domain[]>("/api/store/domains");
  const [addOpen, setAddOpen] = useState(false);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<Domain | null>(null);

  const verify = async (d: Domain) => {
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("POST", `/api/store/domains/${d.id}/verify`),
      `${d.domain} verified — SSL certificate issued`
    );
    if (ok) refetch();
  };

  const remove = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete) return;
    const ok = await runMutation(() => apiSend("DELETE", `/api/store/domains/${confirmDelete.id}`), "Domain removed");
    setConfirmDelete(null);
    if (ok) refetch();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Alert>
        <Info className="h-4 w-4" />
        <AlertDescription className="text-xs">
          Your default subdomain <span className="font-mono font-semibold">{storeSlug || "your-store"}.shopmesh.site</span> is
          always reachable — custom domains are optional extras for branding.
        </AlertDescription>
      </Alert>

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button onClick={() => setAddOpen(true)} className="min-h-[44px] gap-1.5">
          <Globe className="h-4 w-4" /> Connect domain
        </Button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <RowsSkeleton rows={2} />
      ) : (data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<Globe className="h-8 w-8" />}
          title="No custom domains yet"
          hint="Connect a domain you own (e.g. shop.yourbrand.com) and point DNS at SHOPMESH. Free SSL is issued on verification."
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {(data ?? []).map((d) => (
            <Card key={d.id}>
              <CardHeader className="flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 space-y-0">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    <Globe className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> {d.domain}
                    {d.mode === "ns" ? (
                      <span className="rounded-full border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">nameservers</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="rounded-full border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">cname</span>
                    )}
                  </CardTitle>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Added {fmtDate(d.createdAt)}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {d.sslStatus === "issued" ? (
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-800">
                      <Lock className="h-3 w-3" /> SSL issued
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                      <Lock className="h-3 w-3" /> SSL {d.sslStatus}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-8" onClick={() => verify(d)} disabled={d.status === "active"}>
                    <ShieldCheck className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Verify now
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="icon"
                    className="h-8 w-8 text-rose-500"
                    aria-label={`Delete ${d.domain}`}
                    onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(d)}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                {/* stepper */}
                <ol className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {STEPS.map((s, i) => {
                    const idx = STEPS.indexOf(d.status);
                    const done = idx >= i && idx !== -1;
                    return (
                      <li key={s} className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span
                          className={cn(
                            "flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold",
                            done ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                          )}
                        >
                          {done ? <BadgeCheck className="h-3 w-3" /> : i + 1}
                        </span>
                        <span className={cn("text-[10px] capitalize", done ? "font-medium text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground")}>{s}</span>
                        {i < STEPS.length - 1 ? <span className={cn("h-px flex-1", idx > i ? "bg-primary" : "bg-border")} /> : null}
                      </li>
                    );
                  })}
                </ol>
                <DnsInstructions domain={d} />
                {d.errorReason ? <p className="text-xs text-rose-600">{d.errorReason}</p> : null}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <AddDomainDialog
        open={addOpen}
        onOpenChange={setAddOpen}
        onDone={() => refetch()}
      />

      <AlertDialog open={!!confirmDelete} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setConfirmDelete(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Remove {confirmDelete?.domain}?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              Your storefront will stop resolving on this domain (the default subdomain keeps working). DNS records at your
              registrar can be cleaned up afterwards.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Keep domain</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction className="bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-700" onClick={remove}>Remove</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- dns card

function DnsInstructions({ domain }: { domain: Domain }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const copy = async (text: string, key: string) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopied(key);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(null), 1500);
    } catch {
      /* clipboard unavailable */
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed bg-muted/30 p-3">
      <p className="text-xs font-semibold">DNS setup {domain.status === "active" ? "(done — for reference)" : ""}</p>
      {domain.mode === "ns" ? (
        <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5 font-mono text-xs">
          {["ns1.shopmesh.net", "ns2.shopmesh.net"].map((ns) => (
            <div key={ns} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5">
              <span>NS record → {ns}</span>
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-7 gap-1 px-2" onClick={() => copy(ns, ns)}>
                <Copy className="h-3 w-3" /> {copied === ns ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          ))}
          <p className="font-sans text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Point your domain&apos;s nameservers at SHOPMESH (registrar &gt; nameserver settings).</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5 font-mono text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5">
            <span>CNAME www → shops.shopmesh.site</span>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-7 gap-1 px-2" onClick={() => copy("shops.shopmesh.site", "cname")}>
              <Copy className="h-3 w-3" /> {copied === "cname" ? "Copied" : "Copy target"}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <p className="font-sans text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            For the root domain use an ALIAS/ANAME record to the same target if your registrar supports it.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- add dialog

function AddDomainDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onDone }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; onDone: () => void }) {
  const [domain, setDomain] = useState("");
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"cname" | "ns">("cname");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const submit = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("POST", "/api/store/domains", { domain: domain.trim(), mode }),
      "Domain added — now update DNS, then press Verify now"
    );
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      setDomain("");
      onOpenChange(false);
      onDone();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Connect a custom domain</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="dom-input">Domain *</Label>
            <Input id="dom-input" value={domain} onChange={(e) => setDomain(e.target.value)} placeholder="shop.yourbrand.com" />
          </div>
          <RadioGroup value={mode} onValueChange={(v) => setMode(v as "cname" | "ns")} className="gap-2">
            <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl border p-3" htmlFor="mode-cname">
              <RadioGroupItem value="cname" id="mode-cname" />
              <span>
                <span className="block text-sm font-medium">CNAME (recommended)</span>
                <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">Add a CNAME record pointing at SHOPMESH. Fastest setup.</span>
              </span>
            </label>
            <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl border p-3" htmlFor="mode-ns">
              <RadioGroupItem value="ns" id="mode-ns" />
              <span>
                <span className="block text-sm font-medium">Nameservers (NS)</span>
                <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">Hand over DNS management to SHOPMESH. Full control incl. email routing.</span>
              </span>
            </label>
          </RadioGroup>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Status starts at <StatusChip status="verifying" className="mx-0.5" /> — after updating DNS, press “Verify now”.
          </p>
          <Button onClick={submit} disabled={busy || !domain.trim()} className="w-full min-h-[44px] gap-2">
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Globe className="h-4 w-4" />} Add domain
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";
// Task 2-d — SD-10 Integrations: pixel providers, webhooks (endpoints, secret
// reveal, events, send-test), API keys (lite, client-side demo in sandbox).
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import {
  apiSend,
  runMutation,
  StatusChip,
  fmtDateTime,
  useApi,
} from "./ui-bits";
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
