import { Eye, EyeOff, KeyRound, Loader2, Plug, Plus, Send, Trash2, Webhook } from "lucide-react";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- pixels

type Integration = { provider: string; config: Record<string, unknown>; isEnabled: boolean; updatedAt: string | null };

const PIXELS: { provider: string; label: string; field: string; hint: string }[] = [
  { provider: "meta_pixel", label: "Meta Pixel", field: "pixelId", hint: "Facebook & Instagram ad tracking" },
  { provider: "ga4", label: "Google Analytics 4", field: "measurementId", hint: "Traffic & funnel analytics" },
  { provider: "tiktok_pixel", label: "TikTok Pixel", field: "pixelId", hint: "TikTok ads conversion tracking" },
  { provider: "gtm", label: "Google Tag Manager", field: "containerId", hint: "Manage all tags via GTM" },
];

function PixelCards() {
  const { data, refetch } = useApi<Integration[]>("/api/store/integrations");
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!data) return;
    const d: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const i of data) {
      const def = PIXELS.find((p) => p.provider === i.provider);
      if (def) d[i.provider] = typeof i.config[def.field] === "string" ? String(i.config[def.field]) : "";
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
    setDrafts(d);
  }, [data]);

  const save = async (provider: string, isEnabled?: boolean) => {
    const def = PIXELS.find((p) => p.provider === provider)!;
    const current = data?.find((i) => i.provider === provider);
    const nextEnabled = isEnabled ?? current?.isEnabled ?? false;
    const id = drafts[provider]?.trim();
    if (nextEnabled && !id) {
      toast.error(`Enter a ${def.field} before enabling`);
      return;
    }
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("PUT", "/api/store/integrations", { provider, config: { [def.field]: id ?? "" }, isEnabled: nextEnabled }),
      `${def.label} ${nextEnabled ? "enabled" : "disabled"}`
    );
    if (ok) refetch();
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
      {PIXELS.map((p) => {
        const integration = data?.find((i) => i.provider === p.provider);
        return (
          <Card key={p.provider}>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Plug className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> {p.label}</span>
                <Switch
                  checked={integration?.isEnabled ?? false}
                  onCheckedChange={(v) => save(p.provider, v)}
                  aria-label={`Enable ${p.label}`}
                />
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-2">
              <Input
                placeholder={`${p.field}`}
                value={drafts[p.provider] ?? ""}
                onChange={(e) => setDrafts((prev) => ({ ...prev, [p.provider]: e.target.value }))}
              />
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{p.hint}</p>
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-8" onClick={() => save(p.provider, integration?.isEnabled ?? false)}>
                  Save
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

};

const EVENT_CATALOG = [

];

  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">

      {loading ? (

                <CardTitle className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                  <span className="break-all font-mono text-xs">{ep.url}</span>
                  <Switch checked={ep.isActive} onCheckedChange={(v) => toggleActive(ep, v)} aria-label="Toggle endpoint" />
                  <span className="ml-auto flex gap-1">
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-8 gap-1" onClick={() => sendTest(ep)}>
                      <Send className="h-3 w-3" /> Send test
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8 text-rose-500" aria-label="Delete endpoint" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(ep)}>
                      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </span>
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-2.5">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                  {ep.events.map((e) => (
                    <span key={e} className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px]">{e}</span>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 px-2.5 py-1.5">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Secret</span>
                  <code className="flex-1 truncate font-mono text-xs">
                    {revealed[ep.id] ? ep.secret : `${ep.secret.slice(0, 8)}${"•".repeat(12)}`}
                  </code>
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" aria-label={revealed[ep.id] ? "Hide secret" : "Reveal secret"} onClick={() => setRevealed((prev) => ({ ...prev, [ep.id]: !prev[ep.id] }))}>
                    {revealed[ep.id] ? <EyeOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                  </Button>
                </div>
                {ep.deliveries.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="max-h-36 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border p-2">
                    {ep.deliveries.map((d) => (
                      <div key={d.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                        <StatusChip status={d.status === "success" ? "success" : "failed"} />
                        <span className="font-mono">{d.event}</span>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">{d.responseCode ?? "—"}</span>
                        <span className="ml-auto text-muted-foreground">{fmtDateTime(d.createdAt)}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">No deliveries yet.</p>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <CreateWebhookDialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen} onDone={refetch} />

      <AlertDialog open={!!confirmDelete} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setConfirmDelete(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Delete webhook endpoint?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>Events will stop being delivered to {confirmDelete?.url}. Delivery logs are removed too.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Keep endpoint</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              className="bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-700"
              onClick={async () => {
                if (!confirmDelete) return;
                const ok = await runMutation(() => apiSend("DELETE", `/api/store/webhooks/${confirmDelete.id}`), "Endpoint deleted");
                setConfirmDelete(null);
                if (ok) refetch();
              }}
            >
              Delete

          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </section>
  );
}

function CreateWebhookDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onDone }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; onDone: () => void }) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<string[]>(["order.paid", "order.shipped"]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const submit = async () => {
    if (!/^https?:\/\/.+/.test(url.trim())) {
      toast.error("Enter a valid http(s) URL");
      return;
    }
    if (events.length === 0) {
      toast.error("Pick at least one event");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(() => apiSend("POST", "/api/store/webhooks", { url: url.trim(), events }), "Endpoint created — signing secret generated");
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      setUrl("");
      onOpenChange(false);
      onDone();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Add webhook endpoint</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3.5">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="wh-url">Payload URL *</Label>
            <Input id="wh-url" value={url} onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)} placeholder="https://hooks.yourapp.com/shopmesh" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label>Events ({events.length} selected)</Label>
            <div className="grid max-h-44 grid-cols-1 gap-1.5 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border p-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {EVENT_CATALOG.map((e) => (
                <label key={e} className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                  <Checkbox
                    checked={events.includes(e)}
                    onCheckedChange={(v) => setEvents((prev) => (v ? [...prev, e] : prev.filter((x) => x !== e)))}
                    aria-label={e}
                  />
                  <span className="font-mono">{e}</span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Verify payloads with the <code>X-SM-Signature</code> header (HMAC of the raw body using your secret).</p>
          <Button onClick={submit} disabled={busy} className="w-full min-h-[44px] gap-2">
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />} Create endpoint
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- api keys (lite)

type ApiKeyLite = { id: string; name: string; scope: "read" | "read-write"; token: string; createdAt: string };

const LS_KEY = "sm_seller_api_keys";

function loadKeys(): ApiKeyLite[] {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  try {
    return JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY) ?? "[]") as ApiKeyLite[];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function ApiKeysSection() {
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<ApiKeyLite[]>([]);
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<"read" | "read-write">("read");
  const [showOnce, setShowOnce] = useState<ApiKeyLite | null>(null);

  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
  useEffect(() => setKeys(loadKeys()), []);

  const persist = (next: ApiKeyLite[]) => {
    setKeys(next);
    window.localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
  };

  const create = () => {
    if (!name.trim()) {
      toast.error("Give the key a name");
      return;
    }
    const key: ApiKeyLite = {
      id: `key_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`,
      name: name.trim(),
      scope,
      token: `smk_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    persist([...keys, key]);
    setShowOnce(key);
    setCreateOpen(false);
    setName("");
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold"><KeyRound className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> API keys</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">For custom integrations hitting the store API. Sandbox note: keys live in your browser only (demo).</p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)} className="gap-1.5">
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> Create key
        </Button>
      </div>

      {keys.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No API keys yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {keys.map((k) => (
            <div key={k.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border p-3">
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">{k.name}</p>
                <p className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">smk_••••{k.token.slice(-4)} · {k.scope}</p>
              </div>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="icon"
                className="h-8 w-8 text-rose-500"
                aria-label={`Revoke ${k.name}`}
                onClick={() => persist(keys.filter((x) => x.id !== k.id))}
              >
                <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <Dialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Create API key</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-3.5">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="ak-name">Key name *</Label>
              <Input id="ak-name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Inventory sync script" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Scope</Label>
              <Select value={scope} onValueChange={(v) => setScope(v as "read" | "read-write")}>
                <SelectTrigger aria-label="Scope"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="read">read — GET endpoints only</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="read-write">read-write — full store API</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <Button onClick={create} className="w-full min-h-[44px]">Generate key</Button>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* show-once dialog */}
      <Dialog open={!!showOnce} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setShowOnce(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Copy your key now</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">This is the only time the full token is shown. Store it somewhere safe.</p>
            <code className="block break-all rounded-lg bg-muted p-3 font-mono text-xs">{showOnce?.token}</code>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="w-full"
              onClick={async () => {
                if (!showOnce) return;
                try {
                  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(showOnce.token);
                  toast.success("Token copied");
                } catch {
                  toast.error("Could not copy");
                }
              }}
            >
              Copy token
            </Button>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function SellerIntegrations() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <section className="space-y-3">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Tracking pixels</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Fired on your storefront pages and checkout events (after approval).</p>
        </div>
        <PixelCards />
      </section>
      <WebhooksSection />
      <ApiKeysSection />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// Task 2-d — SD-11 Coupons (store scope): list, create dialog, toggle active,
// delete. Same rules as admin coupons but scoped to this store.
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  apiSend,
  EmptyState,
  MoneyInput,
  RowsSkeleton,
  StatusChip,
  fmtDate,
  formatMinor,
  runMutation,
  useApi,
} from "./ui-bits";
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Loader2, Plus, Tag, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

type Coupon = {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  description: string | null;
  type: "percent" | "fixed" | "freeship" | string;
  percent: number | null;
  amountMinor: number | null;
  minSpendMinor: number;
  maxRedemptions: number | null;
  perCustomerLimit: number;
  startsAt: string | null;
  endsAt: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
  timesUsed: number;
  createdAt: string;
};

export default function SellerCoupons() {
  const { data, loading, refetch } = useApi<Coupon[]>("/api/store/coupons");
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<Coupon | null>(null);

  const toggle = async (c: Coupon, next: boolean) => {
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("PATCH", `/api/store/coupons/${c.id}`, { isActive: next }),
      `${c.code} ${next ? "activated" : "paused"}`
    );
    if (ok) refetch();
  };

  const remove = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete) return;
    const ok = await runMutation(() => apiSend("DELETE", `/api/store/coupons/${confirmDelete.id}`), `Coupon ${confirmDelete.code} deleted`);
    setConfirmDelete(null);
    if (ok) refetch();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Discounts shoppers can apply at checkout on your storefront.</p>
        <Button onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)} className="min-h-[44px] gap-1.5">
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New coupon
        </Button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <RowsSkeleton rows={3} />
      ) : (data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<Tag className="h-8 w-8" />}
          title="No coupons yet"
          hint="Percentage, fixed-amount or free-shipping coupons — great for launch promos."
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Code</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Value</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Min spend</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Usage</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Window</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {(data ?? []).map((c) => (
                <TableRow key={c.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <p className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold">{c.code}</p>
                    {c.description ? <p className="max-w-40 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{c.description}</p> : null}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-sm">
                    {c.type === "percent" ? `${c.percent}% off` : c.type === "fixed" ? `${formatMinor(c.amountMinor ?? 0)} off` : "Free shipping"}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-sm tabular-nums">{c.minSpendMinor > 0 ? formatMinor(c.minSpendMinor) : "—"}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-sm tabular-nums">
                    {c.timesUsed}{c.maxRedemptions ? ` / ${c.maxRedemptions}` : ""}
                    <span className="block text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{c.perCustomerLimit}× per customer</span>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {c.startsAt ? fmtDate(c.startsAt) : "start —"}
                    {" → "}
                    {c.endsAt ? fmtDate(c.endsAt) : "no end"}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Switch checked={c.isActive} onCheckedChange={(v) => toggle(c, v)} aria-label={`Toggle ${c.code}`} />
                      <StatusChip status={c.isActive ? "active" : "draft"} />
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8 text-rose-500" aria-label={`Delete ${c.code}`} onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(c)}>
                      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      )}

      <CreateCouponDialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen} onDone={refetch} />

      <AlertDialog open={!!confirmDelete} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setConfirmDelete(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Delete coupon {confirmDelete?.code}?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              Shoppers will no longer be able to redeem it. Past usage stats remain in orders.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Keep coupon</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction className="bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-700" onClick={remove}>Delete</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- create dialog

function CreateCouponDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onDone }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; onDone: () => void }) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState<"percent" | "fixed" | "freeship">("percent");
  const [percent, setPercent] = useState("10");
  const [amountMinor, setAmountMinor] = useState(0);
  const [minSpendMinor, setMinSpendMinor] = useState(0);
  const [maxRedemptions, setMaxRedemptions] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const submit = async () => {
    const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
      code: code.trim().toUpperCase(),
      type,
      description: description || null,
      minSpendMinor,
      maxRedemptions: maxRedemptions ? Number(maxRedemptions) : null,
    };
    if (type === "percent") body.percent = Number(percent);
    if (type === "fixed") body.amountMinor = amountMinor;
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(() => apiSend("POST", "/api/store/coupons", body), `Coupon ${code.toUpperCase()} created`);
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      setCode("");
      setDescription("");
      setPercent("10");
      setAmountMinor(0);
      setMinSpendMinor(0);
      setMaxRedemptions("");
      onOpenChange(false);
      onDone();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>New coupon</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3.5">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="cp-code">Code * (A-Z, 0-9)</Label>
              <Input id="cp-code" className="font-mono uppercase" value={code} onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())} placeholder="RAYA20" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Type</Label>
              <Select value={type} onValueChange={(v) => setType(v as typeof type)}>
                <SelectTrigger aria-label="Coupon type"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="percent">Percent off</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="fixed">Fixed amount off</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="freeship">Free shipping</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {type === "percent" ? (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="cp-percent">Percent (1–100) *</Label>
              <Input id="cp-percent" inputMode="numeric" value={percent} onChange={(e) => setPercent(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""))} />
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {type === "fixed" ? (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Amount off (RM) *</Label>
              <MoneyInput valueMinor={amountMinor} onChangeMinor={setAmountMinor} />
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Min spend (RM)</Label>
              <MoneyInput valueMinor={minSpendMinor} onChangeMinor={setMinSpendMinor} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="cp-max">Max redemptions</Label>
              <Input id="cp-max" inputMode="numeric" value={maxRedemptions} onChange={(e) => setMaxRedemptions(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""))} placeholder="unlimited" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="cp-desc">Description</Label>
            <Input id="cp-desc" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="Raya promo — 20% off everything" />
          </div>
          <Button onClick={submit} disabled={busy || !code.trim()} className="w-full min-h-[44px] gap-2">
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />} Create coupon
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";
// Task 2-d — SEL-ONB onboarding wizard: 1 Store identity → 2 KYC documents →
// 3 Bank account → 4 Review & submit. Data persists via /api/store/* endpoints.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type Dispatch, type SetStateAction } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { useApp } from "@/lib/app-store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { apiGet, apiSend, runMutation, StoreMe, BankAccount, StatusChip } from "./ui-bits";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  BadgeCheck,
  Building2,
  Check,
  ClipboardCheck,
  FileCheck2,
  Loader2,
  Paintbrush,
  Send,
  Store,
  Upload,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";

const BANKS = ["Maybank", "CIMB", "Public Bank", "Bank Rakyat", "Hong Leong"];
const TEMPLATES = [
  { key: "aurora", label: "Aurora", color: "#0f766e", hint: "Calm teal — best for home & living" },
  { key: "sunset", label: "Sunset", color: "#c2410c", hint: "Warm orange — food, crafts, apparel" },
  { key: "rose", label: "Rose", color: "#9f1239", hint: "Deep rose — beauty & boutique" },
];

const DOC_TYPES = [
  { key: "ic_front", label: "IC / Passport (front)", hint: "Photo of your national ID" },
  { key: "ic_selfie", label: "Selfie with IC", hint: "Holding your ID next to your face" },
  { key: "business_reg", label: "Business registration", hint: "SSM cert — skip if sole trader below threshold" },
];

const STEP_LABELS = ["Store identity", "KYC documents", "Bank account", "Review & submit"];

export default function OnboardingWizard({ onStatusChanged }: { onStatusChanged: () => Promise<void> }) {
  const me = useApp((s) => s.me);
  const seller = me.loaded && "seller" in me ? me.seller : null;

  const [storeMe, setStoreMe] = useState<StoreMe | null>(null);
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  // step 1 state
  const [identity, setIdentity] = useState({ name: "", tagline: "", description: "", whatsapp: "", logoUrl: "" });
  const [primaryColor, setPrimaryColor] = useState(TEMPLATES[0].color);

  // step 2 state (simulated uploads — names only, gated client-side)
  const [docs, setDocs] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [docInput, setDocInput] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  // step 3 state
  const [bank, setBank] = useState({ holderName: "", bankName: "", accountNumber: "" });
  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState<BankAccount[]>([]);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const d = await apiGet<StoreMe>("/api/store/me");
      setStoreMe(d);
      setAccounts(await apiGet<BankAccount[]>("/api/store/bank-accounts").catch(() => []));
      return d;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
    refresh().then((d) => {
      if (!d) return;
      setIdentity({
        name: d.store.name ?? "",
        tagline: d.store.tagline ?? "",
        description: d.store.description ?? "",
        whatsapp: d.store.whatsapp ?? "",
        logoUrl: d.store.logoUrl ?? "",
      });
      const themeColor = TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.color === parseThemeColor(d.store.theme))?.color ?? TEMPLATES[0].color;
      setPrimaryColor(themeColor);
    });
  }, [refresh]);

  const docsComplete = DOC_TYPES.every((d) => docs[d.key]);
  const bankComplete = accounts.length > 0;
  const identityComplete = !!(identity.name.trim() && identity.tagline.trim());
  const stepDone = [identityComplete, docsComplete, bankComplete, false];

  const canNext = [identityComplete, docsComplete, bankComplete, true][step];

  const saveIdentity = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(async () => {
      const slugSeed = identity.name.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-") || "logo";
      const logoUrl = identity.logoUrl || `/api/img/${slugSeed}-logo?w=200&h=200&label=${encodeURIComponent(identity.name.trim())}`;
      await apiSend("PATCH", "/api/store/settings", {
        name: identity.name.trim(),
        tagline: identity.tagline.trim(),
        description: identity.description,
        whatsapp: identity.whatsapp,
        logoUrl,
      });
      await apiSend("PUT", "/api/store/theme", { theme: { primaryColor } });
    }, "Store identity saved");
    setBusy(false);
    return ok;
  };

  const addBank = async () => {
    if (!bank.holderName.trim() || !bank.bankName || bank.accountNumber.replace(/\s+/g, "").length < 4) {
      // rely on per-field hints; simple guard
      return runMutation(() => Promise.reject(new Error("Fill holder name, bank and account number (min 4 digits)")), "");
    }
    return runMutation(async () => {
      await apiSend("POST", "/api/store/bank-accounts", bank);
      setAccounts(await apiGet<BankAccount[]>("/api/store/bank-accounts"));
      setBank({ holderName: "", bankName: "", accountNumber: "" });
    }, "Bank account added — admin will verify it");
  };

  const submitForReview = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("POST", "/api/store/onboarding", { action: "submit" }),
      "Submitted! Our team will review your store shortly."
    );
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      await refresh();
      await onStatusChanged(); // seller.status flips to pending_review → shell re-routes
    }
  };

  const gotoStep = async (next: number) => {
    if (next > step && step === 0) {
      const ok = await saveIdentity();
      if (!ok) return;
      await refresh();
    }
    setStep(Math.max(0, Math.min(3, next)));
  };

  const progress = useMemo(() => Math.round(((step + 1) / 4) * 100), [step]);

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto bg-muted/30">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl p-4 sm:p-8">
        {/* header */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
            <Store className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
          </span>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold leading-tight">Set up your store</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {seller?.storeName ?? "Your store"} · 4 quick steps, data saves as you go
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {storeMe?.seller.status === "rejected" && storeMe.seller.rejectReason ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive" className="mt-4">
            <AlertDescription>
              <span className="font-semibold">Your previous submission was rejected: </span>
              {storeMe.seller.rejectReason} — update the details below and submit again.
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}

        {/* progress */}
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span>Step {step + 1} of 4 — {STEP_LABELS[step]}</span>
            <span>{progress}%</span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={progress} />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-6 grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[220px_1fr]">
          {/* step rail */}
          <ol className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto lg:flex-col lg:overflow-visible">
            {STEP_LABELS.map((label, i) => (
              <li key={label} className="shrink-0 lg:shrink">
                <button
                  onClick={() => i < step && setStep(i)}
                  disabled={i > step}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition-colors",
                    i === step && "border-primary bg-primary/5 text-primary font-medium",
                    i < step && "border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:bg-muted",
                    i > step && "border-border/60 bg-card/50 text-muted-foreground"
                  )}
                >
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      "flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-semibold",
                      i < step ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700" : i === step ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "bg-muted"
                    )}
                  >
                    {i < step ? <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : i + 1}
                  </span>
                  <span className="whitespace-nowrap lg:whitespace-normal">{label}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>

          {/* step panels */}
          <motion.div
            key={step}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 12 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
            className="min-w-0"
          >
            {step === 0 && (
              <IdentityStep
                identity={identity}
                setIdentity={setIdentity}
                primaryColor={primaryColor}
                setPrimaryColor={setPrimaryColor}
                busy={busy}
              />
            )}
            {step === 1 && (
              <KycStep docs={docs} setDocs={setDocs} docInput={docInput} setDocInput={setDocInput} />
            )}
            {step === 2 && (
              <BankStep bank={bank} setBank={setBank} accounts={accounts} onAdd={addBank} busy={busy} />
            )}
            {step === 3 && (
              <ReviewStep
                storeMe={storeMe}
                identity={identity}
                primaryColor={primaryColor}
                docs={docs}
                accounts={accounts}
                identityComplete={identityComplete}
                busy={busy}
                onSubmit={submitForReview}
              />
            )}

            {/* footer nav */}
            <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)} disabled={step === 0 || busy}>
                Back
              </Button>
              {step < 3 ? (
                <Button
                  onClick={() => gotoStep(step + 1)}
                  disabled={!canNext || busy}
                  className="min-h-[44px] gap-2"
                >
                  {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : null}
                  {step === 0 ? "Save & continue" : "Continue"}
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button onClick={submitForReview} disabled={busy || !identityComplete} className="min-h-[44px] gap-2">
                  {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Send className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  Submit for review
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function parseThemeColor(themeJson: string | undefined): string | null {
  try {
    const t = themeJson ? JSON.parse(themeJson) : {};
    return typeof t.primaryColor === "string" ? t.primaryColor : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 1

function IdentityStep({
  identity,
  setIdentity,
  primaryColor,
  setPrimaryColor,
  busy,
}: {
  identity: { name: string; tagline: string; description: string; whatsapp: string; logoUrl: string };
  setIdentity: Dispatch<SetStateAction<{ name: string; tagline: string; description: string; whatsapp: string; logoUrl: string }>>;
  primaryColor: string;
  setPrimaryColor: (c: string) => void;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-5">
      <div>
        <h2 className="font-semibold">Store identity</h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">This is what shoppers see on your storefront.</p>
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="onb-name">Store name *</Label>
          <Input id="onb-name" value={identity.name} onChange={(e) => setIdentity({ ...identity, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Lumina Living" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="onb-wa">WhatsApp number</Label>
          <Input id="onb-wa" value={identity.whatsapp} onChange={(e) => setIdentity({ ...identity, whatsapp: e.target.value })} placeholder="60123456789" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="onb-tag">Tagline *</Label>
        <Input id="onb-tag" value={identity.tagline} onChange={(e) => setIdentity({ ...identity, tagline: e.target.value })} placeholder="Calm, functional objects for better days." />
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="onb-desc">Description</Label>
        <Textarea id="onb-desc" rows={3} value={identity.description} onChange={(e) => setIdentity({ ...identity, description: e.target.value })} placeholder="Tell shoppers what you sell and where you ship from…" />
      </div>

      {/* logo preview */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed p-3">
        <span
          className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg text-primary-foreground"
          style={{ backgroundColor: primaryColor }}
        >
          {identity.name ? (
            <img src={`/api/img/${encodeURIComponent(identity.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-"))}-logo?w=96&h=96&label=Logo`} alt="Store logo preview" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            <Paintbrush className="h-5 w-5" />
          )}
        </span>
        <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <p className="font-medium text-foreground">Logo is auto-generated</p>
          <p>A placeholder logo is created from your store name — you can change it anytime in Settings.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* template picker */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label>Pick a look (template)</Label>
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {TEMPLATES.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.key}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPrimaryColor(t.color)}
              className={cn(
                "rounded-xl border p-3 text-left transition-all",
                primaryColor === t.color ? "border-primary ring-2 ring-primary/30" : "hover:border-muted-foreground/40"
              )}
            >
              <span className="block h-10 w-full rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: t.color }} />
              <span className="mt-2 block text-sm font-medium">{t.label}</span>
              <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.hint}</span>
              {primaryColor === t.color ? (
                <span className="mt-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-primary">
                  <BadgeCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Selected
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Saved as your theme primary color — customize everything later in the Page Builder.</p>
      </div>
      {busy ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Saving…</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 2

function KycStep({
  docs,
  setDocs,
  docInput,
  setDocInput,
}: {
  docs: Record<string, string>;
  setDocs: Dispatch<SetStateAction<Record<string, string>>>;
  docInput: Record<string, string>;
  setDocInput: Dispatch<SetStateAction<Record<string, string>>>;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-5">
      <div>
        <h2 className="font-semibold">KYC documents</h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Simulated upload for this demo — type a file name and attach it. Our team reviews these documents
          during the approval step; nothing is uploaded anywhere.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {DOC_TYPES.map((d) => (
          <div key={d.key} className="rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">{d.label}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{d.hint}</p>
              </div>
              {docs[d.key] ? <StatusChip status="approved" /> : <StatusChip status="pending" />}
            </div>
            {docs[d.key] ? (
              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/60 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs">
                <FileCheck2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                <span className="truncate">{docs[d.key]}</span>
                <button
                  aria-label={`Remove ${d.label}`}
                  className="ml-auto text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                  onClick={() => setDocs((prev) => ({ ...prev, [d.key]: "" }))}
                >
                  <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
                <Input
                  placeholder="e.g. my-ic-front.jpg"
                  value={docInput[d.key] ?? ""}
                  onChange={(e) => setDocInput((prev) => ({ ...prev, [d.key]: e.target.value }))}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === "Enter" && (docInput[d.key] ?? "").trim()) {
                      setDocs((prev) => ({ ...prev, [d.key]: (docInput[d.key] ?? "").trim() }));
                    }
                  }}
                  className="h-9 text-xs"
                />
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  className="h-9 gap-1.5"
                  disabled={!(docInput[d.key] ?? "").trim()}
                  onClick={() => setDocs((prev) => ({ ...prev, [d.key]: (docInput[d.key] ?? "").trim() }))}
                >
                  <Upload className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Attach
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {DOC_TYPES.filter((d) => docs[d.key]).length} of 3 documents attached — all three are required to continue.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 3

function BankStep({
  bank,
  setBank,
  accounts,
  onAdd,
  busy,
}: {
  bank: { holderName: string; bankName: string; accountNumber: string };
  setBank: Dispatch<SetStateAction<{ holderName: string; bankName: string; accountNumber: string }>>;
  accounts: BankAccount[];
  onAdd: () => Promise<boolean>;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  const digits = bank.accountNumber.replace(/\s+/g, "");
  const valid = !!(bank.holderName.trim() && bank.bankName && digits.length >= 4);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-5">
      <div>
        <h2 className="font-semibold">Bank account</h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Payouts are transferred here after the 7-day clearing hold.</p>
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="bank-holder">Account holder name *</Label>
          <Input id="bank-holder" value={bank.holderName} onChange={(e) => setBank({ ...bank, holderName: e.target.value })} placeholder="Lumina Living Sdn Bhd" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label>Bank *</Label>
          <Select value={bank.bankName} onValueChange={(v) => setBank({ ...bank, bankName: v })}>
            <SelectTrigger aria-label="Bank name">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Select bank" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {BANKS.map((b) => (
                <SelectItem key={b} value={b}>{b}</SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="bank-acc">Account number *</Label>
        <Input id="bank-acc" inputMode="numeric" value={bank.accountNumber} onChange={(e) => setBank({ ...bank, accountNumber: e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9\s]/g, "") })} placeholder="1622 3810 5543" />
        {bank.accountNumber && digits.length < 4 ? <p className="text-xs text-rose-600">At least 4 digits.</p> : null}
      </div>
      <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onAdd} disabled={!valid || busy} className="gap-2 min-h-[44px]">
        {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Building2 className="h-4 w-4" />}
        Add bank account
      </Button>

      {accounts.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {accounts.map((a) => (
            <div key={a.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-3 py-2.5">
              <div className="min-w-0 text-sm">
                <p className="truncate font-medium">{a.bankName} · {a.accountNumberMasked}</p>
                <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{a.holderName}</p>
              </div>
              {a.verified ? <StatusChip status="verified" /> : <StatusChip status="pending" />}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No account added yet — add one to continue.</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 4

function ReviewStep({
  storeMe,
  identity,
  primaryColor,
  docs,
  accounts,
  identityComplete,
  busy,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  storeMe: StoreMe | null;
  identity: { name: string; tagline: string; description: string };
  primaryColor: string;
  docs: Record<string, string>;
  accounts: BankAccount[];
  identityComplete: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  onSubmit: () => void;
}) {
  const checklist = [
    { label: "Store identity saved", done: identityComplete },
    { label: "KYC documents attached (3/3)", done: DOC_TYPES.every((d) => docs[d.key]) },
    { label: "Bank account added", done: accounts.length > 0 },
    { label: "Profile completed", done: storeMe?.onboarding.checklist.profile ?? false },
  ];
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-lg font-bold text-primary-foreground" style={{ backgroundColor: primaryColor }}>
            {(identity.name || "S").slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
          </span>
          <div>
            <p className="font-semibold">{identity.name || "Your store"}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{identity.tagline || "No tagline yet"}</p>
          </div>
          <span className="ml-auto h-6 w-6 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: primaryColor }} aria-hidden />
        </div>
        {identity.description ? <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{identity.description}</p> : null}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-4">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold"><FileCheck2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> KYC documents</p>
          <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1.5 text-xs">
            {DOC_TYPES.map((d) => (
              <li key={d.key} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="truncate text-muted-foreground">{d.label}</span>
                {docs[d.key] ? <span className="truncate font-medium">{docs[d.key]}</span> : <span className="text-rose-600">missing</span>}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-4">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold"><Building2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Bank account</p>
          {accounts.length > 0 ? (
            <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1.5 text-xs">
              {accounts.map((a) => (
                <li key={a.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="truncate">{a.bankName} · {a.accountNumberMasked}</span>
                  {a.verified ? <StatusChip status="verified" /> : <StatusChip status="pending" />}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : (
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-rose-600">No bank account added — go back to step 3.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-4">
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold"><ClipboardCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Ready to submit?</p>
        <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
          {checklist.map((c) => (
            <li key={c.label} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <span className={cn("flex h-4.5 w-4.5 items-center justify-center rounded-full", c.done ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700" : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground")}>
                <Check className="h-3 w-3" />
              </span>
              <span className={c.done ? "" : "text-muted-foreground"}>{c.label}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Submitting locks your details for review (usually 1–2 business days). You can keep editing products while you wait.
        </p>
        <Button onClick={onSubmit} disabled={busy} className="mt-4 w-full min-h-[44px] gap-2 sm:w-auto">
          {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Send className="h-4 w-4" />}
          Submit for review
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// Task 2-d — SD-04/05 Orders: tabbed list, full detail (items, money, address,
// timeline), fulfill/ship/refund-request actions, printable packing slip.
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import {
  apiGet,
  apiGetPaged,
  apiSend,
  EmptyState,
  MoneyInput,
  RowsSkeleton,
  StatusChip,
  ageOf,
  fmtDateTime,
  formatMinor,
  runMutation,
  useApi,
  type SellerNav,
} from "./ui-bits";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  CircleDollarSign,
  ClipboardList,
  Loader2,
  MapPin,
  PackageCheck,
  Printer,
  RotateCcw,
  Search,
  Truck,
  Undo2,
} from "lucide-react";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- types

type OrderRow = {
  id: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  status: string;
  channel: string;
  totalMinor: number;
  currency: string;
  itemCount: number;
  trackingNumber: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  paidAt: string | null;
  shippedAt: string | null;
};

type OrderDetail = {
  id: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string | null;
  status: string;
  channel: string;
  currency: string;
  subtotalMinor: number;
  discountMinor: number;
  shippingMinor: number;
  taxMinor: number;
  totalMinor: number;
  couponCode: string | null;
  customerNote: string | null;
  paymentProvider: string | null;
  paidAt: string | null;
  fulfilledAt: string | null;
  shippedAt: string | null;
  trackingNumber: string | null;
  trackingProvider: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  items: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    variantLabel: string | null;
    unitPriceMinor: number;
    qty: number;
    lineSubtotalMinor: number;
    discountMinor: number;
    commissionMinor: number;
    sellerNetMinor: number;
    refundedMinor: number;
  }[];
  history: { id: string; fromStatus: string | null; toStatus: string; actor: string; note: string | null; createdAt: string }[];
  refunds: { id: string; amountMinor: number; reason: string | null; status: string; requestedBy: string; createdAt: string }[];
  shippingAddress: { line1?: string; line2?: string; city?: string; postcode?: string; state?: string; country?: string };
  latestPaymentRef: string | null;
};

const TABS = [
  { key: "to_fulfill", label: "To fulfill" },
  { key: "shipped", label: "Shipped" },
  { key: "done", label: "Completed" },
  { key: "refunds", label: "Refunds" },
  { key: "all", label: "All" },
];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- view

export default function SellerOrders({ focusOrderId, onNavigate }: { focusOrderId?: string; onNavigate: (n: SellerNav) => void }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("to_fulfill");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<OrderRow[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
    if (focusOrderId) setSelectedId(focusOrderId);
  }, [focusOrderId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
    setLoading(true);
    apiGetPaged<OrderRow[]>(`/api/store/orders?status=${tab}&search=${encodeURIComponent(search)}&page=${page}&size=12`)
      .then(({ rows: r, meta }) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        setRows(r);
        setTotal(meta?.total ?? r.length);
      })
      .catch(() => alive && setRows([]))
      .finally(() => alive && setLoading(false));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [tab, search, page, tick]);

  if (selectedId) {
    return (
      <OrderDetailView
        orderId={selectedId}
        onBack={() => {
          setSelectedId(null);
          setTick((t) => t + 1);
          onNavigate({ view: "orders" });
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / 12));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Tabs value={tab} onValueChange={(v) => { setTab(v); setPage(1); }}>
        <TabsList className="flex w-full flex-wrap justify-start gap-1 sm:w-auto">
          {TABS.map((t) => (
            <TabsTrigger key={t.key} value={t.key} className="min-h-[36px]">
              {t.label}
            </TabsTrigger>
          ))}
        </TabsList>
      </Tabs>

      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input
          placeholder="Search order number, customer, email…"
          className="pl-8 sm:max-w-sm"
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }}
        />
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <RowsSkeleton rows={5} />
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState icon={<ClipboardList className="h-8 w-8" />} title="No orders here" hint="Orders appear as shoppers check out on your storefront." />
      ) : (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Order</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Customer</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Items</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Total</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Paid</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {rows.map((o) => (
                <TableRow key={o.id} className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setSelectedId(o.id)}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <p className="font-medium">{o.orderNumber}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{ageOf(o.createdAt)}</p>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <p className="max-w-40 truncate">{o.customerName}</p>
                    <p className="max-w-40 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{o.customerEmail}</p>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell><StatusChip status={o.status} /></TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{o.itemCount}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{formatMinor(o.totalMinor)}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground">{o.paidAt ? fmtDateTime(o.paidAt) : "—"}</TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      )}

      {rows.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <span>{total} order{total === 1 ? "" : "s"} · page {page} of {totalPages}</span>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}>Previous</Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page >= totalPages} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}>Next</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- detail

function OrderDetailView({ orderId, onBack }: { orderId: string; onBack: () => void }) {
  const { data: order, loading, error, refetch } = useApi<OrderDetail>(`/api/store/orders/${orderId}`);
  const [shipOpen, setShipOpen] = useState(false);
  const [refundOpen, setRefundOpen] = useState(false);

  if (loading) return <RowsSkeleton rows={6} />;
  if (error || !order) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onBack} className="gap-1.5"><ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Back to orders</Button>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-6 text-sm text-rose-600">Could not load order{error ? `: ${error}` : ""}</CardContent></Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const commission = order.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.commissionMinor, 0);
  const net = order.totalMinor - commission;
  const canFulfill = order.status === "paid" || order.status === "processing";
  const canShip = order.status === "paid" || order.status === "processing";
  const canRefund = ["paid", "processing", "shipped", "delivered", "completed"].includes(order.status);

  const fulfill = async () => {
    const ok = await runMutation(() => apiSend("POST", `/api/store/orders/${order.id}/fulfill`), `Order ${order.orderNumber} marked fulfilled`);
    if (ok) refetch();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* print-only packing slip */}
      <PackingSlip order={order} />

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 print:hidden">
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onBack} className="gap-1.5">
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Orders
        </Button>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{order.orderNumber}</h2>
        <StatusChip status={order.status} />
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {order.channel} · created {fmtDateTime(order.createdAt)}
        </span>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="ml-auto gap-1.5" onClick={() => window.print()}>
          <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Print packing slip
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* actions */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 print:hidden">
        {canFulfill ? (
          <Button onClick={fulfill} className="gap-2 min-h-[44px]">
            <PackageCheck className="h-4 w-4" /> Mark fulfilled
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        {canShip ? (
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setShipOpen(true)} className="gap-2 min-h-[44px]">
            <Truck className="h-4 w-4" /> Ship order…
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        {canRefund ? (
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setRefundOpen(true)} className="gap-2 min-h-[44px] text-rose-600">
            <Undo2 className="h-4 w-4" /> Request refund
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        {order.trackingNumber ? (
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-muted/40 px-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <Truck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> {order.trackingProvider}: {order.trackingNumber}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {/* items */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
          <CardHeader><CardTitle className="text-sm">Items</CardTitle></CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="overflow-x-auto">
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>Item</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Qty</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Unit</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Line total</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Commission</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {order.items.map((i) => (
                  <TableRow key={i.id}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <p className="font-medium">{i.title}</p>
                      {i.variantLabel ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{i.variantLabel}</p> : null}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{i.qty}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{formatMinor(i.unitPriceMinor)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{formatMinor(i.lineSubtotalMinor - i.discountMinor)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums text-amber-600">{formatMinor(i.commissionMinor)}</TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
            {order.customerNote ? (
              <Alert className="mt-3">
                <AlertDescription className="text-xs">Customer note: {order.customerNote}</AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
            ) : null}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* money panel */}
        <Card className="print:hidden">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><CircleDollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Money</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-1.5 text-sm">
            <MoneyRow label="Subtotal" value={order.subtotalMinor} />
            {order.discountMinor > 0 ? <MoneyRow label={`Discount${order.couponCode ? ` (${order.couponCode})` : ""}`} value={-order.discountMinor} /> : null}
            {order.shippingMinor > 0 ? <MoneyRow label="Shipping" value={order.shippingMinor} /> : null}
            <Separator className="my-2" />
            <MoneyRow label="Order total" value={order.totalMinor} strong />
            <MoneyRow label="Platform commission" value={commission} tone="amber" />
            <MoneyRow label="Net to you" value={net} tone="green" strong />
            <Separator className="my-2" />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Paid via {order.paymentProvider ?? "—"}{order.latestPaymentRef ? ` · ref ${order.latestPaymentRef}` : ""}.
              Commission is held for 7 days before it becomes available in your wallet.
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* customer + address */}
        <Card className="print:hidden">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><MapPin className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Customer & shipping</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-1 text-sm">
            <p className="font-medium">{order.customerName}</p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">{order.customerEmail}</p>
            {order.customerPhone ? <p className="text-muted-foreground">{order.customerPhone}</p> : null}
            <Separator className="my-2" />
            <address className="not-italic leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              {order.shippingAddress.line1 ? <span className="block">{order.shippingAddress.line1}</span> : null}
              {order.shippingAddress.line2 ? <span className="block">{order.shippingAddress.line2}</span> : null}
              <span className="block">
                {[order.shippingAddress.postcode, order.shippingAddress.city].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
              </span>
              <span className="block">{[order.shippingAddress.state, order.shippingAddress.country || "Malaysia"].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}</span>
            </address>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* timeline */}
        <Card className="print:hidden">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Status timeline</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <ol className="relative space-y-4 border-l pl-5">
              {order.history.map((h) => (
                <li key={h.id} className="relative">
                  <span className="absolute -left-[26px] top-1 h-3 w-3 rounded-full border-2 border-background bg-primary" aria-hidden />
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium capitalize">{h.toStatus.replace(/_/g, " ")}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{fmtDateTime(h.createdAt)} · by {h.actor}</p>
                  {h.note ? <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{h.note}</p> : null}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
            {order.refunds.length > 0 ? (
              <>
                <Separator className="my-3" />
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">Refunds</p>
                <ul className="mt-1.5 space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                  {order.refunds.map((r) => (
                    <li key={r.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span>{formatMinor(r.amountMinor)} · {r.reason ?? "no reason"}</span>
                      <StatusChip status={r.status} />
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </>
            ) : null}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <ShipDialog open={shipOpen} onOpenChange={setShipOpen} order={order} onDone={refetch} />
      <RefundDialog open={refundOpen} onOpenChange={setRefundOpen} order={order} onDone={refetch} />
    </div>
  );
}

function MoneyRow({ label, value, tone, strong }: { label: string; value: number; tone?: "amber" | "green"; strong?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
      <span className={strong ? "font-medium" : "text-muted-foreground"}>{label}</span>
      <span
        className={
          "tabular-nums " +
          (tone === "amber" ? "text-amber-600" : tone === "green" ? "text-emerald-600" : "") +
          (strong ? " font-semibold" : "")
        }
      >
        {value < 0 ? `−${formatMinor(-value)}` : formatMinor(value)}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ship dialog

function ShipDialog({ open, onOpenChange, order, onDone }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; order: OrderDetail; onDone: () => void }) {
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState(order.trackingProvider ?? "");
  const [tracking, setTracking] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
      setProvider(order.trackingProvider ?? "");
      setTracking("");
    }
  }, [open, order.trackingProvider]);

  const ship = async () => {
    if (!provider.trim() || !tracking.trim()) {
      toast.error("Courier and tracking number are required");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("POST", `/api/store/orders/${order.id}/ship`, { provider: provider.trim(), trackingNumber: tracking.trim() }),
      `${order.orderNumber} marked shipped — customer notified`
    );
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      onOpenChange(false);
      onDone();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Ship {order.orderNumber}</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3.5">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="ship-provider">Courier / provider *</Label>
            <Input id="ship-provider" value={provider} onChange={(e) => setProvider(e.target.value)} placeholder="CityLink, J&T, PosLaju…" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="ship-tracking">Tracking number *</Label>
            <Input id="ship-tracking" value={tracking} onChange={(e) => setTracking(e.target.value)} placeholder="CL123456789" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">We email the customer and fire your <code>order.shipped</code> webhooks.</p>
          <Button onClick={ship} disabled={busy} className="w-full min-h-[44px] gap-2">
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Truck className="h-4 w-4" />} Confirm shipment
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- refund dialog

function RefundDialog({ open, onOpenChange, order, onDone }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; order: OrderDetail; onDone: () => void }) {
  const refunded = order.refunds.filter((r) => r.status !== "rejected").reduce((s, r) => s + r.amountMinor, 0);
  const refundable = Math.max(0, order.totalMinor - refunded);
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState<number>(refundable);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [restock, setRestock] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
      setAmount(Math.max(0, order.totalMinor - order.refunds.filter((r) => r.status !== "rejected").reduce((s, r) => s + r.amountMinor, 0)));
      setReason("");
      setRestock(true);
    }
  }, [open, order]);

  const submit = async () => {
    if (amount <= 0 || amount > refundable) {
      toast.error(`Amount must be between RM 0 and ${formatMinor(refundable)}`);
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("POST", `/api/store/orders/${order.id}/refund-request`, { amountMinor: amount, reason: reason || null, restock }),
      "Refund requested — an admin will review it"
    );
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      onOpenChange(false);
      onDone();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Request refund — {order.orderNumber}</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3.5">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label>Amount (RM)</Label>
            <MoneyInput valueMinor={amount} onChangeMinor={setAmount} />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Refundable balance: {formatMinor(refundable)}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="refund-reason">Reason</Label>
            <Textarea id="refund-reason" rows={3} value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} placeholder="Damaged in transit, item out of stock…" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Restock items</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Return the items to inventory when the refund is processed.</p>
            </div>
            <Switch checked={restock} onCheckedChange={setRestock} aria-label="Restock items" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Requests are reviewed by SHOPMESH admins; the ledger reversal happens on approval.</p>
          <Button onClick={submit} disabled={busy} className="w-full min-h-[44px] gap-2">
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Undo2 className="h-4 w-4" />} Submit request
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- packing slip

function PackingSlip({ order }: { order: OrderDetail }) {
  return (
    <div className="hidden print:block print:mb-6" aria-hidden>
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b pb-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xl font-bold">PACKING SLIP</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{order.orderNumber} · {fmtDateTime(order.createdAt)}</p>
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold">SHOPMESH fulfillment</p>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 text-sm">
        <p className="font-semibold">Ship to</p>
        <p>{order.customerName}</p>
        <p>{order.shippingAddress.line1}</p>
        <p>{[order.shippingAddress.postcode, order.shippingAddress.city].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}</p>
        <p>{[order.shippingAddress.state, order.shippingAddress.country || "Malaysia"].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}</p>
        <p>{order.customerPhone ?? ""}</p>
      </div>
      <table className="mt-4 w-full text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b text-left">
            <th className="py-1">Item</th>
            <th className="py-1 text-right">Qty</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {order.items.map((i) => (
            <tr key={i.id} className="border-b">
              <td className="py-1">{i.title}{i.variantLabel ? ` — ${i.variantLabel}` : ""}</td>
              <td className="py-1 text-right">{i.qty}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <p className="mt-3 text-xs">Thank you for shopping with us! · Total items: {order.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty, 0)}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
