"use client";
// Task 2-d — SD-02/03 Products: catalog table + create/edit dialog with images,
// variants, category, moderation status. Archive = soft delete.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import {
  apiGet,
  apiGetPaged,
  apiSend,
  EmptyState,
  MoneyInput,
  RowsSkeleton,
  runMutation,
  StatusChip,
  formatMinor,
  toMinor,
  type SellerNav,
} from "./ui-bits";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Archive, ImageIcon, Loader2, Package, Plus, Search, Sparkles, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- types

type Variant = {
  id?: string;
  name: string;
  optionValue: string;
  price: string; // RM decimal as typed
  compareAt: string;
  stock: string;
  sku: string;
};

type ProductRow = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  slug: string;
  description: string | null;
  status: string;
  rejectReason: string | null;
  priceMinor: number;
  salesCount: number;
  flagsJson: string;
  images: { url: string }[];
  variants: { id: string; name: string; optionValue: string | null; priceMinor: number; stock: number; sku: string | null }[];
  category: { id: string; name: string } | null;
};

type Category = { id: string; label: string };

type Paged<T> = { rows: T[]; total: number };

function slugifyTitle(t: string): string {
  return t.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "product";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- list view

export default function SellerProducts({
  focusProductId,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  focusProductId?: string;
  onNavigate: (n: SellerNav) => void;
}) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<{ product: ProductRow | null; open: boolean }>({ product: null, open: false });
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<ProductRow[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);

  const refetch = () => setTick((t) => t + 1);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
    setLoading(true);
    apiGetPaged<ProductRow[]>(`/api/store/products?search=${encodeURIComponent(search)}&status=${statusFilter}&page=${page}&size=10`)
      .then(({ rows: r, meta }) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        setRows(r);
        setTotal(meta?.total ?? r.length);
      })
      .catch(() => alive && setRows([]))
      .finally(() => alive && setLoading(false));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [search, statusFilter, page, tick]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusProductId && rows.length > 0) {
      const found = rows.find((r) => r.id === focusProductId);
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
      if (found) setEditing({ product: found, open: true });
    }
  }, [focusProductId, rows]);

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / 10));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <div className="relative min-w-52 flex-1">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            placeholder="Search products…"
            className="pl-8"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSearch(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <Select
          value={statusFilter}
          onValueChange={(v) => {
            setStatusFilter(v);
            setPage(1);
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger className="w-40" aria-label="Filter by status">
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="active">Active</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="pending_review">In review</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="archived">Archived</SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Button
          onClick={() => setEditing({ product: null, open: true })}
          className="min-h-[44px] gap-1.5"
        >
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New product
        </Button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <RowsSkeleton rows={5} />
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<Package className="h-8 w-8" />}
          title="No products yet"
          hint="Create your first product — you can generate placeholder images and add variants in seconds."
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Product</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Price</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Stock</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Sales</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {rows.map((p) => (
                <TableRow key={p.id} className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setEditing({ product: p, open: true })}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-muted">
                        {p.images[0] ? (
                          <img src={p.images[0].url} alt={p.title} className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                        ) : (
                          <ImageIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                        )}
                      </span>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="max-w-56 truncate font-medium">{p.title}</p>
                        <p className="max-w-56 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {p.category?.name ?? "Uncategorised"} · {p.variants.length} variant{p.variants.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell><StatusChip status={p.status} /></TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{formatMinor(p.priceMinor)}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{p.variants.reduce((s, v) => s + v.stock, 0)}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{p.salesCount}</TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      )}

      {rows.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <span>{total} product{total === 1 ? "" : "s"} · page {page} of {totalPages}</span>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}>Previous</Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page >= totalPages} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}>Next</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <ProductEditor
        open={editing.open}
        product={editing.product}
        onOpenChange={(open) => setEditing((prev) => ({ ...prev, open }))}
        onSaved={() => {
          refetch();
        }}
        onArchived={() => {
          setEditing({ product: null, open: false });
          refetch();
        }}
        onNavigate={onNavigate}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- editor

const emptyVariants: Variant[] = [{ name: "Default", optionValue: "", price: "", compareAt: "", stock: "0", sku: "" }];

function ProductEditor({
  open,
  product,
  onOpenChange,
  onSaved,
  onArchived,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  product: ProductRow | null;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
  onArchived: () => void;
  onNavigate: (n: SellerNav) => void;
}) {
  const isNew = !product;
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState("");
  const [images, setImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [variants, setVariants] = useState<Variant[]>(emptyVariants);
  const [customUrl, setCustomUrl] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [confirmArchive, setConfirmArchive] = useState(false);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<Category[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
    setTitle(product?.title ?? "");
    setDescription(product?.description ?? "");
    setCategoryId(product?.category?.id ?? "");
    setImages(product?.images.map((i) => i.url) ?? []);
    setVariants(
      product && product.variants.length > 0
        ? product.variants.map((v) => ({
            id: v.id,
            name: v.name,
            optionValue: v.optionValue ?? "",
            price: (v.priceMinor / 100).toFixed(2),
            compareAt: "",
            stock: String(v.stock),
            sku: v.sku ?? "",
          }))
        : [{ ...emptyVariants[0] }]
    );
  }, [open, product]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    apiGet<{ categories: { id: string; name: string; children?: { id: string; name: string }[] }[] }>("/api/market/home")
      .then((d) => {
        const flat: Category[] = [];
        for (const c of d.categories) {
          flat.push({ id: c.id, label: c.name });
          for (const ch of c.children ?? []) flat.push({ id: ch.id, label: `${c.name} / ${ch.name}` });
        }
        setCategories(flat);
      })
      .catch(() => setCategories([]));
  }, [open]);

  const status = product?.status ?? null;

  const addGenerated = () => {
    const seed = slugifyTitle(title || "product");
    const n = images.length + 1;
    const label = encodeURIComponent(title || "Product");
    setImages((prev) => [...prev, `/api/img/${seed}-${n}?w=900&h=900&label=${label}`]);
  };

  const setVariant = (i: number, patch: Partial<Variant>) =>
    setVariants((prev) => prev.map((v, idx) => (idx === i ? { ...v, ...patch } : v)));

  const save = async () => {
    if (!title.trim()) {
      toast.error("Product title is required");
      return;
    }
    const payloadVariants = variants.map((v) => ({
      name: v.name.trim() || "Default",
      optionName: v.optionValue ? "Variant" : null,
      optionValue: v.optionValue || null,
      priceMinor: toMinor(v.price),
      compareAtPriceMinor: v.compareAt ? toMinor(v.compareAt) : null,
      stock: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(v.stock) || 0)),
      sku: v.sku || null,
    }));
    if (payloadVariants.some((v) => v.priceMinor <= 0)) {
      toast.error("Every variant needs a price above RM 0");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(async () => {
      if (isNew) {
        await apiSend("POST", "/api/store/products", {
          title: title.trim(),
          description: description || null,
          categoryId: categoryId || null,
          images,
          variants: payloadVariants,
        });
      } else {
        await apiSend("PATCH", `/api/store/products/${product!.id}`, {
          title: title.trim(),
          description: description || null,
          categoryId: categoryId || null,
          images,
          variants: payloadVariants,
        });
      }
    }, isNew ? "Product created" : "Product updated");
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSaved();
    }
  };

  const archive = async () => {
    if (!product) return;
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(() => apiSend("DELETE", `/api/store/products/${product.id}`), "Product archived");
    setBusy(false);
    setConfirmArchive(false);
    if (ok) onArchived();
  };

  const generatedPreview = useMemo(() => {
    if (images.length === 0) return null;
    return images[images.length - 1];
  }, [images]);

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
        <DialogContent className="max-h-[92vh] w-[min(880px,94vw)] max-w-none overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {isNew ? "New product" : `Edit — ${product?.title}`}
              {status ? <StatusChip status={status} /> : null}
            </DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>

          {status === "pending_review" ? (
            <Alert>
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs">
                This product is waiting for moderation. New and updated products are reviewed before going
                live{product?.rejectReason ? ` — rejection reason: “${product.rejectReason}”` : ""}. It will appear on your storefront once approved.
              </AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          ) : null}
          {status === "active" ? (
            <p className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-emerald-800">
              Live on your storefront — edits to price/stock go live immediately.
            </p>
          ) : null}

          <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
            {/* left column: identity */}
            <div className="space-y-3.5">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="prod-title">Title *</Label>
                <Input id="prod-title" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="Olive Wood Spoons (Set of 3)" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="prod-desc">Description</Label>
                <Textarea id="prod-desc" rows={5} value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="Materials, dimensions, care instructions…" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label>Category</Label>
                <Select value={categoryId || undefined} onValueChange={(v) => setCategoryId(v === "__none" ? "" : v)}>
                  <SelectTrigger aria-label="Category">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Uncategorised" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent className="max-h-64">
                    <SelectItem value="__none">Uncategorised</SelectItem>
                    {categories.map((c) => (
                      <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.label}</SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Commission rates can differ per category.</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* right column: images */}
            <div className="space-y-3.5">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label>Images ({images.length})</Label>
                {images.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                    {images.map((u, i) => (
                      <div key={`${u}-${i}`} className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
                        <img src={u} alt={`Product image ${i + 1}`} className="aspect-square w-full object-cover" />
                        <button
                          aria-label={`Remove image ${i + 1}`}
                          className="absolute right-1 top-1 rounded-full bg-background/90 p-1 text-rose-600 shadow hover:bg-background"
                          onClick={() => setImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i))}
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex h-24 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    No images yet
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={addGenerated} className="gap-1.5">
                    <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add generated image
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    className="gap-1.5"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!customUrl.trim()) return;
                      setImages((prev) => [...prev, customUrl.trim()]);
                      setCustomUrl("");
                    }}
                  >
                    <ImageIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add custom URL
                  </Button>
                </div>
                {generatedPreview ? (
                  <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Last added: {generatedPreview}</p>
                ) : null}
                <Input
                  placeholder="https://… or /api/img/seed?w=900&h=900"
                  value={customUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomUrl(e.target.value)}
                  className="h-8 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* variants */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <Label>Variants ({variants.length})</Label>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="gap-1"
                onClick={() => setVariants((prev) => [...prev, { name: "Variant", optionValue: "", price: "", compareAt: "", stock: "0", sku: "" }])}
              >
                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add variant
              </Button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {variants.map((v, i) => (
                <div key={v.id ?? `new-${i}`} className="grid grid-cols-2 items-end gap-2 rounded-xl border p-3 sm:grid-cols-12">
                  <div className="col-span-2 space-y-1 sm:col-span-3">
                    <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Name</Label>
                    <Input className="h-9" value={v.name} onChange={(e) => setVariant(i, { name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Default" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1 sm:col-span-2">
                    <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Option</Label>
                    <Input className="h-9" value={v.optionValue} onChange={(e) => setVariant(i, { optionValue: e.target.value })} placeholder="Red / M" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1 sm:col-span-2">
                    <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Price RM *</Label>
                    <MoneyInput valueMinor={v.price ? toMinor(v.price) : null} onChangeMinor={(m) => setVariant(i, { price: (m / 100).toFixed(2) })} className="h-9" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1 sm:col-span-2">
                    <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Compare at</Label>
                    <MoneyInput valueMinor={v.compareAt ? toMinor(v.compareAt) : null} onChangeMinor={(m) => setVariant(i, { compareAt: m ? (m / 100).toFixed(2) : "" })} className="h-9" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1 sm:col-span-1">
                    <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Stock</Label>
                    <Input className="h-9" inputMode="numeric" value={v.stock} onChange={(e) => setVariant(i, { stock: e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "") })} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1 sm:col-span-1">
                    <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">SKU</Label>
                    <Input className="h-9" value={v.sku} onChange={(e) => setVariant(i, { sku: e.target.value })} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="col-span-2 flex justify-end sm:col-span-1">
                    {v.id ? (
                      <span
                        className="flex h-9 items-center px-1 text-[10px] leading-tight text-muted-foreground"
                        title="Existing variants can't be removed — orders may reference them"
                      >
                        saved
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        className="h-9 w-9 text-rose-600"
                        aria-label="Remove variant"
                        onClick={() => setVariants((prev) => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i))}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {!isNew ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Existing variants are updated in place; newly added rows are created on save. Total stock: {variants.reduce((s, v) => s + (Number(v.stock) || 0), 0)}.
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          {/* footer */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t pt-4">
            {!isNew ? (
              <Button variant="ghost" className="gap-1.5 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-700" onClick={() => setConfirmArchive(true)}>
                <Archive className="h-4 w-4" /> Archive
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <span />
            )}
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button onClick={save} disabled={busy} className="min-h-[44px] gap-2">
                {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : null}
                {isNew ? "Create product" : "Save changes"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <AlertDialog open={confirmArchive} onOpenChange={setConfirmArchive}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Archive this product?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              “{product?.title}” will be hidden from your storefront and the marketplace. Order history is kept.
              You can&apos;t unarchive from this demo — contact support to restore.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Keep product</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction className="bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-700" onClick={archive}>
              Archive
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </>
  );
}

"use client";
// Task 2-d — Seller surface shell: auth gate → status router → dashboard layout.
// Status machine: no session → auth screen; onboarding/rejected → wizard;
// pending_review → review screen (polls); active → full seller dashboard.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useApp } from "@/lib/app-store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  apiGet,

  StoreMe,

  fmtDateTime,
} from "./ui-bits";
import OnboardingWizard from "./onboarding";
import SellerDashboard from "./dashboard";
import SellerProducts from "./products";

import PageBuilder from "./builder";

import SellerIntegrations from "./integrations";
import SellerSettings from "./settings";
import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/sonner";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

import {

  TicketPercent,
  Wallet,
} from "lucide-react";

const NAV: { key: SellerNav["view"]; label: string; icon: typeof LayoutDashboard }[] = [
  { key: "dashboard", label: "Dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { key: "products", label: "Products", icon: Package },
  { key: "orders", label: "Orders", icon: ShoppingCart },
  { key: "wallet", label: "Wallet & Payouts", icon: Wallet },
  { key: "builder", label: "Page Builder", icon: LayoutTemplate },
  { key: "domains", label: "Domains", icon: Globe },
  { key: "coupons", label: "Coupons", icon: TicketPercent },
  { key: "integrations", label: "Integrations", icon: Blocks },
  { key: "settings", label: "Store Settings", icon: Settings },
];

export default function SellerShell() {
  const me = useApp((s) => s.me);
  const refreshMe = useApp((s) => s.refreshMe);
  const [nav, setNav] = useState<SellerNav>({ view: "dashboard" });
  const [storeMe, setStoreMe] = useState<StoreMe | null>(null);
  const [mobileNavOpen, setMobileNavOpen] = useState(false);

  const seller = me.loaded && "seller" in me ? me.seller : null;
  const sellerId = seller?.id ?? null;

  const refreshStoreMe = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const d = await apiGet<StoreMe>("/api/store/me");
      setStoreMe(d);
    } catch {
      /* status-gated endpoints may 403 during onboarding — non-fatal */
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sellerId) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
      setNav({ view: "dashboard" });
      refreshStoreMe();
    } else {
      setStoreMe(null);
    }
  }, [sellerId, refreshStoreMe]);

  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    await useApp.getState().logout();
    toast.success("Signed out");
  }, []);

  // ------------------------------------------------------------- render gates

  if (!me.loaded) {
    return (
      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
        <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!seller) {
    return (
      <>
        <AuthScreen onAuthed={refreshMe} />
        <Toaster position="bottom-right" richColors closeButton />
      </>
    );
  }

  const status = seller.status;

  if (status === "suspended" || status === "terminated") {
    return (
      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-6">
        <div className="max-w-md w-full space-y-4 text-center rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8">
          <ShieldAlert className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-rose-500" />
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold capitalize">Store {status}</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            This store is not currently trading. Contact SHOPMESH support if you believe this is a mistake.
          </p>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={logout} className="gap-2">
            <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" /> Sign out
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (status === "onboarding" || status === "rejected") {
    return (
      <>
        <OnboardingWizard onStatusChanged={refreshMe} />
        <Toaster position="bottom-right" richColors closeButton />
      </>
    );
  }

  if (status === "pending_review") {
    return (
      <>
        <PendingReview onLogout={logout} />
        <Toaster position="bottom-right" richColors closeButton />
      </>
    );
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- active

  const storeName = storeMe?.store.name ?? seller.storeName ?? "My store";
  const storeSlug = storeMe?.store.slug ?? seller.storeSlug ?? "";

  const openStorefront = () => {
    const app = useApp.getState();
    app.setActiveStoreSlug(storeSlug || null);
    app.setSurface("shopper");
  };

  const navigate = (n: SellerNav) => {
    setNav(n);
    setMobileNavOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex min-h-0">
      <Toaster position="bottom-right" richColors closeButton />
      {/* desktop sidebar */}
      <aside className="hidden md:flex w-60 shrink-0 flex-col border-r bg-card/50 print:hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-4 border-b">
          <span className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
            <ShoppingBag className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold leading-tight">{storeName}</p>
            <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">/{storeSlug}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <SideNav active={nav.view} onNavigate={navigate} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2" />
        <div className="border-t p-3 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span>Store status</span>
            <StatusChip status={storeMe?.store.status ?? "live"} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span>Plan</span>
            <span className="font-medium capitalize text-foreground">{storeMe?.seller.planCode ?? "free"}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>

      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0">
        {/* top bar */}
        <header className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b bg-background/95 px-4 py-3 print:hidden">
          {/* mobile nav trigger */}
          <Sheet open={mobileNavOpen} onOpenChange={setMobileNavOpen}>
            <SheetTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="outline" size="icon" className="md:hidden" aria-label="Open navigation">
                <Menu className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
            </SheetTrigger>
            <SheetContent side="left" className="w-72 p-0">
              <SheetHeader className="border-b px-4 py-3">
                <SheetTitle className="text-left text-sm">{storeName}</SheetTitle>
              </SheetHeader>
              <SideNav active={nav.view} onNavigate={navigate} className="p-2" />
            </SheetContent>
          </Sheet>

          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h1 className="truncate text-sm font-semibold capitalize">
              {NAV.find((n) => n.key === nav.view)?.label ?? "Dashboard"}
            </h1>
            <p className="hidden sm:block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Seller portal · {seller.displayName} ({seller.email})
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={openStorefront} className="gap-1.5">
            <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">View storefront</span>
            <span className="sm:hidden">Store</span>
          </Button>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={logout} aria-label="Sign out" className="text-muted-foreground">
            <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </header>

        <main className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto">
          <motion.div
            key={nav.view + (nav.pageId ?? "") + (nav.orderId ?? "") + (nav.productId ?? "")}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
            className="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl p-4 sm:p-6"
          >
            {nav.view === "dashboard" && <SellerDashboard onNavigate={navigate} />}
            {nav.view === "products" && <SellerProducts focusProductId={nav.productId} onNavigate={navigate} />}
            {nav.view === "orders" && <SellerOrders focusOrderId={nav.orderId} onNavigate={navigate} />}
            {nav.view === "wallet" && <SellerWallet />}
            {nav.view === "builder" && (
              <PageBuilder
                pageId={nav.pageId}

              />
            )}
            {nav.view === "domains" && <SellerDomains storeSlug={storeSlug} />}
            {nav.view === "coupons" && <SellerCoupons />}
            {nav.view === "integrations" && <SellerIntegrations />}
            {nav.view === "settings" && <SellerSettings onNavigate={navigate} storeMe={storeMe} refreshStoreMe={refreshStoreMe} />}
          </motion.div>
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- side nav

function SideNav({
  active,
  onNavigate,
  className,
}: {
  active: SellerNav["view"];
  onNavigate: (n: SellerNav) => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <nav className={cn("flex flex-col gap-0.5", className)} aria-label="Seller navigation">
      {NAV.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => (
        <button
          key={key}
          onClick={() => onNavigate({ view: key })}
          aria-current={active === key ? "page" : undefined}
          className={cn(
            "flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors",
            active === key
              ? "bg-primary/10 text-primary"
              : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
          )}
        >
          <Icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          {label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </nav>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- pending review

function PendingReview({ onLogout }: { onLogout: () => void }) {
  const refreshMe = useApp((s) => s.refreshMe);
  const me = useApp((s) => s.me);
  const seller = me.loaded && "seller" in me ? me.seller : null;
  const setSurface = useApp((s) => s.setSurface);
  const setActiveStoreSlug = useApp((s) => s.setActiveStoreSlug);
  const [storeMe, setStoreMe] = useState<StoreMe | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    apiGet<StoreMe>("/api/store/me")
      .then((d) => alive && setStoreMe(d))
      .catch(() => {});
    const t = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const d = await apiGet<StoreMe>("/api/store/me");
        if (!alive) return;
        setStoreMe(d);
        if (d.seller.status !== "pending_review") await refreshMe();
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      clearInterval(t);
    };
  }, [refreshMe]);

  const checks = [
    { label: "Identity & KYC documents", done: storeMe?.onboarding.checklist.kyc ?? false },
    { label: "Bank account details", done: storeMe?.onboarding.checklist.bank ?? false },
    { label: "At least one product listed", done: storeMe?.onboarding.checklist.products ?? false },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex items-start justify-center p-4 sm:p-8">
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg space-y-4">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-6 sm:p-8 text-center space-y-3">
          <span className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-700">
            <Clock3 className="h-7 w-7" />
          </span>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Your store is under review</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">

function AuthScreen({ onAuthed }: { onAuthed: () => Promise<void> }) {
  const [loginEmail, setLoginEmail] = useState("");
  const [loginPassword, setLoginPassword] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [reg, setReg] = useState({ fullName: "", displayName: "", email: "", password: "", phone: "", storeName: "" });

  const login = async () => {
    if (!loginEmail || !loginPassword) {
      toast.error("Enter your email and password");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("POST", "/api/auth/login", { email: loginEmail, password: loginPassword, portal: "seller" }),
      "Welcome back!"
    );
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) await onAuthed();
  };

  const register = async () => {
    if (!reg.fullName.trim() || !reg.email.includes("@") || reg.password.length < 8) {
      toast.error("Name, valid email and a password of at least 8 characters are required");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("POST", "/api/auth/register", reg),
      "Store created — let's set it up!"
    );
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) await onAuthed();

  return (

"use client";
// Task 2-d — SD-12 Store Settings: identity form, marketplace opt-in, social
// links, storefront link, policies shortcut to the Page Builder.
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { apiSend, CopyButton, runMutation, StatusChip, type SellerNav, type StoreMe } from "./ui-bits";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { ExternalLink, LayoutTemplate, Loader2, Megaphone, Save, Settings2, ShieldQuestion } from "lucide-react";
import { useApp } from "@/lib/app-store";

type IdentityForm = {
  name: string;
  tagline: string;
  description: string;
  supportEmail: string;
  supportPhone: string;
  whatsapp: string;
  instagram: string;
  facebook: string;
  tiktok: string;
};

export default function SellerSettings({
  storeMe,
  refreshStoreMe,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  storeMe: StoreMe | null;
  refreshStoreMe: () => Promise<void>;
  onNavigate: (n: SellerNav) => void;
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<IdentityForm>({
    name: "",
    tagline: "",
    description: "",
    supportEmail: "",
    supportPhone: "",
    whatsapp: "",
    instagram: "",
    facebook: "",
    tiktok: "",
  });
  const [optIn, setOptIn] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [policyPageId, setPolicyPageId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const setSurface = useApp((s) => s.setSurface);
  const setActiveStoreSlug = useApp((s) => s.setActiveStoreSlug);

  // hydrate once store data arrives (social links are not exposed by /api/store/me,
  // so those three inputs start empty and are only sent when non-blank)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!storeMe) return;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
    setForm({
      name: storeMe.store.name ?? "",
      tagline: storeMe.store.tagline ?? "",
      description: storeMe.store.description ?? "",
      supportEmail: storeMe.store.supportEmail ?? "",
      supportPhone: storeMe.store.supportPhone ?? "",
      whatsapp: storeMe.store.whatsapp ?? "",
      instagram: "",
      facebook: "",
      tiktok: "",
    });
    setOptIn(storeMe.store.marketplaceOptIn);
  }, [storeMe]);

  // policies page lookup (for the “Edit in builder” shortcut)
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/store/pages", { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((body) => {
        const pages = body?.data as { id: string; pageType: string }[] | undefined;
        const policy = pages?.find((p) => p.pageType === "policy" || p.pageType === "policies");
        setPolicyPageId(policy?.id ?? null);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const set = (patch: Partial<IdentityForm>) => setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...patch }));

  const saveIdentity = async () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) return runMutation(() => Promise.reject(new Error("Store name cannot be empty")), "");
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => {
        const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
          name: form.name.trim(),
          tagline: form.tagline,
          description: form.description,
          supportEmail: form.supportEmail,
          supportPhone: form.supportPhone,
          whatsapp: form.whatsapp,
        };
        const social: Record<string, string> = {};
        if (form.instagram.trim()) social.instagram = form.instagram.trim();
        if (form.facebook.trim()) social.facebook = form.facebook.trim();
        if (form.tiktok.trim()) social.tiktok = form.tiktok.trim();
        if (Object.keys(social).length > 0) payload.social = social;
        return apiSend("PATCH", "/api/store/settings", payload);
      },
      "Store identity saved"
    );
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) await refreshStoreMe();
  };

  const saveOptIn = async (next: boolean) => {
    setOptIn(next);
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("PATCH", "/api/store/settings", { marketplaceOptIn: next }),
      next ? "Store listed on the SHOPMESH marketplace" : "Store removed from marketplace listings"
    );
    if (!ok) setOptIn(!next);
  };

  if (!storeMe) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <Skeleton className="h-40 w-full" />
        <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const storefrontUrl = `/${storeMe.store.slug}`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* storefront card */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
          <CardTitle className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <ExternalLink className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Storefront
            <StatusChip status={storeMe.store.status} />
            <span className="ml-auto flex gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="h-8 gap-1.5"
                onClick={() => {
                  setActiveStoreSlug(storeMe.store.slug);
                  setSurface("shopper");
                }}
              >
                Open
              </Button>
            </span>
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
          <code className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs">{storefrontUrl}</code>
          <CopyButton text={storefrontUrl} label="Copy link" />
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Share this with customers — custom domains live in the Domains tab.</span>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* identity */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><Settings2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Store identity</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3.5">
          <div className="grid gap-3.5 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="st-name">Store name *</Label>
              <Input id="st-name" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => set({ name: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="st-tag">Tagline</Label>
              <Input id="st-tag" value={form.tagline} onChange={(e) => set({ tagline: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="st-desc">Description</Label>
            <Textarea id="st-desc" rows={3} value={form.description} onChange={(e) => set({ description: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
          <div className="grid gap-3.5 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="st-email">Support email</Label>
              <Input id="st-email" type="email" value={form.supportEmail} onChange={(e) => set({ supportEmail: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="st-phone">Support phone</Label>
              <Input id="st-phone" value={form.supportPhone} onChange={(e) => set({ supportPhone: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="st-wa">WhatsApp (intl, no +)</Label>
              <Input id="st-wa" value={form.whatsapp} onChange={(e) => set({ whatsapp: e.target.value })} placeholder="60123456789" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="grid gap-3.5 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="st-ig">Instagram URL</Label>
              <Input id="st-ig" value={form.instagram} onChange={(e) => set({ instagram: e.target.value })} placeholder="https://instagram.com/…" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="st-fb">Facebook URL</Label>
              <Input id="st-fb" value={form.facebook} onChange={(e) => set({ facebook: e.target.value })} placeholder="https://facebook.com/…" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="st-tt">TikTok URL</Label>
              <Input id="st-tt" value={form.tiktok} onChange={(e) => set({ tiktok: e.target.value })} placeholder="https://tiktok.com/@…" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end">
            <Button onClick={saveIdentity} disabled={busy} className="min-h-[44px] gap-2">
              {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="h-4 w-4" />} Save changes
            </Button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Logo, banner and theme live in the <button className="font-medium text-primary underline" onClick={() => onNavigate({ view: "builder" })}>Page Builder</button>.
          </p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* marketplace opt-in */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><Megaphone className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Marketplace</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl border p-4">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">List products on the SHOPMESH marketplace</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                When on, your active products can appear in marketplace search and collections — free discovery,
                same 8% commission. Your storefront stays live either way. Approval of your store is still
                required before listings go out.
              </p>
            </div>
            <Switch checked={optIn} onCheckedChange={saveOptIn} aria-label="Marketplace opt-in" />
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* policies */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><ShieldQuestion className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Store policies</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>

          </p>

"use client";
// Task 2-d — Seller surface shared bits: fetch helpers, status chips, stat cards,
// money inputs, date formats. Mirrors admin conventions (consistent chips).
import * as React from "react";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { format } from "date-fns";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { formatMinor, toMinor } from "@/lib/money";
import { Copy, Inbox } from "lucide-react";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- shared types

export type SellerWallet = {
  id: string;
  sellerId: string;
  currency: string;
  pendingMinor: number;
  availableMinor: number;
  reservedMinor: number;
  lifetimeEarnedMinor: number;
  lifetimeCommissionMinor: number;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
};

export type StoreMe = {
  seller: {
    id: string;
    email: string;
    fullName: string;
    displayName: string;
    phone: string | null;
    status: string;
    kycStatus: string | null;
    riskTier: string | null;
    planCode: string | null;
    marketplaceOptIn: boolean;
    submittedAt: string | null;
    rejectReason: string | null;
  };
  store: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    slug: string;
    tagline: string | null;
    logoUrl: string | null;
    bannerUrl: string | null;
    description: string | null;
    status: string;
    supportEmail: string | null;
    supportPhone: string | null;
    whatsapp: string | null;
    marketplaceOptIn: boolean;
    theme: string;
  };
  wallet: SellerWallet | null;
  onboarding: { step: string; checklist: { profile: boolean; storeIdentity: boolean; kyc: boolean; bank: boolean; products: boolean } };
  stats: { ordersCount: number; productCount: number; revenue30dMinor: number };
};

export type BankAccount = {
  id: string;
  holderName: string;
  bankName: string;
  accountNumberMasked: string;
  verified: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
};

export type SellerViewName =
  | "dashboard"
  | "products"
  | "orders"
  | "wallet"
  | "builder"
  | "domains"
  | "coupons"
  | "integrations"
  | "settings";

export type SellerNav = { view: SellerViewName; pageId?: string; orderId?: string; productId?: string };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- fetch helpers

type Envelope<T> = { data?: T; error?: { code: string; message: string; details?: unknown } };

export async function apiGet<T>(url: string): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
  const body = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Envelope<T>;
  if (!res.ok || body.error) throw new Error(body.error?.message ?? `Request failed (${res.status})`);
  return body.data as T;
}

/** Like apiGet but also returns the pagination meta when present (okPaged). */
export async function apiGetPaged<T>(url: string): Promise<{ rows: T; meta: { page: number; size: number; total: number } | null }> {
  const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
  const body = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Envelope<T> & { meta?: { page: number; size: number; total: number } };
  if (!res.ok || body.error) throw new Error(body.error?.message ?? `Request failed (${res.status})`);
  return { rows: body.data as T, meta: body.meta ?? null };
}

export async function apiSend<T>(method: "POST" | "PATCH" | "PUT" | "DELETE", url: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const payload = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Envelope<T>;
  if (!res.ok || payload.error) throw new Error(payload.error?.message ?? `Request failed (${res.status})`);
  return payload.data as T;
}

/** Mutation wrapper: runs fn, toasts success/error, returns success boolean. */
export async function runMutation(fn: () => Promise<unknown>, successMsg: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await fn();
    toast.success(successMsg);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Something went wrong");
    return false;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- data hook

export function useApi<T>(url: string | null, deps: unknown[] = []) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!url) return;
    let alive = true;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- data-fetch reset
    setLoading(true);
    apiGet<T>(url)
      .then((d) => {
        if (alive) {
          setData(d);
          setError(null);
        }
      })
      .catch((e: unknown) => alive && setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load"))
      .finally(() => alive && setLoading(false));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [url, tick, ...deps]);

  const refetch = useCallback(() => setTick((t) => t + 1), []);
  return { data, loading, error, refetch, setData };
}

/** RM input: displays a decimal string, reports minor units. */
export function MoneyInput({
  valueMinor,
  onChangeMinor,
  placeholder,
  className,
  id,
}: {
  valueMinor: number | null;
  onChangeMinor: (minor: number) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  id?: string;
}) {
  const [text, setText] = useState<string>(valueMinor == null ? "" : (valueMinor / 100).toFixed(2));
  useEffect(() => {
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
    setText(valueMinor == null ? "" : (valueMinor / 100).toFixed(2));
  }, [valueMinor]);
  return (
    <div className={cn("relative", className)}>
      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">RM</span>
      <Input
        id={id}
        inputMode="decimal"
        className="pl-10"
        placeholder={placeholder ?? "0.00"}
        value={text}
        onChange={(e) => {
          const v = e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, "");
          setText(v);
          onChangeMinor(toMinor(v));
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- dates

export function fmtDate(v: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!v) return "—";
  try {
    return format(new Date(v), "d MMM yyyy");
  } catch {
    return "—";
  }
}

export function fmtDateTime(v: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!v) return "—";
  try {
    return format(new Date(v), "d MMM yyyy, HH:mm");
  } catch {
    return "—";
  }
}

export function ageOf(v: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!v) return "—";
  const ms = Date.now() - new Date(v).getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
  if (mins < 1) return "just now";
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hours = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  return `${days}d ago`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- copy button

export function CopyButton({ text, label }: { text: string; label?: string }) {
  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      variant="ghost"
      size="sm"
      className="h-8 gap-1 px-2 text-xs"
      onClick={async () => {
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
          toast.success("Copied to clipboard");
        } catch {
          toast.error("Could not copy");
        }
      }}
    >
      <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
      {label ?? "Copy"}
    </Button>
  );
}

/** Debounced callback ref helper (used by the builder autosave). */
export function useDebouncedCallback<A extends unknown[]>(fn: (...args: A) => void, delayMs: number) {
  const fnRef = useRef(fn);
  useEffect(() => {
    fnRef.current = fn;
  });
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = null;
  }, []);
  const run = useCallback(
    (...args: A) => {
      cancel();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => fnRef.current(...args), delayMs);
    },
    [cancel, delayMs]
  );
  useEffect(() => cancel, [cancel]);
  return { run, cancel };
}

export { formatMinor, toMinor };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- add bank dialog

function AddBankDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onDone }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; onDone: () => void }) {
  const [holderName, setHolderName] = useState("");
  const [bankName, setBankName] = useState("");
  const [accountNumber, setAccountNumber] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const submit = async () => {
    const digits = accountNumber.replace(/\s+/g, "");
    if (!holderName.trim() || !bankName || digits.length < 4) {
      return runMutation(() => Promise.reject(new Error("Holder, bank and account number (min 4 digits) are required")), "");
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await runMutation(
      () => apiSend("POST", "/api/store/bank-accounts", { holderName: holderName.trim(), bankName, accountNumber }),
      "Bank account added — verification by admin pending"
    );
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      setHolderName("");
      setBankName("");
      setAccountNumber("");
      onOpenChange(false);
      onDone();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Add bank account</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3.5">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="wa-holder">Account holder name *</Label>
            <Input id="wa-holder" value={holderName} onChange={(e) => setHolderName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Lumina Living Sdn Bhd" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label>Bank *</Label>
            <Select value={bankName} onValueChange={setBankName}>
              <SelectTrigger aria-label="Bank">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Select bank" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {BANKS.map((b) => (
                  <SelectItem key={b} value={b}>{b}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="wa-acc">Account number *</Label>
            <Input
              id="wa-acc"
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={accountNumber}
              onChange={(e) => setAccountNumber(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9\s]/g, ""))}
              placeholder="1622 3810 5543"
            />
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Only the last 4 digits are stored in clear text. Admins verify accounts before payouts run.
          </p>
          <Button onClick={submit} disabled={busy} className="w-full min-h-[44px] gap-2">
            {busy ? <Wallet2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-pulse" /> : <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />} Add account
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
