type QuoteT = {
  subtotalMinor: number;
  discountMinor: number;
  shippingMinor: number;
  totalMinor: number;
  shippingRateId: string;
  coupon: { code: string; valid: boolean; discountMinor?: number; freeShip?: boolean; reason?: string };
  items: { title: string; variantLabel: string | null; qty: number; unitPriceMinor: number; lineTotalMinor: number }[];
};

const CONTACT_KEY = "sm_shopper_contact";
const EMAIL_KEY = "sm_shopper_email";

// =============================================================================================
// CHECKOUT VIEW
// =============================================================================================

export function CheckoutView({ ctx }: { ctx: ShopperCtx }) {
  const { cart, loading: cartLoading } = useCart();
  const items = cart?.items ?? [];

  // prefill contact from a previous checkout (read once at mount)
  const [saved] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return {};
    try {
      return JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(CONTACT_KEY) ?? "{}") as Record<string, string>;
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  });
  const [name, setName] = useState(() => saved.name ?? "");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(() => saved.email ?? "");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(() => saved.phone ?? "");
  const [line1, setLine1] = useState(() => saved.line1 ?? "");
  const [city, setCity] = useState(() => saved.city ?? "");
  const [stateSel, setStateSel] = useState(() => saved.state ?? "Selangor");
  const [postcode, setPostcode] = useState(() => saved.postcode ?? "");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [shippingRateId, setShippingRateId] = useState("standard");
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState("fpx_toyyibpay");
  const [couponInput, setCouponInput] = useState("");
  const [couponCode, setCouponCode] = useState("");
  const [couponErr, setCouponErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [quote, setQuote] = useState<QuoteT | null>(null);
  const [quoting, setQuoting] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState(false);

  const payloadItems = useMemo(
    () => items.map((i) => ({ variantId: i.variantId, qty: i.qty })),
    [items]
  );

  const refreshQuote = useCallback(
    async (code: string | null) => {
      if (payloadItems.length === 0) return;
      setQuoting(true);
      try {
        const q = await postJson<QuoteT>("/api/checkout/quote", {
          storeSlug: cart?.storeSlug,
          items: payloadItems,
          couponCode: code || undefined,
          shippingRateId,
        });
        setQuote(q);
      } catch {
        setQuote(null);
      } finally {
        setQuoting(false);
      }
    },
    [cart?.storeSlug, payloadItems, shippingRateId]
  );

  // auto-quote on items / shipping change (keeps applied coupon)
  useEffect(() => {
    refreshQuote(couponCode || null);
  }, [refreshQuote, couponCode]);

  async function applyCoupon() {
    const code = couponInput.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!code) return;
    setCouponErr(null);
    setQuoting(true);
    try {
      const q = await postJson<QuoteT>("/api/checkout/quote", {
        storeSlug: cart?.storeSlug,
        items: payloadItems,
        couponCode: code,
        shippingRateId,
      });
      if (q.coupon?.valid) {
        setCouponCode(code);
        setQuote(q);
        toast.success(`Coupon ${code} applied`, {
          description: q.coupon.freeShip ? "Free shipping unlocked" : `You save ${formatMinor(q.coupon.discountMinor ?? 0)}`,
        });
      } else {
        setCouponCode("");
        setCouponErr(q.coupon?.reason ?? "Invalid coupon");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setCouponErr(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not validate coupon");
    } finally {
      setQuoting(false);
    }
  }

  const formValid =
    name.trim().length > 0 &&
    /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email.trim()) &&
    line1.trim().length > 0 &&
    city.trim().length > 0 &&
    postcode.trim().length > 0;

  async function placeOrder() {
    setTouched(true);
    if (!formValid || items.length === 0) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await postJson<{ orderNumber: string; orderPaymentRef: string; totalMinor: number }>(
        "/api/checkout/create",
        {
          storeSlug: cart?.storeSlug,
          items: payloadItems,
          customer: { name: name.trim(), email: email.trim(), phone: phone.trim() || undefined },
          shippingAddress: { line1: line1.trim(), city: city.trim(), state: stateSel, postcode: postcode.trim() },
          couponCode: couponCode || undefined,
          provider,
          customerNote: note.trim() || undefined,
        },
        { "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID() }
      );
      window.localStorage.setItem(CONTACT_KEY, JSON.stringify({ name, email, phone, line1, city, state: stateSel, postcode }));
      window.localStorage.setItem(EMAIL_KEY, email.trim().toLowerCase());
      toast.success(`Order ${res.orderNumber} created`, { description: "Redirecting to secure payment…" });
      ctx.nav({ name: "pay", ref: res.orderPaymentRef });
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Checkout failed — please try again");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  if (cartLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 flex-1">
        <Skeleton className="h-8 w-48 mb-6" />
        <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-4">
            <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-xl" />
            <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-xl" />
          </div>
          <Skeleton className="h-80 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="flex-1">
        <EmptyState
          icon={ShoppingBag}
          title="Your cart is empty"
          hint="Add something lovely from the marketplace or a store first."
          action={
            <Button onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "market" })} className="bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800">
              Start shopping
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const total = quote?.totalMinor ?? items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.lineTotalMinor, 0);
  const freeShipProgress = Math.min(100, Math.round((items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.lineTotalMinor, 0) / 10000) * 100));

  const field = (label: string, node: React.ReactNode, error?: boolean) => (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">{label}</Label>
      {node}
      {error ? <p className="text-xs text-rose-600">Required</p> : null}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 flex-1">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">Checkout</h1>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Items from <span className="font-semibold text-teal-700">{cart?.storeName}</span> · one store per order
      </p>

      <div className="mt-6 grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-5">
        {/* left column */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-3 space-y-6">
          {/* contact */}
          <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-5 space-y-4" aria-labelledby="checkout-contact">
            <h2 id="checkout-contact" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold">
              <User className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-700" /> Contact
            </h2>
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {field(
                "Full name *",
                <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Aina Binti Ahmad" className="min-h-[44px]" aria-required />
              )}
              {field(
                "Email *",
                <Input type="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="you@example.com" className="min-h-[44px]" aria-required />
              )}
              {field("Phone", <Input value={phone} onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)} placeholder="012-345 6789" className="min-h-[44px]" />)}
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* shipping address */}
          <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-5 space-y-4" aria-labelledby="checkout-address">
            <h2 id="checkout-address" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold">
              <MapPin className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-700" /> Shipping address
            </h2>
            {field(
              "Street address *",
              <Textarea value={line1} onChange={(e) => setLine1(e.target.value)} placeholder="42 Jalan Merdeka, Taman Setia" rows={2} className="min-h-[44px]" aria-required />
            )}
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
              {field("City *", <Input value={city} onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)} placeholder="Kuala Lumpur" className="min-h-[44px]" aria-required />)}
              {field(
                "State *",
                <select
                  value={stateSel}
                  onChange={(e) => setStateSel(e.target.value)}
                  className="flex h-11 min-h-[44px] w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600/40"
                  aria-label="State"
                >
                  {MY_STATES.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s} value={s}>
                      {s}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              )}
              {field("Postcode *", <Input value={postcode} onChange={(e) => setPostcode(e.target.value)} inputMode="numeric" placeholder="43650" className="min-h-[44px]" aria-required />)}
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* shipping method */}
          <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-5 space-y-3" aria-labelledby="checkout-shipping">
            <h2 id="checkout-shipping" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold">
              <Truck className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-700" /> Delivery
            </h2>
            <RadioGroup value={shippingRateId} onValueChange={setShippingRateId} className="gap-2">
              {SHIPPING.map((s) => {
                const free = s.id === "standard" && (quote?.subtotalMinor ?? 0) >= 10000;
                return (
                  <Label
                    key={s.id}
                    htmlFor={`ship-${s.id}`}
                    className={cn(
                      "flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3.5 transition-colors min-h-[44px]",
                      shippingRateId === s.id ? "border-teal-700 bg-teal-50/60" : "hover:bg-muted/50"
                    )}
                  >
                    <RadioGroupItem value={s.id} id={`ship-${s.id}`} />
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{s.label}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.note}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-teal-700">{free ? "FREE" : formatMinor(s.fee)}</span>
                  </Label>
                );
              })}
            </RadioGroup>
            {quote && quote.shippingMinor === 0 && shippingRateId === "standard" ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-800">
                <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" /> Free standard shipping applied (order above RM 100)
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="pt-1">
                <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-teal-600 transition-all" style={{ width: `${freeShipProgress}%` }} />
                </div>
                <p className="pt-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {freeShipProgress >= 100 ? "You've unlocked FREE standard shipping!" : `${formatMinor(Math.max(0, 10000 - (quote?.subtotalMinor ?? 0)))} away from FREE standard shipping`}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          {/* payment method */}
          <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-5 space-y-3" aria-labelledby="checkout-payment">
            <h2 id="checkout-payment" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold">
              <CreditCard className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-700" /> Payment method
            </h2>
            <RadioGroup value={provider} onValueChange={setProvider} className="gap-2">
              {PROVIDERS.map((p) => (
                <Label
                  key={p.id}
                  htmlFor={`pay-${p.id}`}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3.5 transition-colors min-h-[44px]",
                    provider === p.id ? "border-teal-700 bg-teal-50/60" : "hover:bg-muted/50"
                  )}
                >
                  <RadioGroupItem value={p.id} id={`pay-${p.id}`} />
                  <p.icon className="h-5 w-5 text-teal-700" />
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{p.label}</span>
                </Label>
              ))}
            </RadioGroup>
          </section>
        </div>

        {/* right column — summary */}
        <aside className="lg:col-span-2">
          <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-5 space-y-4 lg:sticky lg:top-20">
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold">Order summary</h2>

            <ul className="space-y-3 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {items.map((i) => (
                <li key={i.id} className="flex gap-3">
                  <img src={i.imageUrl} alt={i.title} loading="lazy" className="h-14 w-14 rounded-lg border object-cover" />
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium leading-tight line-clamp-2">{i.title}</p>
                    {i.variantLabel ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{i.variantLabel}</p> : null}
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Qty {i.qty}</p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{formatMinor(i.lineTotalMinor)}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>

            {/* coupon */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <div className="relative flex-1">
                  <Tag className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
                  <Input
                    value={couponInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setCouponInput(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                    placeholder="Coupon code"
                    className="pl-8 min-h-[44px]"
                    aria-label="Coupon code"
                    onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && applyCoupon()}
                  />
                </div>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={applyCoupon} disabled={quoting || !couponInput.trim()} className="min-h-[44px] border-teal-700/40 text-teal-800 hover:bg-teal-50">
                  {quoting ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <TicketPercent className="h-4 w-4" />} Apply
                </Button>
              </div>
              {couponErr ? <p className="text-xs font-medium text-rose-600">{couponErr}</p> : null}
              {quote?.coupon?.valid ? (
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">
                  {quote.coupon.code} applied {quote.coupon.freeShip ? "— free shipping" : `— ${formatMinor(quote.coupon.discountMinor ?? 0)} off`}
                </p>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <Separator />

            <dl className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Subtotal</dt>
                <dd className="font-semibold">{formatMinor(quote?.subtotalMinor ?? 0)}</dd>
              </div>
              {quote && quote.discountMinor > 0 ? (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-emerald-700">
                  <dt>Discount</dt>
                  <dd className="font-semibold">-{formatMinor(quote.discountMinor)}</dd>
                </div>
              ) : null}
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Shipping</dt>
                <dd className="font-semibold">{quote?.shippingMinor === 0 ? "FREE" : formatMinor(quote?.shippingMinor ?? 0)}</dd>
              </div>
              <Separator />
              <div className="flex justify-between text-base">
                <dt className="font-bold">Total</dt>
                <dd className="font-extrabold text-teal-700">{formatMinor(total)}</dd>
              </div>
            </dl>

            {/* note */}
            <Textarea value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="Note to seller (optional)" rows={2} className="min-h-[44px] text-sm" />

            {touched && !formValid ? (
              <p className="rounded-lg bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-rose-700">
                Please fill in the required fields (name, email, address, city, postcode).
              </p>
            ) : null}

            <Button
              size="lg"
              onClick={placeOrder}
              disabled={submitting || quoting}
              className="w-full min-h-[48px] bg-teal-700 text-white hover:bg-teal-800"
            >
              {submitting ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" />}
              {submitting ? "Creating order…" : `Pay ${formatMinor(total)}`}
            </Button>
            <p className="text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Sandbox demo — no real money moves.</p>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =============================================================================================
// MOCK PAYMENT VIEW
// =============================================================================================

type PaymentT = {
  status: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  amountMinor: number;
  storeName: string;
  storeSlug: string;
  provider: string;
};

export function PayView({ ctx, paymentRef }: { ctx: ShopperCtx; paymentRef: string }) {
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState<PaymentT | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<"awaiting" | "success" | "failure">("awaiting");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [secondsLeft, setSecondsLeft] = useState(10 * 60);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const p = await fetchJson<PaymentT>(`/api/checkout/payments/${encodeURIComponent(paymentRef)}`);
      setPayment(p);
      setFailed(false);
      if (p.status === "succeeded") {
        setPhase((ph) => (ph === "awaiting" ? "success" : ph));
      } else if (p.status === "failed") {
        setPhase((ph) => (ph === "awaiting" ? "failure" : ph));
      }
    } catch {
      setFailed(true);
    }
  }, [paymentRef]);

  // initial load + 3s polling for external status changes
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [load]);

  // 10:00 countdown
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== "awaiting") return;
    const t = setInterval(() => setSecondsLeft((s) => Math.max(0, s - 1)), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [phase]);

  const navToOrder = useCallback(
    (orderNumber: string) => ctx.nav({ name: "order-status", orderNumber }),
    [ctx]
  );

  // auto-redirect after success
  const orderNumber = payment?.orderNumber ?? "";
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== "success") return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => navToOrder(orderNumber), 1600);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [phase, orderNumber, navToOrder]);

  async function simulate(result: "succeeded" | "failed") {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await postJson<{ status: string; orderNumber: string }>(
        `/api/checkout/payments/${encodeURIComponent(paymentRef)}/simulate`,
        { result }
      );
      if (result === "succeeded") {
        // empty the guest cart — the order is placed
        try {
          const { cart } = await fetchJson<{ cart: { items: { id: string }[] } | null }>("/api/cart");
          for (const it of cart?.items ?? []) await fetchJson(`/api/cart/items/${it.id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
        } catch {
          /* best effort */
        }
        notifyCartUpdated();
        setPhase("success");
      } else {
        setPhase("failure");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Payment simulation failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const mm = String(Math.floor(secondsLeft / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
  const ss = String(secondsLeft % 60).padStart(2, "0");

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex items-start sm:items-center justify-center px-4 py-8 sm:py-12" style={{ background: "linear-gradient(180deg, #f0fdfa 0%, #ffffff 40%)" }}>
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.35 }} className="w-full max-w-md">
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border shadow-lg bg-card">
          {/* gateway chrome */}
          <div className="bg-teal-900 px-5 py-4 text-white">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold tracking-wide">
                <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-300" /> SHOPMESH Secure Checkout
              </p>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-400/90 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-950">Demo</span>
            </div>
            <p className="pt-1 text-xs text-teal-100/80">256-bit encrypted · sandbox environment</p>
          </div>

          {failed ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center space-y-3">
              <XCircle className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-rose-500" />
              <p className="font-semibold">Payment session not found</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">This payment reference may have expired.</p>
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "market" })}>Back to market</Button>
            </div>
          ) : !payment ? (
            <div className="p-8 space-y-4">
              <Skeleton className="h-6 w-40" />
              <Skeleton className="h-16 w-full" />
              <Skeleton className="h-12 w-full" />
            </div>
          ) : phase === "success" ? (
            <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} className="p-8 text-center space-y-3">
              <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1 }} transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 16 }} className="mx-auto flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-100">
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-9 w-9 text-emerald-600" />
              </motion.div>
              <p className="text-lg font-extrabold">Payment successful!</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Order {payment.orderNumber} is confirmed.</p>
              <Loader2 className="mx-auto h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Taking you to your order…</p>
            </motion.div>
          ) : phase === "failure" ? (
            <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} className="p-8 text-center space-y-3">
              <XCircle className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 text-rose-500" />
              <p className="text-lg font-extrabold">Payment failed</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No money was taken. You can retry the payment or head back to the store.</p>
              <div className="grid gap-2 pt-2">
                <Button onClick={() => setPhase("awaiting")} disabled={busy} className="min-h-[44px] bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white">
                  <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4" /> Retry payment
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "storefront", slug: payment.storeSlug })} className="min-h-[44px]">
                  Back to store
                </Button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-5">
              <div className="text-center space-y-1">
                <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Amount to pay</p>
                <p className="text-4xl font-extrabold tabular-nums text-teal-800">{formatMinor(payment.amountMinor)}</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  to <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{payment.storeName}</span>
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-muted/70 px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Method</span>
                <span className="font-semibold">{PROVIDER_LABEL[payment.provider] ?? payment.provider}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-muted/70 px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Order</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-semibold">{payment.orderNumber}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-muted/70 px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Session expires in</span>
                <span className={cn("font-mono font-bold tabular-nums", secondsLeft < 60 ? "text-rose-600" : "text-foreground")}>
                  {mm}:{ss}
                </span>
              </div>

              <Button
                size="lg"
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => simulate("succeeded")}
                className="w-full min-h-[48px] bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700"
              >
                {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Landmark className="h-4 w-4" />}
                {busy ? "Processing…" : "Pay Now"}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => simulate("failed")}
                className="w-full min-h-[40px] border-rose-300 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50"
              >
                Simulate failure
              </Button>
              <p className="text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Sandbox demo — no real money moves.</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {payment && phase === "awaiting" ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "storefront", slug: payment.storeSlug })} className="mx-auto mt-4 block text-xs text-muted-foreground underline-offset-2 hover:underline">
            Cancel and return to {payment.storeName}
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =============================================================================================
// ORDER STATUS + LOOKUP
// =============================================================================================

function OrderCard({ o, compact = false }: { o: LookupResultT; compact?: boolean }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const paid = !["payment_pending", "cancelled"].includes(o.status);

  function copy() {
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(o.orderNumber).then(
      () => {
        setCopied(true);
        toast.success("Order number copied");
        setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
      },
      () => toast.error("Could not copy")
    );
  }

  return (
    <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }} className={cn("rounded-2xl border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-5", compact && "shadow-sm")}>
      <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ scale: 0, rotate: -20 }}
          animate={{ scale: 1, rotate: 0 }}
          transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 14 }}
          className={cn("flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full", paid ? "bg-emerald-100" : "bg-amber-100")}
        >
          {paid ? <CheckCircle2 className="h-7 w-7 text-emerald-600" /> : <PackageSearch className="h-7 w-7 text-amber-600" />}
        </motion.div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Order</p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <p className="text-xl font-extrabold font-mono tracking-tight">{o.orderNumber}</p>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={copy} aria-label="Copy order number">
              {copied ? <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {o.storeName} · placed {new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleString("en-MY", { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" })}
          </p>
          <div className="pt-2">
            <StatusBadge status={o.status} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-right">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Total</p>
          <p className="text-lg font-extrabold text-teal-700">{formatMinor(o.totalMinor)}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Separator />

      <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div>
          <h3 className="pb-3 text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Items</h3>
          <ul className="space-y-2">
            {o.items.map((it, i) => (
              <li key={i} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm">
                <span className="min-w-0 truncate">
                  {it.title} <span className="text-muted-foreground">× {it.qty}</span>
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div>
          <h3 className="pb-3 text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Progress</h3>
          <StatusTimeline history={o.history} current={o.status} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export function OrderStatusView({ ctx, orderNumber }: { ctx: ShopperCtx; orderNumber: string }) {
  const [email] = useState(() => (typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.localStorage.getItem(EMAIL_KEY) ?? "" : ""));
  const [data, setData] = useState<LookupResultT | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!email) return;
    let alive = true;
    fetchJson<LookupResultT>(`/api/orders/lookup?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}&orderNumber=${encodeURIComponent(orderNumber)}`)
      .then((d) => {
        if (alive) setData(d);
      })
      .catch((e: Error) => {
        if (alive) setFailed(e.message);
      });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [email, orderNumber]);

  if (!email) {
    return (
      <div className="flex-1">
        <EmptyState
          title="No checkout email found"
          hint="We couldn't find a recent checkout on this device. Use order lookup with your email and order number instead."
          action={
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "lookup" })} className="min-h-[44px]">
                Order lookup
              </Button>
              <Button onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "market" })} className="min-h-[44px] bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800">
                Continue shopping
              </Button>
            </div>
          }
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl px-4 py-8 flex-1">
      {failed ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="Couldn't load this order"
          hint={failed}
          action={
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "lookup" })}>Order lookup</Button>
              <Button onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "market" })} className="bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800">Continue shopping</Button>
            </div>
          }
        />
      ) : !data ? (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Skeleton className="h-28 rounded-2xl" />
          <Skeleton className="h-56 rounded-2xl" />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-5">
          <OrderCard o={data} />
          <div className="flex justify-center gap-3">
            <Button onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "market" })} className="min-h-[44px] bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white">
              Continue shopping
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "lookup" })} className="min-h-[44px]">
              Track another order
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function LookupView({ ctx }: { ctx: ShopperCtx }) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(() => (typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.localStorage.getItem(EMAIL_KEY) ?? "" : ""));
  const [orderNumber, setOrderNumber] = useState("");
  const [result, setResult] = useState<LookupResultT | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function search() {
    if (!email.trim() || !orderNumber.trim()) {
      setError("Both email and order number are required.");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      const data = await fetchJson<LookupResultT>(
        `/api/orders/lookup?email=${encodeURIComponent(email.trim())}&orderNumber=${encodeURIComponent(orderNumber.trim())}`
      );
      setResult(data);
      window.localStorage.setItem(EMAIL_KEY, email.trim().toLowerCase());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Lookup failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl px-4 py-8 flex-1">
      <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
            <PackageSearch className="h-5 w-5 text-teal-700" /> Track your order
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Enter the email you checked out with and your order number (e.g. SM-100017).</p>
        </div>
        <form
          className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            search();
          }}
        >
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="lk-email" className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Email</Label>
            <Input id="lk-email" type="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="you@example.com" className="min-h-[44px]" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="lk-num" className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Order number</Label>
            <Input id="lk-num" value={orderNumber} onChange={(e) => setOrderNumber(e.target.value)} placeholder="SM-100017" className="min-h-[44px] font-mono" />
          </div>
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <Button type="submit" disabled={busy} className="w-full sm:w-auto min-h-[44px] bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white">
              {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <PackageSearch className="h-4 w-4" />} Find my order
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
        {error ? (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-rose-700">
            {error.includes("No order") ? "We couldn't find an order with those details. Double-check the email and order number." : error}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {result ? (
        <div className="pt-5">
          <OrderCard o={result} compact />
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Hero banner carousel (auto-advance 5s)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function HeroCarousel({
  banners,
  ctx,
}: {
  banners: HomePayload["banners"];
  ctx: ShopperCtx;
}) {
  const [idx, setIdx] = useState(0);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const n = banners.length;

  const go = useCallback(
    (next: number) => {
      if (n === 0) return;
      setIdx(((next % n) + n) % n);
    },
    [n]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (n <= 1) return;
    timer.current = setInterval(() => setIdx((i) => (i + 1) % n), 5000);
    return () => {
      if (timer.current) clearInterval(timer.current);
    };
  }, [n]);

  if (n === 0) return null;

  // Banner linkUrls are advisory in this sandbox — any banner taps into browse-all.
  const openBanner = () => ctx.nav({ name: "search", q: "" });

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 pt-4">
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border bg-muted" aria-roledescription="carousel">
        <div className="relative h-40 sm:h-56 lg:h-64" aria-live="polite">
          {banners.map((b, i) => (
            <button
              key={b.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => openBanner()}
              aria-hidden={i !== idx}
              tabIndex={i === idx ? 0 : -1}
              className={cn(
                "absolute inset-0 w-full text-left transition-opacity duration-700",
                i === idx ? "opacity-100 z-10" : "opacity-0 z-0 pointer-events-none"
              )}
            >
              <img src={b.imageUrl} alt={b.title} className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
              <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-black/55 via-black/25 to-transparent" />
              <span className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col justify-center gap-1.5 p-5 sm:p-8 max-w-lg">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-300">SHOPMESH picks</span>
                <span className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-extrabold text-white leading-snug drop-shadow">{b.title}</span>
                <span className="mt-1 inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-white/95 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-teal-800">
                  Shop now <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </span>
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {n > 1 ? (
          <>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => go(idx - 1)}
              aria-label="Previous banner"
              className="absolute left-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-background/80 shadow hover:bg-background transition-colors"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => go(idx + 1)}
              aria-label="Next banner"
              className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-background/80 shadow hover:bg-background transition-colors"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
            <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 z-20 flex -translate-x-1/2 gap-1.5">
              {banners.map((b, i) => (
                <button
                  key={b.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => go(i)}
                  aria-label={`Go to banner ${i + 1}`}
                  className={cn("h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all", i === idx ? "w-6 bg-white" : "w-1.5 bg-white/60")}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const SORTS = [
  { value: "newest", label: "Newest" },
  { value: "price_asc", label: "Price: low to high" },
  { value: "price_desc", label: "Price: high to low" },
  { value: "popular", label: "Popular" },
] as const;

type SortValue = (typeof SORTS)[number]["value"];

const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

export function ResultsView({
  ctx,
  mode,
}: {
  ctx: ShopperCtx;
  mode: { kind: "search"; q: string } | { kind: "category"; categorySlug: string; label?: string };
}) {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<SortValue>("newest");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  // completed-fetch state — loading is DERIVED (no sync setState in effects)
  const [done, setDone] = useState<{ key: string; items: ProductCardT[]; total: number }>({ key: "", items: [], total: 0 });
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [retry, setRetry] = useState(0);

  const search = mode.kind === "search" ? mode.q : "";
  const category = mode.kind === "category" ? mode.categorySlug : "";
  const queryKey = `${search}|${category}|${sort}`;
  const reqKey = `${queryKey}#${page}`;
  const loadingFirst = done.key === "" || done.key.split("#")[0] !== queryKey;
  const fetchingMore = !loadingFirst && done.key !== reqKey;

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ sort, page: String(page), size: String(PAGE_SIZE), _r: String(retry) });
    if (search) params.set("search", search);
    if (category) params.set("category", category);
    fetchEnvelope<ProductCardT[]>(`/api/market/products?${params.toString()}`)
      .then(({ data, meta }) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        const rows = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
        const total = meta?.total ?? rows.length;
        setDone((prev) =>
          page === 1
            ? { key: `${queryKey}#1`, items: rows, total }
            : { key: `${queryKey}#${page}`, items: [...prev.items, ...rows], total: total || prev.total }
        );
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (alive) setFailed(true);
      });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [search, category, sort, page, retry, queryKey]);

  if (failed) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        title="Something went wrong"
        hint="We couldn't load these products. Please try again."
        action={
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              setFailed(false);
              setRetry((r) => r + 1);
            }}
          >
            Retry
          </Button>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  const title = mode.kind === "search" ? (search ? `Results for “${search}”` : "All products") : mode.label ?? "Category";
  const items = done.items;
  const grandTotal = done.total;
  const hasMore = !loadingFirst && items.length < grandTotal;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-6 flex-1">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">{title}</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {loadingFirst ? "Loading…" : `${grandTotal} product${grandTotal === 1 ? "" : "s"} found`}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <SlidersHorizontal className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Select value={sort} onValueChange={(v) => setSort(v as SortValue)}>
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[190px] min-h-[44px]" aria-label="Sort products">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Sort" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {SORTS.map((s) => (
                <SelectItem key={s.value} value={s.value}>
                  {s.label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {loadingFirst ? (
        <ProductGridSkeleton />
      ) : items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="No products found"
          hint={
            mode.kind === "search"
              ? `Try a different keyword — or browse the categories from the menu.`
              : "This category has no active listings yet. Check back soon!"
          }
          action={
            <Button onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "market" })} className="bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800">
              Back to market
            </Button>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
            {items.map((p) => (
              <ProductCard key={p.id} p={p} onOpen={(pp) => openProduct(ctx, pp)} />
            ))}
          </div>
          {hasMore ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center pt-8">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="lg"
                disabled={fetchingMore}
                onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
                className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[180px] border-teal-700/40 text-teal-800 hover:bg-teal-50"
              >
                {fetchingMore ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : null}
                {fetchingMore ? "Loading…" : `Load more (${grandTotal - items.length} left)`}
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            items.length > PAGE_SIZE / 2 ? (
              <p className="pt-8 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">You’ve reached the end — {grandTotal} products shown.</p>
            ) : null
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// ============================================================================
// Shopper — PRODUCT DETAIL PAGE (Task 2-e).
// ============================================================================
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  ChevronRight,
  MessageCircle,
  Store,
  ShoppingCart,
  Zap,
  PackageX,
  ShieldCheck,
  Truck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,

  AlertDialogFooter,

} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { formatMinor } from "@/lib/money";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  fetchJson,
  postJson,
  notifyCartUpdated,
  useCart,
  discountPercent,
  dateShort,
  openProduct,
  EmptyState,
  ProductCard,
  QtyStepper,
  Stars,
  type ProductCardT,
  type ShopperCtx,
} from "./ui-bits";

type VariantT = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  optionName: string | null;
  optionValue: string | null;
  priceMinor: number;
  compareAtPriceMinor: number | null;
  stock: number;
  sku: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
};

type PdpPayload = {
  product: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    slug: string;
    description: string;
    priceMinor: number;
    compareAtPriceMinor: number | null;
    ratingAvg: number;
    ratingCount: number;
    salesCount: number;
    categoryId: string | null;
    categoryName: string | null;
    images: string[];
    variants: VariantT[];
  };
  reviews: { id: string; customerName: string; rating: number; title: string | null; body: string | null; reply: string | null; createdAt: string }[];
  related: ProductCardT[];
  store: { id: string; name: string; slug: string; tagline: string | null; logoUrl: string | null; whatsapp: string | null };
};

export default function PdpView({ ctx, slug, pSlug }: { ctx: ShopperCtx; slug: string; pSlug: string }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<PdpPayload | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [variantId, setVariantId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1);
  const [imgIdx, setImgIdx] = useState(0);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [confirmSwitch, setConfirmSwitch] = useState(false);
  const { cart } = useCart();

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    setData(null);
    setFailed(null);
    setVariantId(null);
    setQty(1);
    setImgIdx(0);
    fetchJson<PdpPayload>(`/api/sf/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/products/${encodeURIComponent(pSlug)}`)
      .then((d) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        setData(d);
        const firstInStock = d.product.variants.find((v) => v.stock > 0) ?? d.product.variants[0];
        setVariantId(firstInStock?.id ?? null);
      })
      .catch((e: Error) => alive && setFailed(e.message));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [slug, pSlug]);

  const variant = useMemo(() => data?.product.variants.find((v) => v.id === variantId) ?? null, [data, variantId]);
  const price = variant?.priceMinor ?? data?.product.priceMinor ?? 0;
  const compareAt = variant?.compareAtPriceMinor ?? data?.product.compareAtPriceMinor ?? null;
  const off = discountPercent(price, compareAt);
  const outOfStock = !variant || variant.stock <= 0;

  const crossStore = Boolean(cart && cart.items.length > 0 && cart.storeSlug && cart.storeSlug !== slug);

  async function addToCart(): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!variant || variant.stock <= 0) return false;
    setAdding(true);
    try {
      await postJson("/api/cart/items", { variantId: variant.id, qty });
      notifyCartUpdated();
      toast.success("Added to cart", { description: `${data?.product.title}${qty > 1 ? ` × ${qty}` : ""}` });
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not add to cart");
      return false;
    } finally {
      setAdding(false);
    }
  }

  function requestAdd(): Promise<boolean> {
    if (crossStore) {
      setConfirmSwitch(true);
      return Promise.resolve(false);
    }
    return addToCart();
  }

  if (failed) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={PackageX}
        title="Product not available"
        hint={failed}
        action={
          <Button onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "market" })} className="bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800">
            Back to market
          </Button>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  if (!data) return <PdpSkeleton />;

  const { product, store } = data;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-6 flex-1">

        <button type="button" className="hover:text-teal-700 transition-colors min-h-[44px] flex items-center" onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "market" })}>
          Market
        </button>
        <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        <button type="button" className="hover:text-teal-700 transition-colors min-h-[44px] flex items-center" onClick={() => ctx.nav({ name: "storefront", slug: store.slug })}>
          {store.name}
        </button>
        <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        <span className="text-foreground font-medium truncate max-w-[50vw]">{product.title}</span>
      </nav>

      <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2">
        {/* gallery */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <motion.div
            key={imgIdx}
            initial={{ opacity: 0.4 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.25 }}
            className="aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border bg-muted"
          >
            <img
              src={product.images[imgIdx] ?? "/api/img/fallback?w=900&h=900"}
              alt={`${product.title} — image ${imgIdx + 1}`}
              className="h-full w-full object-cover"
            />
          </motion.div>
          {product.images.length > 1 ? (
            <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1" role="listbox" aria-label="Product images">
              {product.images.map((url, i) => (
                <button
                  key={url + i}
                  type="button"
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected={i === imgIdx}
                  onClick={() => setImgIdx(i)}
                  className={cn(
                    "h-16 w-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border-2 transition-all",
                    i === imgIdx ? "border-teal-600" : "border-transparent opacity-70 hover:opacity-100"
                  )}
                >
                  <img src={url} alt={`${product.title} thumbnail ${i + 1}`} loading="lazy" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {/* buy box */}
        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {product.categoryName ? <Badge variant="outline" className="border-teal-700/30 text-teal-800">{product.categoryName}</Badge> : null}
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight">{product.title}</h1>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <Stars rating={product.ratingAvg} count={product.ratingCount} />
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">· {product.salesCount} sold</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-end gap-3">
            <span className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-teal-700">{formatMinor(price)}</span>
            {compareAt && compareAt > price ? (
              <>
                <span className="text-lg text-muted-foreground line-through">{formatMinor(compareAt)}</span>
                <Badge className="bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-600">-{off}%</Badge>
              </>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          {/* variant selector */}
          {product.variants.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">
                {product.variants[0].optionName ?? "Option"}

              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Choose option">
                {product.variants.map((v) => {

                  return (
                    <button

                      disabled={soldOut}
                      onClick={() => setVariantId(v.id)}
                      className={cn(

                        v.id === variantId
                          ? "border-teal-700 bg-teal-700 text-white shadow-sm"
                          : "bg-background hover:border-teal-600/60",
                        soldOut && "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed line-through"
                      )}
                    >

                      {soldOut ? " · out" : ""}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <Separator />

          {/* qty + actions */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">

          <div className="grid gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2">

        {/* store card */}

                <Store className="h-4 w-4" /> Visit store
              </Button>
              {store.whatsapp ? (
                <a
                  href={`https://wa.me/${store.whatsapp}?text=${encodeURIComponent(`Hi ${store.name}! I'm interested in "${product.title}".`)}`}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex h-10 min-h-[44px] items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-emerald-600/40 px-4 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 transition-colors"
                >
                  <MessageCircle className="h-4 w-4" /> WhatsApp us
                </a>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>

      {/* related */}
      {data.related.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="pt-12 space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">More from {store.name}</h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6">
            {data.related.map((p) => (
              <ProductCard key={p.id} p={p} onOpen={(pp) => openProduct(ctx, pp)} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* cross-store cart replace confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={confirmSwitch} onOpenChange={setConfirmSwitch}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Start a new cart?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              Your current cart contains items from <span className="font-semibold">{cart?.storeName}</span>. Carts hold items from one
              store at a time — adding this item will replace it.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Keep my cart</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              className="bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800"
              onClick={async () => {
                setConfirmSwitch(false);
                await addToCart();
              }}
            >
              Replace cart
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

function PdpSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-6 flex-1">
      <Skeleton className="h-4 w-64 mb-6" />
      <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <Skeleton className="aspect-square rounded-2xl" />
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
              <Skeleton key={i} className="h-16 w-16 rounded-lg" />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Skeleton className="h-6 w-24" />
          <Skeleton className="h-9 w-3/4" />
          <Skeleton className="h-4 w-40" />
          <Skeleton className="h-10 w-48" />
          <Skeleton className="h-12 w-full" />
          <Skeleton className="h-12 w-full" />
          <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// ============================================================================
// ShopperShell — the SHOPPER surface root (Task 2-e).
// Internal view state machine (no URL routing), sticky market header, category
// menu, global cart drawer, footer, and mounting of every shopper view.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export default function ShopperShell() {
  const setSurface = useApp((s) => s.setSurface);
  const activeStoreSlug = useApp((s) => s.activeStoreSlug);
  const setActiveStoreSlug = useApp((s) => s.setActiveStoreSlug);

  const [view, setView] = useState<ShopperView>({ name: "market" });
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [cartOpen, setCartOpen] = useState(false);
  const [headerSearch, setHeaderSearch] = useState("");
  const restored = useRef(false);

  // ---- mount: activeStoreSlug override, else restore last view --------------
  useEffect(() => {
    if (restored.current) return;
    restored.current = true;
    if (activeStoreSlug) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
      setView({ name: "storefront", slug: activeStoreSlug });
      setActiveStoreSlug(null);
    } else {
      try {
        const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(VIEW_KEY);
        if (raw) {
          const v = JSON.parse(raw) as ShopperView;
          if (v && typeof v.name === "string") setView(v);
        }
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
    }
    setReady(true);
  }, [activeStoreSlug, setActiveStoreSlug]);

  // ---- nav helper: persist + scroll to top ----------------------------------
  const nav = useCallback((v: ShopperView) => {
    setView(v);
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(VIEW_KEY, JSON.stringify(v));
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "instant" as ScrollBehavior });
  }, []);

  // refresh storefront/store-page when slug changes externally
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) return;
    if (activeStoreSlug) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- intentional data-fetch reset
      setView({ name: "storefront", slug: activeStoreSlug });
      setActiveStoreSlug(null);
    }
  }, [activeStoreSlug, ready, setActiveStoreSlug]);

  const ctx = useMemo<ShopperCtx>(() => ({ nav, openCart: () => setCartOpen(true) }), [nav]);

  const showChrome = !isStoreChrome(view);

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-screen">
      <Toaster position="top-center" richColors />

      {showChrome ? (
        <MarketHeader
          view={view}
          nav={nav}
          openCart={() => setCartOpen(true)}
          search={headerSearch}
          setSearch={setHeaderSearch}
        />
      ) : null}

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        <motion.main
          key={`${view.name}:${"slug" in view ? view.slug : ""}:${"pSlug" in view ? view.pSlug : ""}:${"ref" in view ? view.ref : ""}:${view.name === "search" ? view.q : view.name === "category" ? view.categorySlug : view.name === "order-status" ? view.orderNumber : view.name === "store-page" ? view.pageSlug : ""}`}
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.18, ease: "easeOut" }}
          className="flex-1 flex flex-col"
        >
          {view.name === "market" ? <MarketHome ctx={ctx} /> : null}
          {view.name === "search" ? <ResultsView ctx={ctx} mode={{ kind: "search", q: view.q }} /> : null}
          {view.name === "category" ? (
            <ResultsView ctx={ctx} mode={{ kind: "category", categorySlug: view.categorySlug, label: view.label }} />
          ) : null}
          {view.name === "storefront" ? <StorefrontView ctx={ctx} slug={view.slug} /> : null}
          {view.name === "store-page" ? <StorePageView ctx={ctx} slug={view.slug} pageSlug={view.pageSlug} /> : null}
          {view.name === "pdp" ? <PdpView ctx={ctx} slug={view.slug} pSlug={view.pSlug} /> : null}
          {view.name === "checkout" ? <CheckoutView ctx={ctx} /> : null}
          {view.name === "pay" ? <PayView ctx={ctx} paymentRef={view.ref} /> : null}
          {view.name === "order-status" ? <OrderStatusView ctx={ctx} orderNumber={view.orderNumber} /> : null}
          {view.name === "lookup" ? <LookupView ctx={ctx} /> : null}
        </motion.main>
      </AnimatePresence>

      {showChrome ? (
        <ShopperFooter
          onSeller={() => setSurface("seller")}
          onLookup={() => nav({ name: "lookup" })}
          onMarket={() => nav({ name: "market" })}
        />
      ) : null}

      <CartDrawer open={cartOpen} onOpenChange={setCartOpen} ctx={ctx} />
    </div>
  );
}

// =============================================================================================
// Market header (global chrome for market/search/category/pdp/checkout/… views)
// =============================================================================================

function MarketHeader({
  view,
  nav,
  openCart,
  search,
  setSearch,
}: {
  view: ShopperView;
  nav: (v: ShopperView) => void;
  openCart: () => void;
  search: string;
  setSearch: (s: string) => void;
}) {
  const { count } = useCart();
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<CategoryT[] | null>(null);
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    fetchJson<{ categories: CategoryT[] }>("/api/market/home")
      .then((d) => alive && setCategories(d.categories ?? []))
      .catch(() => alive && setCategories([]));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  function submitSearch() {
    nav({ name: "search", q: search.trim() });
    setMobileOpen(false);
  }

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b bg-background/95 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/80">
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl items-center gap-2 sm:gap-4 px-4 py-3">
        {/* mobile menu */}
        <Sheet open={mobileOpen} onOpenChange={setMobileOpen}>
          <SheetTrigger asChild>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="md:hidden flex h-10 w-10 min-h-[44px] items-center justify-center rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
              aria-label="Open menu"
            >
              <Menu className="h-5 w-5" />
            </button>
          </SheetTrigger>
          <SheetContent side="left" className="w-80 p-0">
            <SheetHeader className="border-b p-4">
              <SheetTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-left">
                <ShoppingBag className="h-5 w-5 text-teal-700" /> SHOPMESH
              </SheetTitle>
            </SheetHeader>
            <div className="p-4 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-80px)]">
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
                <Input
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && submitSearch()}
                  placeholder="Search products…"
                  className="pl-8 min-h-[44px]"
                  aria-label="Search products"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Categories</p>
              <ul className="space-y-1">
                {(categories ?? []).flatMap((c) => [{ name: c.name, slug: c.slug, child: false }, ...c.children.map((ch) => ({ name: `↳ ${ch.name}`, slug: ch.slug, child: true }))]).map((c) => (
                  <li key={c.slug}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        nav({ name: "category", categorySlug: c.slug, label: c.name.replace("↳ ", "") });
                        setMobileOpen(false);
                      }}
                      className={cn(
                        "w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-sm font-medium hover:bg-muted transition-colors min-h-[44px]",
                        c.child && "text-muted-foreground pl-6"
                      )}
                    >
                      {c.name}
                    </button>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <Separator />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  nav({ name: "lookup" });
                  setMobileOpen(false);
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-muted min-h-[44px]"
              >
                <PackageSearch className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-700" /> Track my order
              </button>
            </div>
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>

        {/* logo */}
        <button type="button" onClick={() => nav({ name: "market" })} className="flex min-h-[44px] items-center gap-2" aria-label="SHOPMESH home">
          <span className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-teal-700 text-white shadow-sm">
            <ShoppingBag className="h-5 w-5" />
          </span>
          <span className="text-lg font-extrabold tracking-tight text-teal-900">

          </span>
        </button>

        {/* category dropdown (desktop) */}
        <DropdownMenu>
          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
            <button
              type="button"

              aria-label="Browse categories"
            >
              <Menu className="h-4 w-4" /> Categories <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuContent align="start" className="w-64 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto">
            {categories == null ? (

        <div className="relative ml-auto hidden flex-1 max-w-md md:block">
          <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input

            aria-label="Search the marketplace"

        <div className="ml-auto md:ml-0 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {/* track order */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => nav({ name: "lookup" })}

              >

      </div>
    </header>

}

// =============================================================================================
// Cart drawer (global)
// =============================================================================================

function CartDrawer({ open, onOpenChange, ctx }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; ctx: ShopperCtx }) {
  const { cart, count, subtotal, loading } = useCart();
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function setQty(itemId: string, qty: number) {
    setBusyId(itemId);
    try {
      if (qty <= 0) await deleteJson(`/api/cart/items/${itemId}`);
      else await patchJson(`/api/cart/items/${itemId}`, { qty });
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not update cart");
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent side="right" className="flex w-full sm:max-w-md flex-col p-0">
        <SheetHeader className="border-b p-4 space-y-0">
          <SheetTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
            <ShoppingCart className="h-5 w-5 text-teal-700" />
            Your cart
            {count > 0 ? <span className="text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground">({count} item{count === 1 ? "" : "s"})</span> : null}
          </SheetTitle>
          {cart?.storeName ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Items from <span className="font-semibold text-teal-700">{cart.storeName}</span> — one store per cart
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </SheetHeader>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        ) : !cart || cart.items.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center">
            <EmptyState
              icon={ShoppingCart}
              title="Your cart is empty"
              hint="Discover products across the marketplace and its stores."
              action={
                <Button
                  onClick={() => {
                    onOpenChange(false);
                    ctx.nav({ name: "market" });
                  }}
                  className="bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800"
                >
                  Browse marketplace
                </Button>
              }
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-3 max-h-[calc(100vh-230px)]">
              <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                {cart.items.map((it) => (
                  <motion.div
                    key={it.id}
                    layout
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 40 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
                    className={cn("flex gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-card p-3", busyId === it.id && "opacity-60")}
                  >
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        onOpenChange(false);
                        ctx.nav({ name: "pdp", slug: it.storeSlug, pSlug: it.productSlug });
                      }}
                      className="shrink-0"
                      aria-label={`View ${it.title}`}
                    >
                      <img src={it.imageUrl} alt={it.title} loading="lazy" className="h-20 w-20 rounded-lg border object-cover" />
                    </button>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1.5">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            onOpenChange(false);
                            ctx.nav({ name: "pdp", slug: it.storeSlug, pSlug: it.productSlug });
                          }}
                          className="text-left text-sm font-semibold leading-tight line-clamp-2 hover:text-teal-700"
                        >
                          {it.title}
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setQty(it.id, 0)}
                          className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-rose-600 transition-colors p-1"
                          aria-label={`Remove ${it.title}`}
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      {it.variantLabel && it.variantLabel !== "Default" ? (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{it.variantLabel}</p>
                      ) : null}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-0.5">
                        <QtyStepper
                          small
                          value={it.qty}
                          min={0}
                          max={Math.max(1, it.stock)}
                          onChange={(v) => setQty(it.id, v)}
                        />
                        <div className="text-right">
                          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-teal-700">{formatMinor(it.lineTotalMinor)}</p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{formatMinor(it.unitPriceMinor)} each</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </motion.div>
                ))}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>

            <div className="border-t bg-background p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Subtotal</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-extrabold text-teal-700">{formatMinor(subtotal)}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                {subtotal >= 10000
                  ? "You've unlocked FREE standard shipping!"
                  : `Add ${formatMinor(10000 - subtotal)} more for FREE standard shipping.`}
              </p>
              <Button
                size="lg"
                onClick={() => {
                  onOpenChange(false);
                  ctx.nav({ name: "checkout" });
                }}
                className="w-full min-h-[48px] bg-teal-700 text-white hover:bg-teal-800"
              >
                Checkout <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
