```
// ============================================================================
// M09 COMMISSION ENGINE — full spec implementation (PART 3 M09)
// Resolution priority: fee holiday > product override > category ancestor >
// seller override > global default. Money math in integer minor units.
// Commission snapshots are stored per order_item and NEVER recomputed.
// ============================================================================
import { db } from "./db";
import { commissionOf, allocateProportionally } from "./money";
import { toJson } from "./json";

export type CommissionSettingsDTO = {
  defaultPercent: number;
  appliesToShipping: boolean;
  basePriceRule: "paid_price" | "list_price";
  fixedFeeMinor: number;
  minCommissionMinor: number;
  payoutHoldDays: number;
  holdReleaseRule: "days_after_paid" | "days_after_delivered";
  graceDaysAfterDelivered: number;
};

export async function getCommissionSettings(): Promise<CommissionSettingsDTO> {
  const s = await db.commissionSetting.findUnique({ where: { id: 1 } });
  if (!s) {
    // auto-create singleton
    const created = await db.commissionSetting.create({ data: { id: 1 } });
    return created as unknown as CommissionSettingsDTO;
  }
  return s as unknown as CommissionSettingsDTO;
}

type RateResolution = {
  percent: number;
  source: "fee_holiday" | "product" | "category" | "seller" | "global";
  sourceId?: string;
  holidayId?: string;
  holdDays: number;
  fixedFeeMinor: number;
};

async function categoryAncestorChain(categoryId: string | null | undefined): Promise<string[]> {
  // returns [category, parent, grandparent, ...]
  const chain: string[] = [];
  let cur = categoryId ?? null;
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  while (cur && !seen.has(cur)) {
    seen.add(cur);
    chain.push(cur);
    const cat = await db.category.findUnique({ where: { id: cur }, select: { parentId: true } });
    cur = cat?.parentId ?? null;
  }
  return chain;
}

/** Resolve the effective commission rate for an item in context (M09 resolution). */
export async function resolveRate(ctx: {
  sellerId: string;
  categoryId?: string | null;
  productId?: string | null;
  now?: Date;
}): Promise<RateResolution> {
  const settings = await getCommissionSettings();
  const now = ctx.now ?? new Date();
  let fallback: RateResolution = {
    percent: settings.defaultPercent,
    source: "global",
    holdDays: settings.payoutHoldDays,
    fixedFeeMinor: settings.fixedFeeMinor,
  };

  // 0. seller-level hold override
  const seller = await db.seller.findUnique({
    where: { id: ctx.sellerId },
    select: { commissionOverridePercent: true, holdDaysOverride: true },
  });
  if (seller?.holdDaysOverride != null) fallback = { ...fallback, holdDays: seller.holdDaysOverride };

  // 1. active fee holiday covering (seller, category, now)
  const holidays = await db.feeHoliday.findMany({
    where: { isActive: true, startsAt: { lte: now }, endsAt: { gte: now } },
    orderBy: { startsAt: "asc" },
  });
  for (const h of holidays) {
    if (h.scope === "all") {
      return { ...fallback, percent: 0, source: "fee_holiday", holidayId: h.id };
    }
    const ids = JSON.parse(h.scopeIds || "[]") as string[];
    if (h.scope === "sellers" && ids.includes(ctx.sellerId)) {
      return { ...fallback, percent: 0, source: "fee_holiday", holidayId: h.id };
    }
    if (h.scope === "categories" && ctx.categoryId && ids.includes(ctx.categoryId)) {
      return { ...fallback, percent: 0, source: "fee_holiday", holidayId: h.id };
    }
  }

  // 2. product override
  if (ctx.productId) {
    const p = await db.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: ctx.productId },
      select: { commissionPercentOverride: true },
    });
    if (p?.commissionPercentOverride != null) {
      return { ...fallback, percent: p.commissionPercentOverride, source: "product", sourceId: ctx.productId };
    }
  }

  // 3. nearest category ancestor with commission_percent
  const chain = await categoryAncestorChain(ctx.categoryId);
  for (const catId of chain) {
    const cat = await db.category.findUnique({ where: { id: catId }, select: { commissionPercent: true } });
    if (cat?.commissionPercent != null) {
      return { ...fallback, percent: cat.commissionPercent, source: "category", sourceId: catId };
    }
  }

  // 4. seller override
  if (seller?.commissionOverridePercent != null) {
    return { ...fallback, percent: seller.commissionOverridePercent, source: "seller", sourceId: ctx.sellerId };
  }

  // 5. global default
  return fallback;
}

export type CommissionItemInput = {
  productId?: string | null;
  categoryId?: string | null;
  variantLabel?: string | null;
  title: string;
  unitPriceMinor: number;
  qty: number;
  /** list subtotal = unitPrice * qty (before discount) */
};

export type CommissionItemResult = {
  title: string;
  variantLabel?: string | null;
  unitPriceMinor: number;
  qty: number;
  lineSubtotalMinor: number;
  discountMinor: number;
  shippingMinor: number;
  baseMinor: number;
  percent: number;
  percentPartMinor: number;
  fixedFeeMinor: number;
  commissionMinor: number;
  sellerNetMinor: number;
  breakdown: {
    rule_source: string;
    source_id?: string;
    holiday_id?: string;
    percent: number;
    base: number;
    percent_part: number;
    fixed_fee_allocated: number;
    discount_allocated: number;
    shipping_allocated: number;
    flags: string[];
  };
};

export type CommissionOrderResult = {
  items: CommissionItemResult[];
  orderCommissionMinor: number;
  orderSellerNetMinor: number;
  holdDays: number;
  holdReleaseRule: string;
};

/**
 * Compute per-item commission snapshots for an order (M09 BASE + MATH).
 * - orderDiscount allocated proportionally to line subtotals (remainder to highest-value line)
 * - shipping allocated proportionally (or 0 if not applicable per line config)
 * - commission = round_half_up(base * percent/100) + allocated fixed fee
 * - min_commission_minor floored per ORDER (skipped on fee holidays, flagged)
 */
export async function computeOrderCommissions(input: {
  sellerId: string;
  items: CommissionItemInput[];
  orderDiscountMinor: number;
  shippingMinorTotal: number;
  appliesShippingToItem?: boolean; // whether shipping counts toward commission base
  currency?: string;
  now?: Date;
}): Promise<CommissionOrderResult> {
  const settings = await getCommissionSettings();
  const now = input.now ?? new Date();

  const subtotals = input.items.map((it) => it.unitPriceMinor * it.qty);
  const discounts = allocateProportionally(Math.max(0, input.orderDiscountMinor), subtotals);
  const shippingAlloc = allocateProportionally(Math.max(0, input.shippingMinorTotal), subtotals);

  // resolve rate per item (cache by productId/categoryId pair)
  const rates: RateResolution[] = [];
  for (const it of input.items) {
    const r = await resolveRate({
      sellerId: input.sellerId,
      categoryId: it.categoryId ?? null,
      productId: it.productId ?? null,
      now,
    });
    rates.push(r);
  }

  const perOrderFixed = settings.fixedFeeMinor;
  const fixedAlloc = allocateProportionally(perOrderFixed, subtotals);

  const results: CommissionItemResult[] = input.items.map((it, i) => {
    const lineSubtotal = subtotals[i];
    const rate = rates[i];
    const baseRuleList = settings.basePriceRule === "list_price";
    let base = baseRuleList ? lineSubtotal : lineSubtotal - discounts[i];
    if (settings.appliesToShipping) base += shippingAlloc[i];
    const percentPart = commissionOf(base, rate.percent);
    const commission = percentPart + fixedAlloc[i];
    const sellerNet = base + shippingAlloc[i] - commission;
    return {
      title: it.title,
      variantLabel: it.variantLabel ?? null,
      unitPriceMinor: it.unitPriceMinor,
      qty: it.qty,
      lineSubtotalMinor: lineSubtotal,
      discountMinor: discounts[i],
      shippingMinor: shippingAlloc[i],
      baseMinor: base,
      percent: rate.percent,
      percentPartMinor: percentPart,
      fixedFeeMinor: fixedAlloc[i],
      commissionMinor: commission,
      sellerNetMinor: sellerNet,
      breakdown: {
        rule_source: rate.source,
        source_id: rate.sourceId,
        holiday_id: rate.holidayId,
        percent: rate.percent,
        base,
        percent_part: percentPart,
        fixed_fee_allocated: fixedAlloc[i],
        discount_allocated: discounts[i],
        shipping_allocated: shippingAlloc[i],
        flags: [] as string[],
      },
    };
  });

  // min commission floor — per ORDER, skipped when any item ran on a fee holiday
  const onHoliday = rates.some((r) => r.source === "fee_holiday");
  const totalPercentPart = results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.percentPartMinor, 0);
  if (!onHoliday && settings.minCommissionMinor > 0 && totalPercentPart < settings.minCommissionMinor && input.items.length > 0) {
    const bump = settings.minCommissionMinor - totalPercentPart;
    // remainder to highest-value line
    let maxIdx = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < results.length; i++) {
      if (results[i].lineSubtotalMinor > results[maxIdx].lineSubtotalMinor) maxIdx = i;
    }
    results[maxIdx].percentPartMinor += bump;
    results[maxIdx].commissionMinor += bump;
    results[maxIdx].sellerNetMinor -= bump;
    results[maxIdx].breakdown.flags.push("min_commission_floor");
  }

  const holdDays = rates[0]?.holdDays ?? settings.payoutHoldDays;
  const orderCommission = results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.commissionMinor, 0);
  const orderSellerNet = results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.sellerNetMinor, 0);

  return { items: results, orderCommissionMinor: orderCommission, orderSellerNetMinor: orderSellerNet, holdDays, holdReleaseRule: settings.holdReleaseRule };
}

/** Admin simulator (FIN-04): pure computation, no persistence. */
export async function simulateCommission(input: {
  priceMinor: number;
  qty: number;
  discountMinor: number;
  shippingMinor: number;
  categoryId?: string | null;
  sellerId?: string | null;
  productId?: string | null;
}) {
  const result = await computeOrderCommissions({
    sellerId: input.sellerId ?? "simulated",
    items: [
      {
        title: "Simulation item",
        unitPriceMinor: input.priceMinor,
        qty: input.qty || 1,
        categoryId: input.categoryId ?? null,
        productId: input.productId ?? null,
      },
    ],
    orderDiscountMinor: input.discountMinor || 0,
    shippingMinorTotal: input.shippingMinor || 0,
  });
  return {
    commissionMinor: result.orderCommissionMinor,
    sellerNetMinor: result.orderSellerNetMinor,
    holdDays: result.holdDays,
    trace: result.items[0].breakdown,
  };
}

/** Persist snapshots onto order items (called by checkout, never recomputed). */
export function snapshotToJson(r: CommissionItemResult): string {
  return toJson(r.breakdown);
}
```

```
// JSON helpers — SQLite stores JSON in TEXT columns.
export function parseJson<T>(raw: string | null | undefined, fallback: T): T {
  if (raw == null || raw === "") return fallback;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export function toJson(value: unknown): string {
  return JSON.stringify(value ?? null);
}
```

```
// ============================================================================
// M10 WALLETS, LEDGER & PAYOUTS — double-entry engine (PART 3 M10)
// SIGN CONVENTION: seller wallet balance = SUM(credit) - SUM(debit) on
// SELLER:{walletId}:PAYABLE. Credits with available_at > now = pending.
// Every transaction MUST balance: sum(debit) == sum(credit).
// ============================================================================
import { db } from "./db";
import { parseJson, toJson } from "./json";

export const ACCOUNTS = {
  BANK_MAIN: "PLATFORM:BANK_MAIN",
  payoutClearing: () => "PLATFORM:PAYOUT_CLEARING",
  revenueCommission: () => "PLATFORM:REVENUE_COMMISSION",
  revenueAdjust: () => "PLATFORM:REVENUE_ADJUST",
  gateway: (provider: string) => `GATEWAY:${provider.toUpperCase()}`,
  sellerPayable: (walletId: string) => `SELLER:${walletId}:PAYABLE`,
};

export const ACCOUNT_META: Record<string, { name: string; type: "asset" | "liability" | "revenue" | "expense" }> = {
  "PLATFORM:BANK_MAIN": { name: "Platform Main Bank Account", type: "asset" },
  "PLATFORM:PAYOUT_CLEARING": { name: "Payout Clearing", type: "liability" },
  "PLATFORM:REVENUE_COMMISSION": { name: "Commission Revenue", type: "revenue" },
  "PLATFORM:REVENUE_ADJUST": { name: "Manual Adjustments Revenue", type: "revenue" },
};

export async function ensureAccount(code: string, walletId?: string | null) {
  const meta = ACCOUNT_META[code] ?? {
    name: code.startsWith("GATEWAY:") ? `Gateway ${code.slice(8)}` : code.startsWith("SELLER:") ? "Seller Payable" : code,
    type: code.startsWith("SELLER:") ? "liability" : code.startsWith("GATEWAY:") ? "asset" : "asset",
  };
  await db.ledgerAccount.upsert({
    where: { code },
    create: { code, name: meta.name, type: meta.type, walletId: walletId ?? null },
    update: {},
  });
}

export async function ensureWalletAccounts(walletId: string) {
  await ensureAccount(ACCOUNTS.sellerPayable(walletId), walletId);
}

export type LedgerLineInput = {
  accountCode: string;
  direction: "debit" | "credit";
  amountMinor: number;
  walletId?: string | null;
  availableAt?: Date | null;
  memo?: string | null;
};

/** Post a balanced double-entry transaction. Throws if unbalanced. */
export async function postTransaction(input: {
  txnType: string;
  refType?: string | null;
  refId?: string | null;
  description?: string | null;
  currency?: string;
  lines: LedgerLineInput[];
  occurredAt?: Date;
}) {
  const debit = input.lines.filter((l) => l.direction === "debit").reduce((s, l) => s + l.amountMinor, 0);
  const credit = input.lines.filter((l) => l.direction === "credit").reduce((s, l) => s + l.amountMinor, 0);
  if (debit !== credit || debit === 0) {
    throw new Error(`LEDGER_UNBALANCED debit=${debit} credit=${credit} txn=${input.txnType}`);
  }
  for (const l of input.lines) await ensureAccount(l.accountCode, l.walletId ?? null);
  return db.ledgerTransaction.create({
    data: {
      txnType: input.txnType,
      refType: input.refType ?? null,
      refId: input.refId ?? null,
      description: input.description ?? null,
      occurredAt: input.occurredAt ?? new Date(),
      lines: {
        create: input.lines.map((l) => ({
          accountCode: l.accountCode,
          direction: l.direction,
          amountMinor: l.amountMinor,
          walletId: l.walletId ?? null,
          availableAt: l.availableAt ?? null,
          memo: l.memo ?? null,
        })),
      },
    },
    include: { lines: true },
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------- WALLET TRUTH

export type WalletTruth = {
  pendingMinor: number;
  availableMinor: number;
  lifetimeEarnedMinor: number;
  lifetimeCommissionMinor: number;
};

/** Compute wallet balances from ledger lines (the source of truth). */
export async function walletTruth(walletId: string): Promise<WalletTruth> {
  const payable = ACCOUNTS.sellerPayable(walletId);
  const lines = await db.ledgerLine.findMany({
    where: { accountCode: payable },
    select: { direction: true, amountMinor: true, availableAt: true },
  });
  const now = new Date();
  let totalCredits = 0, maturedCredits = 0, totalDebits = 0, lifetimeCommission = 0;
  for (const l of lines) {
    if (l.direction === "credit") {
      totalCredits += l.amountMinor;
      if (!l.availableAt || l.availableAt <= now) maturedCredits += l.amountMinor;
    } else {
      totalDebits += l.amountMinor;
    }
  }
  // lifetime commission from revenue account lines tagged with this wallet? simpler: from txns T1 memo — use commission revenue lines with walletId
  const commissionLines = await db.ledgerLine.findMany({
    where: { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.revenueCommission(), walletId, direction: "credit" },
    select: { amountMinor: true },
  });
  lifetimeCommission = commissionLines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.amountMinor, 0);
  return {
    pendingMinor: totalCredits - maturedCredits,
    availableMinor: maturedCredits - totalDebits,
    lifetimeEarnedMinor: totalCredits - lifetimeCommission,
    lifetimeCommissionMinor: lifetimeCommission,
  };
}

/** Refresh cached wallet columns from ledger truth (nightly invariant in prod; on-write here). */
export async function refreshWalletCache(walletId: string) {
  const truth = await walletTruth(walletId);
  await db.wallet.update({
    where: { id: walletId },
    data: {
      pendingMinor: truth.pendingMinor,
      availableMinor: truth.availableMinor,
      lifetimeEarnedMinor: truth.lifetimeEarnedMinor,
      lifetimeCommissionMinor: truth.lifetimeCommissionMinor,
    },
  });
  return truth;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------- JOURNAL RECIPES

/** T1 — order paid: DR GATEWAY:{p} total | CR SELLER:PAYABLE (available_at=paid+hold) | CR COMMISSION */
export async function postOrderPaid(input: {
  orderId: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  walletId: string;
  provider: string;
  totalMinor: number;
  sellerNetMinor: number;
  commissionMinor: number;
  holdUntil: Date;
  currency?: string;
  occurredAt?: Date;
}) {
  const t = await postTransaction({
    txnType: "order_paid",
    refType: "order",
    refId: input.orderId,
    description: `Order ${input.orderNumber} paid via ${input.provider}`,
    lines: [
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.gateway(input.provider), direction: "debit", amountMinor: input.totalMinor, memo: `Order ${input.orderNumber}` },
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.sellerPayable(input.walletId), direction: "credit", amountMinor: input.sellerNetMinor, walletId: input.walletId, availableAt: input.holdUntil, memo: `Seller net for ${input.orderNumber}` },
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.revenueCommission(), direction: "credit", amountMinor: input.commissionMinor, walletId: input.walletId, memo: `Commission for ${input.orderNumber}` },
    ],
    occurredAt: input.occurredAt,
  });
  await refreshWalletCache(input.walletId);
  return t;
}

/** T2 — gateway settlement: DR BANK_MAIN | CR GATEWAY:{p} */
export async function postGatewaySettlement(input: { provider: string; amountMinor: number; ref: string; occurredAt?: Date }) {
  return postTransaction({
    txnType: "gateway_settlement",
    refType: "settlement",
    refId: input.ref,
    description: `Settlement ${input.ref} via ${input.provider}`,
    lines: [
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.BANK_MAIN, direction: "debit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, memo: input.ref },
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.gateway(input.provider), direction: "credit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, memo: input.ref },
    ],
    occurredAt: input.occurredAt,
  });
}

/** T3 — payout initiated: DR SELLER:PAYABLE | CR PAYOUT_CLEARING */
export async function postPayoutInitiated(input: { walletId: string; payoutId: string; referenceNo: string; amountMinor: number }) {
  const t = await postTransaction({
    txnType: "payout_initiated",
    refType: "payout",
    refId: input.payoutId,
    description: `Payout ${input.referenceNo} initiated`,
    lines: [
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.sellerPayable(input.walletId), direction: "debit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, walletId: input.walletId, memo: input.referenceNo },
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.payoutClearing(), direction: "credit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, memo: input.referenceNo },
    ],
  });
  await refreshWalletCache(input.walletId);
  return t;
}

/** T4 — payout confirmed: DR PAYOUT_CLEARING | CR BANK_MAIN */
export async function postPayoutConfirmed(input: { walletId: string; payoutId: string; referenceNo: string; amountMinor: number }) {
  const t = await postTransaction({
    txnType: "payout_confirmed",
    refType: "payout",
    refId: input.payoutId,
    description: `Payout ${input.referenceNo} confirmed paid`,
    lines: [
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.payoutClearing(), direction: "debit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, memo: input.referenceNo },
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.BANK_MAIN, direction: "credit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, memo: input.referenceNo },
    ],
  });
  await refreshWalletCache(input.walletId);
  return t;
}

/** T4f — payout failed: reverse T3 → DR PAYOUT_CLEARING | CR SELLER:PAYABLE */
export async function postPayoutFailed(input: { walletId: string; payoutId: string; referenceNo: string; amountMinor: number; reason: string }) {
  const t = await postTransaction({
    txnType: "payout_failed",
    refType: "payout",
    refId: input.payoutId,
    description: `Payout ${input.referenceNo} failed: ${input.reason}`,
    lines: [
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.payoutClearing(), direction: "debit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, memo: input.referenceNo },
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.sellerPayable(input.walletId), direction: "credit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, walletId: input.walletId, availableAt: new Date(), memo: `Reversal: ${input.reason}` },
    ],
  });
  await refreshWalletCache(input.walletId);
  return t;
}

/** T5 — refund: DR SELLER:PAYABLE (seller share) + DR COMMISSION (reversal) | CR GATEWAY:{p} */
export async function postRefund(input: {
  orderId: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  walletId: string;
  provider: string;
  amountMinor: number;
  commissionReversalMinor: number;
}) {
  const sellerShare = input.amountMinor - input.commissionReversalMinor;
  const t = await postTransaction({
    txnType: "refund",
    refType: "order",
    refId: input.orderId,
    description: `Refund for ${input.orderNumber}`,
    lines: [
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.sellerPayable(input.walletId), direction: "debit", amountMinor: sellerShare, walletId: input.walletId, memo: `Refund seller share ${input.orderNumber}` },
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.revenueCommission(), direction: "debit", amountMinor: input.commissionReversalMinor, walletId: input.walletId, memo: `Commission reversal ${input.orderNumber}` },
      { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.gateway(input.provider), direction: "credit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, memo: `Refund ${input.orderNumber}` },
    ],
  });
  await refreshWalletCache(input.walletId);
  return t;
}

/** T6 — admin adjustment: DR/CR SELLER:PAYABLE vs PLATFORM:REVENUE_ADJUST */
export async function postAdminAdjustment(input: {
  walletId: string;
  direction: "credit" | "debit"; // credit = add to seller balance
  amountMinor: number;
  reason: string;
  adminEmail: string;
}) {
  const payable = ACCOUNTS.sellerPayable(input.walletId);
  const lines: LedgerLineInput[] =
    input.direction === "credit"
      ? [
          { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.revenueAdjust(), direction: "debit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, memo: input.reason },
          { accountCode: payable, direction: "credit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, walletId: input.walletId, availableAt: new Date(), memo: input.reason },
        ]
      : [
          { accountCode: payable, direction: "debit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, walletId: input.walletId, memo: input.reason },
          { accountCode: ACCOUNTS.revenueAdjust(), direction: "credit", amountMinor: input.amountMinor, memo: input.reason },
        ];
  const t = await postTransaction({
    txnType: "admin_adjustment",
    refType: "wallet",
    refId: input.walletId,
    description: `Manual adjustment by ${input.adminEmail}: ${input.reason}`,
    lines,
  });
  await refreshWalletCache(input.walletId);
  return t;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------- INVARIANTS

/** Nightly invariant (ICCO): every txn balanced; wallet cache == ledger truth. */
export async function runLedgerInvariants() {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const txns = await db.ledgerTransaction.findMany({ include: { lines: true } });
  for (const t of txns) {
    const debit = t.lines.filter((l) => l.direction === "debit").reduce((s, l) => s + l.amountMinor, 0);
    const credit = t.lines.filter((l) => l.direction === "credit").reduce((s, l) => s + l.amountMinor, 0);
    if (debit !== credit) problems.push(`txn ${t.id} (${t.txnType}) unbalanced: D${debit} C${credit}`);
  }
  const wallets = await db.wallet.findMany();
  for (const w of wallets) {
    const truth = await walletTruth(w.id);
    if (truth.availableMinor !== w.availableMinor || truth.pendingMinor !== w.pendingMinor) {
      problems.push(`wallet ${w.id} cache drift: available cache=${w.availableMinor} truth=${truth.availableMinor}, pending cache=${w.pendingMinor} truth=${truth.pendingMinor}`);
    }
  }
  // clearing + gateway accounts must net to zero-ish (settlements outstand-ing)
  return { ok: problems.length === 0, problems, txnCount: txns.length, walletCount: wallets.length };
}

/** Payout statement snapshot builder (sales, commission, refunds, adjustments since last payout). */
export function buildPayoutStatement(params: {
  sellerName: string;
  periodFrom: Date;
  periodTo: Date;
  salesMinor: number;
  commissionMinor: number;
  refundsMinor: number;
  adjustmentsMinor: number;
  negativeCarryMinor: number;
  orderCount: number;
}) {
  return toJson({
    ...params,
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    lines: [
      { label: "Sales (settled to available)", amountMinor: params.salesMinor },
      { label: "Platform commission", amountMinor: -params.commissionMinor },
      { label: "Refunds", amountMinor: -params.refundsMinor },
      { label: "Adjustments", amountMinor: params.adjustmentsMinor },
      { label: "Negative carry-forward", amountMinor: params.negativeCarryMinor },
    ],
  });
}

export function parseStatement(json: string) {
  return parseJson(json, { sellerName: "", periodFrom: "", periodTo: "", lines: [] as { label: string; amountMinor: number }[] });
}
```

```
// Money helpers — all amounts are integer minor units (cents). NEVER floats.
// Currency default: MYR (platform launches local-first, Asia/Kuala_Lumpur).

const SYMBOLS: Record<string, string> = { MYR: "RM", SGD: "S$", IDR: "Rp" };

/** Format minor units into a display string, e.g. 123456 -> "RM 1,234.56" */
export function formatMinor(minor: number | null | undefined, currency = "MYR"): string {
  const value = (minor ?? 0) / 100;
  const sym = SYMBOLS[currency] ?? currency + " ";
  const negative = value < 0;
  const abs = Math.abs(value);
  const formatted = abs.toLocaleString("en-MY", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
  return `${negative ? "-" : ""}${sym} ${formatted}`;
}

/** Parse a user-entered decimal amount string into minor units. "12.50" -> 1250 */
export function toMinor(input: string | number): number {
  const n = typeof input === "number" ? input : parseFloat(String(input) || "0");
  if (Number.isNaN(n)) return 0;
  return Math.round(n * 100);
}

/** Half-up division of positive integers: divHalfUp(250,100)=3? no -> 2.5 rounds to 3. Wait:
 * divHalfUp(250,100) = floor((500+100)/200)=3 → 250/100=2.5 → 3 (half-up). Correct. */
export function divHalfUp(a: number, b: number): number {
  if (b === 0) return 0;
  if (a >= 0) return Math.floor((a * 2 + b) / (b * 2));
  return -Math.floor((-a * 2 + b) / (b * 2));
}

/** commission = round_half_up(base * percent / 100) — M09 math. */
export function commissionOf(base: number, percent: number): number {
  return divHalfUp(Math.round(base * percent * 100), 10000);
}

/** Allocate `amount` across `weights` proportionally, remainder cents to largest weights. */
export function allocateProportionally(amount: number, weights: number[]): number[] {
  const total = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0);
  if (total <= 0 || amount === 0) return weights.map(() => 0);
  const parts = weights.map((w) => Math.floor((amount * w) / total));
  let remainder = amount - parts.reduce((s, p) => s + p, 0);
  const order = weights
    .map((w, i) => ({ i, w: w }))
    .sort((x, y) => y.w - x.w || x.i - y.i);
  let idx = 0;
  while (remainder > 0 && order.length > 0) {
    parts[order[idx % order.length].i] += 1;
    remainder -= 1;
    idx += 1;
  }
  return parts;
}
```

```
// Password hashing (scrypt) — kept separate from auth.ts so seeds/scripts can import it.
import { randomBytes, scryptSync, timingSafeEqual, createHmac } from "crypto";

export function hashPassword(password: string): string {
  const salt = randomBytes(16).toString("hex");
  const hash = scryptSync(password, salt, 64).toString("hex");
  return `s1:${salt}:${hash}`;
}

export function verifyPassword(password: string, stored: string): boolean {
  try {
    const [version, salt, hash] = stored.split(":");
    if (version !== "s1" || !salt || !hash) return false;
    const candidate = scryptSync(password, salt, 64);
    const expected = Buffer.from(hash, "hex");
    return candidate.length === expected.length && timingSafeEqual(candidate, expected);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function randomToken(bytes = 24): string {
  return randomBytes(bytes).toString("hex");
}

export function hmacSha256Hex(secret: string, payload: string): string {
  return createHmac("sha256", secret).update(payload).digest("hex");
}
```

```
export function sectionDef(type: string): SectionDef | undefined {
  return SECTION_REGISTRY.find((s) => s.type === type);
}

export function newSectionId(): string {
  return `sec_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}

export function createSection(type: string): Section | null {
  const def = sectionDef(type);
  if (!def) return null;
  return { id: newSectionId(), type, props: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(def.defaultProps)) };
}

export function parsePageDoc(json: string | null | undefined): PageDoc {
  if (!json) return { sections: [], version: 0 };
  try {
    const doc = JSON.parse(json) as PageDoc;
    return { sections: Array.isArray(doc.sections) ? doc.sections : [], version: doc.version ?? 0 };
  } catch {
    return { sections: [], version: 0 };
  }
}

export function parseTheme(json: string | null | undefined): ThemeTokens {
  const t = json ? (JSON.parse(json) as Partial<ThemeTokens>) : {};
  return { ...DEFAULT_THEME, ...t };
}

/** Default home page template (fired <60s after signup per PART 1 §1.5). */
export function defaultHomeSections(storeName: string, tagline: string): Section[] {
  const mk = (type: string, overrides: SectionProps = {}): Section => {
    const base = createSection(type)!;
    return { ...base, props: { ...base.props, ...overrides } };
  };
  return [
    mk("announcement_bar", { text: `Welcome to ${storeName} — free shipping above RM 100` }),
    mk("header"),
    mk("hero", { heading: storeName, subheading: tagline || "Curated goods, shipped with care." }),
    mk("product_grid", { title: "Fresh arrivals", source: "latest", limit: 8, columns: 4 }),
    mk("image_with_text"),
    mk("testimonials"),
    mk("newsletter"),
    mk("footer"),
  ];
}

export function defaultPageSections(pageType: string, storeName: string): Section[] {
  const mk = (type: string, overrides: SectionProps = {}): Section => {
    const base = createSection(type)!;
    return { ...base, props: { ...base.props, ...overrides } };
  };
  switch (pageType) {
    case "home":
      return defaultHomeSections(storeName, "");
    case "about":
      return [
        mk("announcement_bar", { text: `Welcome to ${storeName}` }),
        mk("header"),
        mk("rich_text", { heading: `About ${storeName}` }),
        mk("footer"),
      ];
    case "contact":
      return [
        mk("announcement_bar", { text: `Get in touch with ${storeName}` }),
        mk("header"),
        mk("rich_text", { heading: "Contact us", body: "We usually reply within one business day." }),
        mk("whatsapp_floating"),
        mk("footer"),
      ];
    default:
      return [mk("announcement_bar"), mk("header"), mk("rich_text", { heading: pageType }), mk("footer")];
  }
}
```

```
"use client";
// SHOPMESH single-route app shell — portal switcher across the three surfaces:
// Shopper (marketplace + storefronts), Seller (dashboard), Admin (command centre).
// In production these live on separate hosts (market/shopmesh.io, seller.shopmesh.io,
// admin.shopmesh.io); in this sandbox they are surfaces on one route.
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useApp } from "@/lib/app-store";
import ShopperShell from "@/components/shopper/shopper-shell";
import SellerShell from "@/components/seller/seller-shell";
import AdminShell from "@/components/admin/admin-shell";
import { Store, ShoppingBag, ShieldCheck, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const SURFACES: { key: "shopper" | "seller" | "admin"; label: string; icon: typeof Store }[] = [
  { key: "shopper", label: "Market", icon: ShoppingBag },
  { key: "seller", label: "Seller", icon: Store },
  { key: "admin", label: "Admin", icon: ShieldCheck },
];

export default function AppRoot() {
  const surface = useApp((s) => s.surface);
  const setSurface = useApp((s) => s.setSurface);
  const refreshMe = useApp((s) => s.refreshMe);
  const hydrateSurface = useApp((s) => s.hydrateSurface);
  const me = useApp((s) => s.me);

  useEffect(() => {
    hydrateSurface();
    refreshMe();
  }, [hydrateSurface, refreshMe]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-background">
      {/* portal switcher (demo chrome) */}
      <div className="fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[90] print:hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border bg-background/95 shadow-lg backdrop-blur px-1.5 py-1.5">
          <span className="pl-2 pr-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground hidden sm:block">
            Portal
          </span>
          {SURFACES.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => (
            <button
              key={key}
              onClick={() => setSurface(key)}
              aria-label={`Switch to ${label} portal`}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors min-h-[32px]",
                surface === key ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow" : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted"
              )}
            >
              <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              {label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {!me.loaded ? (
        <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 text-muted-foreground">
            <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin" />
            <p className="text-sm">Loading SHOPMESH…</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : surface === "shopper" ? (
        <ShopperShell />
      ) : surface === "seller" ? (
        <SellerShell />
      ) : (
        <AdminShell />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
    darkMode: "class",

    "./pages/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,mdx}",

    "./app/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,mdx}",
  ],
  theme: {
  	extend: {
  		colors: {
  			background: 'hsl(var(--background))',
  			foreground: 'hsl(var(--foreground))',
  			card: {
  				DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--card))',
  				foreground: 'hsl(var(--card-foreground))'
  			},
  			popover: {
  				DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--popover))',
  				foreground: 'hsl(var(--popover-foreground))'
  			},
  			primary: {
  				DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--primary))',
  				foreground: 'hsl(var(--primary-foreground))'
  			},
  			secondary: {
  				DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--secondary))',
  				foreground: 'hsl(var(--secondary-foreground))'
  			},
  			muted: {
  				DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--muted))',
  				foreground: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))'
  			},
  			accent: {
  				DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--accent))',
  				foreground: 'hsl(var(--accent-foreground))'
  			},
  			destructive: {
  				DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--destructive))',
  				foreground: 'hsl(var(--destructive-foreground))'
  			},
  			border: 'hsl(var(--border))',
  			input: 'hsl(var(--input))',
  			ring: 'hsl(var(--ring))',
  			chart: {
  				'1': 'hsl(var(--chart-1))',
  				'2': 'hsl(var(--chart-2))',
  				'3': 'hsl(var(--chart-3))',
  				'4': 'hsl(var(--chart-4))',
  				'5': 'hsl(var(--chart-5))'
  			}
  		},
  		borderRadius: {
  			lg: 'var(--radius)',
  			md: 'calc(var(--radius) - 2px)',
  			sm: 'calc(var(--radius) - 4px)'
  		}
  	}
  },
  plugins: [tailwindcssAnimate],
};
export default config;
```

## FILE: Caddyfile
```
:81 {
	@transform_port_query {
		query XTransformPort=*
	}

	handle @transform_port_query {
		reverse_proxy localhost:{query.XTransformPort} {
			header_up Host {host}
			header_up X-Forwarded-For {remote_host}
			header_up X-Forwarded-Proto {scheme}
			header_up X-Real-IP {remote_host}
		}
	}

	handle {
		reverse_proxy localhost:3000 {
			header_up Host {host}
			header_up X-Forwarded-For {remote_host}
			header_up X-Forwarded-Proto {scheme}
			header_up X-Real-IP {remote_host}
		}
	}
}
```
